tgt: USekelamongameli uRamaphosa uzohola ithimba likahulumeni ekuxoxisaneni nalo okujwayelekile nenhlangano yabacosheli bezindaba okuyi-South African National Editors’ Forum mhla zingama-21 kuLwezi 2015 njengengxenye yokuzibophezela kukahulumeni kanye nohlelo oluqhubekayo lokuqinisa ubudlelwano nezikhungo ezisakaza izindaba.

src: Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etelela pele kemedi ya puso mo puisanong ya yona ya ka gale le Foramo ya Bosetšhaba ya Batseleganyi ya Aforika Borwa ka la bo 21 Ngwanaitseele 2015 jaaka karolo ya maitlamo a puso le lenaane le le tswelelang pele go maatlafatsa dikamano le bobegakgang.
tgt: UHulumeni uzobeka esithombeni abahleli bezindaba ngezindaba ezibalulekile kanye nangezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezizayo kanti futhi abahleli bazonikwa ithuba lokuthi baveze ilaka labo kuhulumeni.

src: Puso e tla bua le batseleganyi ka dintlha tsa botlhokwa mmogo le maano a a tlang mme e tla naya batseleganyi tšhono ya go tlhagisa dintlha tse ba nang le kgatlhego mo go tsona mo pusong.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izogubha Usuku Lomhlaba Wonke Lwengculaza ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi - “Siphokophelele Kwisizukulwane Esingenayo i-HIV: SUKUMYENZVIKELLUTHO – kanti lokhu kuyinhlabamkhosi ethi imiphakathi makube khona ekwenzayo ukulwa nalolu bhubhane.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla tshwaya Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS ka moono wa - "Go leba kwa Ditshikeng tse di senang HIV: EMTSAYA KGATSIRELETSLEFELA - e leng pitso ya gore baagi ba tseye dikgato.
tgt: Le ngqikithi yakulo nyaka isuselwe kwingqikithi Yenhlangano Yeziwe Yosuku Lomhlaba Wonke Lwengculazi yangeminyaka esukela kwizi-2011 kuya kwizi-2015 ethi: “Ukufinyelela Lapho Kungasekho Muntu Othelelekile”.

src: Moono wa monongwaga o ikaegile ka moono wa Ditšhabakopano wa Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS wa 2011 go fitlha 2015 wa: "Go fitlhelela Lefela".
tgt: Usuku Lwengculaza Lomhlaba wonke luzophinda luqinise inkulumompendulwano mayelana nokukhishwa inyumbazane kanye nokucwaswa, futhi luzophinda luvukuze imiphakathi ukuthi ukwazi ukubhekana nokuvikela, ukwelapha kanye nezinsizakalo zokweseka lapho abanaleli gciwane.

src: Tiragalo e kgolo ya go keteka Letsatsi la Lefatshe la AIDS e tla tshwarwa kwa KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: Umcimbi omkhulu wokugubha Usuku Lomhlaba Lwengculaza uyobanjelwa KwaZulu-Natali.

src: Seno se tla tlhagola tsela ya fa Aforika Borwa e tla bo e amogela Khonferense ya bo 21 ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya AIDS kwa Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre kwa Durban go tloga ka la bo 17 go fitlha ka la bo 22 Phukwi 2016.
tgt: Kanti yiwona kanye-ke lo mcimbi ozoba yisendlalelo sengqungquthela yengculaza okuyi-21st International AIDS Conference ezobanjelwa kuleli eNkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre e-Durbankusukela mhla ziyi-17 kuya mhla zingama-22 kuNtulikazi 2016.

src: Aforika Borwa e tswelela go nna le tswelelopele mo ntweng kgatlhanong le HIV le AIDS jaaka e atolositse lenaaneo la kalafi ya HIV la naga, moo batho ba ba fetang dimilione di le tharo ba leng mo kalafing ya antiretroviral, mme gape go fokoditswe tshwaetso ya go tswa go mme go ya go ngwana le go bona matshwao a a tokafetseng a bolwetse jwa lehuba.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iyaqhubeka nokubonisa inqubekelaphambili ekulweni ne-HIV kanye ne-AIDS, ngoba isikwaze ukwelula uhlelo lwayo lokuhlinzeka ngemishanguzo, sikhuluma nje kunabantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezintathu abadla imishanguzo, kanti isikwaze futhi nokunciphisa ukusuleleka komntwana ngegciwane elithola kumama omzalayo kanti futhi nezibalo zibonisa ukuthi leli lizwe lenza kahle kangcono ekulweni nesifo sofuba.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa maAforika Borwa go nna le seabe mo ditiragalong tsa Imbizo tse di rulaganyeditsweng go tla tshwarwa go ralala naga mo Bekeng ya Bosetšhaba e e totileng Imbizo go tloga ka la bo 30 Ngwanaitseele go fitlha ka la bo 6 Sedimonthole 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi bahambele Izimbizo ezihlelwe ezweni lonkana ngesonto elaziwa ngokuthi yiNational Imbizo Focus Week kusukela mhla zingama-30 kuLwezi kuya kumhlaka ziyi-6 kuZibandlela 2015.

src: Serala seno se kgontsha baagi go buisana le ditokololo tsa Khuduthamaga.
tgt: Le nkundla yenza ukuthi izakhamuzi zikwazi ukufakana imilomo noNgqongqoshe abathile.

src: Beke ya Bosetšhaba e e Totileng Imbizo e tla diragala ka moono wa: "Mmogo re isa Aforika Borwa pele" mme e tla sedimosetsa baagi ka tiragatso ya puso ya Leano la Dintlharobongwe le le totileng go tlhotlhetsa kgolo ya ikonomi mmogo le go tlhama ditiro, jaaka le tlhagisitswe ke Moporesitente Zuma mo Puong ya gagwe ya Maemo a Setšhaba ka Tlhakole 2015.
tgt: Isonto i-National Imbizo Focus Week lizokwenzeka ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: “Sisonke siqhubekisela iNingizimu Afrika phambili” futhi lapha kuyokwaziswa imiphakathi ngalokho okwenziwa nguhulumeni oHlelweni Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye ekukhuliseni umnotho kanye nasekwakheni amathuba omsebenzi, njengalokhu kwabekwa nguMongameli Zuma eNkulumweni yakhe Echaza Isimo Sezwe ngoNhlolanja 2015.

src: Gape Ditokololo tsa Khuduthamaga di tla dirisa tšhono eno go susumetsa baagi go nna le seabe ka go samagana le mathata a a farologaneng a loago, go akarediwa merero e e amanang le tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi le bana.
tgt: ONgqongqoshe bazophinda basebenzise leli thuba ukukhuthaza umphakathi ukuthi ubambe iqhaza ekulweni nezinto eziningi ezihlukumeza umphakathi, kuhlanganisa nezinto ezihlobene nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: Sedimonthole ke Kgwedi ya Poelano mme Aforika Borwa e tla keteka Letsatsi la Poelano ka la bo 16 Sedimonthole kwa Port Elizabeth, Kapa Botlhaba ka moono wa: "Go fedisa kgaogano: Go aga boAforika Borwa jo bo lebisang kwa nageng ya bosetšhaba ya tlhabologo".
tgt: Inyanga kaZibandlela Yinyanga Yokuxolelana kanti iNingizimu Afrika iyogubha Usuku Lokuxolelana ngomhla ziyi-16 kuLwezi eBhayi, eMpumalanga Kapa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: “Sivala igebe: Sakha ubuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika obufanayo ukuze sibe yizwe elithuthukayo”.

src: Kgwedi e na le bokao jo bo kgethegileng mo setšhabeng gonne e tsweletsa poelano, kagiso le tirisanommogo ya loago e leng seo puso e ntšhwa ya temokerasi ya naga e theilweng mo go sona.
tgt: Le nyanga ibaluleke kakhulu ngoba ikhuthaza ukuxolelana, ukuthola kanye nokubumbana komphakathi kanti lezi yizinto ezaba yisisekelo sokwakhiwa kwentanto yeningi entsha yaleli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa maAforika Borwa otlhe go dirisa kgwedi go golagana jaaka setšhaba se tla bo se tswelela go dira mmogo go aga setšhaba se se kopaneng, se se humileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi basebenzise le nyanga ukuthi baxhumane njengesizwe njengalokhu siqhubeka nokusebenzisana ndawonye sakha isizwe esihlangene nesinenqubekelaphambili.

src: Kabinete e gakolola baduelalekgetho ba ba iseng ba ise dipoelo tsa bona tsa lekgetho tsa ngwaga wa lekgetho wa 2014/15 gore letlha la bofelo ke la bo 27 Ngwanaitseele 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza abakhokhi bentela abangakawahambisi amaphepha abo awubufakazi bokukhokha kwabo intela onyaka wentela wezi-2014/15 ukuthi usuku olungumnqamulajuqu umhla zingama-27 kuLwezi 2015.

src: Kabinete e leboga baduelalekgetho botlhe ka go dirisana mmogo le puso go tlamela ka ditirelo tse di tlhokegang bogolo segolo tse di thusang go tokafatsa matshelo a diketekete tsa baagi go ralala naga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonga bonke abakhokhibentela ngokubambisana nohulumeni ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingeka kakhulu kangaka ezisiza ukwenza ngcono izimpilo zezinkulungwane zemiphakathi ezweni lonkana.

src: Kabinete e akgola Tikwatikwe e Kgolo e e Samaganang le tsa Bong e e Kgatlhanong le Tirisodikgoka (GBVCC) ya Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Loago ka go gapa Sekgele sa Global Best Contact Centre kwa Las Vegas, Amerika ka Labone, la bo 5 Ngwanaitseele 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela isikhungo soMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi okuyi-Gender-Based Violence Command Centre (GBVCC) ngokuhlabana kwaso ngomklomelo i-Global Best Contact Centre Award e-Las Vegas, eMelika, ngoLwesine, mhla zi-5 kuLwezi 2015.

src: GBVCC ke tikwatikwe ya megala e e dirang bosigo le motshegare e e totileng go tlamela batswasetlhabelo ba tirisodikgoka e e ikaegileng ka bong ka tshegetso le tshegetso le thobomaikutlo.
tgt: I-GBVCC isikhungo samahora angama-24 esizinikele ekuhlinzekeni ngokweseka kanye nokweluleka izisulu zodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane.

src: Seno ke kgang e nngwe ya katlego e e bontshang puso e e kgathalang e e ikaeletseng go lwa go fedisa tirisodikgoka e e ikaegileng ka Bong.
tgt: Lena enye indaba eyimpumelelo ebonisa uhulumeni onakekelayo omile ekulweni nokuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane.

src: Kabinete e akgola Eskom ka go dira matsatsi a le 100 kwa ntle ga go kgaola tlamelo ya motlakase.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela u-Eskom ngokusebenza izinsuku eziyi-100 ngaphandle kokunqamula ugesi ngisho nakanye (ukunqamula ugesi ngenhloso yokuwaba ngononina).

src: Eskom e fitlheletse seno ka Labobedi, la bo 17 Ngwanaitseele 2015.
tgt: U-Eskom ufinyelele kuleli qophelo ngoLwesibili, mhla ziyi-17 Lwezi 2015.

src: Matsatsi a le 100 a tlamelo e e sa kgoreletsegang ya motlakase ga a ree gore re itebale.
tgt: Lezi zinsuku eziyi-100 zokuhlinzeka ngogesi okungaphazanyisiwe akusho nokho ukuthi sekufanele ukuthi sihambele phezulu.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging go tswelela go obamela ditsereganyo tsa go somarela motlakase.
tgt: Kodwa okunalokho iKhabhinethi imema yonke imiphakathi ukuthi iqhubeke nokusebenzisa izindlela zokonga ugesi.

src: Kabinete e akgola ba ba supetsweng Dikgele tsa Metshameko tsa Aforika Borwa tsa 2015 tse di tla tshwarwang ka la bo 22 Ngwanaitseele 2015 kwa Sand du Plessis Theater kwa Mangaung, Foreisetata.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela labo abaqokelwe Izindondo Zemidlalo Zowezi--2015 nezizobanjwa ngomhla zingama-22 kuLwezi 2015 eSand du Plessis Theatre eMangaung, eFreyistata.

src: Dikgele, tse di tla tshwarwang ka moono wa: "Botswerere ga se ka go nna yo o gaisang ke ka ga go dira ka bojotlhe ka fao o ka kgonang", di keteka dingwaga di le 10 tsa go lemoga le go tlotla batho le ditlhopha tse di gaisang mo mabaleng le kwa ntle ga mabala.
tgt: Le miklomelo, izobanjwa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: “Ukuhamba phambili akusikhona nje ukuthi yingoba uhambe phambili kodwa kuwukwenza lokho okukwenza ukuba uhambe phambili”, kanti izobe igubha iminyaka eli-10 selokhu yasungulwa ukubona kanye nokuhlonipha labo bantu kanye namathimu abenze kahle ngaphakathi ensimini yokudlala kanye nangaphandle.

src: MaAforika Borwa a rotloediwa go tshegetsa tiragalo ka go tlhopha Naledi ya Metshameko ya Ngwaga wa Maemo a Kabinete mo Mererong e e Botlhokwa ya ga jaana.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuthi baweseke lo mcimbi ngokuthi bavotele uMdlali Ovelele Wonyaka wezi-20.

src: Kabinete e golagane le Moporesitente Zuma mmogo le baagi ba boditšhabatšhaba go nyatsa ka mafoko a a bogale ditlhaselo tsa fa gautshwane tsa borukhutlhi tse di diragetseng kwa Beirut (Lebanon), Baghdad (Iraq), Yola (Nigeria) le Paris (France), tse di bakileng dintsho tsa batho ba ba senang molato mmogo le tshenyo ya dithoto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iye yahlanganyela noMongameli Zuma kanye nomphakathi wamazwe omhlaba ekugxekeni kakhulu ukuhlasela kwabashokobezi okwenzeke e-Beirut (e-Lebanon), e-Baghdad (e-Iraq), eYola (e-Nigeria) kanye nase-Paris (e-France), nokuholele ekutheni kushone abantu abaningi abangenacala kwacekelwa phansi nempahla.

src: Aforika Borwa e tsepame mo go nyatseng ditlhaselo tsotlhe tse di totileng baagi ba ba senang molato mme e boeletsa seemo sa yona sa gore borukhutlhi, ka ditsela tsotlhe fela e bile go sa kgathalesege gore bo tswa kae, bo ka seke ba letlelelwa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika imile ayiguquki ekugxekeni zonke izinhlobo zokuhlasela okuqondiswe kubantu phaqa abangenacala futhi iyaphinda iyakuveza ukuthi yona imelele nezenzo zobushokobezi, ngisho noma ngabe zingezaluphi uhlobo futhi zivela kunoma iyiphi indawo, angeke nanini zabekezeleleka.

src: Kabinete e tshegetsa dikgato tsa Komiti ya Puso ya Ditona e e ka ga Tlhaelo ya Metsi le Komelelo ka go fokotsa ditlamorago tsa komelelo mme e ikuela mo baaging go somarela metsi go netefatsa tlamelo ya mo isagong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayeseka imisebenzi eseyenziwe Yikomidi LoNgqongqoshe BakaHulumeni(i-IMC) Kwinkinga Yokushoda Kwamanzi kanye Nesomiso ukulwa nokuthi imithelela yesomiso ingezweli kakhulu kanti futhi ifisa ukukhuthaza imiphakathi ukuthi isebenzise amanzi ngokuwonga ukuze kuhlale kunamanzi nangomuso.

src: Kabinete e tlaleleditse ka R96,6 milione mo R352,6 milione e e neng e beetswe thoko kwa tshimologong go tshegetsa maiteko a naga a go namola.
tgt: UHulumeni usengeze ngesamba semali esiyizigidi ezingama-96,6 kuleyo yokuqala ayeyikhiphile okwakuyizigidi ezingama-352,6 nebekwe eceleni ukuthi kwesekelwe imizamo yezwe yokulwa nesomiso ezindaweni ezithintekile.

src: Seno se akaretsa go rekwa ga dilori tsa metsi di le 45 gore di rorele metsi kwa mafelong a a amegileng, go epiwa ga didiba le go di tsosolosa, tshomarelo ya metsi mmogo le tsamaiso ya tlhokego, mmogo le tshegetso ka metsi.
tgt: Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuthengwa kwezimoto ezithwala amanzi ezingama-45 ukuze zisabalalise amanzi ezindaweni ezithintekayo, kumbiwe nemigodi ezokhipha amanzi kuphindwe kulungiswe lezo zindawo ebese zingasasebenzi kahle, kongiwe amanzi futhi aphathwe nangendlela kubuye futhi kuthathisiselwe amanzi emithonjeni eyizizinda zalapho kuvela khona amanzi.

src: Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Metseselegae le Ntšhwafastso ya Naga le tla letlelela gore mo mafelong a a amegileng thata go fudusediwe leruo kwa lefatsheng la puso koo go sa ntseng go na le mafulo a a botoka.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya Nezinguquko Kwezomhlaba, kuzothi kulezo zindawo ezishayeke kakhulu, ukuvumele ukuthi imfuyo ithuthwe iyokhothiswa kwezinye izindawo ezingumhlaba kahulumeni lapho kuzobe kusekhonyana ukudla kwezinkomo.

src: Go tlaleletsa foo, Lefapha la Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso le golagane le Boratoropo go diragatsa dikgato tse di farologaneng tsa go boloka metsi ka fa tlase ga kaelo ya Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, uMnyango Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana Nezendabuko usubambisane neziMeya ukuzama ukuza nezindlela ezahlukene zokonga amanzi ngaphansi kolawulo loMnyango Wezamanzi Nenhlanzeko.

src: Tsona di akaretsa go itsese tekanyetso ya metsi go tlhokomela kobamelo ya ditekanyetso tsa metsi go otlhaya ka detefiso fa go tlhokega go baakanya foo metsi a dutlang go nna setlapele go tsweletsa dithekenoloji tse di somarelang metsi di tshwana le ditanka tsa matlwana tse di sa diriseng metsi a mantsi go beeletsa metsi a pula mmogo le go nosetsa ka metsi a a dirisitsweng.
tgt: Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwethula imigomo enqala yokusetshenziswa kwamanzi, ukubheka ukuthi ngabe iyalandelwa yini imigomo yokusetshenziswa kwamanzi ukuthi kuhlawuliswe labo abenzi ngendlela efanele lapho kufanele khona ukubeka phambili ukuvala lezo zindawo zamanzi ezivuzayo ukukhuthaza izinto zobuchwepheshe ezihambisana nokongiwa kwamanzi ezifana namathoyilethi ashaywa ngamanzi amancane ukongiwa kwamanzi emvula kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamanzi asesebenze kwenye indawo lapho kwenziwa izinto ezifana nokunisela.

src: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o ne a eteletse pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa go ya kwa Samiting ya Baeteledipele ba G20 kwa Antalya, Turkey go tloga ka la bo 15 go fitlha ka la bo 16 Ngwanaitseele 2015.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma uye wahola ithimba eliqhamuka eNingizimu Afrika ebeliya kwiNgqungquthela Yabaholi be-G20 ebibanjelwe e-Antalya, ezweni lase-Turkey kusukela mhla ziyi-15 kuya kumhla ziyi-16 Lwezi 2015.

src: Moono wa samiti e ne e le kakaretso, dipeeletso le tiragatso.
tgt: Ingqikithi yale ngqungquthela yabaholi bamazwe yathi ukufaka wonke umuntu, ukutshala izimali kanye nokwenza.

src: Aforika Borwa e gareng ga dinaga di le 51 tse di saenileng Tumelano ya Thefosanyo ya Itiriso ya Tshedimosetso ya Lekgetho kwa Berlin, Germany ka Diphalane 2015.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika iphakathi kwamazwe angama-51 awasayina isivumelwano esaziwa ngokuthi i-Agreement on Automatic Exchange to Tax Information e-Berlin, e-Germany ngoMfumfu 2015.

src: Dinaga di tla simolola go refosanya tshedimosetso ka 2017 mme seo se tla bo se maatlafadiwa ke molao o o fa pele ga Palamente ga jaana.
tgt: La wamazwe azoqala abelane ngolwazi kusukela ngonyaka wezi-2017, kanti lokho kuyokwenziwa ngaphansi komthetho okumanje usezithebeni zePhalamende.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o amogetse go konosediwa ga dintlha tsa dikgato di le 15 tsa porojeke ya G20/Mokgatlho wa Tirisanommogo mo Ikonoming le mo Tlhabololong ya Motheo mo Dikgogolong le mo Tshutisong ya Dipoelo, tse di neng di le botlhokwa go netefatsa gore ga go gobelelwe le go netefatsa lotseno lwa Borwa jwa Aforika.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma ukwamukele ukuphothulwa kwezinto ezizokwenziwa eziyi-15 ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-G20/Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development Base Erosion and Profit Shifting project, nobekuyizinto ebezibaluke kakhulu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke into ihamba ngendlela efanele kanye nokuzinziza indawo yokwenza imali ekwi-sub-Saharan Africa.

src: Ditokololo tsa Lekgotla la Ditona tsa Kitlano ya Ditso tsa Borwa jwa Aforika (SACU) di kopane ka la bo 11 Ngwanaitseele 2015 kwa Windhoek, Namibia pele ga go tlhomiwa ga ntlokgolo ya SACU le dipuisano tse di sa rulaganngwang tsa Ditlhogo tsa Mebuso tsa SACU le Puso.
tgt: Amalungu e-Southern African Customs Union (SACU) uMkhandlu WoNgqongqoshe aye ahlangana ngomhla ziyi-11 Lwezi 2015 eWindhoek, eNamibia ngaphambi kokwethulwa kwamahhovisi amakhulu e-SACU kanye nangaphambi kokuba nesithangami sokucobelelana ngolwazi noMongameli bamazwe e-SACU kanye noHulumeni.

src: Lekgotla le dirisitse tšhono go lebelela tswelelopele e e dirilweng mo Leanong la Dintlha di le Thataro fa e sale ka kopano ya bofelo mme la gatelela maitlamo a lona go SACLekgotla le dumelane gore SACU e tshwanetse go dira go feta go aroganngwa ga lotseno go nna maiteko a tlhabololo a a tla tshegetsang kgolagano mo kgaolong.
tgt: Lo Mkhandlu wasebenzisa leli thuba ukubheka inqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe Ohlelweni Olunamaphuzu Ayisithupha kusukela emhlanganweni wawo wokugcina, waphinda futhi wagcizelela ukuzibophezela kwawo kwi-SACUMkhandlu wavuma ukuthi i-SACU le kumele yenze okungaphezulu kokwabelana ngemali eyenziwe nje kuphela kodwa kumele iqhamuke ngisho nanezinhlelo ezizokweseka ukuhlangana esifundeni.

src: Gape ditokololo di amogetse mosupatsela le leano la tiro le le lebisang kwa samiting e e tla tshwarwang ka Seetebosigo 2016.
tgt: Amalungu aphinda futhi emukela ibalazwe kanye namapulani okusebenzela ingqungquthela yabaphathi bamazwe ezobanjwa ngoNhlangulana 2016.

src: Kabinete e amogela Dipoelo tsa Boruni tsa 2014-15 tsa puso ya bosetšhaba le tsa diporofense.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela Imiphumela Yokucwaningwa Kwamabhuku yezi-2014-15 kuhulumeni kazwelonke kanye nakohlumeni bezifundazwe.

src: Pegelo e bontsha tokafalo e e tswelelang pele mo bontsing jwa dintlha tsa dipoelo tsa boruni tsa dipuso tsa bosetšhaba le diporofense.
tgt: Umbiko ubonisa ukuthi kukhona ukwenza ngcono kuyona yonke imikhakha yokucwaningwa kwamabhuku kuhulumeni kazwelonke nohulumeni wesifundazwe.

src: E bontsha motsamao o o namatshang o o lebisang kwa taolong e e siameng mmogo le tsamaiso e e siameng ya ditšhelete mme e gatelela taolo e e siameng jaaka mafapha a le mantsi a bone boruni jo bophepa.
tgt: Imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi khona kukhona okuncane okuzanywayo ngasekuphatheni kahle izinto ngendlela kanye nasekuphatheni izimali ngendlela futhi kwenza ukuthi kunokuphathwa ngendlela manje kweminyango kahulumeni, kanti lokhu kubonakale ngokuthi iminyango eminingi kahlumeni ithole imibiko yokucwaningwa kwamabhuku engenawo amachashaza.

src: Tokafalo eno gape e bontsha gore puso e dira ka natla go netefatsa gore go nna le maikarabelo mo dikarolong tsotlhe tsa tiro ya yona.
tgt: Lokhu kwenza kangcono kubuye kubonise ukuthi uhulumeni usebenza kanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abasebenzisa izimali zikahulumeni bayaphendula kuyona yonke imisebenzi abayenzayo.

src: Le fa go ntse go na le tokafalo eno, puso e sweditse go tswelela go tshegetsa mafapha a a nang le diphitlhelelo tse di maswe le go netefatsa gore dikarolo tsotlhe tsa puso di dira ka tshwanelo.
tgt: Nakuba kukhona lokhu kwenza kangcono ngale ndlela, uhulumeni uthathe isinqumo sokuthi uzoqhubeka weseke leyo minyango ethole imibiko engemihle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhulumeni wonkana usebenza ngendlela engcono kakhulu.

src: Kabinete e amogela go thapiwa ke Moporesitente Zuma ga Moatlhodi Mandisa Muriel Maya jaaka Motlatsamoporesitente wa Kgotlatshekelokgolo ya Boikuelo go ya ka karolo ya 174(4) ya Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 le Mosiamisi Nonkosi Zoliswa Mhlantla jaaka moatlhodi wa Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo go ya ka Karolo ya 174(3) ya Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996.Go thapiwa gono go maatlafatsa maitlamo a Aforika Borwa a tekatekano ya bong kwa magatong a a kwa godimodimo mme go tsweletsa go fetolwa ga boatlhodi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela ukuqokwa nguMongameli Zuma kukaJaji uMandisa Muriel Maya njengeSekelamongameli leNkantolo Enkulu Yokwedluliswa Kwamacala ngokwemigomo yesigaba se-174(4) soMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika wangonyaka we-1996 kanye nokuqokwa Kwejaji uNonkosi Zoliswa Mhlantla njengojaji eNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ngokwemibandela yesigaba se-174(3) soMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika we-1996.Lokhu kuqokwa kwalaba kuqinisa ukuzibophezela kweNingizimu Afrika ukuthi kube nobulingana kobulili ezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu futhi kuqhubela phambili ukushintshwa kanye nokuguqulwa kwamajaji.

src: Kabinete e akgola baatlhodi ka bobedi mme e ba eleletsa tsotlhe tse dintle mo tiragatsong ya maikarabelo ano a botlhokwa mo Bosiamising jwa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabahalalisela bobabili abehluleli futhi ibafisela okuhle kodwa ekusebenzeni kwabo ekwenzeni lomsebenzi obucayi kangaka esigqikini samajaji eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e akgola Ngaka S'thembele Ngidi yo a dirileng hisetori fa a ne a aloga kwa Kholetšheng ya Bongaka ya Aforika Borwa jaaka moitseanape wa kankere (oncologist) wa ntlha wa mosadi wa KwaZulu-Natal mme e le wa bobedi fela mo nageng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ifisa ukuhalalisela uDkt S’thembile Ngidi oqophe umlando ngenkathi ethweswa imiyezane eCollege of Medicine South Africa njengodokotela wokuqala ongumuntu wesifazane ukuba ngudokotela ofunde wagogoda ekuhlonzeni kanye nasekudanjisweni komdlavuza KwaZulu-Natali kanti ungowesibili kuphela kuleli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e akgola modiri wa dibaesekopo wa Aforika Borwa Reina-Marie Loader yo setshwantsho sa gagwe 'Horn' se amogetseng dikakgolo di le dintsi, go akarediwa go supiwa mo Dikgeleng tsa Tshomarelo ya Ditshukudu tsa 2015 ka Phukwi mo karolong ya Temogo e e Gaisang, Thuto le Matlole, mme se gapile sekgele sa Setshwantsho se se Gaisitseng sa Tshomarelo kwa Moletlong wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Dibaesekopo kwa New York City, Amerika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imncoma kakhulu umenzi wamafilimu waseNingizimu Afrika uReina-Marie Loader owenze umbhalo osabhayisikobho onesihloko esithi ‘Horn’ nothole ukunconywa okuningi kakhulu, nowaze waqokelwa ngisho nemiklomelo ama-Rhino Conservation Awards anonyaka wezi-2015 ngoNtulikazi ngaphansi komkhakha othi: Best Awareness, Education and Funding, wase uphumelela kwindondo eyaziwa ngokuthi i-Best Conservation Film kwi-International Film Festival eNew York City, e-USA eyabanjwe khona ngonyaka wezi-2015.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso kwa go balelapa le ditsala tsa Motlatsatona wa Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe, Mme Pamela Tshwete, ka loso la ga mmaagwe, Mama Ruth Nomzi Zondeki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi dudu emndenini kanye nakubangani beSekelangqongqoshe loMnyango Wezamanzi Nenhlanzeko, uNks Pamela Tshwete, ngokushiywa emhlabeni ngumama wakhe, uMama uRuth Nomzi Zondeki.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso kwa pusong ya New Zealand, balelapa, ditsala le Mokgatlho wa Rakabi wa New Zealand ka loso lwa naledi ya rakabi, Jonah Tali Lomu, yo o nnileng le seabe se segolo mo motshamekong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yedlulisa amazwi enduduzo kuhulumeni wasezweni lase-New Zealand, emndenini, kubangani kanye nakwinhlangano yebhola lombhoxo iNew Zealand Rugby Union ngokudlula emhlabeni kwesihlabani sebhola lombhoxo, uJonah Tali Lomu, obaziwa kakhulu ngegalelo lakhe emdlaweni wezombhoxo.

src: Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi.
tgt: AbaqashiweBonke laba abaqashiwe ukuqashwa kwabo kuyoqinisekiswa mhla izicucu zokuqashwa kwabo kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokufaneleka kwabo kulezi zikhala kwavunywa.

src: Go atolosiwa ga Konteraka ya ga Rre Maswahle Diphofa – Mokaedikakaretso (DG): Lefapha la Bodiredipuso le Tsamaiso ka dingwaga di le tlhano.
tgt: Ukwelulwa Kwesivumelwano Sokusebena iminyaka emihlanu sikaMnu Maswahle Diphofa – uMqondisi-Jikelele (i-DG): uMnyango Wezemisebenzi Kahulumeni Nokuphathwa Kwayo.

src: Go atolosiwa ga Konteraka ya ga Mme Nonkululeko Sindane – DG: Lefapha la Bosiamisi le Tlhabololo ya Molaotheo ka dikgwedi di le somepedi.
tgt: Ukwelulwa Kwesivumelwano Sokusebenza izinyanga eziyishumi nambili sikaNks Nonkululeko Sindane – u-DG: uMnyango Wezobulungiswa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo.

src: Rre Livhuwani Tommy Makhode Motlatsa Mokaedikakaretso (DDG): Maano a Setheo le Tshegetso mo Lefapheng la Saense le Thekenoloji.
tgt: UMnu Livhuwani Tommy Makhode njengeSekela likaMqondisi-Jikelele: Ukuhlelwa Kwesikhungo kanye Nokweseka eMnyangweni Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe.

src: Rre Rory Gallocher jaaka Motlhankedikhuduthamagamogolo (CEO) wa Bothati jwa Taolo ya Dintlo tsa Loago.
tgt: UMnu Rory Gallocher njengeSikhulu Esiphezulu Kwisikhungo Esilawula Izindlu Zomphakathi.

src: Ngaka Pradish Rampersadh jaaka Mokaedikhuduthamaga yo montšhwa wa Lekgotla la Diporofešene tsa Saense ya Tlhago la Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UDkt Pradish Rampersadh njengoMqondisi Omkhulu WoMkhandlu WaseNingizimu Afrika Wemisebenzi Yesayensi Yemvelo.

src: Rre Mark Barnes jaaka CEO wa Setlhopha sa Kantoroposo ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMnu Mark Barnes njengeSikhulu Esiphezulu Jikelele Kwinhlangano Yeposi YaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Boto ya Bankatlhabololo ya Borwa jwa Aforika:i. Rre Jabulani Philip Moleketi – (o thapiwa gape mme ke Modulasetilo)ii.
tgt: Ibhodi Yebhange i-Development Bank of Southern Africa:i. UMnu Jabulani Philip Moleketi – (uqokwe kabusha futhi kanti unguSihlalo)ii.

src: Rre Msokoli Frans Baleni – (o thapiwa gape mme ke Motlatsamodulasetilo)iii.
tgt: UMnu Msokoli Frans Baleni – (uqokwe kabusha futhi kanti uyiSekela Sihlalo)iii.

tgt: UNks Martie Janse van Rensburg – (UnguMqondisi Ongasiyona Ingxenye Yesigungu Seziphathimandla)iv.

src: Mme Malijeng Theresa Ngqaleni – (Mokaedi yo e seng wa Khuduthamaga) lev.
tgt: UNks Malijeng Theresa Ngqaleni – (UnguMqondisi Ongasiyona Ingxenye Yesigungu Seziphathimandla) kanyev.

tgt: UNks Kameshni Naidoo – (uqokwe kabusha futhi njengoMqondisi Ongasiyona Ingxenye Yesigungu Seziphathimandla).

tgt: Ibhodi Yenhlangano Yomshuwalense Wengcuphe Eyisipesheli:i. UNks Margaret Octavia Ndlovu – (uqokwe kabusha futhi njengoMqondisi Ongasiyona Ingxenye Yesigungu Seziphathimandla) kanyeii.

src: Go Tsenngwa Tirisong ga Manaane a Puso a a Botlhokwa.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go saeniwa ga ditumelano di le 26 tsa boleng jo bo kanaka R94 bilione go tswa mo Ketelong ya Puso ya Moporesitente wa China Xi Jinping ya mo malobeng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ngezandla ezimhlophe ukusayindwa kwezivumelwano ezingama-26, ngenkathi uMongameli wase-China u-Xi Jinping ehambele kuleli esikhathini esifushane esedlule, ezibalelwa kwizigidigidi zamarandi ezingama-94.

src: Ditumelano tse di saenilweng di akaretsa R12 bilione ya go aga bodutelo jwa dikoloi mo Aforika Borwa, ya madikadimo a a kanaka US$500 milione go tsamaisa ditlhabololo tsa mafaratlhatlha a Eskom le ya tlamelo e e netefaleditsweng e e kanaka US$2.5 bilione go thusa Transnet go tswa kwa Bankeng ya Ditlhabololo ya China.
tgt: Lezi zivumelwano zibandakanya nesamba semali engamarandi ayizigidigidi eziyi-12 yokusungula isikhungo sokwakha izimoto eNingizimu Afrika, nemali ebolekwe abakwa-Eskom engamaDola aseMelika ayizigidi ezingama-500 yokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda kanye nesibambiso samaDola aseMelika ayizigidigidi ezimbili nesigamu esinikezwe abakwa-Transnet, esikhishwe yiBhange Lentuthuko lase-China.

src: Jaaka Foramo ya Bobedi ya Tirisanommogo ya China-Aforika (FOCAC),Moporesitente Jinping o ikanne go beeletsa US$60 bilione tebang le tlhabololo mo Aforika.
tgt: Njengengxenye yeNgqungquthela Yesibili Yobambiswano Phakathi Kwamazwe ase-Afrika ne-China (i-FOCAC), uMongameli Xi Jinping wathembisa ukuthi izwe lakhe lizohlinzeka ngemali engamaDola aseMelika (i-US$) ayizigidigidi ezingama-60 yentuthuko e-Afrika.

src: Kamogelotiragatso ya Tlhomamiso e ntšhwa mmogo le Leanotiro la (2016-2018) kwa FOCAC le sobokanya kgolo ya tirisanommogo magareng ga Aforika le China, e leng se se tla bulelang ditšhono tse ditšhwa tsa kgwebisano le dipeeletso go thusa go tlhatlosa kgolo ya ikonomi.
tgt: Ukwamukelwa kweSimemezelo esisha kanye noHlelo Lokusebenza (lowezi-2016-2018) kwingqungquthela ye-FOCAC kuqinisa ubambiswano oludlondlobalayo phakathi kwe-Afrika ne-China, oluzovula amathuba amasha okuhwebelana nokutshalwa kwezimali ukuze kukhuthazwe ukukhula komnotho.

src: Ikonomi e amogetse gape le tshegetso ya ikonomi go tswa kwa Setlhopheng sa BMW sa Aforika Borwa ka go tlhagisa dipeeletso tsa bokanaka R6 bilione kwa bodutelong jwa yone jwa Rosslyn, Pretoria, e leng se se pakang tirisano mmogo e e botlhokwa e e leng teng magareng ga kgwebo le puso, mmogo le tiro eo kgwebo e e jarileng mo go tlhabololeng ikonomi.
tgt: Umnotho uthole futhi inkuthazo ngesimemezelo seNkampani yakwa-BMW yaseNingizimu Afrika sokutshalwa kwemali engamarandi ayizigidigidi eziyisithupha ophikweni lwayo oluse-Rosslyn, ePitoli, okuwubufakazi bobambiswano olusemqoka olukhona phakathi kwabamabhizinisi nohulumeni, kanye nendima edlalwa ngabamabhizinisi ekuthuthukisweni komnotho.

src: Ka labobedi, 8 Sedimonthole, Moporesitente Zuma o apesitse baagi ba Aforika Borwa mmogo le batswantle ba ba tlotlegang bao ba nnileng le seabe mo go rotloetseng ditirelo tsa botho Matshwao a Tlotlo a Bosetšhaba.
tgt: NgoLwesibili mhla ziyisi-8 kuZibandlela, uMongameli Zuma uzohlonipha ngeziNdondo Zezwe abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nabakwamanye amazwe abavelele abafake isandla esikhulukazi ekuthuthukisweni kwabantu.

src: Matshwao a Tlotlo a Bosetšhaba ke motsotswana wa go lebelela kwa morago, go keteka le go ikgantsha ka batho ba borona.
tgt: Umcimbi wokunikezwa kweziNdondo Zezwe uhlinzeka ngethuba lokubheka emuva kanye nokubungaza umsebenzi omuhle futhi uletha ukuziqhenya okukhulu kubantu bakuleli.

src: A keteka diphitlhelelo tsa botho, go ikentsha setlhabelo ga batho le kgaratlho ya batho eo e dirang gore naga ya rona e nne lefelo le le botoka.
tgt: Lezi zindondo zibungaza insebenzo enhle, ukuzinikela kanye nendima enkulu edlalwe ngabantu abathile ngenhloso yokwenza izwe lethu libe yizwe elingcono kakhulu.

src: Re bontsha tlotlo go baamogedi ba Matshwao a Tlotlo a Bosetšhaba ba 2015.
tgt: Sibathulela isigqoko bonke labo abaklonyeliswe ngeziNdondo Zezwe zowezi-2015.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go somarela metsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi amanzi bawasebenzise ngokuwonga.

src: Seno ke go tshegetsa dikgato di le dintsinyana tse di tserweng go ka fokotsa tlhaelo ya metsi, e leng seo se gagamaditsweng ke mogote oo naga e itemogetseng one mo dibekeng tse di fetileng.
tgt: Lokhu kuzolekelela emizamweni ehlukahlukene esiqalisiwe yokunciphisa ukuntuleka kwamanzi, okubhebhethekiswe nayisivuvu sokushisa ebesikhona kulama viki edlule.

src: Le fa e le gore pula ya mo malobeng kwa dikarolong tse dingwe tsa naga e fokoditse kimologo, tlhaelo ya metsi ya naga e tswelela go nna kgwetlho e kgolo mme go tlhokega gore rona rotlhe re somarele metsi le go a dirisa ka maikarabelo.
tgt: Nakuba izimvula ezitholakele esikhathini esifushane esedlule ezingxenyeni ezithile zaleli lizwe ziyidambisile kancane inkinga yokuntuleka kwamanzi, ukushoda kwamanzi kuseyinselelo enkulu futhi kudinga ukuthi sonke siqinisekise ukuthi amanzi siwasebenzisa ngokuwonga.

src: Kabinete e tlhagisitse ditebogo tsa yone mo maAforika Borweng otlhe ka go tsaya karolo mo Letsholong la monongwaga la Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo Kgatlhanong le Tiririsodikgoka mo Basading le mo Baneng, le le konoseditsweng ka la bo 10 Sedimonthole 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise amazwi okubonga kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababambe iqhaza emkhankasweni walo nyaka weziNsuku eziyi-16 Wokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane, ophothulwe izolo.

src: Dipatlisiso tsa sešweng di bontsha gore palo e e kwa godimo ya ditshwaetso tse dintšhwa, bogolosegolo mo makgarebeng le mo basetsanyaneng mo Aforika, e mo bao ba leng magareng ga dingwaga di le 15 le 24.MaAforika Borwa a rotloediwa go gatelapele ka ditiro tsa manaane a bolweladitshwanelo a letsatsi le letsatsi jaaka karolo ya go nna Kgatlhanong le Tirisodikgoka mo Basading le mo Baneng ya #365 Days Campaign le ya letsholo la #CountMeIn e leng tse di diragadiwang ngwaga otlhe.
tgt: Ucwaningo lwakamuva lukhombisa ukuthi siphezulu isibalo sabantu abasuleleka ngegciwane lesandulela ngculazi (i-HIV) kwizwekazi lase-Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane abasebasha kanye namantombazane aneminyaka yobudala ephakathi kweyi-15 kanye nengama-24.Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayakhuthazwa ukuthi baqhubeke nokulwisana nsukuzonke nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, njengengxenye yomkhankaso we-#365 Days Campaign Wokulwisana Nodlame Olubhekiswe Kwabesifazane Nezingane kanye nomkhankaso we-#CountMeIn, okuyimikhankaso ezoqhubeka kuze kuphele unyaka ozayo.

src: Ka go dirisa #365 Days Campaign le #CountMeIn, naga e tlhoka go tswelela go golaganya ditokololo tsa baagi, bogolosegolo banna, go golagana le puso mo go samaganeng le leuba WEBTOKEN maikarabelo a naga, ka bongwe jwa rona kgotsa ka go golagana ga rona, go fedisa go ata ga kokwanatlhoko ka go tlhokomela boitekanelo jwa rona le jwa batho ba bangwe.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisa umkhankaso we#365 Days Campaign kanye nowe-#CountMeIn, leli lizwe kudingeka ukuthi liqhubeke nokugqugquzela amalungu omphakathi, ikakhulukazi amadoda, ukuthi asebenzisane nohulumeni ekulwisaneni nalesi sihlava.

src: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke kgatelopele e e dirilweng ke Lekgotla la Dipatlisiso tsa Saense le Intaseteri ka go tlhagisa thulaganyo ya tlhagiso ya melemo ya HIV.
tgt: Kungumthwalo osemahlombe esizwe sonke, nomuntu ngamunye, ukunqanda ukusabalala kwe-HIV ngokuthi sinakekele izimpilo zethu kanye nezabanye abantu.

src: Seno se atumetsa intaseteri ya boitekanelo gaufi le kalafi ya thibelobolwetse e e sa jeng madi a mantsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise ukuyithokozela inqubekelaphambili eyenziwe wuMkhandlu Wocwaningo Lwezesayensi Nezimboni (i-CSIR) ekuthuthukisweni kwenqubo yokuthola ikhambi lokuvimbela i-HIV.

src: Fa naga e ssantse e tsweletse go kgarakgadiwa ke go batlana le kalafi ya go fedisa HIV le AIDS, maAforika Borwa a tswelela go rotloediwa go tsenela thobalano e e babalesegileng le go obamela metheo ya ABC (Ikilele mo thobalanong, Ikanyege mme o Dirise Mosomelwana).6 Kabinete e akgotse barutwana botlhe, baithuti, barutabana, bafatlhosi, dikolo le ditheo tsa thuto e kgolwane ka go konosetsa ngwaga wa dithuto o o atlegileng, le fa go nnile le dikgwetlho tse go itemogetsweng tsone mo gare ga ngwaga.
tgt: Lokhu sekubeke imboni yezempilo esimweni sokuthi khona maduze nje ikwazi ukuqhamuka nekhambi lokuvimbela isandulela ngculazi elingambi eqolo futhi elizoba nomthelela omuhle kwezomnotho.

src: Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Loago, ka tirisanommogo le Lefapha la Phemelo mmogo le Setheo sa Naga sa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa, ba tla tshwara Kopano ya bone ya Bašwa ya Bosetšhaba ya bo Leno ke lenaale la tlhabololo ya boeteledipele leo maitlhomo a lone e leng go fetola maitshwaro le go natlafatsa bašwa ka ditšhono tse di leng fa pele ga matlho a bone.
tgt: Njengoba kusenzima kuleli lizwe ukuthola ikhambi lokwelapha ingculazi, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele bazivikele uma beya ocansini futhi balandele umgomo we-ABC (okusho Ukuzithiba, Ukwethembeka kanye Nokusebenzisa Ikhondomu) ngenhloso yokuvimbela ukusuleleka ngegciwane lesandulela ngculazi.6 IKhabinethi ibashayela ihlombe bonke abafundi, izitshudeni, othisha, izikole kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ngokuphothula unyaka wemfundo obe yimpumelelo, nakuba kube nezinselelo ezithile ngokuqhubeka konyaka.

src: Kopano eno gape e thusa ka go ruta basimanyana go ka nna banna ba ba tlotlang basadi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibafisela okuhle kodwa labo bafundi abavumile ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwabo kuhleliselwe onyakeni ozayo, njengoba bezoqala ukubhala ngasekuqaleni kowezi-2016.

src: Tumelano e e kopanetsweng e e saenilweng ke Tona ya Lefapha la Thuto le Katiso tse di Kgolwan, Ngaka Blade Nzimande, mmogo le balekane ba BRICS e leng – Brazil, Russia, India le China – e ikemiseditse go ka tlhagisa letlhomeso la tirisanommogo mo thutong mo nakong e e tlang.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye noPhiko Lukazwelonke Lwezokuthuthukiswa Kwentsha (i-NYDA), uzobamba iNgqungquthela Yentsha Kazwelonke yesithupha.

src: Tumelano e akaretsa thutokakaretso, togamaano ya dipholisis tsa thuto, dikholeje le dithuto tse dikgolwane tsa Katiso le Thuto ya Diatla le ya Setegenik (TVET) Dikholeje tsa TVET di na le bokgoni jwa go bulela ditšhono tsa ikonomi mo bašweng ba borona, fa ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe di baakanya dikgwetlho tsa botlhokatiro, tlhokotekatekano le lehuma.
tgt: Lolu wuhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kobuholi entsheni, okuhloswe ngakho ukuguqula uziphatha nokucabanga kwentsha futhi ihlinzekwe ngolwazi oluphathelene namathuba akhona njengamanje enzelwe intsha.

src: Tumelano, e e tla tokafatsang boleng jwa go ithuta le jwa thuto ya barutabana, gape e dira gore diyunibesiti tsa BRICS di ipofe go tshegetsa diporojeke tsa dipatlisiso tse di kopanetsweng, go rotloetsa manaane a tirisanommogo mo maemong a thuto ya morago ga go konosetsa dithuto tsa ntlha tse digolwane, a bongaka le a a kwa godimo ga a bongaka mmogo le go phasaladiwa sebedi ga dipoelo tsa saense.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela izolekelela futhi ekucijeni nokufundisa abafana ukuze bakhule babe ngamadoda abazisayo abesifazane futhi abahloniphayo.8 Isivumelwano esisayindwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha, uDkt Blade Nzimande namazwe e-BRICS abambisene naleli, i-Brazil, Russia, India kanye ne-China – kuhloswe ngaso ukuthuthukisa uhlaka lokubambisana kwezemfundo esikhathini esizayo.

src: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le ne le tshwere Foramo ya Saense ya Aforika Borwa ka fa tlase ga moono “Re tlhotlheletsa dipuisano ka ga saense”.
tgt: Lesi sivumelwano sibandakanya imikhakha yemfundo yonkana, isu lenqubomgomo yezemfundo amakolishi eMfundo Yobuchwepheshe Bamakhono Ezandla Nokuqeqesha (ama-TVET) kanye nomkhakha wezemfundo ephakeme.

src: Palo e e fetang dikete di le 45 e tsenetse dikganetsano ka ga kipano le saense, thekenoloji le boitlhamedi mmogo le baagi, bogolosegolo go totilwe tlhabololo.
tgt: Amakolishi angama-TVET anawo amandla nekhono lokuvula amathuba ezomnotho kubantu abasha bakuleli, futhi ngokunjalo alekelele empini yokulwisana nenselelo yokuntuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi, ukungalingani kanye nobubha, okuyizinto ezikhahlameza imiphakathi.

src: Gape foramo e nnile le karolo ya go matlafatsa ditirisanommogo tsa boitlhamedi tsa thekenoloji, saense ya boditšhabatšhaba tsa togamaano ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lesi sivumelwano, okuhloswe ngaso ukwenza ngcono izinga lokufundisa kanye nelokuqeqeshwa kothisha, sibophezela futhi namanyuvesi amazwe e-Brics ekusekeleni imiklamo yocwaningo eyenziwa ngokuhlanganyela, sikhuthaze nezinhlelo zokubambisana emazingeni eziqu ze-postgraduate, doctoral kanye postdoctoral futhi siwabophezele nasekushicileleni imiphumela yocwaningo lwezesayensi ngokubambisana.

src: Mokgatlho o rwele maikarabelo a go tsenyatirisong ditshwetso mo mererong ya tsa kwa lewatleng ya lefatshe, go simolola ka Ikonomi ya kwa Mawatleng, dikgato tsa thuso mmogo le dintlha tsa pabalesego le tshireletsego kwa lewatleng.
tgt: UMnyango Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe usingathe iNgqungquthela Yezesayensi yaseNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sokhela inhlansi yokuqalisa ukuxoxisana nokufakana imilomo ngezesayensi.” Angaphezu kwama-45 amazwe abambe iqhaza kwizinkulumo-mpikiswano eziphathelene nokuxhumana okukhona phakathi komphakathi nezesayensi, ezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqanjwa nokusungulwa kwemikhiqizo nezinhlelo ezintsha, ikakhulu ngaphansi kwesimo sentuthuko.

src: Go tseeng karolo mo mokgatlhong ono go tla tshegetsa lenaane la puso la go bulela bokgoni jwa mawatleng jwa naga ka go dirisa Buka ya Togamaano ya Ikonomi ya kwa Mawatleng mmogo le Operation Phakisa, e eleng tseo di ikaeletseng go ka tlhola ditiro tse di ka fetang milione wa ditiro ka 2033.‎.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ilekelelile futhi nasekuqiniseni ukubambisana kweNingizimu Afrika namanye amazwe omhlaba kwezesayensi, ezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuqanjwa nokusungulwa kwemikhiqizo nezinhlelo ezintsha.10 INingizimu Afrika izomelwa eMkhandlwini Wamazwe Ngamazwe Wezolwandle.

src: Sesole sa Tshireletso ya Naga ya Aforika Borwa (SANDF) se simolotse mo bekeng e e fetileng thulaganyo ya tlhabolola Seteišene sa Sesole sa kwa Metsing sa Setlhake sa Salisbury kwa Durban go ka nna kampa e e dirang ka botlalo ya sesole sa kwa metsing.
tgt: Leli yigxathu elikhulukazi eliphokophele ekutholeni kwaleli lizwe kanye nezwekazi lonkana ithuba lokudlondlobala nokukhombisa ikhono lalo emkhakheni wezolwandle.

src: Ntšhwafatso ya mafelotiriso e tla tokafatsa bokgoni jwa tsa tshireletsego mmogo le go nna le seabe mo ikonoming ya kwa mawatleng.
tgt: Le nhlangano iyona ethweswe umsebenzi wokwamukela izinqumo eziphathelene nezindaba zasolwandle emhlabeni jikelele, kusukela kwezoMnotho Wasolwandle, izinhlelo zokuhlenga abadinga usizo oluphuthumayo olwandle kanye nezindaba eziphathelene nokuphepha nokuvikeleka olwandle.

src: Lefapha la Boitekanelo ka tirisanommogo le Soul City le Times Media, le thankgolotse kanale ya thelebišene e e samaganang le tsa boitekanelo tsa mokgwa wa go itlhokomela ya The Good Life Network mo kanaleng ya 199 ya DStv.
tgt: Ukubamba iqhaza kulo mkhandlu kuzosekela izinhlelo zikahulumeni ngokuvula amathuba okukhula nokudlondlobala kwaleli lizwe, ngokusebenzisa iSu Lomnotho Wasolwandle kanye nomkhankaso we-Operation Phakisa, okuhloswe ngakho ukuvula amathuba omsebenzi angaphezu kwesigidi ngowezi-2033.‎1.11 Ngeviki eledlule uMbutho Wezokuvikela waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANDF) uqalise inqubo yokulungisa kabusha nokuvuselela iSiteshi Sasolwandle sesiQhingi i-Salisbury e-Durban njengesizinda semikhumbi yezempi esisebenza ngokuphelele.

src: Kanale e abelana ka diteng tsa fa gae tsa mmatota tse di dirang gore o itise tse di farologaneng ka ga dijo, go ikatisa, ditshwanelo tsa botho, dirwe tsa thobalano mo bašweng, HIV le TB, mmogo le ditshwanelo tsa bareki le tsa bong jo bo farologaneng.
tgt: Ukulungiswa kwalesi sizinda kuzophucula amandla nekhono lokuzivikela kwaleli lizwe futhi kufake isandla nasemnothweni wasolwandle.12 UMnyango Wezempilo, ngokubambisana ne-Soul City kanye ne-Times Media, wethule isiteshi sikamabonakude esizokwethula izinhlelo zezempilo nenhlalakahle yabantu esibizwa nge-Good Life Network esizokhonjiswa ku-DStv, kwisiteshi nombolo 199.

src: Kabinete e letleletse gore go phasaladiwe Lokwalotemoso lwa lefapha la puso ka ga Inšorense ya Bosetšhaba ya Boitekanelo, Inšorense ya Bosetšhaba ya Boitekanelo (NHI) mo Aforika Borwa gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.
tgt: Lesi siteshi sihlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihlabahlosile futhi ezithokozisayo ezivutshelwe kuleli eziphathelene nokudla okunomsoco, ezempilo nokuzivocavoca ukuze uhlale ungumqemane, amalungelo esintu, izindaba zocansi eziqondiswe entsheni, isandulela ngculazi kanye nesifo sofuba (i-TB), namalungelo abathengi kanye nawabesifazane.

src: NHI ke karolo e kgolo ya puso ya ntšhwafatso ya lekala la boitekanelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi basibukele lesi siteshi sikamabonakude.

src: Pholisi e tshitshinya bokgoni jwa puso jwa go abelana ka ditirelo tsa boitekanelo mo go botlhe bao ba etelang mafelotiriso a bone a boitekanelo.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.1 IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukushicilelwa kohlaka loMthetho Odingidwayo ophathelene noMshwalense Kazwelonke Wezempilo (i-NHI) weNingizimu Afrika, ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngalo.

src: E tla tlamelwa ka matlole ka go dirisa motlamedi wa matlole otlhe ao a tla dirisediwang gape le go duelela badiredi ba ditlamo tsa boitekanelo tsa poraefete bao ba batlang go nna le karolo mo sekemeng seno.
tgt: I-NHI iyingxenye yezinguquko ezinohlonze ezizokwenziwa nguhulumeni emkhakheni wezempilo.

src: Fa e fetswa go konosediwa, pholisi eo e tla tsenngwatirisong mo pakeng ya dingwaga di le tharo mme e tla tsepamisa mogopolo bogolosegolo mo go simololeng go thusa mafelo a a sa boneng ditirelo tse di lekaneng.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo ihlongoza ukuthi kukhushulwe amandla nekhono likahulumeni lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu kubo bonke abantu abavakashela izikhungo zezempilo ezingaphansi kukahulumeni.

src: Tona ya Boitekanelo, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, gompieno o tla ema ka lefoko bobegakgang mabapi le go tsenngwatirisong ga NHKabinete e atlenegisitse Pholisi e e Kopanetsweng ya Bosetšhaba ya Thuto ya Bana ya go sa le Gale (ECD).Pholisi e tlhagisitswe ka go buisana le bannaleseabe ba ba farologaneng mo lekaleng leno.
tgt: Lo mshwalense uzoxhaswa ngezimali yisikhwama esizolawulwa nguhulumeni kazwelonke futhi lesi sikhwama sizobaxhasa nodokotela abazimele abafisayo ukubamba iqhaza.

src: E ne ya isiwa kwa baaging gore ba dire ditshwaelo ka Tlhakole 2015.Pholisi eno e e kopanetsweng ya ECD e tla netefatsa gore bana botlhe le batlhokomedi ba bone ba kgona go fitlhelela ditirelo tse di boleng tse di mosola tsa ECD go tswa kwa tshimologong go fitlha kwa Mophatong wa Pholisi eno e atolosa ditirelo go fitlha mo baneng ba dingwaga di le robedi ba ba nang le dikgwetlho tsa go ithuta.
tgt: Uma sekuphothuliwe ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlanganiswa kwale nqubomgomo, izoqaliswa kancane kancane esikhathini esiyiminyaka embadlwana futhi izogxila ikakhulukazi ekuqalisweni kokuhlinzekwa kosizo lwezempilo olusezingeni eliphezulu kulezo zindawo ezingalutholi njengamanje.

src: Gape pholisi e abelana le ka letlhomeso la tekolo le tshekatsheko go netefatsa fa e tsenngwatirisong ka tshwanelo mo baneng botlhe go sa kgathalesege lotso lwa bone, bong jwa bone kgotsa tumelo ya bone.
tgt: Namhlanje uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, uzohlinzeka abezindaba ngolwazi oluphathelene nokuqaliswa kwe-NHI.2 IKhabhinethi iyamukelile iNqubomgomo Kazwelonke Edidiyelwe Yokuthuthukiswa Kwezingane Zisencane (i-ECD).Le nqubomgomo yathuthukiswa ngokubonisana nababambiqhaza abahlukahlukene kulo mkhakha.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Lokwalotemoso lwa lefapha la puso tebang le Ditshwanelo tsa Batho ba ba nang le Bogole mmogo le Dikgatosenngotirisong tsa lone.
tgt: NgoNhlolanja wezi-2015 idlule esigabeni sokubonisana nomphakathi ngenhloso yokuthola izimvo zabantu.

src: Seno se bapisitswe le Dipeelo tsa Tlhabololo ya Tshomarelo ya go akaretsa bagolofadi, tseo di amogetsweng ke Kopanokakaretso ya Dinagakopano (UNGA) ka Lwetse 2015.Pholisi e tla gatelela phetolothefosano le dipaakanyo mabapi le kakaretso yotlhe, go kopanngwa le tekatekano tebang le batho ba ba nang le bogole.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo yeze-ECD edidiyelwe izoqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izingane ezisencane kanye nabanakekeli bazo bathola izinsizakalo ze-ECD ezibanzi futhi ezisezingeni eliphezulu, kusukela ngenkathi zizalwa kuze kuyofinyelela kwiBanga Le nqubomgomo izokwelula izinsizakalo ze-ECD ukuze zifinyelele nasezinganeni ezineminyaka yobudala eyisishiyagalombili ezinobunzima bokuthuthuka ngendlela efanelekile.

src: Pholisi e beela boitekanelo jwa batho kwa setlhoeng mo tlhabololong ka go dira gore go nne le tekatekano tebang le go abelana ka metswedi ya matlole go ka tshegetsa dipeeletso mo maemong a a kwa godimo a ditirelo, go abela ditirelo kwa malapeng a a tlamelwang ka ditirelo tse dinnye, ntse go tsweletswe go tlhokomela le go ntšhwafatsa mafaratlhatlha a a santseng a le teng a kgeleloleswe.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo ihlinzeka futhi nangohlaka lokuqapha nokuhlola ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqaliswa ngendlela efanelekile kuzo zonke izingane, kungakhathalekile ukuthi ngezaluphi uhlanga, ubulili noma inkolo.3 IKhabhinethi ilwamukelile uhlaka loMthetho Odingidwayo Wezamalungelo Abantu Abakhubazekile kanye neSimo Oluzoqaliswa Ngaphansi Kwaso.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go tlisiwa kwa Palamenteng ya Aforika Borwa ga Pegelo ya Dipaka di le Tlhano (2009-2014) ka ga Go Tsenngwa Tirisong ga Melao ya go Fedisa Mekgwa yotlhe ya Tlhaolele mo Basading.
tgt: Lokho kuhambisana neziNjongo Zentuthuko Esimeme ebandakanya abantu abakhubazekile, ezamukelwa yisiGungu Esibandakanya Wonke Amazwe (i-UNGA) angamalungu eNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) ngoMandulo wezi-2015.Le nqubomgomo izosheshisa uguquko futhi ilungise isimo esingagculisi neze esikhona njengamanje mayelana nokubandakanywa ngokuphelele nokudidiyelwa kanye nokuphathwa ngokulingana kwabantu abakhubazekile.

src: Pegelo e tlamela ka lemorago la mesola ya melao e e farologaneng, dipholisis le manaane ao a tsentsweng tirisong mmogo le go neela dintlhakgolo tsa dikatlego tsa naga fa go tla mo matlafatsong ya basadi le tekatekano ya bong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukushicilelwa kweNqubomgomo Kazwelonke Yezokuthuthwa Kwendle ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngayo.

src: Pegelo gape e tlhagisa gore go na le dikgwetlho tse di tsweletseng le dikgoreletso go ka fedisa tlhokotekatekano le tlhaolele mo nageng.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo iqhakambisa futhi ibeke eqhulwini inhlalakahle yabantu ngokuthi iqinisekise ukulingana phakathi kwendlela okwabiwa ngayo izimali zokusekela ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo emazingeni aphezulu kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo kulawo makhaya angazitholi ngendlela efanelekile, futhi kusenjalo kulungiswe futhi kuvuselelwe kabusha ingqalasizinda ekhona njengamanje yokuthuthwa kwendle.5 IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukwethulwa ePhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika Kombiko Wesihlanu Okhishwa Ngezikhathi Ezithile Kuphela (wezi-2009-2014) ophathelene Nokuqaliswa Kwesivumelwano Sokuqedwa kwazo zonke Izinhlobo Zokucwaswa Kwabesifazane.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Leanotirotlhomo la Bosetšhaba la Twantsho ya Ditiro tsa Tlhaolele, Tlhaolele go ya ka Lotso, Tlhaolele go ya ka Semorafe mmogo le Ditiragalo tse Dingwe tsa Tlhoko Itshokelano, gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.
tgt: Lo mbiko uhlinzeka ngemininingwane efingqiwe mayelana nemithetho ehlukahlukene nezinqubomgomo kanye nezinhlelo eziqalisiwe ukuze kutholakale ukuthi zinawo yini umthelela obonakalayo, futhi uhlinzeka nangemininingwane yalokho osekufezekiswe yileli lizwe mayelana nokufukulwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabesifazane kanye nokulingana ngokobulili.

src: Leano leno ke togamaano ya bosetšhaba e e rulagantsweng e bile e kopanetswe ka maitlhomo a go lwantshana le tlhaolele go ya ka lotso mme go agiwa Aforika Borwa wa boammaruri wa temokerasi yo a senang tlhaolele go ya ka lotso le go ya ka bong.
tgt: Lo mbiko uyakwamukela futhi ukuthi kusenezinselelo nezithiyo ezingafuni ukushabalala ezivimbela ukuqedwa kokungalingani nokucwaswa kwabantu abathile kuleli.6 IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukushicilelwa koHlaka Lohlelo Lokusebenza Lukazwelonke Lokulwisana Nobuhlanga, Ukucwaswa Kwezinhlanga Ezithile, Ukukhishwa Inyumbazane Kwabantu Bakwamanye Amazwe Abakuleli kanye Nokungabekezelelani Okuhlobene Nalokhu, ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngalo.

src: Le neelana ka letlhomeso la dikgato tse di rulaganeng tsa leruri tse di ka tsewang ke naga ka bojotlhe go ka samagana le lefa la ditiro tsa tlhaolele le la tlhaolele go ya ka lotso.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luyisu lokusebenza lukazwelonke elididiyelwe futhi elihlelekile okuhloswe ngalo ukulwisana nobuhlanga kanye nokwakha iNingizimu Afrika ebuswa ngentando yeningi eqinisekisayo ukuthi kuqedwa ngokuphelele ukucwasana ngokobuhlanga nangokobulili.

src: Seno se thusa Aforika Borwa go ka fitlhelela maikano a yone a boditšhabatšhaba, a kgaolo le a bosetšhaba, bogolosegolo Kgoeletso ya Durban le Leanotiro tse di amogetsweng ke Dinagakopano (UN) kwa Khonferenseng ya Lefatshe e e kgatlhanong le Ditiro tsa Tlhaolele ka 2001.
tgt: Luhlinzeka futhi ngohlaka lokuqinisekisa ukuthi leli lizwe lonkana lithabatha izinyathelo ezihleleke kahle, ezihambelanayo futhi ezizoqhubeka isikhathi eside ngenhloso yokulwisana nokhondolo lobuhlanga kanye nokucwaswana ngokobuhlanga.

src: Kabinete e nopoletswe ka kgatelopele e e dirilweng mo lenaaneng la phetolelokgaso go ya go ya dijithale.
tgt: Luzolekelela iNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ikwazi ukufezekisa izibopho zayo zikazwelonke, nezesifunda kanye nezamazwe ngamazwe, ikakhulukazi isiMemezelo Sesivumelwano saseThekwini kanye noHlelo Lokusebenza olwamukelwa yiNhlangano Yezizwe kwiNgqungquthela Yamazwe Omhlaba yokulwisana Nobuhlanga eyabanjwa ngowezi-20.7 IKhabhinethi yethulelwe nolwazi mayelana nenqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe ohlelweni lokufudukela kumsakazo wedijithali.

src: E amogetse gape le tshimololo ya paka ya kgasopedi mabapi le kgaso ya dijithale mo Aforika Borwa go ka simolola ka la bo 1 Tlhakole 2016.Phetogelo e no ya go tswa mo ditirelong tsa kgaso ya analoko go ya go ya dijithale e tlhagisa makhubu a a tlhokegang thata a kgaso a a nang le matshwanedi a go abelana ka ditirelo tse di latelelang tsa porotebente.
tgt: Ikwamukelile ukuqala kwesikhathi lapho isiginali yokusakaza ngedijithali izosebenza kanye kanye nesiginali ye-analogi eNingizimu Afrika kusukela mhla lu-1 kuNhlolanja 2016, kuze kufike usuku lomnqamulajuqu wokuqedwa kwe-analogi ngokuphelele.

src: Seno se tla oketsa kgaisano ya ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa ka go tsosolosa intaseteri ya kgaso, go natlafatsa intaseteri ya botlhagisi jwa ditlhagisiwa tsa ileketeroniki, go tlhola ditiro, mmogo le go tlhagisa mananeo a kgaso a a farologaneng a mantsi a fa gae.
tgt: Ukufuduswa kwezinsizakalo zokusakaza nge-analogi ziye kwidijithali kuzokhulula amagagasi okusakaza ngomoya adingeka kakhulu, okuzokwenza ukuthi lawo magagasi asetshenziselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ze-inthanethi esheshayo.

src: Kabinete e nopoletswe ka ga diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Ditshupetso tsa Boitshimololedi le tsa Saense le Thekenoloji mo Aforika Borwa ya 2014 mmogo le setlwaedi sa tiragatso ya Thulaganyo ya Boitshimololedi ya Naga (NSI), tse di tlhagisiwang ngwaga le ngwaga ke Lekgotla la Dikeletso ka Boitshimololedi la Bosetšhaba.
tgt: Lokhu kuzobeka umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika esimweni sokuncintisana neminotho yakwamanye amazwe ngokuthi kuvuselelwe imboni yezokusakaza, kuqiniswe imboni yezama-elekthronikhi, kuvulwe amathuba omsebenzi futhi kwandiswe isibalo sezinhlelo zomsakazo ezivutshelwe ngaphakathi kuleli kanye nezinhlelo ezizokwanelisa izidingo zabantu abahlukahlukene.8 IKhabhinethi ithulelwe ulwazi ngalokho okutholwe wuMbiko wezi-2014 Wezinkomba Zesayensi, Ubuchwepheshe kanye Nokusungulwa Nokuqanjwa Kwemikhiqizo Nezinhlelo Ezintsha eNingizimu Afrika nezinqubo zakamuva eziphathelene nokusebenza koHlelo Lukazwelonke Lokusungulwa Nokuqanjwa Kwemikhiqizo Nezinhlelo (i-NSI) ezintsha, okhishwa njalo ngonyaka nguMkhandlu Kazwelonke Wezokweluleka mayelana Nokusungulwa Nokuqanjwa Kwemikhiqizo Nezinhlelo Ezintsha.

src: Pegelo e dirisa ditshupetso tse di diphatsa go ka sekaseka tiragatso le seabe sa NSI mo ditlapeleng tse di botlhokwa tsa bosetšhaba tse di tlhagisitsweng ke Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) mmogo le ditokomane tse dingwe tsa dipholisi tse di nang le seabe mo tlhabololong ya ikonomi ya loago.
tgt: Lo mbiko usebenzisa izinkomba ezisemqoka kakhulu ngenhloso yokuhlola umsebenzi we-NSI kanye negalelo layo kwizinto ezibalulekile eziseqhulwini kuleli njengoba zibekwe ngokucacile oHlelweni Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) kanye nezinye izincwajana eziphathelene nezinqubomgomo ezilekelelayo ekuthuthukisweni kwenhlalo-mnotho yabantu bakuleli.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go phosololwa ga dikgotlatshekelo tsa magiseterata tebang le Limpopo le Mpumalanga, mmogo le go tlhomiwa ga Kgotlatshekelo ya Magiseterata ya Lephalale jaaka kantoro ya tikologo ya Karolo ya Limpopo, go nna monamaotshwere go fitlhelela kantoro ya tikologo ya karolo ya leruri e agiwa mo lefelong leo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukuhlelwa kabusha kwezifundankantolo (zezimantshi) eLimpopo naseMpumalanga, kanye nokuqokwa kweNkantolo Kamantshi yaseLephalale njengesizinda sesikhashana soPhiko lwaseLimpopo lweNkantolo Ephakeme, kuze kufike isikhathi lapho kuzokwakhiwa khona isizinda esizimele ngasodwana esizosebenza ngokugcwele soPhiko lweNkantolo Ephakeme kule ndawo.

src: Go phosololwa ga dikgotlatshekelo tsa magiseterata mmogo le mafelo a taolo a Dikarolo tsa Kgotlatshekelo e Kgolo ka karolo ya ntšhwafatso ya pholisi maitlhomo a yone ke go baakanya lefa la thulaganyo ya bodulo e e sa siamang ya mo malobeng.
tgt: Ukuhlelwa kabusha kwezifunda-nkantolo zezimantshi kanye negunya lokwengamela leziMpiko zeNkantolo Ephakeme kuyingxenye yezinguquko okuhloswe ngazo ukulungisa ukhondolo lwesikhathi esedlule lokuklanywa kwezifunda-nkantolo ngendlela engenabo ubulungiswa.

src: Ke karolo gape ya phetolothefosano e e namileng go ka thusa go ka fitlhelela bosiamisi, e leng seo se lepalepisitsweng le Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa ya 1996.
tgt: Futhi kuyingxenye yezinto eziphoqelekile zokuqinisekisa ukulethwa koguquko olubanzi ngenhloso yokwenza ngcono ukutholakala kobulungiswa, okuyinto ehambelana noMthethosisekelo WeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika we-19.10 IKhabhinethi iwamukelile umbiko ophathelene nenqubekelaphambili eseyenziwe ekuqalisweni kweziqondiso zeKhabhinethi esifundazweni saseLimpopo ngaphansi kweSigaba 100 (1)

src: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo ka ga kgatelopele mabapi le go tsenngwatirisong ga ditaelo tsa Kabinete kwa Limpopo go ya ka Karolo ya bo 100 (1)
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukuhoxiswa kweziqondiso zeSigaba 100 (1)

src: go fitlha ka Mopitlwe 2016 mo mafapheng a a latelang a porofense ya Limpopo: Lefapha la Boitekanelo Lefapha la Dipalangwa Lefapha la Ditirelo tsa Puso Lefapha la Ditsela le Mafaratlhatlha go akaretsa le Lefapha la Matlole.
tgt: ngaphambi komhla zingama-31 kuNdasa 2016 kule minyango yesifundazwe elandelayo: Owezempilo Owezokuthutha Owezemisebenzi Yomphakathi Owezemigwaqo Nengqalasizinda kanye neHhovisi likaMgcinimafa.

src: Kabinete gape e amogetse go gogelwa morago ga nakwana ga Karolo ya bo 100 (1)
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile futhi ukuhoxiswa, ngaphansi kwemibandela ethile, kweziqondiso zeSigaba 100 (1)

src: mo Thuto go ka ala tsela gore Lefapha la Matlole la Porofense le tsenya ka matlhagatlhaga Karolo ya bo 18 ya Molao wa Botsamaisi jwa Madi a Puso (PFMA), 1999 (Molao wa bo 1 wa 1999) kwa Lefapheng la Thuto la Limpopo, ka tshegetso go tswa kwa pusong ya bosetšhaba.
tgt: eMnyangweni Wezemfundo ngenhloso yokulungiselela ukuthi iHhovisi likaMgcinimafa Esifundazweni likwazi ukuqalisa ngokuphelele iSigaba 18 soMthetho Wezokuphathwa Kwezimali Zikahulumeni, we-1999 (uMthetho Nombolo 1 we-1999) eMnyangweni Wezemfundo eLimpopo, ngokusekelwa nguhulumeni kazwelonke.

src: Kabinete e amogetse ditaelo tse di latelang tebang le Tonakgolo le Bakhuduthamaga (di-MEC) tsa Matlole le tsa Thuto:a) Go tlamela ka badiredi mafapha a porofense ka go thapa badiredi ba ba gaisangb) Go konosetsa go thapa botsamaisi jo bogolo lec) Go samagana ka tshwanelo le go retelelwa le bogwenegwene jwa boeteledipele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamukelile lezi ziqondiso ezilandelayo ezibhekiswe kuNdunankulu nakuNgqongqoshe Wesifundazwe Wezezimali kanye Nowezemfundo:a) Ukulekelelwa kweminyango yesifundazwe ukuthi ikwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ogculisayo ngokuthi kuqashwe abasebenzi abanekhono futhi abakhutheleb) Ukuphothulwa kwenqubo yokugcwaliswa kwezikhala zomsebenzi ezikhona ezingeni labaphathi kanyec) Nokubhekana ngqo nenkinga yokuhluleka kwabaphathi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo ngendlela efanelekile kanye nokulwisana nesihlava senkohlakalo.11 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isingathe iNgqungquthela esemazingeni aphezulu yeziNgxoxo Zokufakana Imilomo Ngodaba Lokulwisana Nezidakamizwa ezobanjwa kusukela mhla ziyi-11 kuze kube mhla ziyi-12 kuNdasa 2016, ngokusekelwa yiNhlangano Yamazwe ase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore Aforika Borwa e tshware Khonferense ya maemo a a kwa godimo ya Dipuisano tse di leng Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi go simolola ka la bo 11 go fitlha ka la bo 12 Mopitlwe 2016, e leng seo se tla nnang ka fa tlase ga taolo ya Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU).Seno se diragadiwa jaaka kopano ya go lekola ya Dipuisano tse di Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi magareng ga Aforika le Russia, e leng seo se ikaeletseng go tlhagisa maemo a a kopanetsweng tebang le go samagana le mathata a lefatsha a a ka ga diritibatsi.
tgt: Lesi isigcawu sokulandelela emva kweZingxoxo Zokufakana Imilomo ezabe ziphakathi kwezwe lase-Russia kanye namazwe ase-Afrika, okuhloswe ngaso ukwethula umbono owodwa futhi ofanayo, okhombisa ubumbano nokuvumelana mayelana nokulwisana nenkinga yezidakamizwa emhlabeni.

src: Seno se tla tlhagisiwa kwa Kopanong e e Itlhophileng ya UNGA ka Moranang 2016.Ntwa kgatlhanong le diritibatsi tseo di seng mo molaong e tsamaisana le NDP e bile Dipuisano eno e tla tlhagisa serala sa go ka tsweletsa go gagamatsa Leano la Botlhokwa la Diritibatsi la Bosetšhaba (2013-2017).
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwethulwa kwiSigcawu Esikhethekile se-UNGA esizobajwa ngoMbasa 2016.Impi yokulwisana nezidakamizwa ezingekho emthethweni iyahambelana nalokho okushiwo yi-NDP futhi lezi ziNgxoxo zizohlinzeka ngethuba lokuphucula uHlelo Lukazwelonke Lokulwisana Nezidakamizwa (lowezi-2013-2017) ukuze lube ngolungcono kakhulu kunakuqala.12 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi uMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu usingathe ingqungquthela, okuzobanjiswana kuyona noHlelo Lwenhlangano Yezizwe Lwezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu, ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi “Ukuhola Ukulethwa Koguquko Edolobheni: Oluzophendula Imijondolo ibe Yizindawo Zokuhlalisa Abantu Ezibandakanya Umuntu Wonke, Eziphephile, Ezinohlonze futhi Ezisimeme” ezoba ngoNdasa 2016.Le ngqungquthela izosekela i-ajenda yamazwe omhlaba yezentuthuko futhi isekele ne-ajenda yakuleli ngokuqinisa ukwesekwa kweNjongo ye-11 Yezinjongo Zentuthuko Esimeme: Yokwenza Amadolobha nezindawo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu zibe ngezibandakanya umuntu wonke, eziphephile, ezinohlonze futhi ezisimeme.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore Lefapha la Bonno jwa Batho le tshware mmogo Khonferense le Lenaane la Bonno jwa Batho la “Ketelelopele ya Diphetogo mo Motseteropong: go tswa kwa megoafatsheng go lebisa kwa Bonnong jwa Batho jo bo akaretsang botlhe, jo bo babalesegileng, jo bo sa Tseweng ke Ditsuatsue le jwa Leruri” ka Mopitlwe 2016.Khonferense e tshegetsa maphata ka bobedi e leng lephata la tlhabololo la boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le lephata la tlhabololo la fa gae ka go gagamatsa tshegetso Peelong ya bo 11 ya Dipeelo tsa Tlhabololo ya Leruri: Go dira gore diteropokgolo le bonno jwa batho di fitlhelesege, di babalesege, di se tsewe ke ditsuatsue mme e nne tsa leruri.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iyingxenye yezingxoxo zokuqaliswa kwe-Ajenda Yenhlangano Yezizwe Yokuletha Intuthuko ezolandelwa emva konyaka wezi-2015 kanye “ne-Ajenda Entsha Yezindawo Ezisemadolobheni” ezokwamukelwa futhi ilandelwe yiNhlangano Yezizwe ngowezi-20.13 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi uMkhandlu Wocwaningo Lwezolimo usingathe iNgqungquthela yesithathu Yamazwe Omhlaba Ephathelene Nocwaningo Lwezolimo Okuhloswe Ngalo Ukuletha Intuthuko ezobanjwa ngoMbasa 2016.

src: Khonferense ke karolo ya dipuisano tse di ka ga go tsenngwatirisong ga Lenaneo la Tlhabololo la Dinagakopano (UN) la morago ga 2015 mmogo le “Lenaneo le Lentšhwa la Teropo” leo le tla amogelwang ke Dinagakopano (UN) ka 2016.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela izohlonza ucwaningo lwamazwe ngamazwe kanye nezinto eziseqhulwini eziphathelene nokuqanjwa nokusungulwa kwemikhiqizo nezinhlelo ezintsha ngenhloso yokufezekisa izinjongo zentuthuko yesikhathi esizayo, ikakhulukazi ukuze kuhlomule abalimi abangamalunga omndeni owodwa abalima, balawule futhi basebenze epulazini okungelabo, futhi ukuze kuhlomule nemiphakathi ehlwempu.

src: Melaotlhomo.
tgt: Imithethosivivinywa.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe Molaotlhomo wa Tiromaano ya Sekgoba sa kwa Mawatleng wa 2015 gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wezokuhlelwa Kokuhlaliswa Kwabantu Ezindaweni Ezakhelene Nolwandle wezi-2015 ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Molaotlhomo yoo o abelana ka letlhomeso la semola go ka bulela bokgoni jwa ikonomi ya kwa mawatleng ka go rotloetsa tiromaano ya sekgoba sa dikoporasi.
tgt: Lo mthethosivivinywa uhlinzeka ngohlaka lomthetho oluzoveza ukuthi ulwandle lungaba negalelo elingakanani kwezomnotho, ngokuthi kugqugquzelwe ukubambisana ekuhlelweni kokuhlaliswa kwabantu kwizindawo ezakhelene nolwandle.

src: Molaotlhomo o tla thusa ditheo tseo di leng gone ga jaanong tsa Operation Phakisa.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uzolekelela izinhlaka ezikhona njengamanje ze-Operation Phakisa.

src: o batla go rotloetsa tirisanommogo le dithulaganyo tse di nang le maikarabelo tsa bobusi jwa mawatle.
tgt: Ngalokhu kuhloswe ukugquguzela ubambiswano kanye nokulawulwa kwezasolwandle ngendlela ephusile.

src: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o tla etelela pele mokete wa naga wa Letsatsi la Poelano ka la bo 16 Sedimonthole kwa Port Elizabeth, Kapa Botlhaba ka fa tlase ga moono: "Go fokotsa dikgaogano: Go aga Legae la Setšhaba sa Aforika Borwa se se lebisang kwa pusong e tlhabololang setšhaba.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzohola umgubho woSuku Lokubuyisana ozobanjwa kuleli mhla ziyi-16 kuZibandlela e-Port Elizabeth, esifundazweni saseMpumalanga Kapa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sivala igebe: Sakha isizwe saseNingizimu Afrika esiyimbumba, njengoba siphokophele ekwakheni isizwe esithuthukayo”.

src: Tona ya Lefapha la Mafaratlhatlha a Ditlhaeletsano le Ditirelo tsa Poso, Ngaka Siyabonga Cwele, o tla etelelapele baemedi ba Aforika Borwa kwa UNGA kwa Samiting ya Lefatshe ya Setlhopha sa Tshedimosetso go tloga ka la bo 15 go fitlha ka la bo 16 Sedimonthole 2015, mo maemo a naga ya Aforika Borwa, a tla nnang le seabe mo go WSIS+10 mo go ka se tlhagisiweng Pampiri-Epe.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezengqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi, uDkt Siyabonga Cwele, uzohola ithimba elizokwethamela iNgqungquthela Yamazwe Omhlaba Yomphakathi Wezolwazi (i-WSIS), ezobanjwa yi-UNGA kusukela mhla ziyi-15 kuya kumhla ziyi-16 kuZibandlela 2015, lapho kuzokwethulwa khona umbono nokucabanga kweNingizimu Afrika, ngenhloso yokufaka isandla ezingxoxweni ze-WSIS+10, okuyizingxoxo ezingeyona ingxenye yezethulo ezisemthethweni.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mo Mererong e e Botlhokwa ya ga jaana.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni eziqavile ezisematheni.

src: Aforika Borwa e tshwere ka aktlego Samiti ya bo supa ya Diteropokgolo tsa Aforika le dipusoselegae tsa Aforika kwa Johannesburg go tloga ka la bo 29 Ngwanaitseele go fitlha ka la bo 3 Sedimonthole 2015.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isingathe ngempumelelo iNgqungquthela Yesikhombisa Yamadolobha ase-Afrika ebihanjelwe yizithunywa ebezimele amadolobha nohulumeni basekhaya base-Afrika, ebibanjelwe eGoli kusukela mhla zingama-29 kuLwezi kuya kumhla zi-3 kuZibandlela 2015.

src: Ka fa tlase ga moono: “Go baakanya bokamoso jwa Aforika le batho: seabe sa bothati jwa selegae jwa Aforika mo lenaaneng la 2063 la Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika” samiti, eo e ngoketseng dimeyara di le 15 000 le dikhanselara di le 500 000, ke enngwe ya matsholo a a matla a go aga tshwaraganelo ya Aforika.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ebihanjelwe yizimeya eziyi-15 000 kanye namakhansela ayizi-500 000 futhi ebibanjwe ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ukusungula nokuqalisa izinhlelo zokwenza ingomuso le-Afrika kube ngeliqhakazile, ngokubambisana nabantu: igalelo loMasipala base-Afrika kwi-Ajenda yowezi-2063 yeNhlangano Yamazwe ase-Afrika”, ingenye yezindlela ezinohlonze futhi eziphathekayo zokwakha ubumbano kwelase-Afrika.

src: Samiti e ne e tsepamisitse mogopolo mo go matlafatseng dipusoselegae go ralala le kontinente ya Aforika, bogolosegolo botsamaisi jwa matlole le go tlhola motheo wa lotseno lo lo babalesegileng, gore go fitlhelelwa Lenaneo la 2063 la – Aforika yo re mo batlang.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela yabe igxile ekuqiniseni ohulumeni basekhaya kulo lonke izwekazi lase-Afrika, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokusungulwa kwemithombo ethembekile yokungenisa imali ukuze kufezekiswe i-Ajenda yowezi-2063 – yokuqinisekisa ukuthi izwekazi lase-Afrika liba yilelo esilifunayo.

src: Samiti eno e tshegetsa dipeelo tsa NDP mo diteropokgolo le dipusoselegae di tshamekang karolo e e botlhokwa mo tlhabololong ka botlalo.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela isekela izinjongo ze-NDP lapho amadolobha kanye nohulumeni basekhaya bedlala indima ebalulekile kwintuthuko yethu yonkana.

src: Kabinete e tswelela go itshepa gore fa dipuisano di tswelela kwa Khoferenseng ya Makoko ya bo 21 (COP21) tebang le Letlhomeso la Tumelano ya Dinagakopano tebang le Phetogo ya Maemo a Loapi (UNFCCC), tumelano e e sa tseeng letlhakore e e tshwaraganyang maphata otlhe e tla amogelwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isenalo ithemba lokuthi ezingxoxweni eziqhubekayo kwiNgqungquthela Yamazwe Abambe Iqhaza (i-COP21) yesigcawu sama-21 soHlaka Lwesivumelwano Senhlangano Yezizwe Esiphathelene Nokuguquguquka Kwesimo Sezulu (i-UNFCCC), kuzofinyelelwa esivumelwaneni esingachemile futhi esizoba yisibopho kuwo wonke amazwe abambe iqhaza.

src: Phetogo ya maemo a loapi ke bothata jwa lefatshe lotlhe mme go tlhokega tharabololo ya lefatshe lotlhe, e leng seo se ka baakanngwang ka tshwanelo ke dipuso di le mmalwa, ka fa tlase ga tetlelelo ya UNFCCC le makoko otlhe a tsaya WEBTOKEN Aforika Borwa re ka bua ka boikgantsho gore re tsentsetirisong dipholisi tse di mafolofolo e bile e le tsa boitshimololedi tse di gatelang pele, mmogo le maano a a samaganang le maemo a loapi a a fetogetseng ruri.
tgt: Ukuguquguquka Kwesimo Sezulu yinkinga yomhlaba wonke edinga isixazululo somhlaba wonke, futhi lena yinkinga engaxazululwa kuphela ngokuthi wonke amazwe omhlaba abambisane, ngaphansi kwesivumelwano esibanzi se-UNFCCC okumele sihlonishwe futhi silandelwe yiwona wonke amazwe ayingxenye yaso, futhi kumele wonke amazwe adlale indima ebonakalayo.

src: Dipholisi tseno di laolwa ke metheo e e reretsweng ruri ya tlhabololo ya leruri, e leng karolo e e botlhokwa thata ya Ponelopele ya 2030 jaaka go tlhagelela mo NDJaaka e le kopano ya bofelofelo ya Kabinete monongwaga wa 2015, kabinete e eletsa maAforika Borwa otlhe matlhatsi le matlhogonolo mo pakeng e e tlang ya khunologo.
tgt: Thina eNingizimu Afrika, singasho kugcwale umlomo ukuthi sisungule izinqubomgomo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, ezenzelwe ukubhekana nesimo esiphila ngaphansi kwaso njengamanje kanye nanoma isiphi esinye isimo esiqubukayo, ezikhombisa inkuthalo nokusukumela phezulu, futhi sisungule nezinhlelo zokubhekana nesimo sezulu esiguquguqukayo ngaso sonke isikhathi.

src: Ka mowa wa setlha seno le ka go tsweletsa mowa wa Botho, Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go ka thusa batho le malapa a a tlhokang mo ditšhabeng tsa bobone.
tgt: Lezi zinqubomgomo ziholwa ngumgomo obanzi wokuletha intuthuko esimeme, oyinsika yeNhloso-Mbono yowezi-2063 oqukethwe yi-NDP.3 Njengoba lona kungumhlangano weKhabinethi wokugcina wezi-2015, iKhabhinethi ithanda ukudlulisa izilokotho ezinhle kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngalesi sikhathi samaholide kaKhisimusi.

src: Re setšhaba se se tlhokomelanang, se se tlhotlanang mme e bile se tlhokomela bao ba humanegileng.
tgt: Ngaphansi komoya wesikhathi samaholide kaKhisimusi futhi ngokulandela umoya woBuntu, iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi balekelele abantu abahlwempu nabantulayo kanye nemindeni edla imbuya ngothi emiphakathini abahlala kuyona.

src: Ngwaga o Mošwa o o tlang o neela botlhe tšhono ya go ikana gape go direla bokamoso jo bo botoka mo go botlhe.
tgt: Thina siyisizwe esinakekelanayo, esihloniphanayo futhi esibalekelelayo abantu abantulayo.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso a yone le kutlwelobotlhoko kwa go ba lelapa le ditsala tsa Mohamed Ismail (“Issy”) Dinat, yo a ragileng kgamelo ka Labobedi, 8 Sedimonthole.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukudlulisa amazwi enduduzo kanye nokuzwelana kwayo nomndeni nabangani ba-Mohamed Ismail (“Issy”) Dinat, odlule emhlabeni ngoLwesibili mhla ziyisi-8 kuZibandlela.

src: Go se inaganele a le esi ga gagwe mmogo le mo go nneng le seabe ga gagwe mo kgaratlhong go nnile le seabe mo go iponeleng kgololesego ya rona.
tgt: Ukukhathalela kwakhe abanye abantu kanye negalelo lakhe elikhulukazi emzabalazweni wenkululeko kwasilekelela kakhulu ekutheni sithole inkululeko.

src: Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi.
tgt: AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikezwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Khomišene ya Dipatlisiso tsa Metsi:a) Ngaka Nozibele Mjoli (Monnasetulo)b) Moporofesara Sibusiso Vil-Nkomo (Motlatsamonnasetulo)c) Moporofesara Aldo Stroebeld) Mme Nompumelelo Msezanee) Ngaka Mosidi Makgaef) Mme Masaccha Khulekelwe Mbonambig) Rre Mxolisi Adolphius Cassius Ndhlovuh) Ngaka Ntombifuthi Patience Nala andi) Baemedi go tswa kwa Lefapheng la Saense le Thekenoloji.

tgt: Nksz Thulisile Glory Manzini oqashwe njengo-DDG: oPhikweni Lwezokuphatha e-DTPS.

src: Fa re digela, Kabinete e leboga maAforika Borwa ao a obametseng tsa lekgetho ka go tsenya dipusetso tsa bone tsa lekgetho e leng seo se dirileng gore go nne le palogotlhe ya dipusetso tsa lekgetho di le 5.94 milione tse di amogetsweng tsa baobamelalekgetho.
tgt: Uma sesiphothula, iKhabhinethi ithanda ukudlulisa amazwi okubonga kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abawathumelile amafomu abo entela, okuyinto eyenze ukuthi inani lamafomu entela athunyeliwe lifinyelele kwizigidi ezingu-.Leli nani lingaphezulu ngamaphesenti ayi-11.52 uma liqhathaniswa nenani lowezi-2014, futhi isibalo sabantu abathumele amafomu abo entela ngesikhathi esibekiwe libe ngaphezulu kwamaphesenti angama-90, osekwenzeke iminyaka emithathu ilandelana.

src: Kobamelo e e jaaka eno ya maemo a a kwa godimo e thusa puso go abelana ka ditirelo tse di tokafatsang boleng jwa matshelo a baagi WEBTOKEN pakeng eno ya khunulogo, puso e tsenyatirisong matsholo a a farologaneng a a tlhokang gore maAforika Borwa otlhe mmogo le baeng ba yone go tshameka karolo ya bone mo go netefatseng gore ba keteka paka ya khunulogo mo tikologong e e babalesegileng e bile e sireletsegile.
tgt: Leli nani eliphezulu kangaka lokuthunyelwa kwamafomu entela kwenza uhulumeni akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingongqangi ezizokwenza ngcono izinga lempilo yazo zonke izakhamuzi zakuleli.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo go botlhe go dirisana mmogo le Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ngalesi sikhathi samaholide kaKhisimusi, uhulumeni useqalise imikhankaso ehlukahlukene edinga ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nabavakashi badlale indima yabo ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi isikhathi samaholide kaKhisimusi sithokozelwa ngaphansi kwesimo esiphephile futhi esivikelekile.

src: (SAPS) le go bega tiragalo efe kgotsa efe ya bosenyi mo malapeng le mo ditšhabeng tsa WEBTOKEN go kgoneng gore go amogelwe thologelo ya baeti ba ba kgabaganyang melelwane, mafapha otlhe a puso kwa meeding ya go tsena mo nageng go simolola ka la bo 10 Sedimonthole 2015 go fitlha ka la bo 14 Ferikgong 2016 go tla atolosiwa diura tsa one tsa tirelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu ukuthi basebenzisane noMbutho Wamaphoyisa ase-Ningizimu Afrika futhi kumele sibike emaphoyiseni nanoma isiphi isenzo sobugebengu esenzeka emakhaya ethu nasemphakathini.

src: One a tla akaretsa Lefapha la Boitekanelo, Lefapha la Temothuo, SAPS, Lefapha la Merero ya Selega le Tirelo ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa (SARS).
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya uMnyango Wezempilo, Nowezolimo, Nowezamaphoyisa, Nowezasekhaya kanye Nophiko Lwezokuqoqwa Kwentela lwaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kopane go buisana ka maemo a ikonomi le merero e e amang tekanyetsokabo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibambe umhlangano ngenhloso yokubhunga ngesimo somnotho kanye nezindaba ezihlobene nalokhu eziphathelene nesabelomali.

src: Kabinete e ne ya amogela dintlha tse dintsi tse di amang ikonomi ya naga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphawule izinto ezimbadlwana ezinomthelela emnothweni wakuleli.

src: Maemo go ralala lefatshe a koafetse mo dikgweding tse di fetileng.
tgt: Kulezi zinyanga ezedlule zehlile izilinganiso zesimo somnotho emhlabeni jikelele.

src: Kgolo e e bokoa ya lefatshe lotlhe e supa tiragatso e e bokoa le dikotsi tse di kwa godimo mo dinageng tse di botlhokwa tse di tlhabologang, go akaretsa China.
tgt: Ukukhula kancane komnotho womhlaba kukhombisa ikakhulukazi ukungaqhubi kahle kanye nobungozi obuphakeme emazweni asathuthuka amaningi asemqoka, kubandakanya nezwe lase-China.

src: Poelomannong e e amogelegang e e solofelwang kwa USA e ka baka tlhatlogo ya dieelo tsa morokotso go ralala lefatshe.
tgt: Ukusimama komnotho okubhekwe ngabomvu kwelaseMelika kungenzeka kuholele ekukhuphukeni kwamazinga enzalo emhlabeni jikelele.

src: Methamo e e ka fa tlase ga kgatelelo ya kgwebisano le maemo a a sa iketlang mo mebarakeng ya lefatshe ya matlole di gatelela tlhokego ya gore ditšhaba di tlhome tsepamo le go gata ka tlhoafalo mo dipakeng tse di latelang.
tgt: Ukwehla komthamo wokuhwebelana kanye nezinkinga zokungaqhubi kahle kwezimakethe zamazwe omhlaba kugcizelela isidingo sokuthi amazwe athathe izinyathelo ezinohlonze, futhi enze izinto ngokucophelela okukhulu kulesi sikhathi esizayo.

src: Kabinete e ne gape ya amogela gore go na le dipoelo dingwe tse di siameng ka ntlha ya tlhwatlhwa e e kwa tlase ya oli e e sa tlhotlhiwang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphawulile futhi ukuthi kukhona imihlomulo ethile etholakalayo ngenxa yentengo ephansi kawoyela ongahluziwe.

src: Jaaka moromelantle wa diphatlho o mogolo, Aforikaborwa e tlhobaediwa ke bokoa bo bo tswelelang ba ditlhwatlhwa tsa diphatlho.
tgt: Njengelizwe eliyisikhondlakhondla ekuthunyelweni kwemikhiqizo yezimbiwa emazweni angaphandle, iNingizimu Afrika ikhathazekile ngesimo esiqhubekayo samanani aphansi entengo yezimbiwa.

src: Puso e tswelela go agelela mo maemong a ikonomi ya naga a mefutafuta, le dipoelo tsa thomelontle di tswelela go ikaega go le gontsi ka dimetale le dire tse di tlhotlhilweng go se kae.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokwakha uhlaka lwezomnotho olugxile emikhiqizweni ehlukahlukene, futhi imali etholakala ngokuthunyelwa kwempahla zohwebo emazweni angaphandle isancike kakhulu kwimikhiqizo esansimbi kanye nemikhiqizo engakalungiswa ngokuphelele.

src: Go wa ga ditlhwatlhwa tsa diphatlho go ka se dirologe ka bonako.
tgt: Ukwehla kwamanani entengo yezimbiwa akubonakali kuyinto ezophela khona maduze nje.

src: Se se tla nna le ditlamorago tse di tla tswelelang mo ikonoming ya Aforika Borwa le tsa dinaga tse dingwe tse dintsi tse e leng balekane ba rona mo kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Lokhu kusazowukhahlameza isikhathi eside umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika futhi kukhahlameze namazwe amaningi esihwebelana nawo kwizwekazi lase-Afrika.

src: Kwelotlase ya Ranta mo dingwageng di le mmalwa tse di fetileng e tlamela ka ditšhono tse di botoka tsa kgolo ya thomelontle mme, mmogo le tlhwatlhwa e e kwa tlase ya oli, e thusitse go fokotsa kgatelelo mo akhaontong ya matlole ya naga.
