tgt: Ukwehla kwamandla eRandi kule minyaka embalwa edlule kuhlinzeka ngamathuba angcono kakhulu okukhulisa umthamo wempahla ethunyelwa emazweni angaphandle futhi lokhu kanye nentengo ephansi kawoyela ongahluziwe, kulekelelile ekwehliseni ingcindezi emgodlagodleni wezimali kahulumeni wakuleli.

src: Le fa go le jalo, kgolo e e bokoa mo balekaneng ba Aforika Borwa ba kgwebisano e kaya topo e e fokotsegileng ya ditlhagiswa tsa Aforika Borwa kwa dinageng tse dingwe.
tgt: Kepha-ke, ukungakhuli kahle kweminotho yamazwe ahwebelana neNingizimu Afrika sekuholele ekutheni sehle isidingo sokuthengwa kwezimpahla zaseNingizimu Afrika emazweni angaphandle.

src: Maemo a lefatshe a tsewa a gwetlha mo mebarakeng e e alogang, ka ditlhwatlhwa tse di kwa tlase tsa diphatlho le go gagamadiwa ga pholisi ya ditšhelete kwa USA e leng se se beileng kgatelelo mo kelelong ya madi le ditsholofelo tsa kgolo.
tgt: Isimo sezomnotho esikhona njengamanje emhlabeni jikelele sithathwa njengesiyinselelo enkulu, ikakhulukazi emazweni asafufusa, ngenxa yenani eliphansi lentengo yezimbiwa kanye nokuqiniswa kwenqubomgomo yezezimali yaseMelika, okuyinto efake ingcindezi kwizilinganiso zokungena nokuphuma kwezimali kanye nokukhula komnotho.

src: Se, se bakile ketsaetsego mo mebarakeng ya madi.
tgt: Lokhu sekulunciphise kakhulu uzinzo ezimakethe zezimali.

src: Ranta ya Aforika Borwa, e leng lengwe la madi a mebaraka e e alogang le go gwebisanwang thata ka lona, e utlwisitswe botlhoko, segolo mo dibekeng tse di sa tswang go WEBTOKEN maemong a a bokete a a lefatshe, a mo go ona diikonomi tsotlhe di lebaganeng le dikgwetlho tse dikgolo, Kabinete e gateletse tlhokego ya gore puso e tsereganye ka botlhale le ka go tsaya tshwetso go busetsa segalo sa kgolo ya ikonomi.
tgt: Kula maviki edlule, iRandi laseNingizimu Afrika, okungolunye lwezinhlobo zemali yamazwe asathuthuka okuhwebelwana ngazo kakhulu, likhahlamezeke kakhulu.

src: Puso e tla golagana le balekane ba loago, segolo kgwebo le mekgatlo ya badiri, go bopa tumalano mo dikgatong tse di kopanetsweng tse di tlhokegang go tsepamisa ikonomi, go bopa tshepo, go tsholetsa maemo a peeletso le poelo mo Aforika Borwa go ya ntlheng ya kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang.
tgt: Kulesi simo esinzima esibhekene namazwe omhlaba, iKhabhinethi iphinde yagcizelela ukuthi kunesidingo sokuthi uhulumeni angenelele ngendlela enohlonze ukuze kubuyiswe umgqigqo namandla okukhula komnotho.

src: Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba (SoNA) ka 11 Tlhakole e tla tsaya tsia tiro e. Kabinete e tiisitse mekgwa e e maatla ya go busetsa tsela e e isegang ya matlole go lebilwe koafalo e e nnileng teng mo ikonoming ya lefatshe le ditlamorago tsa yona mo gae.
tgt: UHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) luyakuhlinzekela lokhu kungenelela kukahulumeni.

src: Tona ya Matlotlo, Pravin Gordhan, o tla ribolola ditsela tse fa a ala tekanyetsokabo ya bosetšhaba ka 24 Tlhakole Tlamelo ka matlole go Thuto e KgolwaneKabinete e amogetse diphetolo mo dikabong tsa tekanyetsokabo ya bosetšhaba tse di tla fetisang matlole go thusa diyunibesithi ntle le go fetisa ditekanyetso tse di begilweng tsa tirisong ya matlole.
tgt: Futhi uhulumeni uzokwelula isandla kulabo abambisene nabo, ikakhulukazi abamabhizinisi kanye nezinyunyana zabasebenzi, ukuze kube nokuvumelana ngezinyathelo ezizothathwa ngokuhlanganyela zokuletha uzinzo emnothweni wakuleli, nokuqinisekisa ukwethenjwa komnotho, nokukhuphula izinga lokutshalwa kwezimali futhi kubuyiselwe iNingizimu Afrika emgudwini wokuqinisekisa ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya umuntu wonke.

src: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma le Tona ya Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso, Blade Nzimande, go sa le gale ba supile gore dikabo tse di tla dirisediwa gore dituelo di se tlhatlosiwe jaaka go dumelanwe mo ngwageng wa ga jaana wa dithuto, go phimola sekoloto sa baithuti sa Sekema sa Thuso ya Matlole sa Baithuti sa Bosetšhaba le go thibela kokotsego ya sekoloto se mo pakagareng.
tgt: Inkulumo Echaza Ngesimo Sezwe (i-SoNA) ezokwethulwa mhla ziyi-11 kuNhlolanja izochaza kabanzi ngalo msebenzi okumele wenziwe.

src: Mekgwa e ya tsereganyo ke tsibogo ya ditherisano di le mmalwa tse di simolotseng ka Diphalane 2015 e bile di santse di tswelela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukuthathwa kwezinyathelo ezinqala zokubuyisela leli lizwe emgudwini wezezimali osimeme, esikhathini lapho isimo sezilinganiso zokukhula komnotho ziphansi kakhulu emhlabeni jikelele kanti futhi lokhu kuyinto enomthelela emnothweni wakuleli.

src: Tona ya Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso le setlhopha sa gagwe sa bolaodi o tshwere dikopano di le mmalwa le boeteledipele ba SASCO, Makgotla a Dikemedi tsa Baithuti otlhe, Foramo ya Diyunibesithi tsa Aforika Borwa, Kopano ya Baithuti ba Aforika Borwa, boCEO ba diSETA, Mokgatlo wa Tlhabololo ya Thuto e Kgolwane le komiti ya Palamente e e nang le maikarabelo a thuto e kgolwane.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali u-Pravin Gordhan uzohlinzeka ngemininingwane ephathelene nalezi zinyathelo ngenkathi ethula isabelomali sezwe mhla zingama-24 Nhlolanja Ukuxhaswa ngezimali komkhakha wezeMfundo EphakemeIKhabhinethi izamukelile izichibiyelo ezenziwe kwizabelomali zikazwelonke ezizoholela ekutheni kuthathwe imali ebeyabelwe imiklamo ethile inikezwe amanyuvesi, ngaphandle kokuthi kwephulwe imikhawulo yokusetshenziswa kwezimali ebimenyezelwe phambilini.

src: Moporesitente o kopane gape le boeteledipele ba baithuti e bile o ba begetse ka go tlhongwa ga Khomišene e e tla lebang dintlha tse di tlhagisitsweng ka ga Thuto e Kgolwane.
tgt: Esikhathini esifushane esedlule uMongameli Jacob Zuma kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha u-Blade Nzimande bamemezele ukuthi le mali izonikezwa izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ngenhloso yokuzinxephezela njengoba kuvunyelwane ngokuthi ingakhushulwa imali yokukhokhela imfundo ephakeme ngalo nyaka wezemfundo, futhi kukhokhwe ngokuphelele sonke isikweleti semali ekweletwa abafundi abangaphansi koHlelo Lukazwelonke Lokuxhaswa Kwabafundi Ngezimali (i-NSFAS) futhi kuvinjelwe nokukhula kwalesi sikweleti esikhathini esimaphakathi.

src: Ditherisano tse di santse di tswelela pele gonne re dumela gore jaaka puso re batla go dira go bona tharabololo ya leruri.
tgt: Lezi zinyathelo zokungenelela ziyimpendulo kahulumeni kwiziphakamiso ezenziwe ezigcawini zokubonisana eziningana eziqale ngoMfumfu 2015 futhi eziqhubekayo.

src: Ditopo tsa baithuti di nyalana le maitlhomo a thulaganyo ya puso tebang le thuto.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha kanye nethimba lakhe labaphathi babambe imihlangano eminingana nabaholi be-SASCO, nayo yonke iMikhandlu Emele Abafundi (ama-SRC), neNhlangano Yabafundi BeNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika, neNyunyana Yabafundi baseNingizimu Afrika, nabaPhathi Abakhulu (ama-CEO) bama-SETA, neNhlangano Yoguquko Kwezemfundo Ephakeme kanye nekomidi lasePhalamende elengamele ezemfundo ephakeme.

src: Mo maemong a ga jaana, dibilione tsa diranta tse 2.33 di abetswe go samagana le tlhaelo mo go tlameleng diyunibesithi ka matlole ka ntlha ya tumalano ya koketso ya dituelo ka 0% ka Mo ngwageng wa ditšhelete wa 2016/17, puso e abile sešwa dibilione tsa diranta di le 2.543 tsa matlole a Puso go abelwa NSFAS go tlamela ka dikadimo tsa go thusa baithuti ba ba supilweng ke NSFAS ba le 71 753 mme ba ne ba tlametswe ka seripa fela kgotsa ba sa tlamelwa gotlhelele ka matlole mo dingwageng di le tharo tse di fetileng tsa dithuto.
tgt: UMongameli uphinde futhi wabamba umhlangano nabaholi babafundi, futhi wamemezela ukuthi kuzosungulwa iKhomishana ezocubungula izindaba eziphathelene neMfundo Ephakeme.

src: Se se kaya gore baithuti ba ba tshwanelwang ba, ba ka se ganediwe go tsweletsa dithuto tsa bona ka ntlha ya fa ba na le dikoloto tse di saletseng morago tsa diyunibesithi.
tgt: Izimfuno zabafundi ziyahambelana nezinjongo zohlelo lukahulumeni oluphathelene nezemfundo.

src: Dibilione tse dingwe tsa diranta di le 2.039 di abetswe NSFAS mo ngwageng wa ditšhelete wa 2016/17 go tshegetsa baithuti ba ba senang matlole kgotsa ba matlole a a tlhaelang ba ba santseng ba le mo diyunibesithing ka 2016 go konosetsa dithuto tsa bona.
tgt: Njengesinyathelo esiphuthumayo sokubhekana nesimo esikhona njengamanje, kubekwe eceleni isamba semali engamarandi ayizigidigidi ezingu-2.33 okuhloswe ngayo ukuvala isikhala sokushoda kwemali yokuqhuba umsebenzi wansukuzonke emanyuvesi ngenxa yesivumelwano sokungakhushulwa kwemali yokufunda ngowezi-20.

src: Matlole a ke tlaleletso mo godimo ga dibilione tsa diranta di le 10 tse NSFAS e tla di rebolang mo ngwageng wa dithuto wa 2016.Puso e ineetse go tlamela ka thuto ya morago ga sekolo, go baithuti botlhe ba ba tshwanelwang, ya mahala go batlhoki le ba maemo a a kwa tlase a badiri, mo teng ga ditekanyetso tse di diregang tsa matlole.
tgt: Ngonyaka-mali wezi-2016/17, uhulumeni ubeke eceleni imali yoMbuso engamarandi ayizigidigidi ezingu-2.543 ezokwabelwa i-NSFAS ngenhloso yokuboleka abafundi abahlonziwe abayizi-71 753 abakulungele ukuxhaswa ngezimali ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-NSFAS kodwa kule minyaka emithathu edlule abathole uxhaso lwezimali olungaphelele noma abangalutholanga uxhaso lwezimali.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go baithuti, badiri, batlhatlheledi le batsamaisi ba diyunibesithi go dirisana mmogo le puso go fitlhelela maikaelelo a. Dikgato tse di kgoreletsang dithuto kgotsa di tlholang maemo a a sa iketlang kgotsa go solofela dilo tse di ka se fitlhelelegeng, ga di na thuso epe.
tgt: Lokhu kusho ukuthi laba bafundi abakulungele ukuxhaswa ngezimali ngeke basavimbeleka ekutheni bakwazi ukuqhubeka nemfundo yabo ngenxa yemali abayikweletayo.

src: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a botlhokwa a puso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba ya ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma e e tlhagisitsweng ka Labone, 11 Tlhakole.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukele Inkulumo Echaza Isimo Sezwe kaMongameli Jacob Zuma ethulwe ngoLwesine, ziyi-11 kuNhlolanja.

src: Puo e tlhomile mosupatsela wa togamaano wa tiragatso ya Lenaanetiro la Puso.
tgt: Le nkulumo ithula umgudu wamaqhinga wokuqalisa ukusebenza kohlelo lokusebenza lukahulumeni.

src: Moporesitente o ikuetse mo pusong, mekgatlho ya badiri mmogo le mo kgwebong go dira mmogo go bona ditharabaololo tsa kgolo ya ikonomi e e nnelang leruri.
tgt: UMongameli unxuse uhulumeni, abasebenzi kanye nabamabhizinisi ukuba basebenzisane ukuthola izixazululo zokukhula komnotho okusimeme.

src: Kabinete e tshegetsa dikgato tsa go fokotsa ditshenyegelo tse di itsesitsweng ke Moporesitente tse di tla tlhalosiwang ke Tona ya Ditšhelete ka la bo 24 Tlhakole.
tgt: IKhabinethi isekela izinyathelo zokunciphisa izindleko ezimenyezelwe nguMongameli, ezizochazwa kabanzi nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali mhla zingama-24 kuNhlolanja.

src: Puo ya Tekanyetsokabo ya 2016/17 e tla tlhagisa kabelo ya ditlamelo go ya kwa manaaneng a a farologaneng a puso go ya jaaka Moporesitente a gateletse.
tgt: INkulumo Yesabelomali yonyaka wezi-2016/17 izophinda iveze ukwabiwa kwezinsizakusebenza kuzinhlelo zeminyango ezihlukahlukene njengoba kugcizelelwe nguMongameli.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Indaba ya Meepo e e atlegileng e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Motsekapa go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 11 Tlhakole.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukubanjwa ngempumelelo kweNgqungquthela Yezimayini, ebibanjelwe eDolobheni LaseKapa kusukela ziyi-8 kwaze kwaba mhla ziyi-11 kuNhlolanja.

src: Baemedi ba ba eteletseng pele go tswa kwa lephateng la meepo le dipuso tse di farologaneng tsa Aforika ba arogane megopolo ya bona malebana le ka moo lephata le ka tsamaisang dipeeletso ka teng mmogo le go dirisa ditšhono tse di leng teng mo Aforika.
tgt: Izikhulu eziqhamuka kumkhakha wezokuvukuza kanye nakohulumeni abaningana base-Afrika zabelane ngemibono yazo ukuthi lo mkhakha ungalunxenxa kanjani utshalomali uphinde usebenzise ngempumelelo amathuba akhona e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e lebogetse maitlamo a a dirilweng ke puso ya Japane a go oketsa dipeeletso tsa yona mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuthokozele ukuzibophezela okwenziwe nguhulumeni wase-Japan kokwandisa utshalomali lwakhe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse maitlamo a yona a lephata la meepo le le tsepameng e bile le dira ka katlego.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqinisekisile ukuzibophezela kwayo kumkhakha wezokuvukuza ozinzile futhi okhulayo.

src: Tumelano ya Letlhomeso la Indaseteri ya Meepo e e nnelang Leruri e tshegetsa indaseteri ya meepo mo seemong sa ga jaana se se boima.
tgt: UMhlahlandlela Wesivumelwano Semboni Yezokuvukuza Ezinzile usekela imboni yezokuvukuza esimweni samanje esinzima.

src: Puso e tswelela go tlamela ka netefaletso ya taolo mme e tla netefatsa gore go konosediwa Molaotlhomo wa Tlhabololo ya Dimenerale le Ditlamelo tsa Peteroliamo, o o fa pele ga Palamente.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokucacisa imithetho eza kusetyenziswa futhi uzoqinisekisa ukuthi uMthethosivivinywa Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezimbiwaphansi Nopethroli, osezithebeni zePhalamende, uyaphothulwa.

src: Ditshwetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Pholisi ya Bosetšhaba ya makgaolakgang ya Itekolesego, e e samaganang le dikgwetlho tse di kgoreletsang go dira sentle ga Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Itekolesego, wa 2004 (Molao wa bo 7 wa 2004).Pholisi e setse e fetile mo tsamaisong ya patlomaikutlo a setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphasise Inqubomgomo Kazwelonke Yezokugembula yokugcina, exazulula izinselele ezithiya ukusebenza ngempumelelo koMthetho Kazwelonke Wezokugembula, wezi-2004 (uMthetho we-7 wezi-2004).

src: Pholisi e tshitshinya dipaakanyo mo letlhomesong la taolo ya dipopegotheo tsa diboto tsa itekolesego mme e maatlafatsa didirisiwa tsa taolo go fokotsa tiriso e e botlhaswa ya itekolesego.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo iphakamisa izichibiyelo kumhlahlandlela wokulawula wezigungu zokugembula futhi iqinisa izindlela zokulawula ngenhloso yokunciphisa ukugembula budedengu.

src: E ama dikhasino, dibingo, metšhini e dituelo tsa yona di lekanyeditsweng mmogo le go betšha dipitsi.
tgt: Ufaka amakhasino, amabhingo, imishini ekhona izamba ezithile, kanye nokubhejela amahhashi.

src: Pholisi e tla emisetsa Boto ya Bosetšhaba ya Itekolesego ka Molaodi wa Bosetšhaba wa Itekolesego o o tla ikarabelang ka tlhamalalo kwa Lefapheng la Kgwebisano le Intaseteri.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo izoqeda Isigungu Sikazwelonke Sokugembula kungene Umlawuli Kazwelonke Wezokugembula esikhundleni saso nozokuba ngaphansi koMnyango Wezokuhweba Nezezimboni.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tlhagiso ya Pegelo ya Tshekatsheko ya Dingwagapotlana tsa go Golegwa Bosenyi kwa Palamenteng, e leng se se tlhokegang go ya ka Molao wa Bosiamisi wa Bana, wa 2008 (Molao wa bo 75 wa 2008).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukulethwa ePhalamende koMbiko Wokubuyekezwa Kweminyaka Ephansi Yokuphila Kwengqondo Ukuze Utholakale unecala lobelelesi, nokudingekayo ngokoMthetho Wezobulungiswa Bezingane, wezi-2008 (uMthetho wama-75 wezi-2008).

src: Pegelo e atlenegisa gore naga e amogela maitlamo a boditšhabatšhaba le a kgaolo malebana le dingwagapotlana tsa go golegelwa bosenyi tsa bana ba ba iphitlhelang ba na le kgotlhang le molao.
tgt: Lo mbiko uphakamisa ukuthi izwe lisebenzise izibopho zomhlaba nesifunda mayelana neminyaka ephansi yokuphila kwengqondo ukuze utholakale unecala lobelelesi lezingane eziphula umthetho.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go tsenngwa mo kaseteng ga Dikgaolo tsa Tlhabololo ya Maatla a a Ntšhwafadiwang (REDZ).
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukumenyezelwa kweZindawo Zokuphehlwa Kwamandla Asebenziseka Kabusha (i-REDZ).

src: Seno se tla rulaganya thulaganyo ya taolo, sa supa mafelo a go ka maatlafadiwang dithekenoloji tsa motlakase wa phefo le wa letsatsidi ka bonwang le moo go ka atolosiwang tlamelo ya mafaratlhatlha a a boteng gona.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqondisa izinhlelo zokulawula, kuhlonze izindawo zebalazwe lapho ubuchwepheshe be-Photovoltaic obusebenzisa umonya nelanga kungasetshenziswa khona futhi lapho kungandiswa khona kakhulu ukuphehlwa kukagesi ongena ezintanjeni zikagesi zikazwelonke.

src: Di-REDZ tseno di tla netefatsa kgabaganyo ya go ya kwa ikonoming e e tlhagisang khabone e e kwa tlase, di akofise tlhabololo ya mafaratlhatlha, le go tshwaela mo letlhomesong le le rulaganeng e bile le bonelwa pele la taolo le le fokotsang tsamaiso e e amanang le ditshenyegelo tsa go obamela.
tgt: Lawa ma-REDZ azoqinisekisa ukuguqukela kumnotho ongcolisa kancane, ukusheshiswa kokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda, kanye nokufaka isandla kumhlahlandlela ocacile noqagulekayo onciphisa izithiyo ezihlobene nezindleko zokuthobela umthetho.

src: Kabinete e boleletswe ka diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Aforika Borwa ya 2014 ya Disupi tsa Saense, Thekenoloji le Boitlhamedi mo Lekgotleng la Bosetšhaba la Bokgakolodi jwa Boitlhamedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngemiphumela Yombiko Wezinkomba ZaseNingizimu Afrika Zesayensi, Ezobuchwepheshe Nokusungula zonyaka we-2014 woMkhandlu Kazwelonke Olulekayo Wezokusungula.

src: Pegelo eno e tlamela ka mokgwa wa tiragatso wa Tsamaiso ya Bosetšhaba ya Boitlhamedi (NSI).
tgt: Umbiko uhlinzeka lokho okuvamise ukwenzeka ekusebenzeni koHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusungula.

src: E sekaseka tiragatso le tshwaelo ya NSI mo ditlapeleng tsa botlhokwa tsa bosetšhaba tse di tlhagisitsweng mo Leanong la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NPD).
tgt: Luhlola ukusebenza kanye nomthelela we-NSI emisebenzini kazwelonke eseqhulwini njengoba ivezwe kuHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kweze (i-NDP).

src: Kabinete e amogetse tiriso ya badiredisetšhaba ba ba rotseng tiro le ba ba dirang jaaka batlhatlheledi kwa Sekolokatisong sa Bosetšhaba sa Puso (NSG).NSG e tlhomilwe ka 2013, e tsena mo legatong la Setheo sa Tsamaiso le Boeteledipele jwa Botsamais jwa Thuto mo Pusong (PALAMA), mme thomo ya yona ke go tsweletsa phitlhelelo e e tswelelang ya boleng le dintlhatheo tse di laolang tsamaiso ya puso le go tokafatsa boleng, katoloso le ditlamorago tsa tlhabololo ya bokgoni jwa badiri mo ditheong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukusetshenziswa kwabafundisi bezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme esebethathe umhlalaphansi kanye nabasebenzi bakahulumeni njengabafundisi baseSikoleni Sikahulumeni Sikazwelonke (i-NSG).I-NSG yathulwa ngokusemthethweni ngonyaka we-2013, esikhundleni seSikhungo Sikahulumeni Sokuphatha Nobuholi (i-PALAMA), futhi sinegunya lokukhuthaza ukufezwa kwemigomo ebusa ukulawula kuhulumeni kanye nokwenza ngcono izinga, ubukhulu kanye nomthelela wokuthuthukiswa kwamandla ezokuphathwa kwezabasebenzi ezikhungweni.

src: Maiteko ano a tla lekelediwa ka go tsenngwa tirisong ga Lenaane le le Pateletsang la Kitsisotiro la badiredisetšhaba.
tgt: Lesi sinyathelo sizohlolwa ngokuqaliswa kokusetshenziswa koHlelo Oluphoqelekile Lokwamukelwa Kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni.

src: Mokgwa ono o kgontsha badiredisetšhaba go oketsa boleng mo tirelong setšhaba.
tgt: Le ndlela yenza ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bakwazi ukwengeza ukubaluleka emsebenzini kahulumeni.

src: Ba tla dirisa maitemogelo a bona, bokgoni le kitso go tataisa le go rotloetsa badiredisetšhaba.
tgt: Bazokhipha isipiliyoni, amakhono kanye nolwazi lwabo ukuqeqesha abasebenzi bakahulumeni.

src: Gape maiteko ano a tla tokafatsa boleng jwa ditirelo tse re di nayang setšhaba ka tsela e e bokgoni e bile e le tlhotlhwatlase.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luzophinda lwenze ngcono ngendlela eyimpumelelo futhi engabizi izinga lezinsizakalo esizihlinzeka umphakathi.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Pegelo ya Naga ya Aforika Borwa ya Legato la Bofelo la bo 3 le le malebana le go Tsenngwa tirisong ga Mokgatlho wa Tirisanommogo ya Ikonomi le Tlhabololo (OECD) (Tumelano e e kgatlhanong le Pipamolomo).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume Umbiko Wezwe LaseNingizimu Afrika Wesigaba Sokugcina sesi-3 omayelana nokuqala koKusebenza Kwenhlangano Yezentuthuko Nokubambisana Kwezomnotho (i-OECD) (Isivumelwano Sokulwa Nokufumbathisa).

src: Pegelo e tshwanetse go neelwa Setlhopha sa Tiro sa Pipamolomo sa OECD.
tgt: Umbiko uzonikezwa Iqembu Elisebenza Ngokufumbathisa le-OECD.

src: Pegelo e tlhalosa tswelelopele e e dirilweng ke naga ka ditsereganyo tsa yona tsa go fedisa pipamolomo ka go e supa, go batlisisa mmogo le go e sekisetsa.
tgt: Lo mbiko uveza inqubekela phambili eyenziwe nguhulumeni ekungeneleleni kwakhe ukuqeda ukufumbathisa okwenziwa ngabantu abavela emazweni angaphandle ngokubona, ukuphenya kanye nokushushisa amacala amayelana nakho.

src: Gape pegelo e sedimosa maiteko a a tserweng go lemosa ka bosenyi jono.
tgt: Lo mbiko uphinda uveze izinyathelo ezithathiwe ukuqwashisa ngalobu bugebengu.7 IKhabhinethi ivume ukuthi uMnyango Wezasekhaya (i-DHA) ufakwe kabusha Eqoqwaneni Lezobulungiswa, Ukuvinjelwa Kobugebengu Nezokuphepha.

src: Thomo ya Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae ke go tshola le go babalela rejisetara ya boammaaruri ya boitshupo le seemo sa botlhe ba ba mo nageng ya rona, e leng sa botlhokwa se se kgontshang ditiro tse dingwe tsotlhe tsa mmuso.
tgt: Igunya loMnyango Wezasekhaya wukugcina irejista ephephile, enolwazi okuyilonalona lomazisi kanye nesimo sawo wonke umuntu ongaphakathi kwemigcele yethu, nekwenza kwenzeke yonke eminye imisebenzi yombuso.

src: Gape le romilwe go tsamaisa tsamaiso ya bofudugedi, e e amang ka tlhamalalo pabalesego ya bosetšhaba, tirisano ya loago mmogo le phitlhelelo ya diphitlhelelo tsa WEBTOKEN malobeng DHA e ne e arogantswe jaaka ditirelo tsa tshegetso ya tsamaiso ka kakaretso ka fa tlase ga Setlhopha sa Bolaodi le Tsamaiso.
tgt: Uphinde wanikezwa igunya lokusingatha uhlelo lokufuduka, olunomthelela ngqo ekuphepheni kwezwe, ukubumbana komphakathi kanye nokufezwa kwezinhloso zentuthuko.

src: Molaotlhomo.1 Kabinete e amogetswe go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo wa Tshireletso, Tsweletso, Tlhabololo le Tsamaiso ya Kitso ya Tshimologo kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Ngaphambili i-DHA ibifakwe ngaphansi kweqoqwana likaHulumeni Nokulawulwa komsebenzi ojwayelekile wokusekela ukulawula.

src: Molaotlhomo ono ke wa go sireletsa, go tsweletsa le go tsamaisa dithulaganyo tsa Kitso ya Tshimologo.
tgt: Imithethosivivinywa.1 IKhabhinethi ikuphasisile ukwethulwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa Wokuvikela, Ukukhuthaza, Ukuthuthukiswa Nokusingathwa Kolwazi Lwendabuko.

src: O dira tlamelo ya go tlhomiwa le ditiro tsa kantoro ya Bosetšhaba ya dithulaganyo tsa Kitso ya Tshimologo, tsamaiso ya ditshwanelo tsa batshodi ba kitso ya tshimologo, go tlhamiwa le ditiro tsa phanele ya Bogakolodi ya dithulaganyo tsa kitso ya tshimologo.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa ukuvikela, ugqugquzele intuthuko nokulawula Kwezinhlelo Zolwazi lwendabuko.

src: Gape o letlelela phitlhelesego le seemo sa phitlhelesego ya kitso ya merafe ya tshimologo le ya selegae, go tlhamiwa ga thulaganyo ya bosetšhaba ya go rekotiwa ga dithulaganyo tsa kitso ya tshimologo, go kwadisiwa le go tlhomamisiwa ga badiragatsi ba tshimologo, kgokaganyo ya boitlhamedi jo bo ikaegileng ka kitso ya tshimologo.
tgt: Uhlinzeka ukusungulwa kanye nemisebenzi yehhovisi Likazwelonke Lezinhlelo Zolwazi Lwendabuko, ukuphathwa kwamalungelo abanikazi bolwazi lwendabuko, ukusungulwa kanye nemisebenzi yephaneli yokweLuleka ngezinhlelo zolwazi lwendabuko.

src: Molaotlhomo o tla tshegetsa Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Melao ya Dithoto tsa Tlhaloganyo, wa 2-13 (Molao wa bo 28 wa 2013).Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Molaotlhomo o Baakantsweng wa Makwadisetso a Dikano, wa 2015 gore go tshwaelwe mo go ona.
tgt: Uphinda uvumele ukufinyelela kanye nemibandela yokufinyelela olwazini lwemiphakathi yendabuko neyendawo, ukusungulwa kohlelo lokuqopha lwezinhlelo zolwazi lwendabuko, ukubhaliswa, ukugunyazwa kanye nokunikezwa izitifiketi kongoti bolwazi lwendabuko, ukulawulwa nokuqondiswa kokusungula okuncike olwazini lwendabuko.

src: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Makwadisetso a Dikano, wa 1937 (Molao wa bo 47 wa 1937).
tgt: Lo mthethosivivinywa uzosekela Umthetho Oyisichibiyelo Wemithetho Yobunikazi Bolwazi, wezi-2013 (uMthetho wa-28 wezi-2013).IKhabhinethi ivume ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Iregistra Yamatayitela yonyaka wezi-2015 ukuthi umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Molaotlhomo o ikaeletse go baakanya Molao wa Makwadisetso a Dikano, wa 1937 (Molao wa bo 47 wa 1937) gore go fudugiwe go tswa kwa kantorong ya dikano ya dipampiri go ya kwa go ya mokgwa wa eleketoroniki.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Weregistra Yamatayitela, we-1937 (uMthetho wama-47 we-1937).

src: O samagana le merero ya tshireletsego ka go tlamela ka kwadiso ya diphetiso jaaka badirisi ba ba mo molaong ba thulaganyo ya kwadiso ya dikano ya eleketoroniki.2 Kabinete e amogetse go itsesewe ga Molaotlhomo wa Boitekanelo jwa Dimela, wa 2015 kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuchibiyela uMthetho Wamaregistra Amatayitela, we-1937 (uMthetho wa-47 we-1937) ukuze kufudukwe kusukwa ekusebenzeni ngephepha kuyiwe kulezo ezisebenza ngobuchwepheshe ehhovisi lamatayitela.

src: Molaotlhomo o lepalepanya melao ya Aforika Borwa le maitlamo a a maleba le dipeelo go gokaganya kgwebisano ya boditšhabatšhaba e e babalesegileng e bile e sa gobelele go netefatsa kgwebisano ya naga ya selegae le ya boditšhabatšhaba ya dimela le ditlhagiswa tsa dimela.
tgt: Uxazulula izindaba zezokuphepha ngokuhlinzeka ukubhalisa kwabadlulisi bezakhiwo njengabasebenzisi abasemthethweni bohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe lokubhaliswa kwamatayitela.2 IKhabhinethi ikuvuphasisile ukulethwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa wezi-2015 Wempilo Yezihlahla.

src: Fa Molaotlhomo o setse o fetisitswe, Aforika Borwa o tla kgona go thibela go tlisiwa ga ditshenekegi le malwetsi a dinaga di sele a a tswaletsweng tse di ka anamisang ditshenekegi le malwetsi a a kotsi mo dimeleng tsa naga.3 Kabinete e amogetse go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Dikgotlatshekelo tsa Molao, wa 2015 kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Lo mthethosivivinywa wenza umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika uhambisane nezibopho kanye namazinga ukwenza lula futhi kube nobulungiswa ukuhweba komhlaba ukuphephisa ukuhweba komhlaba nokwaleli lizwe ngezihlahla kanye nemikhiqizo yezihlahla.

src: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Dikgotlatshekelo tsa Bomagiseterata, wa 1944 (Molao wa bo 32 was 1944) le Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Dikgotlatshekelo tse di Kwa Godimo, wa 2013 (Molao wa bo 10 wa 2013).Paakanyo e lebeletse go fokotsa mathata a bakoloti ba ba iphitlhelang ba sotlakakiwa ke thulaganyo ya go koleka dikoloto kwa dikgotlatshekelong tsa bomagiseterata le go amogela porojeke ya Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Madirelo ya go tlosa tshedimosetso e e maswe ya sekoloto ya badirisi.
tgt: Uma lo Mthethosivivinywa usuphasile, iNingizimu Afrika izokwazi ukuvimbela ukwethulwa kwezindlela zokuhlukanisa zangaphandle zezinambuzane nezifo ezingasabalalisa izinambuzane eziyingozi kanye nezifo zezitshalo kuleli lizwe.3 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukwethulwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa wezi-2015 Ochibiyela Umthetho Wezinkantolo.

src: Maikaelelo a Molaotlhomo ke go baakanya dikarolo tsa Molao wa Dikgotlatshekelo tsa Bomagiseterata, wa 1994 (Molao wa bo 32 wa 1994) (MCA), go samagana le tshotlakako e e mo Taelong e e Baakantsweng ya Tuelo (EAO).Molaotlhomo o ikaelela go samagana le go fedisa dikatlholo tse di rebolwang e se ka fa molaong, gantsi di dirwa ke ditlelereke tsa kgotlatshekelo kwa ntle ga bookamedi jwa bosiamisi, mme gantsi ka ntlha ya go tlhoka maitemogelo, gongwe go dirisana le ba ba kolotwang, babueledi gongwe ba ba kolekang sekoloto.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wezinkantolo Zezimantshi, we-1944 (uMthetho wa-32 we-1944) noMthetho Wokuchibiyela Izinkantolo Eziphakeme, wezi-2013 (uMthetho we-10 wezi-2013).Izichibiyelo zihlose ukuphungula usizi lwabakweletayo abazithola behlukunyezwa ohlelweni lokuqoqa izikweletu ezinkantolo zezimantshi kanye nokufaka uhlelo loMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni lokususa ulwazi lwezikweletu zabathengi olungeluhle.

src: Molaotlhomo o tla netefatsa gore bakoloti ba newa katlholo e e obamelang taelo ya tuelo gongwe Taelo ya Go Tsewa ga Tuelo e e obamelang melao ya tuelo.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuchibiyela izingxenye zoMthetho Wezinkantolo Zezimantshi, we-1994 (uMthetho wa-32 we-1994) (i-MCA), ukubhekana nokusetshenziswa budedengu koMyalelo Wokuchibiyela Izinkokhelo (i-EAO).Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukubhekana futhi uqede izahlulelo ezikhishwa ngokungemthetho, kakhulukazi ngonobhala bezinkantolo ngaphandle kokubheka umthetho, izikhathi eziningi ngenxa yokungazi noma ukuhlangana nabakweletwayo, nabameli babo noma nabaqoqi bezikweletu.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforikaborweng otlhe go dirisa tšhono eo le go tlotla temokerasi e e bonweng ka bothata ka go ya go dirisa ditshwanelo tsa bona tsa go kwadisa le go tlhopha mo ditlhophong tse di tlang.2 Moporesitente o tla tsaya Leeto la Semmuso go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Islamo ya Iran go tloga ka la bo 28 go fitlha la bo 29 Tlhakole 2016.Leeto le tla maatlafatsa dipuisano tsa rona tse di tswelelang pele tsa sepolotiki le ikonomi le Iran le go susumetsa dikamano tsa Dinaga tsa Borwa jwa Mogarafatshe.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uzoqinisekisa ukuthi abakweletwayo banikezwa izahlulelo ezihambisana nomyalelo wokukhokha ngamancozuncozu noma Umyalelo Wokuthathwa Kwezinkokhelo ohambisana nemali esemthethweni ebekelwe ukuthi ikhokhwe.

src: Jaaka Molaodimogolo wa Sesole sa Tshireletso ya Naga ya Aforika Borwa (SANDF), Moporesitente Zuma o tla bo a tsamaisa kwa karolong ya botlhano ya meletlo ya Letsatsi la Matsholo a a Tlhometseng kwa Port Elizabeth, Kapabotlhaba, ka la bo 21 Tlhakole 2016.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.1 Impelaviki yokuqala yokubhalisa abavoti bebhalisela Ukhetho Lukahulumeni Wasekhaya lonyaka we-2016 kuzoqhutshwa mhla zi-5 zize zibe yi-6 Ndasa 2016.

src: Moletlo ono wa ngwaga le ngwaga o supa tshegetso le ditebogo go banna le basadi ba SANDF.3 Moporesitente Zuma o tla bua kwa pulong ya Ntlo ya Bosetšhaba ya Dikgosi/Ntlo ya Bosetšhaba ya Baeteledipele ba Setso kwa Palamenteng, Motsekapa ka la bo 26 Tlhakole 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi zisebenzise leli thuba futhi zihloniphe le ntando yeningi labantu eyatholakala kanzima ngokuthi ziye ukuyosebenzisa ilungelo lazo lentando yeningi labantu ngokubhalisa kanye nokuvota okhethweni oluzayo.2 UMongameli Zuma uzothatha Uhambo Olusemthethweni Lombuso Lokuvakashela i-Islamic Republic of Iran kusukela zi-28 zize zibe ngama-29 Nhlolanja 2016.Lokhu kuvakasha kuzoqinisa ukuxosisana kwethu okuqhubekayo ngezepolitiki nangezomnotho ne-Iran nokwenza ngcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwalawa mazwe.

src: Botsalano magareng ga puso le baeteledipele ba setso bo botlhokwa jaaka mmogo ba direla go tokafatsa matshelo a batho.4 Ka Lamatlhatso, la bo 20 Thakole 2016, Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etelela pele kemedi ya Ditona kwa Dipontshong tsa Moporesitente tsa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa kwa Grace Bible Church kwa Pimville, Soweto.
tgt: NjengoMkhuzi Omkhulu Wombutho Wezokuvikela WaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANDF), uMongameli Zuma uzophatha imibhiyozo Yosuku Lwamasosha yehlandla lesihlanu eBhayi, eMpumalanga Kapa, mhla zingama-21 Nhlolanja 2016.

src: Dipontsho tseno di tshegediwa ke mafapha a Merero ya Selegae, Badiri, Tlhabololo ya Loago le Phemelo.
tgt: Le mibhiyozo eyenziwa minyaka yonke ikhombisa ukusekela nokubonga amalungu esilisa nawesifazane e-SANDF.3 UMongameli Zuma uzokwethula inkulumo ekuvulweni Kwendlu Kazwelonke Yabaholi Bendabuko ePhalamende, eKapa mhla zingama-26 Nhlolanja 2016.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo bašweng ba lefelo leo go tsenela dipontsho, tse di tla tlamelang ka tshedimosetso ya gore ba ka tsweletsa dithuto tsa bona jang, ba itshimololela dikgwebo jang gongwe go ungwelwa mo maitekong a puso a tshegetso.5 Kabinete e amogetse go amogelwa ga Seminara ya Kgaolo ya Aforika ka ga Tshireletso ya Batho go ya ka Boitlhophelo jwa Bona jwa Bong, Boitshupo le Itlhagiso ya Bong, ke Khomišene ya Ditshwanelo tsa Botho ya Aforika Borwa, go tloga ka la bo 3 go fitlha la bo 5 Mopitlwe 2016.Seminara e tla gokaganya puisano gore go tlhaloganngwe botoka modi le go tlhagelela ga dikgwetlho tseno gore go bonwe ditharabololo tse di dirang mmogo le boitlhophelo jo bo gona mo Mebusong go samagana le dikgatako tseno.
tgt: Ubuhlobo phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nabaholi bendabuko busemqoka njengoba besebenzela ukwenza ngcono izimpilo zabantu.4 NgoMgqibelo, mhla zingama-20 Nhlolanja 2016, iPhini likaMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa uzohola ithimba loNgqongqoshe kuMbukiso Wokuthuthukiswa Kwentsha oqhutshwa nguMongameli e-Grace Bible Church ePimville, eSoweto.

src: Kabinete e eleletsa barutwana botlhe ba ba kwalang ditlhatlhobo tsa Tlaleletso tsa Setifikeiti se Segolwane/Materiki masego.
tgt: Lo mbukiso usekelwa nguMnyango Wezasekhaya, Umnyango Wezabasebenzi, Umnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi noMnyango Wezokuvikela.

src: Barutwana ba rotloediwa go fitlhelela Lenaane le le sa tswang go tlhomiwa la tshegetso la tšhono ya bobedi ya materiki le le fitlhelwang kwa diporofenseng tsotlhe mme le thusa barutwana ka dithuto tsa bona ka ditlamelo tse di farologaneng.
tgt: IKhabinethi inxusa intsha yakule ndawo ukuthi ithamele lo mbukiso, ozohlinzeka ulwazi mayelana nokuthi ingaziqhuba kanjani izifundo zayo, iqale amabhizinisi kanye nokuhlomula kuzinhlelo zokusekelwa nguhulumeni.5 IKhabhinethi ivume ukusingathwa koMhlangano Wase-Afrika omayelana noKuvikelwa Kwabantu kuncike Ekuzikhetheleni Ubulili, Ukuveza Ubulili kanye Nenkulumo, yiKhomishani Yamalungelo Esintu YaseNingizimu Afrika, kusukela mhla zi-3 zize zibe yi-5 Ndasa 2016.Lo mhlangano uzokwenza lula ukuxoxisana ukuze kube nokuqonda kwezimbangela eziyimisuka kanye nokuvela kwalezi zinselele ukuze kutholakale izisombululo ezisebenzayo ezikhona kuMbuso ukubhekana nalokhu kwephulwa komthetho.6 IKhabinethi ifisela impumelelo bonke abafundi ababhala ukuhlolwa kokuChibiyela Isitifiketi Sikamatikuletsheni.

src: Maitlhomo a Lenaane la Materiki la Tšhono ya Bobedi ke go tlamela bašwa ba ba sa kgonang go fitlhelela ditlhokego tsa Setifikeiti sa Bosetšhaba se Segolwane (NSC), tšhono ya bobedi go amogela materiki mme ka go rialo ba tokafatse boleng jwa matshelo.
tgt: Abafundi bayakhuthazwa ukuthi bamukele ngezandla zombili uhlelo lwethuba lesibili lokubhala umatikuletsheni olusanda kuthulwa ngokusemthethweni olutholakala kuzo zonke izifundazwe futhi olusiza abafundi ngezifundo zabo ngokusebenzisa izinsiza ezihlukahlukene.

src: Ditlhatlhobo tsa tlaleletso ke karolo ya Lenaane la lefapha la Tshegetso la Tšhono ya Bobedi ya Materiki mme le naya barutwana ba ba iseng ba fitlhelele ditlhokegopotlana tsa go fetisiwa le go bona setifikeiti, ba ba tlhokang dirutwa tse pedi go fitlhelela NSC, tšhono ya go dira jalo.
tgt: Inhloso yoHlelo Lwethuba Lesibili Lokubhala Umatikuletsheni ukunikeza abantu abasha ithuba lokuphasa umatikuletsheni ngaleyo ndlela benze ngcono isimo sezimpilo zabo.

src: E ikuela mo baameging botlhe ba ba nang le kgatlhego mo Thutong e Kgolwane go tshwaela mo tirong ya khomišene gore go bongwe tharabololo ya leruri ya dikgwetlho tse di lebaganeng le Thuto e Kgolwane.
tgt: Ukuhlolwa kokuchibiyela kuyingxenye yoHlelo Lomnyango Lwethuba Lesibili Lokubhala Umatikuletshenzi kanye nokuhlinzeka abafundi abangakwazanga ukuhlangabezana nemibandela yokukhushulwa neyokunikezwa isitifiketi, kodwa abadinga ukuphasa izifundo ezimbili kuphela ukuze bathole i-NSC ithuba lokwenza njalo.

src: Tona ya Ditlamelo tsa Dimenerale Mosebenzi Zwane, Tona kwa Lefapheng le le mo Kantorong ya Moporesitente Susan Shabangu le Tona ya Tlhabololo ya Loago Bathabile Dlamini - ba ba neng ba tlhomilwe ke Moporesitente Zuma go tlamela tshegetso go puso ya porofene, beng ba moepo mmogo le malapa a a amegileng go latela matlhotlhapelo a kwa Moepong wa Gauta wa Lily kwa Barberton - ba tlhaloseditse Kabinete dintlha tsa ga jaana.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni eziqavile kwezemvelo.1 UNgqongqoshe Wezezimbiwaphansi uMosebenzi Zwane, Ungqongqoshe Ehhovisini Likamongameli uSusan Shabangu kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uBathabile Dlamini – abaqokwe nguMongameli Zuma ukuthi basekele uhulumeni wesifundazwe, abaphathi bemayini nemindeni ethintekile kulandela isigameko sase-Lily Gold Mine eBarberton - bazise iKhabhinethi ngezakamumva.

src: Kabinete e ikamantse le Moporesitente ka go ikuela mo setšhabeng go baya badiri ba moepo ba ba sa ntseng ba gaeletswe ka fa tlase ga lefatshe mmogo le bamalapa a bona mo dithapelong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi njengoMongameli icela isizwe ukuthi sigcine emithandazwe nasemicabangweni abavukuzi abathathu abasavaleleke emathunjini omhlaba kanye nemindeni yabo.2 IKhabhinethi isakhathazekile ngesomiso esisalokhu siqhubekile nokuhlasela izingxenye ezithile zezwe.

src: Kabinete e sa ntse e tshwentswe ke komelelo e e sa ntseng e amile dikarolo dingwe tsa naga.
tgt: Iiphinde yazwakalisa ukubonga kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, abasekela imizamo yokusiza ezindaweni ezihlaselwe yisomiso.

src: E tlhagisitse ditebogo go maAforika Borwa otlhe, a a tshegetsang maiteko a namolo ya komelelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa ukubonga kubo bonke abananele ikwelo lokubika ukuvuza kwamazi ukusekela Umkhankaso Wokulwa Nokuvuza Kwamanzi oholwa Ungqongqoshe Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle uNomvula Mokonyane.

src: Kabinete e leboga botlhe ba ba tsibogetseng boikuelo jwa go bega go dutla go tshegetsa Letsholo la Ntwa ya go Dutla le le eteletsweng pele ke Tona ya Metsi le Bophepa Nomvula Mokonyane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabonga ngomoya wobuntu okhonjiswe yisinyathelo esiholwa yi-Operation Hydrate owenze umehluko emiphakathini ekhahlamezekile.3 IKhabhinethi idingide yaphinda yabheka imiphumela ephelele yokuqala kokusebenza koMthetho Ochibiyela Imithetho Yentela, wezi-2014.

src: Kabinete e ganetsane le go lebelela ditlamorago ka botlalo tsa go simolola go dirisiwa ga Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Melao ya Kgethiso, 2014.
tgt: Ngokwalo Mthetho, ukushintshwa kwesikhwama seprovidenti imali yaso ikhokelwe ngamancozuncozu ngenyanga kuzoqala mhla lu-1 Ndasa 2016.

src: Go ya ka Molao, go fetolelwa ga ditshiamelo tsa letlole la tlamelo go nna tse di duelwang ka paka e e rileng go tla simolola ka la bo 1 Mopitlwe 2016.
tgt: Lokho kusho ukuthi kusukela ngalolu suku imihlomulo yesikhwama seprovidenti kanye nemihlomulo yesikhwama sezimpesheni kuzolawulwa ngendlela efanayo ngokuthi uma amalungu esikhwama seprovidenti ethatha umhlalaphansi ayovunyelwa ukuthatha ingxenye yokukodwa kokuthathu njengemali eyisamba futhi ingxenye yokubili kokuthathu yemihlomulo yawo kuyomele ikhokhwe ngamancozuncozu nyangazonke.

src: Ditlamelo tseo ke tse di dirang mo ditokololong tsa matlole a phenšene ga jaana.
tgt: Njengamanje, lesi simiso siyasebenza kumalungu esikhwama sempesheni sikahulumeni.

src: Diphetogo tsa molao di ama baamogedi ba ba kwa godimo mmogo le batho botlhe ba e leng ditokololo tsa matlole a tlamelo.
tgt: Izinguquko kulo mthetho zithinta abantu abahola kakhulu kanye nabo bonke abantu abangaphansi kwezikhwama zeprovidenti.

src: Ditheo di le mmalwa le batho ba tlhagisitse matshwenyego ka go tsenngwa tirisong ga diphetogo tse dintšhwa mme ba dirile ditlhagiso kwa pusong malebana le go tsenngwa tirisong.
tgt: Izinhlangano kanye nabantu abaningi bazwakalise ukukhathazeka mayelana nokuqaliswa kokusetshenziswa kwezinguquko ezintsha futhi benza izethulo kuhulumeni mayelana nokuqaliswa kokusetshenziswa kwalezi zinguquko.

src: Go bonala gore le fa go nnile le thulaganyo e e tseneletseng ya patlomaikutlo e e dirilweng pele ga molao o ka fetisiwa, matshwenyego ao a sa ntse a le gona le gore go tshwanetse ga samaganwa le matshwenyego ao pele ka bonako go netefatsa gore fa molao o simolola go dira, diphetogo tsa ditshiamelo tsa letlole la tlamelo di tla diragadiwa sentle kwa ntle ga kgoreletsego.
tgt: Kusobala ukuthi, phezu kwezinhlelo zokuxoxisana ezenziwa ngaphambi kokuphasiswa kwalo mthetho, kusekhona ukukhathazeka futhi lokho kukhathazeka kumele kuxazululwe ngokushesha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngesikhathi umthetho uqala, izinguquko kumihlomulo yesikhwama seprovidenti ziqale ngaphandle kwezihibe futhi ngempumelelo.

src: Ka ntlha ya seo, Kabinete e sweditse go tlhagisa paakanyo ya molao ya Molao wa Paakanyo ya Melao ya Kgethiso e le ntlha e e akofileng go busetsa morago letlha la tshimologo go tloga go la bo 1 Mopitlwe 2016 go ya go la bo 1 Mopitlwe 2018 go letla gore go nne le patlomaikutlo ya baamegi ba botlhokwa gape.
tgt: Ngalesi sizathu, iKhabhinethi inqume ukuthula umthetho wokuchibiyela uMthetho Ochibiyela Imithetho Yentela ngokushesha ukuhlehlisa ukuqala kosuku lokusebenza kwezinguquko lusuka mhla lu-1 Ndasa 2016 luye mhla lu-1 Ndasa 2018 ukuze kuqhutshekwe nokuxoxisana nabo bonke abathintekayo.

src: Patlomaikutlo eno e ka baka gore go nne le paakanyo e nngwe ya melao.
tgt: Lokho kuxoxisana kungaholela kokunye ukuchitshiyelwa kwemithetho.

src: Molaotlhomo wa Paakanyo o tla tlhagisiwa mo Palamenteng mo malatsing a se kae a a latelang.
tgt: Umthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela uzobekwa ezithebeni zePhalamende ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ezizayo.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso ka ntlha ya go tlhokafala fa gautshwane ga Moitshepi Bishopo Glayton Modise wa Kereke ya International Pentecostal Holiness Church.
tgt: Amazwi enduduzo.1 IKhabhinethi lithanda ukudlulisa amazwi enduduzo ngokudlula emhlabeni koNgcwele uBhishobhi Glayton Modise we-International Pentecostal Holiness Church.

src: Bishopo Modise o eteletse pele phuthego ya ditokololo tse di fetang dimilione di le tharo go ralala borwa jwa Aforika, go latela go tlhokafala ga ga rraagwe le mosimolodi wa kereke, Moitshepi Comforter Frederick Modise ka 1996.
tgt: UBhishobhi Modise uhole leli sonto elinamalungu angaphezu kwezigidi ezintathu kuyo yonke iningizimu ne-Afrika, emva kokushona kukababa wakhe futhi ongumsunguli wesonto, Ongcwele u-Comforter Frederick Modise ngonyaka we-19.2 IKhabhinethi lithanda ukudlulisa amazwi enduduzo ngokudlula emhlabeni kwaloyo owayenguNobhala-Jikelele Wenhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) u-Boutros Boutros-Ghali.

src: Gape kabinete e romela matshediso malebana le go tlhokafala ga Mokwaledi-Kakaretso wa maloba wa Ditšhabakopano (UN) Kgosi Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
tgt: Waqala ukusebenza njenjoNobhala-Jikelele we-UN ngonyaka we-1992 ngesikhathi sokukhula kwamandla e-UN kulandela indima yayo empini yase-Gulf, esebenza ihlandla lokuphatha leminyaka emihlanu elilodwa.

src: O tlhokafaletse kwa sepetlele sa Cairo ka Labobedi a na le dingwaga tse O tla gakologelwa ka tshwaelo ya gagwe mo kagisong le temokerasi.
tgt: Ushonele esibhedlela sase-Cairo ngoLwesibili eneminyaka engama-93.

src: Kabinete e akgola Rre Kevin Govender wa Kantoro ya Motsekapa ya Bolepanaledi go lebeletswe Tlhabololo mmogo le Mokgatlho wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Bolepanaledi yo a tla abelwang mmogo Metale o o Tlotlegang wa Edinburgh wa 2016 ka ntlha ya go tlhoma Kantoro ya Bolepanaledi go lebeletswe Tlhabololo kwa Motsekapa.
tgt: Kevin Govender weHhovisi elizinze eKapa le-Astronomy for Development and the International Astronomical Union ozoklonyeliswa nabanye ngeNdodo i-Edinburgh yonyaka we-2016 ngokusungula iHhovisi le-Astronomy for Development eDolobheni LaseKapa.

src: Govender ke moAforika Borwa wa ntlha go amogela sekgele seno se se tlotlegang sa diphitlhelelo tsa saense le thekenoloji e e tshwaelang mo go tlhaloganyeng le itekanelong ya batho.
tgt: U-Govender yisakhamuzi sokuqala saseNingizimu Afrika ukuthola lo mklomelo ohloniphekile wempumelelo kwezesayensi nezobuchwepheshe okunomthelela ekuqondeni nakunhlalonhle yabantu.

src: Kabinete e akgola motantshi wa dingwaga di le 16 wa ballet, Leroy Mokgatle yo a gapileng sekgele sa Audience Favourite mmogo le sekolašipi kwa Kgaisanong ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Ballet ya Pris de Lausanne kwa Switzerland.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela umdansi we-ballet oneminyaka eyi-16 ubudala u-Leroy Mokgatle owine i-Audience Favourite award nomfundaze e-Prix de Lausanne International Ballet Competition e-Switzerland.

src: Ke moAforika Borwa wa ntlha go gapa sekolašipi mo dingwageng di le 28 le wa bobedi mo hisetoring ya naga.
tgt: Uyisakhamuzi sokuqala saseNingizimu Afrika ukuwina lo mfundaze eminyakeni enga-28 futhi ungowesibili emlandweni waleli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e ikamanya le Moporesitente Zuma go akgola bafenyi ba Dikgele tsa bo 2 tsa Ngwaga le ngwaga tsa Ubuntu.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi lijoyina uMongameli Zuma ngokuhalalisela abawinde Izindondo zo-Ubuntu Zesibili ezibanjwa minyaka yonke.

src: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaaneo a botlhokwa a puso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Puo ya Tekanyetsokabo ya 2016 e e dirilweng ke Tona ya Ditšhelete Pravin Gordhan ka la bo 24 Tlhakole 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukelile Inkulumo Yesabelomali Yonyaka we-2016 ethulwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali uPravin Gordhan mhla zi-24 Nhlolanja 2016.

src: Tekanyetsokabo eno e bontsha go tsetsepela ga rona, maitlamo a rona mmogo le mosola wa rona fa re ntse re samagane le paka eno e e maswe go gaisa ya ikonomi mo ya mo malobeng.
tgt: Lesi sabelomali sikhombisa ukubuyela esimweni, ukuzibophezela kanye nokukwazi ukubhekana nezinselele njengoba sibhekene nesimo somnotho esibi kakhulu emlandweni wamanje.

src: Tekanyetsokabo e tsibogela se naga e se tlhokang mme e dira gore go nne le boikanyego mo ikonoming ka go baya naga mo tseleng e e ikanyegang, ya leruri le e e ka diregang mme e akaretsa ya kgolo ya ikonomi.
tgt: Lesi sabelomali siphendula mayelana nalokho okudingwa yizwe futhi sibuyisa ukuzethemba emnothweni ngokubeka izwe emgudwini wokukhula komnotho ofaka uwonkewonke othembekile, ozinzile futhi okhulayo.

src: Gape kabinete e amogela dikgato tsa botlhokwa tsa go fokotsa ditshenyegelo mme e itlama go dira mmogo le maphata otlhe go tshwaela mo maitekong a a tlhakanetsweng a bosetšhaba a go diragatsa kgato eno e e tlhomilweng ke tekanyetsokabo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamukela futhi izinyathelo zokunciphisa izindleko futhi iyazibophezela ekusebenzisaneni nayo yonke imikhakha ekudlaleni indima emizamweni kazwelonke yawo wonke umuntu ukuqalisa ukusebenza umgudu ocatshwe yisabelomali.

src: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa ga Setlhopha sa Bobegakgang sa Moporesitente (PPC) ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukuthulwa ngokusemthethweni kweThimba Labezindaba Likamongameli (i-PPC) nguMongameli Jacob Zuma.

src: PPC e tla akaretsa batseleganyi ba dikgang tsa sepolotiki, bakwaladikgang ba sepolotiki, babegakgang ba dipolotiki mmogo le babegakgang ba ikonomi ba ba tlhomamisitsweng go bega dikgang tsa Kantoro ya Moporesitente ka dinako tsotlhe.
tgt: I-PPC izobunjwa ngabahleli bezindaba zombusazwe, ababhali bezindaba zombusazwe, ababika ngezindaba zombusazwe kanye nezintatheli zezindaba zomnotho ezinikezwe imvume yokubika ngeHhovisi Likamongameli ngokugcwele futhi ngokuqhubekayo.

src: Maitlhomo a PPC ke go tlamela bobegakgang ka phitlhelesego e e tokafaditsweng ya tshedimosetso.
tgt: Inhloso ye-PPC ukuhlinzeka abemithombo yezindaba ukufinyelela okwenziwe ngcono olwazini.

src: Gape e tla tokafatsa go fitlhelesega ga Moporesitente le Kantoro ya Moporesitente mo bobegakgannyeng go netefatsa gore babegakgang ba amogela tshedimosetso ya lemorago le dithulaganyo go tokafatsa go tlhaloganya le go bega ga bona.
tgt: Kuzophinda kwenze ngcono ukufinyela kwabezindaba kuMongameli kanye nakwiHhovisi Likamongameli, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izintatheli zithola ulwazi oluyisisekelo kanye nezinhlelo ukwenza ngcono ukuqonda kanye nokubika kwazo.

src: Ditokololo tsa setlhopha sa bobegakgang di tla amogela dipego go tswa go Motlatsamoporesitente le Tona nngwe le nngwe e Moporesitente a e laletsang go arogana manaane a botlhokwa a bosetšhaba.
tgt: Amalungu abalulekile ezindaba azophinda akhishelwe izindaba yiPhini Likamongameli kanye nanoma yimuphi uNgqongqoshe omenywa nguMongameli ukuthi azise ngezinhlelo ezibalulekile ezweni lethu.

src: Kabinete e tlhagisitse ditebogo ka ntlha ya karolo eo Aforika Borwa e nnileng le yona malebana le go busetsa kagiso kwa Burundi, go lepalepana le maitlamo a rona a dipholisi tsa dinaga di sele go netefatsa gore go nna le kontinente e e renang kagiso e bile e tsepame.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise ukubonga ngomsebenzi owenziwe yiNingizimu Afrika ekubuyiseni uxolo e-Burundi, ngokuhambisana nokuzibophezela kwinqubomgomo yethu yazangaphandle ukuqinisekisa izwekazi elinokuthula futhi elizinzile.

src: Gape e amogetse dipoelo tsa Puisano e e akaretsang ya ka fa gare ga Burundi e e neng e tshwerwe ka nako ya leeto la kemedi ya maemo a a kwa godimo ya Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU), e e neng e eteletswe pele ke Moporesitente Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yamukela imiphumela yeZingxoxo Zezakhamizi Zase-Burundi ezabanjwa ngesikhathi kuvakashe ithimba eliphezulu loMongameli leNhlangano Yamazwe Ase-Afrika (i-AU) e-Bujumbura e-Burundi, elaliholwa nguMongameli Zuma.

src: Kabinete e amogela go thapiwa ga Moporesitente Zuma ke Mokwaledikakaretso wa Ditšhabakopano (UN) Ban Ki-moon, go tlhakanela bodulasetilo jwa Khomišene ya Maemo a a kwa Godimo ya Boitekanelo, Ditiro le Kgolo ya Ikonomi le Moporesitente François Hollande wa Rephaboliki ya France.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukuqokwa kukaMongameli Zuma nguNobhala-Jikelele Wenhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) u-Ban Ki-moon, ukuba abe ngomunye wosihlalo Bekhomishani Ephezulu Yezemisebenzi Kwezempilo Nokukhula Komnotho benoMongameli u-François Hollande weRiphabhuliki yase-France.

src: Ga se la ntlha Moporesitente Zuma a thapiwa ke setheo sa lefatshe go dira tiro mo seraleng sa lefatshe.
tgt: Lokhu akukhona okokuqala ukuthi uMongameli Zuma aqokwe yinhlangano yomhlaba ukuthi enze umsebenzi ezingeni lomhlaba.

src: Go thapiwa gono ke ka ntlha ya go lemoga boeteledipele jo bo gaisang jo bo bontshitsweng ke Moporesitente wa rona mo seraleng sa lefatshe.
tgt: Lokhu kuqokwa kukhombisa uwukubona ubuholi obuqotho obukhonjiswe nguMongameli wethu emhlabeni jikelele.

src: Khomišene e tla susumetsa go tlhamiwa ga ditšhono tsa ditiro tse dintšhwa mo lephateng la boitekanelo go ralala dinaga tsotlhe, bogolo segolo tse di sa tlhabologang mo go kalo.
tgt: Le khomishani izokhuthaza ukudalwa kwamathuba emisebenzi amasha emkhakheni wezempilo emazweni wonke, kakhulukazi lawo angathuthukile kahle.

src: Gape seno se maatlafatsa go diragadiwa ga Lenaane la 2030 la Tlhabololo e e nnelang leruri, e leng se se tla thusang go samagana le dikgwetlho tse di maphata mararo a botlhokatiro, lehuma le go tlhoka tekatekano.
tgt: Lokhu kuzophinda kugxilise ukuqaliswa koHlelo Lwentuthuko Ezinzile lwe-2030, oluzokwenza umsebenzi omkhulu ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezintathu okungukuswelakala kwemisebenzi, ububha nokungalingani.

src: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa ga Tshekatsheko ya Bosetšhaba ya Baagi ya 2016 kwa Mamelodi, Pretoria ke Tona mo Kantorong ya Moporesitente Jeff Radebe le Radipalopalokakaretso Pali Lehohla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukuthulwa ngokusemthethweni kweNhlolovo Kazwelonke Yomphakathi yonyaka we-2016 eMamelodi, ePitoli nguNgqongqoshe eHhovisini LikaMongameli u-Jeff Radebe kanye noMqondisi-Jikelele Womnyango Wezezibalo uPali Lehohla.

src: Tshekatsheko ya monongwaga e dirwa ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "MoAforika Borwa yo ke mo itseng, legae le ke le tlhaloganyang" mme go totilwe magae a feta 1,5 milione - e leng palo e kgolo go gaisa fa e bapisiwa le e e neng e totilwe mo dingwageng di le tlhano tse di fetileng mo go neng go dirilwe tshekatsheko ya magae a le 300 000 fela.
tgt: Inhlolovo yalo nyaka yenziwa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi “iNingizimu Afrika engiyaziyo, ikhaya engiliqondayo” futhi ihlose imindeni engaphezulu kwesigidi esi-1,5 – nokuyinhlolovo enkulu njengamanje uma kuqhathaniswa neyayibanjwe eminyakeni emihlanu edlule eyenziwa emindenini eyi-300 000 kuphela.

src: Tshekatsheko e tla dirwa ka Moranang mme dipholo di tla itsesewe kwa bokhutlong jwa Seetebosigo 2016.
tgt: Le nhlolovo izokwenziwa ngoMbaso kanti imiphumela yayo izotholakala emaphethelweni kaNhlangulana 2016.

src: Kabinete e nopotse ke go tshwenngwa ke pegelo e e tlhagisitsweng ke Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Boitekanelo (WHO) le Mokgatlho wa Tirisanommogo ya Ikonomi le Tlhabololo mo Patlisisong ya Mmaraka wa Boitekanelo e e eteletsweng pele ke Moatlhodi Sandile Ngcobo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaqaphela ngokukhathazeka umbiko othulwe yiNhlangano Yezempilo Yenhlangano Yezizwe kanye neNhlangano Yokubambisana Kwezomnotho Nentuthuko Ophenyweni Ngemakethe Yezempilo eholwa nguJaji Sandile Ngcobo.

src: Pegelo e supa gore Aforika Borwa e tlamela ka ditirelo tsa kalafi tse di tlhotlhwagodimo go gaisa fa e bapisiwa le dinaga tse dingwe.
tgt: Imibiko ikhomba ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ihlinzeka izinsizakalo zezokwelashwa ezimba eqolo kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa namanye amazwe.

src: Kabinete e tla emela go konosediwa ga patlisiso pele ga go dira kgoeletso ka morero ono.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izolinda ukuphothulwa kwalolu phenyo ngaphambi kokwenza isimemezelo mayelana nalolu daba.

src: Ditshwetso tsa botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Togamaanotlhomo ya go Samagana le Kgotlhelego ya Mowa mo Baaging ba Lotseno lo lo kwa tlase ba ba nnang mo go kitlaneng gona mo Aforika Borwa gore go dirwe ditshwaelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukushicilelwa kweQhinga Eliwuhlaka Lokubhekana Nokungcola Komoya Emiphakathini YaseNingizimu Afrika Enabantu Abaningi Abahola Kancane ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngalo.

src: Maikaelelo a togamaano ke go tlamela ka tsela e e tsepameng go samagana le seelo se se kwa godimo sa kgotlhelego mo baaging bangwe ba ba bonang lotseno lo lo kwa tlase mme ba nna mo go kitlaneng gona.
tgt: Leli qhinga lihlose ukuhlinzeka indlela egxile ekubhekaneni namazinga aphezulu okugcola emiphakathini enabantu abaningi abahola kancane.

src: E tlamela ka tsela e e gokaganeng ya go tsenngwa tirisong ga maiteko a go fokotsa go fisa dituki mo magaeng.
tgt: Lihlinzeka indlela ehlelekile ukuqalisa imizamo yokunciphisa intuthu edalwa ukusetshenziswa kwezinto ezifana namalahle negesi emakhaya.

src: Tsereganyo eno e ikaelela go netefatsa gore dikarolo tseno di obamela Seemo sa Bosetšhaba sa Boleng jwa Mowa wa Tikologo.
tgt: Lokhu kungenelela kuhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zindawo zithobela Amazinga Kazwelonke Omoya Wendawo Ohlanzekile.

src: Togamaano eno e e tsepameng e tla tshegetsa togamaano e e leng teng ya bosetšhaba ya go samagana le kgotlhelego ya mowa mo nageng.
tgt: Leli qhinga lizosekela iqhinga likazwelonke elisetshenziswa njengamanje ukubhekana nokugcoliseka komoya ezweni.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go amogelwa ga Khonferense ya bo 21 ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya AIDS (AIDS 2016) ke puso le Mokgatlho wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa AIDS kwa International Convention Centre (ICC) kwa Durban go tloga ka la bo 18 go fitlha ka la bo 22 Phukwi 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukusingathwa ngokuhlanganyela kweNkomfa Yomhlaba Yengculazi Yama-21 (i-AIDS 2016) phakathi kukahulumeni neNhlangano Yomhlaba Ye-AIDS e-International Convention Centre (ICC) e-Durban kusukela mhla zi-18 zize zibe nga-22 Ntulikazi 2016.

src: Go amogela khonferense go tla tokafatsa tsibogo ya naga ya rona ya HIV le TB fa go ntse go ama nngwe ya dikgwetlho tsa botlhokwa tota mo Aforika Borwa, mo kgaolong le mo lefatsheng.
tgt: Ukusingathwa kwale nkomfa kuzokwenza ngcono ukubhekana kwezwe ne-HIV nesifo sofuba ngesikhathi esifanayo kube nomthelela kwenye yezinselele ezibaluleke kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, esifundeni kanye nasemhlabeni.

src: Khonferense eno e tla naya babatlisisi go tswa lefatsheng ka bophara serala sa go arogana dikgatelopele tsa ga jaana tsa saense mo lephateng, go ithuta mo boitseanapeng jwa ba bangwe mmogo le go tlhama maano a go tsweletsa dikarolo tsotlhe tsa maiteko a re a tlhakanetseng a go alafa le go thibela HIMolaotlhomo.
tgt: Ukusingathwa kwale nkomfa kuzohlinzeka inkudla kubacwaningi abavela emhlabeni jikelele ukuthi babelane ngenqubekela phambili yakamumva yezesayensi kulo mkhakha, ukufunda kumakhono abanye kanye nokuthuthukisa amaqhinga okuqhubezela phambili zonke izingxenye zemizamo yethu yokwelapha nokuvimbela igciwane lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV).

src: Kabinete e amogetse tlhagiso ya Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa 2015 wa Dipalangwa tsa Bosetšhaba tsa mo Lefatsheng, o o baakanyang Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Dipalangwa tsa mo Lefatsheng, 2009 (Molao wa bo 5 wa 2009).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuphasisile ukwethulwa ePhalamende Kwesichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Kazwelonke Wezithuthi Ezihamba Phansi sonyaka we-2015, esichibiyela uMthetho Kazwelonke Wezithuthi Ezihamba Phansi, wezi-2009 (uMthetho we-5 wezi-2009).

src: Dipaakanyo tsa Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Dipalangwa tsa mo Lefatsheng wa 2009 di tla tsweletsa thulaganyo ya go fetola le go aga sešwa thulaganyo ya bosetšhaba ya dipalangwa tsa mo lefatsheng.
tgt: Izichibiyelo eMthethweni Kazwelonke Wezithuthi Ezihamba Phansi wezi-2009 zizoqhubeza izinhlelo zokuguqula kanye nokuhlela kabusha uhlelo lukazwelonke lwezithuthi ezihamba phansi.

src: Seno se tla tshwaela mo tirelong ya dipalangwa tsa botlhe e e babalesegileng, e e fitlhelesegang mme e le bokgoni.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela kumisebenzi yezithuthi zomphakathi eziphephile, ezitholakala kalula, ezisebenza kahle nangempumelelo.

src: Molaotlhomo o dira tlamelo ya ditlhabololo tse dintšhwa mo lephateng la dipalangwa tsa botlhe.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlinzeka intuthuko entsha emkhakheni wezithuthi zomphakathi.

src: Molaotlhomo o tlamela ka kaedi ya, magareng ga tse dingwe, dipalangwa tse di senang dienjene, ditirelo tsa dipalangwa tse di bidiwang ka tiriso ya diselefounu gongwe dikhomphiutara mmogo le go tshwaya dipalangwa tsa botlhe.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlinzeka umhlahlandlela, phakathi kokunye, ngezithuthi ezingenanjini, ngezithuthi ezikulanda emva kokuzibiza ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe kanye nokubhalwa kwezithuthi zomphakathi.

src: Gape o sedimosa ntlha ya tsamaiso malebana le dithata tse di roletsweng mmogo le melawana malebana le go rebolwa ga dilaesense tsa go dira tsa dipalangwa tsa botlhe.
tgt: Uphinda ucacise ngokulawula okuphathelene namandla abiwe kanye nemithethonkambiso emayelana nokukhishwa kwamalayisensi okuqhuba ibhizinisi lezithuthi zomphakathi.

src: Gape molaotlhomo ono o tla kgontsha go anamisiwa ga Mafaratlhatlha a a Lotaneng a Dipalangwa tsa Botlhe mme ke karolo ya Leano la Bosetšhaba la Mafaratlhatlha le Porojeke ya Togamaano e e Lotaneng ya 7 e e totileng go dirisa tlhabololo e e gokaganeng ya mafaratlhatlha a a lotaneng a dipalangwa go dira gore ditoropokgolo e nne madutelo a kgolo ya ikonomi.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uzophinda uvumele ukuqaliswa Kwezithuthi Zomphakathi Ezididiyelwe futhi uyingxenye yoHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwengqalasizinda kanye nePhrojekthi Edidiyelwe Yamaqhinga ye-7, egxile ekusetshenzisweni kokuthuthukiswa okulawulwayo kwezithuthi zasedolobheni futhi ezididiyelwe ukwakha amadolobha njengezizinda zokukhula komnotho.

src: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o tla tsaya Leeto la Semmuso go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Bofederale ya Nigeria go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 9 Mopitlwe 2016.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzothatha Uhambo Olusemthethweni Lokuvakashela e-Federala Republic of Nigeria kusukela mhla zi-8 zize zibe yi-9 Ndasa 2016.

src: Leeto la Semmuso le tla tokafatsa dikamano tsa ga jaana tsa sebedi le go tsweletsa gape kgwebisano ya mo kgaolong.
tgt: Lokhu kuVakasha Kombuso kuzokwenza gcono ubudlelwano obukhona njengamanje phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili futhi kuphinde kwenze gcono ukuhweba phakathi kwezifunda.

src: Kgwedi ya Ditshwanelo tsa Botho ka Mopitlwe 2016 e tla ketekwa ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Aforika Borwa e kopane kgatlhanong le tlhaolele ya bosemorafe."
tgt: INyanga Yamalungelo Oluntu ngoNdasa 2016 izogujwa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "INingizimu Afrika ihlangene ekulweni nobandlululo."

src: Lefapha la Botsweretshi le Setso le rulagantse leano la kgwedi le le akaretsang metseletsele ya dipuisano tse di ka ga go dira mmogo go aga setšhaba se se sa tlhaoleng go ya ka bosemorafe, bong, se se nang le tekatekano le sa temokerasi.
tgt: UMnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko uhlanganise uhlelo oluzoqhubeka inyanga noluhlanganisa uchungechunge lwezingxoxo mayelana nokusebenza ngokubambisana ukwakha umphakathi ongacwasi ngokobuhlanga, ngokobulili, olinganayo futhi onentando yeningi.

src: Kabinete e laletsa maAforika Borwa go tshwaela mo Leanotirong la Bosetšhaba la go lwantsha Bosemorafe, Tlhaolo go ya ka Bosemorafe, Letlhoo la Batswakwantle mmogo le Go tlhoka itshokelano go go Amanang le tseo (2016-2021) pele ga la bo 30 Seetebosigo 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuba ziphawule ngoHlelo Lokusebenza Lukazwelonke Lokulwa Nobandlululo, Ukucwasa Ngokobuhlanga, Inzondo Yabantu Bokufika kanye noKungabekezelelani okuhlobene Nalokhu (lwezi-2016-2021) ngaphambi komhla zi-30 Nhlangulana 2016.

src: Leano le tlamela ka motheo wa pholisi ya botlhe e e kgatlhanong le go tlhaola go ya ka bosemorafe e e tla thusang go diragatsa maitlamo a rona a boditšhabatšhaba a ditshwanelo tsa botho.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luhlinzeka isisekelo senqubomgomo yomphakathi yokulwisana nokucwasa ngokobuhlanga nokuzosiza ekuqaliseni ukusebenza kwezibopho zethu zomhlaba zamalungelo oluntu.

src: Puisano ya Russia-Aforika e e Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi kwa ICC kwa Durban go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 9 Mopitlwe 2016 e tlamela ka serala sa go tokafatsa Leanolegolo la Bosetšhaba la Diritibatsi (2013-2017)Ntwa kgatlhanong le diritibatsi tse di seng mo molaong go lepalepana le Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) mme puisano e ka fa tlase ga bookamedi jwa AU go latelelwa maitlamo go ya ka Ditumelano tse di maleba tsa UN tsa Bosenyi jo bo Rulagantsweng go ralala Dinaga, Leano la Tiragatso la AU la Taolo ya Diritibatsi (2013-2017) le ditshwetso tsa BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa).Khonferense ke kopano e e latelang Puisano ya Russia-Aforika e e Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi, e maikaelelo a yona e leng go tlhagisa seemo se se gokaganeng malebana le gore baeteledipele ba lefatshe ba ikaelela go samagana jang le bothata jwa boditšhabatšhaba jwa diritibatsi.
tgt: Izingxoxo phakathi kwe-Russia-ne-Afrika Zokulwa Nezidakamizwa e-ICC e-Durban kusukela mhla zi-8 kuze kube mhla zi-9 Ndasa 2016 zinhlinzeka inkundla yokwenza ngcono Iqhinga Likazwelonke Lokulwa Nezidakamizwa (lwezi-2013-2017).Ukulwa nezidakamizwa ezingekho emthethweni kuhambisana noHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwentuthuko futhi lezi zingxoxo zingaphansi kwe-AU ekufezeni izibopho zayo ngokweZivumelwano Ze-UN Ezimayelana Nezidakamizwa Nobugebengu Obuhlelekile Obuxuba Amazwe, Uhlelo Lokusebenza Lwe-AU Lokulawula Izidakamizwa (lwezi-2013-2017) nezinqumo ze-BRICS (i-Brazil, i-Russia, i-India, i-China neNingizimu Afrika).Le nkomfa yisithangami sokulandelela seZingxoxo Phakathi Kwe-Russia-ne-Afrika, ihlose ukuthula indlela eyodwa yokuthi abaholi bomhlaba bazobhekana kanjani nenkinga yezidakamizwa ekhungethe umhlaba wonke.

src: Seno se tla tlhagisiwa kwa Kopanong e e Kgethegileng ya Kokoanokakaretso ya UN ka Moranang 2016.
tgt: Lokhu kuzothulwa ezithebheni zoMhlangano Okethekile Wesigungu-Jikelele Se-UN ngoMbaso 2016.

src: Puso - ka tirisanommogo le Bokwaledi jwa Kgweranoditšhaba, Yunibesithi ya Aforika Borwa (UNISA) mmogo le Setheo sa Bosetšhaba sa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa - e amogela Khonferense ya bo 2 ya Kgweranoditšhaba e e ka ga Tiro ya Bašwa kwa khamphaseng ya Unisa kwa Pretoria go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 10 Mopitlwe 2016.
tgt: Uhulumeni – ngokubambisana nonoBhala Wamazwe e-Commonwealth, Inyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika ne-Ejensi Kazwelonke Yentuthuko Yentsha – bazosingatha Inkomfa Yesi-2 Yamazwe e-Commonwealth Emayelana Nomsebenzi Wentsha Ophikweni Lwe-Unisa ePitori kusukela zi-8 zize zibe yi-10 Mbaso 2016.

src: Khonferense e tshwarwa ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Go akaretsa Bašwa mo Kagong ya Setšhaba: Seabe sa Modiri wa Mošwa" mme e tla sekaseka gape seabe sa badiri ba tiro ya bašwa mmogo le barutegi ba ba akaretsang bašwa mo tlhabololong ya dinaga tsa bona.
tgt: Le nkomfa izobanjwa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: Ukusebenzisa Intsha Ekwakheni Isizwe: Indima Yabasebenzi Abayintsha” futhi izohlola kabusha indima yabasebenzi abayintsha kanye nezifundiswa ekusebenziseni intsha ekuthuthukiseni amazwe azo.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mo Mererong e e Botlhokwa ya ga jaana.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisematheni.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa molaetsa wa ga Moporesitente Zuma wa botlhokwa jwa go tlotla ditheo le ditsamaiso tse di tlhamilweng go ya ka Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 le molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcizelela umyalezo kaMongameli Zuma omayelana nesidingo sokuhlonipha izikhungo kanye nezinhlelo ezisungulwe ngokoMthethosisekelo weRiphabhuliki YaseNingizimu Afrika we-1996 kanye nomthetho.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o samagane le morero wa Mokhomišinara wa Tirelo ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa le Tona ya Ditšhelete ka tsela e e siameng a dirisa ditsela tse di siameng tsa molao.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uxazulula udaba lukaKhomishana Wenhlangano Yokuqoqwa Kwentela eNingizimu Afrika kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezezimali ngokusebenzisa imigudu efanele esebenzisa izimiso zomthetho ezifanele.

src: Moporesitente o baakanya dikgato tsa go samagana le dintlha tseno ka maikarabelo le ka tsela e e siameng gore botlhe ba bone molemo.
tgt: UMongameli uthatha izinyathelo zokuxazulula lolu daba ngendlela efanele nenobungani ukuze kuhlomule wonke umuntu.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maphateng otlhe a a nang le dikgatlhego go diga makgwafo le go itshwara mme ba neele sebaka sa gore morero ono o rarabololwe ka go dirisiwa ga ditsela tse di siameng.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi inxusa bonke abanentshisekelo kulolu daba ukuthi bahlise umoya futhi bazilawule, futhi basidedele ithuba lokuthi kuxazululwe lezi zindaba kusetshenziswa imigudu efanele.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go ikwadisetsa Ditlhopho tsa Pusoselegae tsa 2016 ka la bo 5 le la bo 6 Mopitlwe 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi zibhalisele ukuvota Okhethweni Lukahulumeni Wendawo lonyaka we-2016 mhla zi-5 nangomhla zi-6 Ndasa 2016.

src: Ditlhopho tsa pusoselegae di farologane le ditlhopho tsa bosetšhaba mme di tlhoka gore o ikwadise mo otong e o nnang mo go yona.
tgt: Ukhetho lohulumeni bendawo ludinga ukuthi ubhalise esigcemeni ohlala kusona kanti ukhetho lukazwelonke aludingi ukuthi ubhalise esigcemeni ohlala kusona.

src: Go botlhokwa gore o nne le Lekwaloitshupo (ID) - go tla amogelwa ID e e tala e e nang le bar-code mmogo le karata ya Boitshupo - le go tlhola seemo sa gago sa ikwadiso, nomoro ya oto kwa diteišeneng tse di farologaneng tsa ditlhopho.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuthi ube nomazisi (i-ID) – bamukelekile bobabili oluhlaza onamagabela kanye nalowo oyikhadi – ukubheka isimo sakho sokubhalisa, inombolo yesigceme kanye nendawo yesiteshi sokuvota.

src: Dikantoro tsotlhe tsa Merero ya Selegae di tla bo di butswe go tloga ka 08:00 go fitlha ka 17:00 ka la bo 5 le la bo 6 Mopitlwe 2016, mme seo ke go lepalepana le diura tsa tiro tsa Khomišene ya Ditlhopho e e Ikemetseng (IEC) mo matsatsing a mabedi ao.
tgt: Wonke amahhovisi oMnyango Wezasekhaya azobe evuliwe kusukela ngehora le-08:00 kuze kube yihora le-17:00 mhla zi-5 zize zibe yi-6 Ndasa 2016, nokuhambisana nahora okusebenza Ekhomishani Yokhetho Ezimele kulezi zinsuku ezimbili.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo batlhophing botlhe ba bašwa mmogo le ba ba tla bong ba tlhopha la ntlha go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu abasha nalabo abazobe bevota okokuqala ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota.

src: Ka go tlhopha o tsaya kgato ya go dira gore lentswe la gago le utlwale mo ditshwetsong tse di go amang le tse di amang baagi ba gaeno.
tgt: Ngokuvota, uthathe isinyathelo sokwenza izwi lakho lizwakale izinqumweni ezithinta wena nomphakathi ohlala kuwo.

src: Pusoselegae e mo diatleng tsa gago!.
tgt: Ukuba nezwi kuzinqumo zikahumeni wendawo kusezandleni zakho!.

src: Kabinete e nyefola ditshupetso tse di tletseng tirisodikgoka tsa baithuti, tse di kgoreleditseng dithuto kwa diyunibesithi tse dingweng mme di lebisitse kwa tshenyong ya dithoto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayigxeka imibhikisho yabafundi enodlame, ephazamise izifundo kwamanye amayunivesithi futhi yaholela nasekonakalisweni kwempahla.

src: Ditshupetso tseno di lomeletsa baithuti ba ba nang le tshiamelo tšhono ya go tsweletsa dithuto mme gape di ama tshwanelo ya bone ya go iponela thuto e kgolwane.
tgt: Le mibhikisho ivimvela abafundi abadinga ukufunda ithuba lokuqhubeza izifundo zabo futhi ithikameza ilungelo labo lokuthola imfundo yasemazingeni aphakeme.

src: Puso e buletse dipuisano le baamegi botlhe ba thuto e kgolwane go buisana le go ganetsana.
tgt: Uhulumeni uvula imigudu yokuxhumana nabo bonke abathintekayo emfundweni ephakeme ukuze kuxoxwe futhi kuboniswane.

src: Seno se buseditse maemo sekeng le tsweletso ya kgolagano ya loago kwa diyunibesithing tse di batlang go bona ditharabololo tsa dikgwetlho tsa pakagare le pakatelele tse di amanang le go fetolwa ga lephata jaaka go tlhalositswe mo ditshwetsong tsa Samiti ya 2015 ya Diphetogo mo Thutong e Kgolwane.
tgt: Lokhu sekuholele ekutheni isimo sibuyele kwesijwayelekile nokukhuthazwa kobunye emayunivesithi ethu afuna ukuthola izisombululo zesikhathi esiphakathi nendawo kuya kweside kwizinselele ezihlobene nokuguqula lo mkhakha njengoba kuchaziwe kuzinqumo ezathathwa kuMhlangano Wokuguqula Ezemfundo Ephakeme we-2015.IKhabinethi isekela imizamo yabezomthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isiko lokufunda liyabuyiswa, futhi impahla kanye namalungelo abantu kuyavikelwa.

src: Kabinete e tshegetsa maiteko a ditheo tsa tiragatso ya molao go netefatsa gore go busediwa setso sa go ithuta, le gore go sirelediwa dithoto le ditshwanelo tsa batho.
tgt: Umthetho ubalulekile futhi kumele ulandelwe ngazo zonke izikhathi.

src: Go tshwanetse ga busediwa maemo sekeng kwa diyunibesithing tsa rona gore manaane a thuto a tswelele pele fa go ntse go samaganwe le dikgwetlho tsa pakagare le pakatelele.
tgt: Isimo esijwayelekile kanye nokuthula kumele kubuyele emayunivesithi ukuze izinhlelo zezemfundo ziqhubekele phambili ngesikhathi kusaxazululwa izinselele zesikhathi esiphakathi nendawo kuya kweside.

src: Kabinete e akgotse baithuti ba ba emeng mmogo kgatlhanong le bosemorafe le letlhoo la basweu, e leng sekai sa gore re ka dira mmogo go agelela mo tswelelopeleng le diphitlhelelong tse di dirilweng mo lephateng la thuto e kgolwane go baakanyetsa ngwaga ono wa dithuto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibashayela ihlombe abafundi abakhulume ngazwi linye lokulwisana nokucwasa ngokwebala nokuchitha inkolelo yabamhlophe, nokuyinto eyisibonelo ukuthi sonke singasebenzisana ukwakhela kwinqubekela phambili kanye nemihlomulo eyenziwe emkhakheni wezemfundo ephakeme ukulungiselela lo nyaka wokufunda.

src: Re tshwanetse go sireletsa tswelelopele eo le go letla gore go busediwe le go somarela taolo kwa diyunibesithing tsotlhe tsa rona.
tgt: Kumele sivikele inqubekela phambili futhi sivumele ukuthula ukuthi kubuyiswe futhi kugcinwe emayunivesithi ethu.

src: Gape kabinete e ikuela mo baameging botlhe go dira mmogo gore diyunibesithi tsa rona e nne baeteledipele ba puisano e e akaretsang le diphetogo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinda inxusa bonke abanentshisekelo ukuthi basebenzisane ukuze amayunivesithi ethu abe ngabaholi bokuxoxisana okufaka wonke umuntu kanye nezinguquko.

src: Kabinete e nopotse kgolagano e e tshitshintsweng ya ditheo tse tharo tsa mabotlolo tsa Setlamo sa Coca Cola mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphawula ngokuhlanganiswa okuhlongozwayo kwemisebenzi emithathu yamabhodlela enkampanini yakwa-Coca Cola eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e lemoga gore morero o tla reediwa kwa Lekgotleng la Dikgaisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphawula ukuthi lolu daba luzolalelwa Enkantolo Yezokuncintisana.

src: Kabinete e tlhagisa matshwenyego a yona ka tatlhegelo ya ditiro e e tshitshintsweng mmogo le phokotso ya ditiro mo dikgatong tsa kgolagano eno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalisa ukukhathazeka kwayo ngokulahleka kwamathuba emisebenzi okuhlongozwayo kanye nokuncipha kwamathuba emisebenzi okuzodalwa yilokhu kuhlanganiswa.

src: Ka ntlha ya botlhokatiro jo bo kwa godimo, Kabinete e ikuela mo ditlamong go netefatsa gore ga go nne le ditiro tse di latlhegang mme go tsholwa seemo sa ditiro.
tgt: Njengoba amazing okuswelakala kwemisebenzi ephezulu, iKhabhinethi inxusa izinkampani ukuthi ziqinisekise ukuthi ayilahleki imisebenzi futhi amazinga aphakathi nendawo emisebenzi ayagcinwa.

src: Kabinete e akgola Moambasadara wa Aforika Borwa wa Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Kgwebisano (WTO), Rre Xavier Carim, yo o tlhophilweng modulasetilo wa Setheo sa Tharabololo ya Dikgotlhang sa Lekgotlakakaretso la WTLekgotlakakaretso ke setheo se se tsayang ditshwetso tse di kwa godimo sa WTO magareng ga Dikhonferense tsa Ditona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Inxusa laseNingizimu Afrika Enhlanganweni Yomhlaba Yezohwebo (i-WTO) uMnu Xavier Carim, okhethelwe ukuba ngusihlalo weSigungu Esixazulula Izingxabano soMKhandlu-Jikele we-WTUMkhandlu-Jikelele yisigungu esiphezulu esithatha izinqumo se-WTO phakathi kweNkomfa yoNgqongqoshe.

src: Go thapiwa ga Moambasadara Carim go lemosa seabe sa botlhokwa sa Aforika Borwa mo WTO mme gape ke sesupo sa maitshwaro a ga Moambasadara Carim.
tgt: Ukuqokwa kweNxusa uCarim kuyinto eyingxenye yokuqashelwa kwendima ebalulekile edlalwa yiNingizimu Afrika ku-WTO futhi kuyingxenye yobufakazi bekhono leNxusa uCarim.

src: Kabinete e lemogile kitsiso ya Barclays PLC ya maikaelelo a yona go fokotsa 62.3% ya botsholadišere jwa yona mo Barclays Africa Group Limited (BAGL) mo dingwageng tse di latelang di le pedi go ya go di le tharo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphawulile ngesimemezelo se-Barclays PLC senhloso yaso yokwehlisa amasheya aso angamaphesenti anga-62,3 enawo e-Barclays Africa Group Limited (e-BAGL) eminyakeni emibili kuya kwemithathu ezayo.

src: Barclays PLC, bogolosegolo Motlhankedikhuduthamagamogolo, o buisane le Matlotlo a Bosetšhaba le Bankakgolo ya Aforika Borwa mme re amogela maitlamo a setlamo a go diragatsa togamaano e ntšhwa ka tsela e e tla fokotsang ditlamorago mo ikonoming e BAGL e dirang mo go yona.
tgt: I-Barclays PLC, ikakhulukazi u-CEO, uye waxoxisana noMnyango Wezezimali neBhange Lombuso leNingizimu Afrika ezigxoxweni ezivulelekile, futhi siyakwamukela ukuzibophezela kwenkampani ukuqalisa ukusebenzisa iqhinga elisha ngendlela ezonciphisa umthelela eminothweni yasemazweni lapho kusebenza khona i-BAGIBhangengodla lizosebenzisana neBarclays PLC ne-BAGL ukuqinisekisa ukuthi noma yibuphi ubungozi obungavela kulokhu kuncishiswa kwamasheya kuyavinjelwa futhi kuthathwa izinyathelo ezifanele ukuphatha ukufuduswa kwezimali ezivela kulokhu kuncishiswa kwamasheya.

src: Bankakgolo ya Aforika Borwa e tla dira le Barclays PLC le BAGL go netefatsa gore go fokodiwa matshosetsi otlhe a a ka nnang teng mo tiragatsong eo le gore go tsewa dikgato tse di maleba go samagana le motsamao wa ditšhelete o o tla bakwang ke tiragatso eo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela bonke abafike kumanqamu kanye nabawinile kuZindondo Zikazwelonke Zokufundisa ezabanjwa mhla zingama-27 Nhlolanja 2016.

src: Kabinete e akgola botlhe ba ba fitlheletseng makgaolakgang mmogo le bafenyi ba Dikgele tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Barutabana tse di neng di tshwerwe ka la bo 27 Tlhakole 2016.
tgt: Labo thisha abazinikele baqhubezela izwe lethu phambili ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi amagumbi abo akhiqiza abafundi abakhuthazekile abayobamba iqhaza ekuthuthukisweni kweNingizimu Afrika.

src: Barutabana bano ba ba ititeileng sehuba ba tsweletsa naga ya rona pele ka go netefatsa gore diphaposiborutelo di tlhagisa barutwana ba ba rotloetsegileng ba ba tla tshwaelang mo tlhabololong ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela iMarket Theatre yaseGoli ngokugubha unyaka wayo wama-40 ikhona.

src: Kabinete e akgola Market Theatre kwa Johannesburg ka go keteka ngwaga wa bo 40 e ntse e le teng.
tgt: Ngesikhathi sobandlululo leli shashalazi laba wuphawu loMzabalazo ngokulandisa ngezindaba eziyiqiniso zaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ka paka ya tlhaolele teatere e nnile sekao sa Kgaratlho ka go anela dikgang tsa boammaaruri tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Chad Hendricks, wase-Retreat e-Cape Flats ngokuwina Umncintiswano Ohlonishayo Wababhidisi we-Len van Zyl eKapa.

src: Kabinete e akgola morutabana wa mmino, Rre Chad Hendricks, go tswa kwa Retreat kwa Cape Flats ka ntlha ya go fenya Kgaisano ya maemo ya Batshwaratakata ya Len van Zyl kwa Motsekapa.
tgt: Umklomelo wakhe ufaka umfundaze waseMelika wezinyanga ezintathu lapho uMnu Hendricks ezobe efunda e-Orchestra Philadelphia futhi aqeqeshwe nguSolwazi odumile uVictor Yampolsky e-Chicago.

src: Dimpho tsa gagwe di akaretsa sekolašipi sa dikgwedi di le tharo kwa Amerika koo Rre Hendricks a tla ithutang kwa Philadelphia Orchestra mme a katisiwa ke Moporofesara Victor Yampolsky kwa Chicago.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela umdidiyeli wamafilimu, uMnu.

src: Kabinete e akgola motlhagisi wa difilimi, Rre Anant Singh, ka ntlha ya go abelwa maemo a boraro ka filimi ya Shepherds and Butchers kwa Panorama Audience Award for Fiction Film kwa Moletlong wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Difilimi wa Berlin.
tgt: Anant Singh, ngokunikezwa indawo yesithathu ngefilimu ethi Shepherds and Butchers kwi-Panorama Audience Award for Fiction Film eMgubheni Womhlaba Wamafilimu waseBerlin.

src: Seno ke phitlhelelo e kgolo ka ntlha ya fa filimi e ne e gaisana le difilimi di le 51 go tswa kwa dinageng di le Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi:.
tgt: Lokhu kuyimpumelelo enkulu njengoba ifilimu ibincintisana namanye amafilimu anga-51 asemazweni anga-336.

src: Katoloso ya konteraka ya ga Rre Lionel October jaaka Mokaedikakaretso (DG) mo Lefapheng la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri, sebaka sa dingwaga di le tlhano.
tgt: Lionel October njengoMqondisi Jikelele (u-DG) woMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni, isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu.

src: Go thapiwa ga Ngaka Mantlhake J Maboya jaaka Motlatsamokaedikakaretso (DDG): Pholisi ya Kharikhulamo le Tekolo mo Lefapheng la Thuto ya Motheo.
tgt: Ukuqashwa kukaDkt.

src: Go thapiwa ga Mme Shamilla Chettiar jaaka DDG: Ditirelo tsa Pholisi le Kitso kwa Lefapheng la Bojanala.
tgt: Mantlhake J Maboya njengePhini Likamqondisi Jikelele (i-DDG): Inqubomgomo Nokuqashelwa Kwekharikhulamu eMnyangweni Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo.

src: Go thapiwa ga Rre Mbulelo Tshangana jaaka DG mo Lefapheng la Manno a Batho.
tgt: Ukuqashwa kukaNkz.

src: Go thapiwa gape ga Rre Kutoane Obed Kutoane jaaka Motlhankedikhuduthamagamogolo wa Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited.
tgt: Shamilla Chettiar njenge-DDG: Imisebenzi Yenqubomgomo Nezolwazi eMnyangweni Wezokuvakasha.

src: Ditshwetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi Eziqavile.

src: Kabinete e sekasekile Dipegelo tsa Dipoelo tsa Dikgatelopele tsa Kotara ya Boraro tsa paka ya Diphalane go fitlha Sedimonthole 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlole Imibiko Yesigamu Sesithathu Yemiphumela Yenqubekela Phambili yesikhathi sikaMfumfu kuze kushaye uZibandlela 2015.

src: Dipegelo di bontsha kgatelopele e e utlwalang malebana le go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a puso a a amang ka tlhamalalo tokafatso ya matshelo a maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Imibiko ibonisa inqubekela phambili ebonakalayo ekuqalisweni kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezinomthelela ngqo ekuthuthukisweni kwezimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Dipegelo tsa Dipoelo tsa Dikgatelopele di naya bosupi jwa gore puso e dirile kgatelopele go fitlhelela diphitlhelelo tse di neng di tlhagisitswe mo Letlhomesong la Togamaano ya Pakagare la 2014-2019.
tgt: Imibiko Yemiphumela Yenqubekela Phambili ihlinzeka ubufakazi bokuthi uhulumeni ube nenqubekela phambili ekufezeni imikhawulo ebekwe Ohlakeni Lwamaqhinga Lwesikhathi Esiphakathi Nendawo 2014-2019.

src: Gape di re atametsa le go fitlhelela Ponelopele ya 2030 jaaka e tlhagisitswe mo Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP), le maitlhomo a lona e leng go samagana le lehuma, botlhokatiro le go tlhoka tekatekano.
tgt: Iphinda isisondeze ekufezeni Umbono we-2030, njengoba ubekiwe oHlelweni Lwentuthuko Lukazwelonke (i-NDP), oluhlose ukulwa nobubha, ukuntuleka kwamathuba emisebenzi kanye nokungalingani.
