src: Kabinete e lemogile tswelelopele e e amogelesegang e e dirilweng go fitlhelela diphitlhelelo le ditlhagiso tsa botlhokwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphelile inqubekela phambili eyamukelekile eyenziwe ukufeza imikhawulo kanye nemiphumela.

src: Kabinete e lemogile gore le fa go nnile le tswelelopele e e bonalang malebana le bontsi jwa disupi, go sa ntse go na le dikarolo tse di tlhokang tsereganyo e e gokaganeng ya puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqaphela ukuthi yize kube nenqubekela phambili ebonakalayo maqondana nezinkomba eziningi, zisekhona izindawo ezidinga ukungenelela okuhleliwe kukahulumeni.

src: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a botlhokwa a puso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e tlhagisitse Ditebogo tsa yona go maAforika Borwa a a tsibogetseng boikuelo jwa Khomišene ya Ditlhopho e e Ikemetseng (IEC) jwa gore batho ba ikwadise, ba tlhole seemo sa bone sa ikwadiso mmogo le go ntšhwafatsa dintlha tsa bona mo lenaneng la batlhopi ka mafelo a beke a la bo 5 le la bo 6 Mopitlwe 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise ukubonga kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abananele ikhwelo leKhomishana Ezimele Yokhetho (i-IEC) lokuthi abantu babhalise, babheke isimo sabo sokubhalisa futhi babuyekeze imininingwane yabo esohlwini lwabavoti ngempelasonto yomhla zi-5 nangomhla zi-6 Ndasa 2016.

src: Batho ba ka nna dimilione di le tharo ba etetse diteišene tsa ditlhopho naga ka bophara mme baikwadisi ba bantšhwa ba le 544 552 (78%) ba ne ba le dingwaga tse di ka fa tlase ga 30, e leng sesupo sa keletso ya maAforika Borwa go nna le seabe mo go ageng temokerasi ya rona.
tgt: Balinganiselwa kuzigidi ezintathu abantu abavakashele iziteshi zokuvota ezweni lonke kanti abantu aba-544 552 kwababhalise okokuqala ngqa (ama-78.6 %) ngabantu abaneminyaka engaphansi kwa-30 ubudala, nokubonisa ukuzimisela kwezakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ekubambeni iqhaza ekwakheni umbuso wethu wentando yeningi.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng go diragatsa tshwanelo ya bona ya molaotheo ka go ikwadisa mme e rotloetsa ba ba ikwadisitseng mo nakong e e fetileng go tlhomamisa dintlha tsa bona tsa ikwadiso ya ditlhopho ka ntlha ya fa go na le mabaka a le mmalwa a a bakileng diphetogo mo lenaneng la batlhopi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi basebenzise ilungelo labo lentando yeningi ngokubhalisela ukuvota futhi inxusa labo abaseke babhalisa ngaphambilini ukuthi baqinisekise imininingwane yabo yokubhalisela ukuvota njengoba ziningana izinto eziye zaholela ezinguqukweni ohlwini lwabavoti.

src: Beke ya bofelo ya ikwadiso e tla nna ka la bo 9 le la bo 10 Moranang 2016 fa diteišene tsa ditlhopho di tla bo di butswe gape go tloga ka ura ya bo 8:00 mo mosong go fitlha ka ura ya bo 17:00 mo maetsiboeng.
tgt: Impelasonto yokubhalisa okokugcina izoba mhla zi-9 nangomhla zi-10 Mbaso 2016 lapho kuzophinda kuvulwe iziteshi zokuvota kusukela ngehora le-8:00 kuze kushaye ihora le-17:00.

src: Seno e tla bo e le tšhono ya bofelo ya gore batlhophi ba ikwadise le go ntšhwafatsa dintlha tsa bona tsa ikwadiso kwa diteišene tsa ditlhopho.
tgt: Leli kuyoba yithuba lokugcina lokuthi abavoti babhalise futhi babuyekeze imininingwane yabo yokubhalisa eziteshini zabo zokuvota.

src: Le fa go le jalo, go ikwadisa go tswelela pele kwa dikantorong tsa selegae tsa IEC ka dinako tsa tiro go tloga Mosupologo go fitlha ka Labotlhano, go fitlha lenane la batlhophi la Ditlhopho tsa Makgotlatoropo tsa 2016 le tswalelwa ka letsatsi le go tla bong go itsesiwe letlha la ditlhopho ka lona.
tgt: Kodwa ukubhalisa kuyaqhubeka emahhovisi e-IEC endawo ngezikhathi zomsebenzi kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuze kushaye uLwesihlanu, kuze kuvalwe uhlu lwabavoti loKhetho Lomasipala lonyaka we-2016 ngosuku okumenyezelwa ngalo usuku lokuvota.

src: Kabinete e kgalema ka bogale tirisodikgoka e e neng e aparetse mafelo a beke ya ikwadiso fa gautshwane kwa mafelong mangwe mme e boeletsa gore ga gona motho ope yo o tshwanetseng go thibela moAforika Borwa ope go diragatsa tshwanelo ya gagwe ya tmolaotheo ya go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka udlame olube khona kwezinye izindawo ngempelasonto yokubhalisela ukuvota esanda kudlula futhi iyagcizelela ukuthi akukho muntu ongavimbela noma yisiphi isakhamizi saseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi sisebenzise ilungelo laso lentando yeningi lokubhalisela ukuvota.

src: Kabinete e ikuela gape mo go botlhe ba ba rweleng maikarabelo go tila dikgato tseo tsa bosenyi le gore ba ba amegang ba bege ditiragalo tseo kwa ditheong tsa tiragatso ya molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinda inxusa bonke labo abenza lokhu ukuthi bayeke le misebenzi yobugebengu futhi ukuthi labo abathintekile babike lezi zigilamikhuba kwabezomthetho.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo ditheong tsotlhe tsa tiragatso ya molao go tsaya dikgato tse di bogale kgatlhanong le batlolamolao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abaphethe ezomthetho ukuthi bathathele labo abaphula umthetho izinyathelo ezinqala.

src: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla etela Port Elizabeth ka la bo 8 Moranang 2016 go tlhatlhoba kgatelopele e e dirilweng tebang le go tlhabolola mafaratlhatlha a dipalangwa tsa mo lewatleng jaaka karolo ya maiteko a naga a Ikonomi ya Lewatle.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma uzohambela e-Port Elizabeth mhla zi-8 Mbaso 2016 ukuyohlola inqubekela phambili ekwakhiweni kwengqalasizinda yezokuthutha yasolwandle njengengxenye yezinyathelo zoMnotho Wezwe Wasolwandle.

src: Ikonomi ya Lewatle ke nngwe ya maphata a le mararo a Operation Phakisa mme e atametsa naga gaufi le go bula bokgoni jwa mawatle a Aforika Borwa, a a nang le bokgoni jwa go nna le seabe sa bokana ka R177 bilione mo ikonoming ya naga le go tlhama ditiro tse dintšhwa di feta milione.
tgt: UMnotho Wasolwandle ungenye yemigudu emithathu yoMKhankaso we-Operation Phakisa futhi usondeza izwe ekufezeni ukubaluleka kwezilwandle zaseNingizimu Afrika, nokungenzeka kufake izigidigidi ezi-177 zamarandi emkhiqizweni okhiqizwe ngaphakathi ezweni kanye nokudala amathuba emisebenzi emisha angaphezu kwesigidi.

src: Kabinete e amogela go konosediwa ka katlego ga Leeto la Semmuso la ga Moporesitente Zuma kwa Rephaboliking ya Bofeterale ya Nigeria go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 9 Mopitlwe 2016, e e tokafaditseng dikgolagano tse di leng gona tsa sebedi tsa sepolotiki, ikonomi le loago.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukuphethwa ngempumelelo koHambo Olusemthethweni lukaMongameli Zuma lokuvakashela eRiphabhuliki YaseNigeria kusukela mhla zi-8 zaze zaba yi-9 Ndasa 2016, nokwenze ngcono ubudlelwano bezepolitiki, bezomnotho kanye nobezenhlalo phakathi kwamazwe amabili.

src: Nngwe ya dintlhakgolo tsa diphitlhelelo tsa leeto e nnile go godisiwa ga Khomišene ya Dinagapedi go ya kwa seemong sa Tlhogo ya Mmuso, e leng se se bayang tlhabololo ya ikonomi magareng ga dinaga tse pedi go nna setlapele.
tgt: Okunye okufezwe yilokhu kuvakasha kube ukuphakanyiswa kweKhomishani Yamazwe Amabili yayiswa ezingeni leZinhloko Zombuso, nokuqhakambisa ukuthuthukiswa komnotho phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili.

src: Kabinete e amogela go bulelwa ga ikonomi ya Nigeria ditlamo tsa Aforika Borwa mo maphateng a a farologaneng a tshwana le a boenjiniri, ditlhaeletsano tsa megala, dikago, diphofo, bobegakgang, bojanala, dibanka, boitumediso, dithoto, kgwebo, mmogo le ditirelo tsa go phuruphutsha oli le gase.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukuvulwa komnotho waseNigeria uvulelwa izinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika emikhakheni ehlukahlukene efana nowezobunjiniyela, owezokuxhumana ngezigcingo, owezokwakha, owezezindiza, owezezindaba, owezokuphathwa kwezivakashi, owezamabhange, owezokuzijabulisa, owezakhiwo, owezokuthengisa, owezemisebenzi yokuthola upetroli negesi.

src: Kabinete e letetse kgolo ya palo ya dipeeletso tsa Nigeria mo Aforika Borwa e leng se se tla tsweletsang kgwebisano ya maphatamabedi magareng ga dinaga tse pedi tse.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikulangazelele ukwanda kwenani lotshalomali lwaseNigeria eNingizimu Afrika nokuzokhuthaza uhwebo oluhlomulisa amazwe womabili.

src: Dipoelo tsa puisano eno magareng ga diikonomi tse pedi tse dikgolo go gaisa mo kontinenteng di tla gokaganya diikonomi tsa kgaolo, mme ka go rialo di oketse mmaraka o o tlhakanetsweng le go godisa maiteko a a leng teng a kgolo ya ikonomi mmogo le ditiro mo Aforika.
tgt: Imiphumela yalokhu kuxoxisana phakathi kwezikhondlakhondla ezimbili zezomnotho ezwenikazi kuzodidiyela iminotho yezifunda, ngaleyo ndlela kwandise imakethe efanayo futhi kukhuphule izinhlelo ezikhona njengamanje zokukhula komnotho kanye namathuba emisebenzi e-Afrika.

src: Seno se supa gore Aforika Borwa e sa ntse e le boyo jo bo gaisanang jwa dipeeletso le fa ikonomi ya lefatshe e ntse e le mo mathateng, mme se tla lebisa kwa ditšhonong tsa ditiro mmogo le tlhabololo ya bokgoni jwa maAforika Borwa otlhe.
tgt: Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isalokhu iyindawo yotshalomali ekwazi ukuncintisana nezinye phezu kwesimo somnotho womhlaba esingesihle, futhi kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwamathuba emisebenzi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tsibogetse gore Aforika Borwa e tla nna le seabe mo Kopanong ya bo 60 ya Khomišene ya Seemo sa Basadi ya Ditšhabakopano (UN) (CSW60) e e diragalang kwa New York, Amerika go tloga ka la bo 14 go fitlha ka la bo 24 Mopitlwe 2016 ka fa tlase ga moono wa: “Maatlafatso ya basadi le kgolagano ya yona le tlhabololo e e nnelang leruri.” Kopano e diragala mo ngwageng wa botlhokwa wa Aforika Borwa ka ntlha ya fa o na le diphitlhelelo tse tharo tsa botlhokwa, e leng, Segopotso sa bo 20 sa Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996, Segopotso sa bo 40 sa Dikhuduego tsa kwa Soweto le Segopotso sa bo 60 sa mogwanto wa basadi wa 1956.Aforika Borwa e tlhagisitse pegelo kwa UN CSW60 mme seno se re naya tšhono ya go lekanyetsa kgatelopele e re e dirileng fa e sale re bona temokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphelile ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika izobamba iqhaza eMhlanganweni wa-60 Wekhomishana Yenhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) emayelana Nesimo Sabesifazane (i-CSW60) ezobanjelwa e-New York, e-USA kusukela zi-14 zize zibe nga-24 Ndasa 2016 ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "Ukufukulwa Kwabesifazane kanye nokuxhumana kwakho nentuthuko ezinzile".

src: Go botlhokwa go lemoga gore fa e sale ka puso ya temokerasi, Aforika Borwa, gareng ga tse dingwe, e nnile le seabe kwa Khonferenseng ya bo 4 ya Lefatshe ya Basadi ka 1995, mme ya saena Sekwalwa sa Beijing sa Maikano le Dirala tsa go tsaya Dikgato gone mo ngwageng oo.
tgt: Lo mhlangano ubajwa onyakeni obalulekile kuNingizimu Afrika njengoba kunemicimbi emintathu ebalulekile, okungukuGunjwa kweminyaka e-20 yoMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi YaseNingizimu Afrika yonyaka we-1996, Umgubho weminyaka e-40 Yezibhelu Zentsha YaseSoweto kanye noMgubho wa-60 wemashi yabesifazane yonyaka we-1956.INingizimu Afrika ithule umbiko ku-UN CSW60 futhi lokhu kusinika ithuba lokulinganisa inqubekela phambili esesiyifezile kusukela ekuqaleni kwentando yeningi.

src: Go lepalepana le tshwetso ya E/RES/2013/18 ya Lekgotla la UN la Ikonomi le Loago, Aforika Borwa e itlamile go tswelela go diragatsa Sekwalwa sa Beijing sa Maikano le Dirala tsa go tsaya Dikgato, e leng leano la maatlafatso le tsweletso ya basadi.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuba siveze ukuthi kusukela ngesikhathi sombuso wentando yeningi eNingizimu Afrika, phakathi kwezinye izinto , sibambe iqhaza eMhlanganweni We-4 Womhlaba Wabantu Besifazane ngonyaka we-1995, futhi sasayina ne-Beijing Declaration ne-Platform for Action ngomnyaka ofanayo.

src: Melaotlhomo.
tgt: Imithethosivivinywa.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Dipopegotheo tsa Makgotlatoropo wa 2016 wa Pusoselegae kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuphasisile ukwethulwa ePhalamende Kwesichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wezinhlaka Zikamasipala: Uhulumeni Wendawo sonyaka we-2016.

src: Go dirwa dipaakanyo mo Molaong wa Dipopegotheo tsa Makgotlatoropo,1998 (Molao wa bo 117 wa 1998) wa Pusoselegae o o fetisitsweng pele ga ditlhopho tsa ntlha tsa temokerasi tsa pusoselegae tse di diragetseng ka la bo 5 Sedimonthole 2000.Dipaakanyo di tla tokafatsa tsamaiso ya ditlhopho tsa pusoselegae mme gareng ga diphetogo tse dingwe, o batla go:a) baakanya seemo sa makgotlatoropo a Karolo ya Ab) tlosa go kaiwa ga dikarolo tsa tsamaiso ya dikgaoloc) tlhamalatsa letlha la go simolola tiro ga molekgotlad) letla Moporesitente go tlhoma le go itsise letlha la ditlhopho tsa makgotlatoropoe) letla gore go nne le katoloso ya kitsiso ya dipholo tsa ditlhophof) gore motsamaisi wa lekgotlatoropo a itsese IEC ka diphatlhatiro tse di mo otongg) swetsa gore Mokhuduthamaga a itsise le go tlhoma letlha la ditlhopho tsa tlaleletsoh) tlhamalatsa ditlhokego tsa maloko a setlhophatshwetso tsa kopano ya lekgotlai) tlhamalatsa mabaka a go tlhopha ga molekgotla yo e leng modulasetilo ka nako ya kopano ya lekgotlaj) oketsa pharologano ya palo ya batlhophi mo otong nngwe le nngwe ka nako ya kopano ya lekgotla lek) oketsa pharologano ya palo ya batlhophi mo otong nngwe le nngwe ka nako ya go aroganngwa ga melelwane go tlhalosa kabo ya ditilo tse di fetang tekano mo makgotlatoropong a selegae.
tgt: Kwenziwa izichibiyelo kuMthetho Wezinhlaka Zikamasipala: Uhulumeni Wendawo we-1998 (uMthetho wa-117 we-1998), owaphasiswa ngaphambi kokubanjwa kokhetho lokuqala lwentando yeningi lohulumeni basekhaya olwabanjwa mhla zi-5 Zibandlela 2000.Ukuchibiyela kuzokwenza ngcono ukulawulwa kokhetho lohulumeni bendawo futhi phakathi kokunye, kuhlose:a) ukuchibiyela indlela yomasibala beSigaba Ab) ukuqeda konke ukukhuluma ngezindawo zokuphathwa kwezifundac) ukucacisa ngosuku lokuqala umsebenzi kwekhanselad) ukunquma ukuthi uMongameli kumele aqoke futhi amemezele usuku lokhetho lomasipalae) ukuvumela ukwelulwa kwesikhathi sokumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yokhethof) udinga ukuthi imenenja kamasipala yazise i-IEC ngezikhala zomsebenzi ezivulekile kuzigcemeg) ukunquma ukuthi Ilungu Lomkhandlu limemezela futhi liqoke usuku lokhetho lokuchibiyelah) ukucacisa isibalo esidingekayo sabantu abakhona ukuze kubanjwe umhlangano kamasipalai) ukucacisa izimo zokuvota zekhansela elingusihlalo ngesikhathi kubanjwe imihlangano yomkhandluj) ukukhulisa ukuguqulwa kwesibalo sabavoti kusigceme ngasinye ngesikhathi kubanjwe imihlangano yomkhandlu kanyek) nokukhulisa ukuguqulwa kwesibalo sabavoti kusigceme ngasinye ngesikhathi sokuklanywa kwendawo ukucacisa ukwabiwa kwezihlalo eziningi komasipala bendawo.

src: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Moporesitente Zuma - jaaka modulasetilommogo le Moporesitente wa Fora François Hollande wa Khomišene ya Maemo a a Kwa Godimo ya Ditiro tsa Boitekanelo le Kgolo ya Ikonomi - o tla tsenela go tlhomiwa ga yona semmuso kwa Lyon, Fora ka Laboraro, 23 Mopitlwe 2016.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma – njengomunye wosihlalo benoMongameli waseFrance u-François Hollande beKhomishani Ephezulu Yezemisebenzi Kwezempilo Nokukhula Komnotho – uzothamela ukuthulwa ngokusemthethweni kwayo e-Lyon, e-France ngoLwesithathu, zi-23 Ndasa 2016.

src: Khomišene e totile tlhokego ya baporofešenale ba boitekanelo mo dinageng tsa lotseno lo lo magareng le lo lo kwa tlase.
tgt: Le khomishana igxile kusidingo sabasebenzi bezempilo abaqeqeshiwe emazweni azuza imali kancane naphakathi nendawo.

src: Go solofetswe gore maiteko ano a UN a oketse go nna teng ga boitekanelo lefatshe ka bophara le go tsweletsa kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang, e e nang le seabe mo tiragatsong ya Lenaane la 2030 la Tlhabololo e e nnelang Leruri.
tgt: Lolu hlelo lwe-UN kulindeleke ukuthi lukhulise ezempilo emhlabeni wonke kanye nokukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho ofaka wonke umuntu, nokuyinto enomthelela ukuqalisweni koHlelo Lwentuthuko Oluzinzile lonyaka we-2030.

src: Moporesident Zuma o tla tsaya Leeto la Semmuso go ya kwa Nagabogosing ya Saudi Arabia go tloga ka la bo 27 go fitlha ka la bo 28 Mopitlwe 2016, le le tla maatlafatsang botsalano jo bo leng teng magareng ga dinaga tse pedi.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzothatha Uhambo Olusemthethweni Lokuvakashela i-Kingdom of Saudi Arabia kusukela mhla zi-27 zize zibe mhla zi-28 Ndasa 2016, nokuzoqinisa ubudlelwano obukhona phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili.

src: Moporesitente o tla tsenela Samiti ya bo 4 ya Tshireletsego ya Nyutlilea kwa Washington, Amerika go tloga ka la bo 31 Mopitlwe go fitlha ka la bo 1 Moranang 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uzothamela Umhlangano We-4 Wokuphepha Kwenuzi e-Washington, e-USA kusukela mhla zi-31 Ndasa kuze kube mhla lu-1 Mbaso 2016.

src: Samiti e tla bua ka matshosetsi a a golang a borukhutli jwa nyutlilea le go sedimosa dikgato tse di ka tsewang ke baagi ba boditšhabatšhaba go fokotsa tiriso ya yuraniamo e e humileng thata, go sireletsa dimateriale tse di mo matshosetsing, go tsibogela go utswiwa ga nyutlilea le go thibela, batlisisa le go kgoreletsa maiteko a borukhutli jwa nyutlilea.
tgt: Lo mhlangano uzodingida ubungozi obukhulayo benuzi yobushokobezi futhi uveze izinyathelo ezingathathwa ngamazwe omhlaba ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-uraniyamu ecebe kakhulu, ukulondoloza impahla esengozini, ukuvimbela okushushunjiswa kwenuzi kanye nokuvimbela, ukuthola nokuphazamisa imizamo yobushokobezi benuzi.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o tla etelela pele meletlo ya Letsatsi la Ditshwanelo tsa Botho kwa Setediamo sa Moses Mabhida kwa KwaZulu-Natal ka Mosupologo, 21 Mopitlwe ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Aforika Borwa e kopane kgatlhanong le bosemorafe."
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzohola imigubho yoSuku Lwamalungelo Oluntu e-Moses Mabhida Stadium, esifundazweni saKwaZulu-Natal ngoMsombuluko, zi-21 Ndasa 2016 ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "iNingizimu Afrika ibumbene ekulweni nokucwasana ngobuhlanga."

src: Jaaka go itsisitswe ka Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba (SoNA) ya 2016, Letsatsi la Ditshwanelo tsa Botho la monongwaga le tla tlhoma motheo wa lenaane la pakatelele la go aga setšhaba se se sa tlhaoleng go ya ka morafe.
tgt: Njengoba kwamenyezelwa eNkulumweni Yesimo Sezwe yonyaka we-2016, Usuku Lwamalungelo Oluntu lwalo nyaka luzokwakha isisekelo sohlelo lwesikhathi eside lokwakha umphakathi ongacwasi ngokobuhlanga.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go kopana kgatlhanong le, le go nyatsa bosemorafe - e ka nna kwa magaeng a rona, mo baaging, mo dikopanong tsa loago, kwa ditirong gongwe mo mafaratlhatlheng a ditlhaeletsano tsa loago.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa zonke izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi zilwe futhi zingxeke ukucwasa ngokobuhlanga - kungaba semakhaya ethu, emiphakathini , emicimbini yokuzijabulisa, ezindaweni zokusebenza noma ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.

src: Re tshwanetse go dira mmogo go fitlhelela temokerasi e e kopaneng, e e sa tlhaoleng go ya ka bosemorafe le fa e le go tlhaola go ya ka bong.
tgt: Kufanele sonke sisebenzisane ukufeza intando yeningi ebumbene, engacwasi ngokwebala nangokubulili.

src: Bakhuduthamaga ba tla buisana le maAforika Borwa go ralala naga ka nako ya Beke ya Bosetšhaba ya Imbizo magareng ga la bo 4 le la bo 10 Moranang 2016, ka fa tlase ga moono wa: Mmogo re tsweletsa pele Aforika Borwa: Godisa Aforika Borwa."
tgt: Amalungu Esigungu Esiphezulu azoxoxisana nezakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezweni lonke ngesikhathi seSonto Likazwelonke Eligxile Ezimbizweni phakathi komhla zi-4 kuze kube mhla zi-10 Mbaso 2016, ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "Ngokubambisana singenza iNingizimu Afrika iqhubekele phambili: Khula Ningizimu Afrika."

src: Beke eo e tsamaelana le Beke ya Palamente ya Dikgaolotlhopho le meletlo ya Kgwedi ya Kgololesego.
tgt: Leli viki lihambisana neViki LePhalamende Lokubuyela Emazikweni kanye nokugujwa kweNyanga Yenkululeko.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa maAforika Borwa go nna le seabe se se tlhaga mo ditiragalong tseno le go buisana le baeteledipele ba sepolotiki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika uthi zibambe iqhaza ngendlela ebonakalayo kule micimbi futhi zixoxisane nezikhulu zezombusazwe.

src: Beke ya Imbizo e tla tlhagisa go tsenngwa tirisong ga Leano la Dintlharobongwe le maikaelelo a lona e leng go susumetsa kgolo ya ikonomi le go tlhama ditiro tse di tlhokegang thata.
tgt: Iviki Eligxile Ezimbizweni lizocacisa ngokuqala kokusetshenziswa koHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye oluhlose ukufukula ukukhula komnotho kanye nokuvula amathuba emisebenzi adingeka kakhulu.

src: E tla bontsha gape dikatlego tsa pusoselegae, go akarediwa diphitlhelelo tse di fitlheletsweng ka ntlha ya leano la tsosoloso ya pusoselegae - dikgato tsa Re boela kwa Tshimologong.
tgt: Lizophinda liveze impumelelo kahulumeni wendawo, kubandakanya impumelelo efezwe ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lokuvuselela kabusha ukulumeni wendawo.

src: Gape beke eo e tla tsamaelana le mafelo a beke a ikwadiso ya bofelo pele ga Ditlhopho tsa Makgotlatoropo tsa 2016, e naya gape baeteledipele tšhono ya go susumetsa le go rotloetsa maAforika Borwa ka thuto ya ditlhopho go ikwadisa le go tlhomamisa dintlha tsa bona tsa go tlhopha.
tgt: Leli viki lizophinda lihambisane nempelasonto yokugcina yokubhalisela Ukhetho Lomasipala lonyaka we-2016, futhi lihlinzeke abaphathi ngelinye ithuba lokukhuthaza nokuvukuza izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ngokusebenzisa umkhankaso wokufundisa abavoti ukuthi babhalise futhi baqinisekise imininingwane yabo yokuvota.

src: Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla bula Samiti ya bo 2 ya Lekgotla la Tlhabololo ya Badiri e e tla diragalang kwa Gallagher Convention Centre kwa Midrand ka la bo 29 le la bo 30 Mopitlwe 2016, ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Tirisanommogo go lebeletswe bokgoni - Boikuelo jwa go tsaya Dikgato".
tgt: IPhini Likamongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa uzovula Ingqungquthela Ye-2 Yomkhandlu Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwabasebenzi ezobanjelwa eGallagher Convention Centre eMidrand mhla zi-29 nangomhla zi-30 Ndasa 2016 ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "Ukusebenzisana kwezamakhono – Ikhwelo Lokuthi Kusetshenzwe".

src: Samiti e kgobokanya baamegi go tswa kwa lephateng la thuto e kgolwane go thusa mo tlhabololong ya lona le go tlhama tirisanommogo e e tla bopang ditheo tsa thuto e e kgolwane tse di maatla e bile di siametse indaseteri.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ihlanganisa ababambiqhaza abavela kuwo wonke umkhakha wezemfundo ephakeme ukusiza ukukhula kwawo kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obakha izikhungo zezemfundo ephakeme eziqotho eziyilungele imboni.

src: Beke ya Bosetšhaba ya Metsi ya 2016 e tla ketekiwa go tloga ka la bo 14 go fitlha ka la bo 22 Mopitlwe ka moono wa: "Metsi a batho, metsi ka batho".
tgt: Iviki Likazwelonke Lamanzi lonyaka we-2016 lizoba kusukela mhla zi-14 kuze kube mhla zi-22 Ndasa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "Amanzi abantu, amanzi aphethwe ngabantu".

src: Beke e tla tlhagisa metsi jaaka tshwanelo ya botho ka go godisa temogo ya mathata a batho ba ba sa kgoneng go fitlhelela metsi a a phepa, a a nwegang.
tgt: Leli viki lizoveza amanzi njengelungelo lomuntu ngokuqwashisa abantu ngosizi lwabantu abangenawo amanzi ahlanzekile okuphuza.

src: Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe le sa ntse le tsweletse ka go fedisa thulaganyo ya matlwana a dikgamelo mme ga jaana le setse le fedisitse 78% ya thulaganyo ya matlwana a dikgamelo kwa mafelong a baipei mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMnyango Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle usalokhu uqhubekile nohlelo lokuqeda uhlelo lwamabhakede futhi kuze kube yimanje usuqede ama-78,8% ohlelo lwamabhakede emijondolo eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Diporofense di le supa di dirile bontle tota ka palogare ya phediso ya 90%.
tgt: Izifundazwe eziyisikhombisa zisebenze kahle ngokuqeda uhlelo lwamabhakede ngama-90%.

src: Tse di kgonneng go fedisa gotlhelele kwa mafelong a baipei ke KwaZulu-Natal, Bokone Bophirima, Mpumalanga le Gauteng.
tgt: Lezo zifundazwe ezikwazile ukuqeda nya uhlelo lwamabhakede emijondolo yi-KwaZulu-Natal, yiNyakatho Ntshonalanga, yiMpumalanga neGauteng.

src: Kapa Bophirima e fitlheletse 99.8%.
tgt: INtshonalanga Kapa ifinyelele kuma-99,8% okuqedwa kohlelo lwamabhakede.

src: Go tswa mo diphitlhelelong tse di neng di beilwe tsa 26 120 kwa Kapa Bokone, Kapa Botlhaba, Bokone Bophirima le Foreisetata, go konoseditswe dithulaganyo di le 11 650 go fitlha ga jaana.
tgt: Kumkhawulo we-26 120 eNyakatho Kapa, eMpumalanga Kapa, eNyakatho Ntshonalanga naseFreyistata, kuze kube manje sekuqedwe izinhlelo azingaba yi-11 650.Nakuba imvula esanda kunetha ilethe ukukhululeka okuncane, umthelela wesomiso uyaqhubeka nokuzwakala kwezinye izingxenye zaleli lizwe.

src: Le fa pula ya fa gautshwane e thusitse, ditlamorago tsa komelelo di tsweletse go utlwala mo dikarolong dingwe tsa naga.
tgt: Izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika kumele ziqhubeke nokusebenzisa amanzi ngokuwonga futhi ziqalise imizamo yokonga amanzi.

src: Puso e tlametse ka R1 bilione go samagana le mathata a komelelo.
tgt: Uhulumeni wabe isigidigidi esi-1 samarandi ukubhekana nenkinga yesomiso.

src: Kabinete e amogela tswelelopele e e dirilweng ke lenaane la Ntwa kgatlhanong le go dutla ga dipeipi tsa metsi ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Lerothodi lengwe le lengwe le botlhokwa".
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamukela inqubekela phambili eyenziwa wuHlelo Lokulwa Nokuvuza Kwamanzi lweminyaka emihlanu ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "Iconsi ngalinye libalulekile".

src: Lenaane le ikaelela go ngoka, katisa le go phasalatsa bašwa ba le 15 000 ba ba nang le dithuto tse dinnye tsa Mophato wa 12 gongwe N3 jaaka dipolamara, diathisene gongwe baemedi ba metsi.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luhlose ukuqasha, luqeqeshe futhi lusabalalise abantu abasha aba-15 000 abaphase Ibanga le-12 noma u-N3 njengoplamba, abenzi bomsebenzi wezandla kanye nama-ejenti amanzi.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mo Mererong e e Botlhokwa ya ga jaana.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni eziqavile kwezemvelo.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go badiraditshupetso go itshwara le go tlhagisa dingongorego tsa bona ka tsela e e obamelang molao le Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa ababhikishi ukuthi benze konke okusemandleni ukuthi bazibambe futhi bazwakalise izikhalazo zabo ngendlela ehambisana nomthetho kanye noMthethosisekelo.

src: Go thuba le go senya dithoto ga e tlhole e le tshwanelo ya go dira ditshupetso mme ke tiro ya disenyi tse di senang taolo.
tgt: Ukucekela phansi kanye nokonakalisa impahla kuyadlula emkhawulweni welungelo lokubhikisha futhi ngumsebenzi wabantu abanobugebengu.

src: Ditheo tsa tiragatso ya molao di tla diragatsa molao ka go tshwara le go pega molato ba ba senyang dithoto kwa diyunibesithi, ditheong tse dingwe tsa thuto e kgolwane, le mo baaging ka nako ya ditshupetso.
tgt: Abathobelisi bomthetho bazolandela umthetho ngokubopha futhi babeke amacala labo bantu abonakalisa impahla emayunivesithi, kwezinye izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, emiphakathini kanye nangezikhathi zokubhikisha.

src: Tona ya Ditšhelete o begetse Kabinete ka letsholo la fa gautshwane le a le tsereng go ya Amerika le Borithane le baamegi ba ba farologaneng, go akarediwa baeteledipele ba kgwebo.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali wazise iKhabhinethi mayelana nomkhankaso osanda kuba khona wokuya e-US nase-United Kingdom nabantu abahlukahlukene okusetshenziswana nabo, kuhlanganisa abaholi bezamabhizinisi.

src: Kabinete e itlamile go netefatsa gore naga e dira mmogo go netefatsa gore maemo a rona ga a fokodiwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi leli lizwe lisebenza ngokubambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi asihliselwa kwelinye izinga.

src: Leeto leno le naya puso tšhono ya go tlhalosa ka maiteko a le mmalwa a a diragadiwang go samagana le dikgwetlho.
tgt: Lokhu kuvakasha kunikeza uhulumeni ithuba lokwazisa ngemizamo eminingana esiqalisiwe ukubhekana nezinselele.

src: Ona a akaretsa dikgato tse di tshwaraganetsweng go akofisa kgolo e e akaretsang botlhe, dikgato tsa go akofisa tsolotanyo ya ditšhelete, go akofisa go tsenngwa tirisong ga Lenaane la Dipeeletso tsa Mafaratlhatlha la R870 bilione mmogo le tswelelopele e e dirilweng go rarabolola mathata a motlakase, go akarediwa motlakase o o ntšhwafadiwang.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinyathelo zokusebenzisana ukusheshisa ukukhula komnotho okufaka wonke umuntu, izinyathelo zokusheshisa ukuhlanganiswa kwezimali, ukusheshiswa kokuqaliswa koHlelo Lokutshala Imali Kungqalasizinda olubiza izigidigidi ezi-870 zamarandi kanye nenqubekela phambili esiyenziwe ekuxazululeni izingqinamba zezamandla, kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ezamandla ezisebenziseka kabusha.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maphateng otlhe go buisanela manaane le ditsereganyo tse di tserweng go sireletsa ikonomi ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa yonke imikhakha ukuthi yazise ngazo zonke izinhlelo ezinhle kanye nokungenelela okwenziwe ukusiza umnotho wethu.

src: Go botlhokwa gore maphata otlhe a netefatse gore ikonomi ya naga e kgona go emelana le dikgwetlho.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuthi yonke imikhakha iqinisekise ukuthi umnotho wezwe uyakwazi ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima.

src: Mo ntlheng eno, Kabinete e laetse gape Komiti ya Ditona ya Dipeeletso go akofisa ditshwetso tsotlhe tsa botlhokwa tse di amanang le ikonomi.
tgt: Mayelana nalokhu, iKhabhinethi ijube iKomiti Lotshalomali Elixube Ongqongqoshe ukuthi liqalise ngokushesha ukusebenzisa zonke izinqumo ezibalulekile ezimayelana nomnotho.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa gore go emelana le dikgwetlho ga ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa go agilwe mo dintlhatheong tse di tsepameng tsa ikonomi mmogo le dipholisi tse di dirisegang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela ukuthi umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika okwazi ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima wakhelwe phezu kwezisekelo zomnotho kanye nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzisekayo ezingezoqobo.

src: Kabinete e lemogile kgetse ya kgotlatshekelo e e tlhatlhetsweng ke Mokgatlho wa Meepo ya gore Tumelano ya Meepo e se e e mo molaotheong mme e tseewe jaaka e e seng mosola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaqaphela icala elivulwe yi-Chamber of Mines ukuthi kumenyezelwe Umqulu Wezezimayini njengophambene noMthethosisekelo futhi oyizeleze.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa gore dintlhatheo tsa Tumelano ya Meepo di ikaeletse go fetola indaseteri ya meepo le go samagana le go tlhoka tekatekano ga maloba go go tlhotlheleditsweng ke tlhaolele gore indaseteri e lepalepane le diphetogo tsa go fetolwa ka kakaretso ga seemo sa Aforika Borwa sa loago, polotiki mmogo le ikonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela ukuthi imigomo yoMqulu Wezezimayini wukuguqula imboni yasezimayini ukulungisa ukungalingani kwaphambilini okwabangelwa wubandlululo ukuze imboni ihambisane nezinguquko jikelele zaseNingizimu Afrika zesimo somphakathi, sezombusazwe kanye nesezomnotho.

src: Kgodiso ya baagi ke ntlha e nngwe ya botlhokwa go netefatsa gore tlhabololo ya meepo ga e kgaphele thoko baagi ba ba maleba.
tgt: Ukufukulwa komphakathi ngenye yezindawo ezibalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezimayini akushiyi ngaphandle imiphakathi efanele.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo badirising botlhe ba tsela, bogolo segolo ba ba tla bong ba le mo maetong ka paka ya malatsi a boikhutso, go diragatsa seabe sa bona ka go rwala maikarabelo a pabalesego ya bona le ya badirisi ba bangwe ba tsela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abasebenzisi bomgwaqo, kakhulukazi labo abathatha uhambo ngamaholidi azayo, ukuthi badlale indima yabo ekuphepheni kwabo kanye nokwabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo.

src: Go fedisa matlhotlhapelo a mo tseleng e sa ntse e le setlapele sa bosetšhaba.
tgt: Ukuqeda izingozi zomgwaqo kusalokhu kungumsebenzi oseqhulwini kuzwelonke.

src: Bakgweetsi ba tshwanetse go nna ba butse matlho, ba obamele melawana ya tsela, ba seke ba nwa mme ba kgweetsa, ba obamele tekanyetso ya lebelo mmogo le go netefatsa gore dijanaga tsa bona di siametse tsela.
tgt: Abashayeli kumele baqaphele, bathobele imithetho yomgwaqo, bangaphuzi bese beyashayela, bagcine umkhawulo wejubane futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izimoto zabo zisesimweni esifanele sokuba semgwaqeni.

src: Kabinete e akgola bafenyi botlhe ba Dikgele tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Ditshwanelo tsa Bogole tse di neng di tshwerwe ka la bo 11 Mopitlwe 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela bonke abawinile kuZindondo Zikazwelonke Zamalungelo Okukhubazeka ezazibanjwe mhla zi-11 Ndasa 2016.

src: Dikgele tseno di lemogile batho ba ba nang le bogole le balweladitshwanelo ba ditshwanelo tsa bogole ba ba itshupileng ka 2015.
tgt: Le miklomelo ihlonipha abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka kanye nezishoshovu zamalungelo okukhubazeka abenze umsebenzi oncomekayo ngonyaka we-2015.

src: Kabinete e akgola bafenyi botlhe ba Dikgele tsa bo 3 tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Botswerere tsa Ngwaga le Ngwaga tsa Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS), tse di akgolang botswerere jwa ditokololo tsa SAPS, maresefe mmogo le ditokololo tsa diforamo tsa baagi tsa sepodisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela bonke abanqobile ku-3rd South African Police Service (SAPS) Excellence Awards, abonga umsebenzi oncomekayo wamalungu e-SAPS, amarizevu kanye namalungu ezinkundla zamaphoyisa omphakathi.

src: Kabinete e akgola bakwadimmogo Mandla Dube le Leon Otto ba Pambili Media ka baesekopo ya bona ya Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu.
tgt: IKhabinethi ihalalisela abalobi abahlanganyele uMandla Dube no-Leon Otto we-Pambili Media ngefilimu ethi Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu.

src: MaAforika Borwa a rotloediwa go bogela baesekopo eno ya sepolotiki e e kgatlhisang e e ka ga go fetoga ga mosimanyana wa dingwaga di le 19 wa kwa Mamelodi, kwa botlhaba jwa Pretoria, go nna mogaka wa Kgaratlho.
tgt: Izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ziyakhuthazwa ukuba zibuke le filimu yezombusazwe emayelana nokuguquka kwensizwa eneminyaka eyi-19 edabuka eMamelodi, empumalanga nePitori, iba yisishoshovu soMzabalazo.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse gore puso, ka Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri le la Botsweretshi le Setso, e tla tswelela go tshegetsa kgolo ya indaseteri ya botsweretshi ka go keteka le go anela dikgang tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabinethi ikugcizelele ukuthi uhulumeni, ngokusebenzisa iminyango wezoHwebo Nezimboni kanye Nowezobuciko Namasiko, uzoqhubeka nokusekela ukukhula kwemboni yezobuciko ekugubheni nasekuxoxeni umlando waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e akgola molweladitshwanelo tsa bosiamisi jwa loago Moruti Michael Lapsey ka go amogela Sekgele sa Kagiso ya Setšhaba sa boditšhabatšhaba sa 2016 mo karolong ya 'Kagiso ya Lefatshe le Poelano - Modirakagiso yo o Itsegeng Boditšhabatšhaba'.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela isishoshovu sezobulungiswa kwezenhlalakahle uMfundisi Michael Lapsley ngokuthola Umklomelo Womhlaba Wokuthula Emphakathini we-2016 esigabeni “Ukuthula Nokubuyisana Emhlabeni – Umdalixolo Odumile emhlabeni'.

src: Kabinete e akgola Pieter du Preez jaaka a tlhophetswe Sekgele sa Motshameki wa Lefatshe wa Ngwaga yo o nang le Bogole sa Laureus, go latela tiragatso ya gagwe e e gaisitseng ka 2015.
tgt: IKhabinethi ihalalisela u-Pieter du Preez ngokuqokelwa Umklomelo weLaureus World Sportsperson of the Year with a Disability, ngokudlala kwakhe okuvelele ngonyaka we-2015.

src: Kabinete e akgola Wayde van Niekerk yo o dirileng hisetori ya lebelo ka go nna monna wa ntlha mo hisetoring go taboga mabelo otlhe a le mararo: 100m ka fa tlase ga metsotswana e le 10, 200m ka fa tlase ga metsotswana e le 20 le 400m ka fa tlase ga metsotswana e le 44, jaaka go tlhomamisitswe ke Mokgatlho wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Difetereišene tsa Mabelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela u-Wayde van Niekerk oqophe umlando kwezokugijima ngesivinini ngokuba umuntu wokuqala emlandweni ngokugijima yonke imijaho emithathu: ama-100m ngaphansi kwemizuzwana eyi-10, ama-200m ngaphansi kwemizuzwana enga-20 kanye nama-400M ngaphansi kwemizuzwana enga-44, njengoba kuqinisekiswe yiNhlangano Yomhlaba Ebunjwe Yizinhlangano Zokusubatha.

src: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a botlhokwa a puso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e amogela diphitlhelelo tse di tlhagisitsweng ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka nako ya ketelo ya setsha kwa Boemelakepeng jwa Port Elizabeth kwa Kapa Botlhaba, go sekaseka kgatelopele e e leng teng malebana le go tsenngwa tirisong ga Operation Phakisa: e leng maiteko a Ikonomi ya Mawatle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile osekuzuziwe okuqhakanjiswe nguMongameli u-Jacob Zuma ngenkathi ehambele mathupha Echwebeni laseBhayi eMpumalanga Kapa, ukuhlola inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe maqondana nokuqaliswa ukusebenza kohlelo lomnotho wasolwandle olwaziwa ngokuthi yi-Operation Phakisa: Umnotho Waselwandle.

src: Puso e golotse dipeeletso tse di ka nnang bokana ka R17 bilione mo Ikonoming ya Mawatle.
tgt: Uhulumeni usethukulule utshalomali olufinyelela cishe kwizigidigidi eziyi-17 zamarandi Emnothweni Wasolwandle.

src: Fa e sale e tlhomiwa, go tlhamilwe ditiro di feta 4 500 mo maphateng a a farologaneng.
tgt: Kusukela ekusengulweni kwalo lolu hlelo, sekusungulwe imisebenzi engaphezu kwezi-4 500 emikhakheni enhlobonhlobo.

src: Mekoro e e gogang e le mebedi mo go e e robongwe e e agiwang ke Southern African Shipyards ba e agela Bothati Jwa Bosetšhaba jwa Maemelakepe jwa Transnet (TNPA) kwa Boemelakepeng jwa Durban di lebile kwa Boemelakepeng jwa Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Izingalawana ezimbili kweziyisishiyagalolunye ezakhiwa Izakhamkhumbi zaseNingizimu ne-Afrika zakwa-Transnet National Ports Authority (i-TNPA) Echwebeni lase-Durban zizohanjiswa Echwebeni laseBhayi.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o tlhomile mokoro wa ntlha o o gogang kwa Port Elizabeth, o o teilweng leina la Mvezo, o teelelwa lefelo le Moporesitente Nelson Mandela a belegetsweng kwa go lona.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma wethule ingalawana yokuqala eBhayi, ebizwa ngokuthi uMvezo, eqanjwe ngegama lendawo yokuzalwa kaMongameli waphambilini uNelson Mandela.

src: TNPA e abile madi a feta R7 bilione go tokafatsa maemelakepe a rona.
tgt: I-TNPA seyabe izigidigidi ezingaphezu kweziyi-7 zamarandi ukwenza ngcono amachweba ethu.

src: Moporesitente o ne a lebelela mafelo a dikepe di emelang mo go ona a a ntšhwafaditsweng mo Boemelakepeng jwa Port Elizabeth a a tla kgonang go amogela dikepe tse dingwe di le 12 fa a bapisiwa le a ga jaana a a amogelang di le pedi.
tgt: UMongameli uzibhekile izindlela ezishibilikayo ezivuselelwe kabusha nezakhiwe kabusha kanye nemigudu eholela ezakhiweni zokukhuleka imikhumbi Echwebeni laseBhayi ezizokwazi ukuhlala imikhumbi eyi-12 ngaphezulu uma kuqhathaniswa nalena emibili ekhona njengamanje.

src: Kabinete e leboga baduelalekgetho botlhe ba ba tshwaraganeng le puso mo ngwageng wa ditšhelete wa 2015/16 go tsholetsa kokoanyo ya rona ya lotseno go ya go R1 trilione la ntlha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke abakhokhi bentela ababambisane nohulumeni onyakeni wezimali wezi-2015/16 ekuthatheni izimali zethu eziqoqwayo bazibeke kutriliyoni yamarandi okokuqala ngqa emlandweni.

src: Seno ke sesupo se se tlhamaletseng se se ka ga maatla a ikonomi ya rona e e tsweletseng pele le fa go le thata WEBTOKEN fela ka tuelo ya lekgetho ya maAforika Borwa a a obamelang melao mmogo le kokoanya e e matlhagatlhaga ya letseno ka Tirelo ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa (SARS) moo puso e kgonang go tlamela ka botlalo ditirelo tse di tlhokegang tse di nang le seabe mo tokafatsong ya matshelo a maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Lesi yisibonakaliso esicacile samandla omnotho wethu ohlumayo ngisho ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima.

src: Kabinete e amogela kitsiso ya ga Moporesitente Zuma ya gore la bo 3 Phatwe 2016 ke letlha la Ditlhopho tsa Pusoselegae tsa 2016.
tgt: Kungenxa yezinkokhelo zentela ezivela kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abathobela umthetho kanye nokuqoqwa kwezimali ngempumelelo yiSikhungo Sezinsizakalo Zokuqoqwa Kwezimali saseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS) nakuba uhulumeni ukwazi kangcono ukuhlinzeka izinsizakalo ezibhekwe ngamehlo abovu ezinegalelo ekwenzeni ngcono izimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Puso e kgotsofaditswe ke gore mafelo a beke a mabedi a ikwadiso a la bo 5-6 Mopitlwe le la bo 9-10 Moranang a ne a na le palo e e kwa godimo ya ba ba ka tlhophang ba ba neng ba etetse diteišene tsa ditlhopho, bogolo segolo ba ba tla bong ba tlhopha la ntlha mmogo le bašwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamukelile isimemezelo sikaMongameli uZuma somhla zi-3 Ncwaba 2016 njengosuku Lokhetho Lohulumeni Bezindawo Lwezi-2016.

src: Kabinete e leboga botlhe ba ba tsibogetseng boikuelo jwa go ikwadisa le go tlhola dintlha tsa bona mo lenaneng la batlhopi.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyakujabulela ukuthi izimpelasonto ezimbili zokubhalisela ukuvota ngomhla zi-5–6 kuNdasa kanye nomhla ziyi-9–10 kuMbasa zibonise inqwaba yabantu abangavota behambela ezikhungweni zokuvota, ikakhulukazi labo abazobe bevota okokuqala kanye nentsha.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging botlhe ba ba iseng ba ikwadise gongwe go tlhola dintlha tsa bona go etela dikantoro tsa Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho kwa makgotlatoropong a bona le go ntšhwafatsa dintlha tsa bona mo lenaneng la batlhophi (ba tlamele ka diaterese) le go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha ka ditlhopho tsa la bo 3 Phatwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke labo abasabelile ekhweleni lokubhalisela ukuvota kanye nokuyobheka imininingwane yabo ohlwini labavoti.

src: Gape batlhophi ba ka romela dinomoroitshupo tsa bona ka SMS mo go 3281.0 gongwe go letsetsa tikwatikwe ya kgolagano kwa 0800 11 8000 go tlhomamisa seemo sa bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa zonke izakhamuzi ezingakabhaliseli ukuvota noma ezingakayibheki imininingwane yazo ukuba zihambele amahhovisi eKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele komasipala bezindawo bazo bese zivuselela imininingwane yazo ohlwini labavoti (zihlinzeke ngamakheli) bese zibhalisela ukuvota okhethweni lomhla zi-3 kuNcwaba.

src: Ikwadiso e netefatsa gore leina la gago le teng mo lenaneng la batlhophi gore o kgone go tlhopha.
tgt: Ukubhalisa kuqinisekisa ukuthi igama lakho likhona ohlwini labavoti ukuze uzokwazi ukuvota.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging botlhe go diragatsa tshwanelo ya bona ya temokerasi e e lwetsweng ka thata ya go tlhopha mo Ditlhophong tsa Dipusoselegae tsa 2016 ka la bo 3 Phatwe 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema izakhamizi ukuba zisebenzise ilungelo lethu lomthethosiseko esalithola kanzima lokuvota Okhethweni Lohulumeni Bezindawo Lwezi-2016 ngomhla zi-3 Ncwaba 2016.

src: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa semmuso ga Porojeke ya Tekeletso ya eChannel ya Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae (DHA) ke Moporesitente Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukwethulwa ngokusemthethweni komklamo obizwa ngokuthi yi-eChannel Pilot Project woMnyango Wezasekhaya (i-DHA) nguMongameli uZuma.

src: Thulaganyo eno e ntšhwa ya boitlhamedi e letla baagi go dira dikopo tsa dikarata tsa boitshupo mo inthaneteng go tila mela e meleele.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luusha lesimanje manje luvumela izakhamuzi ukuba zikwazi ukufaka izicelo zazo zomazisi abangamakhadi, i-Smart ID, ku-inthanethi futhi zigweme imigqa emide.

src: Tirisanommogo eno le dibanka tse dikgolo di le nne - Dibanka tsa ABSA, FNB, Nedbank le Standard - go tsenyatirisog serala sa go dira dikopo ka inthanete tsa dikarata tsa boitshupo le makwalo a mosepele go kgontsha badirisi go etela dikioseke tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae go isa fela dikgatiso tsa menwana le ditshwantsho morago ga go dira peelano le tuelo mo inthaneteng.
tgt: Lokhu kusebenzisana namabhange amane amakhulu – okuyi-ABSA, i-FNB, i-Nedbank kanye ne-Standard Bank – ukwethula inkundla yokufaka izicelo kwi-inthanethi zomazisi abangamakhadi kanye namaphasiphothi kuzokwenza izakhamuzi zikwazi ukuhambela amakhosombe e-DHA ukuhambisa izinsalela zawo zeminwe kanye nezithombe emva kokuba esenze isivumelwano sokubonana futhi enza nezinkokhelo kwi-inthanethi.

src: eChannel ke karolo ya togamaano ya tlhabololo ka kakaretso ya lefapha go tlosa ditirelo kwa mokgweng wa pampiri go ya go wa dijitale, e leng tsamaiso e e tla akaretsang go phepafatsa rejisetara ya baagi.
tgt: I-eChannel iyingxenye yeqhinga selilonke lomnyango lesimanjemanje lokususa izinsizakalo ephepheni ziye kubuxhakaxhaka bubochwepheshe, uhlelo oluzobandakanya ukulungiswa kwamaphutha kwirejista enemininingwane yabantu.

src: Kabinete e amogela katlego ya Beke ya Imbizo e e neng e tshwerwe fa gautshwane ka moono wa 'Mmogo re tswetsa pele Aforika Borwa', e mo go yona batlhankedi ba puso ba neng ba kopana le baagi go ralala naga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukelile impumelelo yeViki Lokubamba Izimbizo esanda kubanjwa nje ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi ‘Sisonke siqhubekisela iNingizimu Afrika phambili’, ebonise izikhulu zikahulumeni zixoxisana nemiphakathi ezweni lonkana.

src: Kabinete e akgola maAforika Borwa a a nnileng le seabe mo manaaneng a feta 36 go ralala naga, a a netefaditseng gore puso e tsibogela ditlhokego tsa baagi tse di supilweng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabancoma labo bantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezingaphezu kwama-36 ezweni lonkana, abaqinisekisile ukuthi uhulumeni uyaphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi ezihlonziwe.

src: Beke ya Imbizo e maatlafaditse baagi ka tshedimosetso e e ka ga manaane a puso.
tgt: IViki Lokubamba Izimbizo isimamise imiphakathi ngolwazi maqondana nezinhlelo zikahulumeni.

src: Lefapha la Manno a Batho le ne le amogetse khonferese e e atlegileng tota ya Ditšhabakopano (UN) e e dirang ka mafelo a baipei, e gatelela seelo se se kwa godimo sa phudugelo mo metsesetoropong mmogo le go gola ga mafelo a baipei.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu usingathe ingqungquthela eyimpumelelo Yenhlangano Yezizwee (i-UN) ebibhekene nezindawo zokuhlala eziyimikhukhu, igcizelela izinga elimangalisayo lokufudukela kwabantu emadolobheni kanye nokukhula kwemikhukhu.

src: Ga jaana batho ba le bilione mo lefatsheng ba nna mo mafelong a baipei.
tgt: Njengamanje abantu abayisigidigidi esisodwa emhlabeni bahlala emikhukhwini.

src: Fa e sale ka 1994, Aforika Borwa e agile matlo a le dimilione e le karolo ya go netefatsa gore go nna le botshelo jo bo botoka go botlhe.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika kusukela ngowe-1994 seyakhe izigidi ngezigidi zezindlu njengengxenye yokuqinisekisa impilo engcono kubo bonke abantu.

src: MelaotlhomoKabinete e amogetse Melaotlhomo e e latelang:.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywaIKhabhinethi igunyaze lezinhlaka zeMithethosivivinywa elandelayo:.

src: Molaotlhomo wa Tshireletso ya Dikago tsa Botlhokwa wa 2016 o o tla phasaladiwang mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore baagi ba tshwaele mo go ona.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuvikelwa Kwengqalasizinda Esemqoka wezi-2016 uzoshicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze kutholakale imibono yomphakathi ngawo.

src: Molaotlhomo o phimola Molao wa Dintlha tsa Botlhokwa tsa Bosetšhaba, wa 1980 (Molao wa bo 102 wa 1980), mme o ikaelela go lepalepanya thulaganyo ya go supa le go goeletsa dikago tsa botlhokwa ka tsela e e seng bofitlha mme e le maikarabelo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchitha uMthetho Wezintuba Ezisemqoka Zikazwelonke, we-1980 (uMthetho we-102 we-1980), futhi ufuna ukuhambelanisa inqubo yokuhlonza kanye nokudalulwa kwengqalasizinda esemqoka ngendlela esobala nephendulayo.

src: Gape o tla netefatsa gore dikago tsotlhe tsa botlhokwa tsa tshireletsego ya setšhaba mo nageng di a supiwa mme di sirelediwa ka tsela e e maleba.
tgt: Uzophinda futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izingqalasizinda zokuvikelela kuzwelonke kwezwe ziyakwazi ukuhlonzwa futhi ziyavikelwa ngokwanele.

src: Molaotlhomo o dira tlamelo ya gore go tlhomiwe letlhomeso la setheo go tlhokomela le go tsamaisa tshireletso ya dikago tsotlhe tsa botlhokwa.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlinzekela ukumiswa kohlaka lokusebenza lwesikhungo ukuqapha nokusebenzisa ukuvikelwa kwezingqalasizinda ezisemqoka.

src: Gape o tlhalosa tiro ya bothati jo bo tla gakololang Tona ya Sepodisi ka kgoeletso ya dikago tsa botlhokwa.
tgt: Uphinde uchaze imisebenzi yomgwamanqa ozokweluleka uNgqongqoshe Wezamaphoyisa ekudalulweni kwezingqalasizinda ezisemqoka.

src: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Mekgatlho ya Dithoto tse di Tlhakanetsweng wa 2016 o o tla phasaladiwang gore baagi ba tshwaele mo go ona.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchitshiyelwa Kwezinhlangano Zempahla Ehlanganyelwayo wezi-2016 uzoshicilelwa ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o baakanya Molao wa ga jaanong wa Mekgatlho ya Dithoto tse di Tlhakanetsweng, wa 1996 (Molao wa bo 28 wa 1996).Molaotlhomo o tla maatlafatsa thulaganyo ya bolaodi jwa temokerasi jwa Mekgatlho e e leng teng ga jaana ya Dithoto tse di Tlhakanetsweng gongwe ditheo tsa Dikgwama tse di okameng mafatshe a a tlhakanetsweng ke baagi.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho wamanje Wezinhlangano Zempahla Ehlanganyelwayo, we-1996 (uMthetho wama-28 we-1996).UMthethosivivinywa uzoqinisa uhlelo lokubusa ngentandoyeningi lweziNhlangano ezikhona njengamanje Zempahla Ehlanganyelwayo noma izikhungo ezikhona njengamanje Zesikhwama Sezimali Ezisisiwe ezengamela umhlaba osetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o o baakantsweng o dira tlamelo ya gore go tlhomiwe Mokwadisi mo Lefapheng la Tlhabololo ya Metseselegae le Ntšhwafatso ya Naga, mme o tlhalosa tiro ya kantoro eno.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa ochitshiyelwe uhlinzekela ukumiswa kwehhovisi likaNobhala eMnyangweni Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya kanye Nezinguquko Kwezomhlaba, futhi uchaze imisebenzi yaleli hhovisi.

src: Fa Molaotlhomo o setse o fetisitswe jaaka molao, o tla maatlafatsa taolo ya ditheo tsa bolaodi le go tokafatsa tshegetso ya Mmuso mo go tsona.
tgt: Uma lo Mthethosivivinywa usuphasisiwe waba umthetho, uzoqinisa ukulawulwa kwezikhungo zokubusa futhi uthuthukise ukwesekwa kwawo nguMbuso.

src: O tla kgontsha baagi go bona, go tshola le go tsamaisa dithoto ka ditheo tsa tsamaiso tse di bokgoni tse di tshegediwang ke puso.
tgt: Uzovumela imiphakathi ukuba ithole, ibambe futhi iphathe izimpahla ngokusebenzisa izikhungo zokwenziwa komsebenzi ezisungulwe ngokusemthethweni ngempumelelo zisekelwa nguhulumeni.

src: Go itsisewe ga Molaotlhomo wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Tsereganyo wa 2016 kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Ukwethulwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokulamula Emhlabeni Wonke wezi-2016 ePhalamende.

src: Thulaganyo ya tsereganyo ya boditšhabatšhaba ke sediriswa sa botlhokwa sa go gweba go ralala melelwane ya naga.
tgt: Inqubo yokulamula emhlabeni wonke iyithuluzi elisemqoka lokwenza ibhizinisi ngaphesheya kwemingcele yezwe.

src: E tla tokafatsa phitlhelesego ya ditirelo tsa bosiamisi mo ditlamong tse di gwebang kwa ntle ga naga le ditlamo tsa kwa ntle tse di mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Uzokwenza ngcono ukufinyeleleka kwezinsizakalo zobulungiswa ezinkampanini ezenza ibhizinisi ngaphandle kwaleli lizwe kanye nezinkampani zasemazweni angaphandle eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Molaotlhomo o phimola Molao wa Temogo le Tiragatso ya Dikabo tsa Tsereganyo ya Dinaga di sele, wa 1977 (Molao wa bo 4 wa 1977) mme gape o baakanya Molao wa ga jaana wa Tshireletso ya Kgwebo, wa 1978 (Molao wa bo 99 wa 1978).
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchitha uMthetho Wokwamukelwa kanye Nokuqiniswa Kwemiklomelo Yokulamula Emazweni Angaphandle, we-1977 (uMthetho wama-40 we-1977) uphinde futhi uchibiyele uMthetho wamanje Wokuvikelwa Kwebhizinisi, we-1978 (uMthetho wama-99 we-1978).

src: Molaotlhomo o o tshitshinngwang o lepalepana le Sekao sa Molao wa Tsereganyo ya Kgwebo ya Boditšhabatšhaba, se se amogetsweng ke Khomišene ya UN ya Molao wa Kgwebisano ya Boditšhabatšhaba.
tgt: Umthethosivivinywa ohlongozwayo uhambelana Nomthetho Owuhlaka maqondana Nokulamula Kwezokuhwebelana Ezweni Lonke, owamukelwa yiKhomishana Yenhlangano Yezizwe maqondana Nomthetho Wezokuhwebelana Emhlabeni Wonke.

src: Go phasaladiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Setheo sa bosetšhaba sa Dipatlisiso wa 2016 mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore batho ba tshwaele mo go ona.
tgt: Ukushicilelwa kohlaka loMthethosivivinywa Wokuchitshiyelwa Kwesisekelo Socwaningo Lukazwelonke wezi-2016 kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze umphakathi uphawule.

src: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Setheo sa Bosetšhaba sa Dipatlisiso, wa 1998 (Molao wa bo 23 wa 1998).Molaotlhomo o tla tokafatsa bokgoni jwa Aforika Borwa jwa go gaisana mo tlhabololong ya dipatlisiso le boitlhamedi ka tsamaiso ya kgolagano le setšhaba ka tsela e e bokgoni, e e lekaneng mme e gokagane ya saense, mmogo le tlamelo le phitlhelesego e e tokafetseng ya ditlamelo tsa dipatlisiso.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wesisekelo Socwaningo Lukazwelonke, we-1998 (uMthetho wama-23 we-1998).

src: Gape o tla tokafatsa tsibogo le bokgoni jwa tlhabololo ya dipatlisiso le tlamelo ya boitlhamedi, go tokafatsa boleng jwa botshelo jwa maAforika Borwa ka go lepalepanya ditlapele tsa puso botoka.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uzokwenza ngcono ubuqhudelwano beNingizimu Afrika ekuthuthukisweni kocwaningo kanye nokuqamba kabusha ngokusebenzisa ukuphathwa ngempumelelo, ngendlela egculisayo futhi edidiyelwe kokuxoxisana komphakathi nabezesayensi, kanye nokuhlinzekwa okwenziwe ngcono kwengqalasizinda yocwaningo kanye nokufinyeleleka.

src: Ditshwetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: Kabinete e amogetse lekwalotlhomo la mabudusatsela la Sepodisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele Umthetho Odingidwayo Omaqondana Nobuphoyisa.

src: Lekwalotlhomo la mabudusatsela le phasaladitswe la ntlha gore baagi ba tshwaele mo go lona ka Mopitlwe 2015.
tgt: Uhlaka Lomthetho Odingidwayo lwashicilelwa okokuqala ukuze kutholakale imibono yomphakathi ngoNdasa 2015.

src: Lekwalo le dira tlamelo ya tirelo ya sepodisi e e ikamanyang le boagi jo bo tlhaga mme e tsibogela tikologo ya ga jaana ya sepodisi.
tgt: Lo mthetho odingidwayo uhlinzekela imisebenzi yobuphoyisa echeme nezakhamuzi eziphilayo futhi ephendulayo esimweni samanje semisebenzi yobuphoyisa.

src: Gape le dira tlamelo ya Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa le sepodisi sa metro se se maikarabelo e bile se le porofešenale.
tgt: Uphinde uhlinzekele Umbutho Wamaphoyisa waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) kanye namaphoyisa kamasipala akwaziyo ukuphendula futhi asebenza ngobungoti.

src: Gape Lekwalotlhomo la mabudusatsela le ikuela gore go tlhamiwe Boto ya Bosetšhaba ya Sepodisi e, gareng ga tse dingwe, e tla rwalang maikarabelo a go tlhoma ditlhokego tsa go ngoka badiri, go tlhopha le go thapa bangokiwa ba bantšhwa mo tirelong ya sepodisi.
tgt: Umthetho Odingidwayo unxusa ukuba kusungulwe iBhodi Likazwelonke Lamaphoyisa, elizokuba, phakathi kweminye imisebenzi, nesibophezelo sokumisa imigomo yezinjongo zokuqashwa, ukuhlungwa kanye nokuqokwa kwabantu abasha emisebenzini yobuphoyisa.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Lekwalotlhomo la mabudusatsela la Tshireletsego le Pabalesego.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele Umthetho Odingidwayo Omaqondana Nezokuphepha Nokuvikeleka.

src: Lekwalotlhomo la Mabudusatsela le le setseng le ntsheditswe go batla maikutlo a batho ka Tlhakole 2015, le totile mokgwa o o lotaneng wa tlhabololo wa pabalesego e e sa feleleng fela mo sepodising.
tgt: Umthetho Odingidwayo, obuvele usukhishiwe ukuze kuxoxiswane nomphakathi ngawo ngoNhlolanja 2015, ugxile endleleni yokusebenza edidiyelwe nethuthukisayo maqondana nokuphepha okungale komsebenzi wobuphoyisa.

src: Le ikaelela go kaela mo dikgatong tse di tla thusang baagi ka thibelo mo mererong ya tshireletsego.
tgt: Ufuna ukuba ngumkhombandlela mayelana nezinyathelo zokuvikela ezokuphepha zemiphakathi.

src: Lekwalotlhomo la Mabudusatsela le supa mafapha otlhe a a maleba mmogo le mekgatlho ya baagi e e tshwaelang mo pabalesegong ya baagi.
tgt: Umthetho Odingidwayo uhlonza yonke iminyango efanelekile kanye nezinhlangano ezigxile emiphakathini ezinegalelo ekuphepheni kwemiphakathi.

src: Kabinete e rebotse Pholisitlhomo ya Tiragatso ya Setso ya Thupiso mo Aforika Borwa mme e rebotse gore Lefapha la Merero ya setso le simolole go kwala molao wa bosetšhaba wa thupiso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze uhlaka lweNqubomgomo emaqondana Nosiko Lokusoka eNingizimu Afrika futhi yagunyaza nokuthi uMnyango Wezendabuko uqale ukwenza uhlaka lomthetho kazwelonke omaqondana nokusoka.

src: Pholisi e setse e fetile mo thulaganyong ya patlomaikutlo a baamegi ba ba maleba.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo isivele isidlule ohlelweni olunzulu lokuxoxisana nomphakathi maqondana nayo kanye nababambiqhaza abafanelekile.

src: Pholisi e tlamela ka kaedi e e netefatsang tshireletso ya meetlo ya setso ya thupiso ya basimane ya ngwaga le ngwaga kwa ntle ga go ba baya mo kotsing.
tgt: Inqubomgomo ihlinzeka ngemihlahlandlela eqinisekisa ukuvikelwa kosiko lomdabu lokusokwa minyakayonke kwabafana abasebancane ngaphandle kokubeka ukuphepha kwabo engcupheni.

src: Seno ke karolo ya dikgato tse puso e di tsayang go maatlafatsa meetlo e e maleba e bile e amogelesega.
tgt: Lokhu kwenza ingxenye yezinyathelo uhulumeni azithathayo ukuqinisa amasiko afanelekile kanye navumelekile.

src: E busetsa seelo se se amogelesegang sa maikarabelo go botlhe ba ba tsamaisang dikolo tsa thupiso le batsadi ba ba romelang bana kwa dikolong tseno.
tgt: Igcina izinga elivumelekile lokukwazi ukuziphendulela kulabo bantu abaphethe izikole zokusoka kanye nabazali abathumela izingane zabo kulezo zikole.

src: Kabinete e amogetse dikatlegeniso tse di dirilweng ke Komiti ya Dipatlisiso malebana le kgonagalo ya go gweba ka manaka a ditshukudu jaaka boitlhophelo jwa go ka somarela ditshukudu tsa naga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze izincomo ezenziwe yiKomidi Lophenyo olumaqondana nokufaneleka kokuhweba ngezimpondo zobhejane njengenye yezindlela zokulondoloza obhejane kuleli lizwe.

src: Dikatlenegiso di tshegeditswe ke Komiti ya Setegeniki ya Bogakolodi ya Mafapha le Komiti ya Ditona e e thapetsweng go batlisisa kgonagalo ya go dira gore go nne le kgwebisano ya semolao ya boditšhabatšhaba ya manaka a tshukudu.
tgt: Lezi zincomo zamukelwa yiKomidi Lokweluka Kwezobuchwepheshe Leminyango Ehlukene kanye neKomidi loNgqongqoshe Abahlukene aqokelwa ukuba aphenye ngamathuba okwenza kube semthethweni ukuhweba ngokuthengiselana ngezimpondo zobhejane emhlabeni wonke.

src: Dikatlenegiso di tshegetsa mokgwa wa tsamaiso ya togamaano ya Aforika Borwa wa go rarabolola mathata a bogodu jwa ditshukudu mmogo le kgwebisano e e seng mo molaong ka ditshukudu.
tgt: Izincomo zigunyaza indlela yokusebenza yaseNingizimu Afrika yokuphathwa ngobuqhinga obudidiyelwe kwesixazululo sokuzingelwa kobhejane kanye nokuhweba ngobhejane okungekho emthethweni.

src: Komiti e atlenegisa gore mokgwa wa ga jaana wa go tshola seelo sa naga o tswelediwe go na le gore go gwebisanwe ka manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Ikomidi lincoma ukuthi indlela esetshenziswa manje ukugcina isibalo sobhejane baleli lizwe kumele igcinwe uma iqhathaniswa nokuhwebelana ngezimpondo zobhejane.

src: Togamaano ya naga e akaretsa tshireletso maatlafatso ya baagi tsamaiso ya diphologolo ditlamelo tsa molao tse di diragadiwang le go dirisiwa sentle le tsamaiso ya tlhokego.
tgt: Indlela yokusebenza ngobuqhinga yaleli lizwe iqukethe ukuvikeleka ukunikezwa komphakathi amandla ukuphathwa kwebhayoloji izimiso zemithetho ephendulayo eziqaliswa ukusebenza ngempumelelo futhi eziqiniswayo kanye nokuphathwa kokufunwa ngamandla kobhejane.

src: Kabinete e amogetse dithadiso tse di latelang tsa madi a segopotso tsa 2016:a) Motseletsele wa ledi la National Geographic Coin - Maiteko a Dikatse tse Dikgolo: 'Lengau'b) Motseletsele wa korone ya selefera le ledi la tiki 'boitlhamedi jwa Aforika Borwa - ‘Dolosse’.Dithadiso tsa madi, mmogo le dikgoeletso tsa tsona, di tla gatisiwa mo Kaseteng ya Puso, mme di tla tlhagisiwa le go rekisiwa ka ditsela tsa setlwaedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze lawa madizayini alandelayo ezinhlamvu zemali azokuba yisikhumbuzo sowezi-2016:a) Uhlelo Lochungechunge Lwezinhlamvu Zemali ze-National Geographic –Amakati Amakhulu: ‘Ingulule’.b) Uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zemali zepondo notiki ezinomqhele wesiliva ‘Okukhandwe eNingizimu Afrika–‘i-Dolosse’.Amadizayini ezinhlamvu zemali, kanye nokwaziswa kwawo, azophrintwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni, bese emva kwalokho azobe esekhiqizwa bese edayiswa kusetshenziswa imigudu ejwayelekile.

src: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Magareng ga la bo 18 le la bo 22 Moranang 2016, Moporesitente Zuma o tla tsaya maeto a tiro kwa mebusong e e leng ditokololo tsa Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Ditso tsa Borwa jwa Aforika (SACU) e e akaretsang wa Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho le wa Swaziland.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uzokube phakathi komhla ziyi-18 nama-22 Mbasa 2016 enohambo olusemthethweni lokuvakashela amazwe angamalungu eNhlangano yaMazwe Angakhokisani Intela yoHwebo aseNingizimu neAfrika (i-SACU) ahlanganisa i-Namibia, iBotswana, iLesotho kanye ne-Swaziland.

src: Maeto a tla tokafatsa seabe sa botlhokwa se SACU e nang naso go tsweletsa kgolagano ya kgaolo le tlhabololo ya ikonomi ya ditokololo tsotlhe tsa yona.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambela kuzothuthukisa indima ebalulekile i-SACU eyidlalayo ekukhuthazeni ukuhlanganiswa kwezifunda kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho wawo wonke amalungu ayo.

src: Moporesitente o tla tsaya Leeto la Semmuso go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Islamo ya Iran ka la bo 23 le la bo 24 Moranang 2016 go maatlafatsa dipuisano tsa sepolotiki le tsa ikonomi magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi.
tgt: UMongameli uzothatha uhambo Lokuhambela Kombuso ezweni lase-Islamic Republic of Iran ngomhla zingama-23 nama-24 kuMbasa 2016 ukuyoqinisa izingxoxo zezombusazwe kanye nezomnotho phakathi kwalamazwe amabili.

src: Moporesitente o tla etelela pele meletlo ya Bosetšhaba ya Letsatsi la Kgololesego ka la bo 27 Moranang 2016 kwa Limpopo, kwa Lebaleng la Metshameko la Giyani ka moono wa: "Mmogo re aga baagi ba ba botoka - Pusoselegae e ama mongwe le mongwe".Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe le maphata otlhe go bontsha boikanyego jwa bona ka go nna le seabe mo ditiragalong tse di farologaneng tsa segopotso sa Kgwedi ya Kgololesego.
tgt: UMongameli uzohola imigubho yoSuku Lwenkululeko Lukazwelonke ngomhla zingama-27 Mbasa 2016 eLimpopo, eGiyani Stadium ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Sisonke sakha imiphakathi engcono – Uhulumeni Wezindawo uwumsebenzi wawo wonke umuntu”.IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nayo yonke imikhakha ukuba bakhombise ugqozi lwabo ngezwe labo ngokubamba iqhaza emicimbini enhlobonhlobo yokugubha iNyanga Yenkululeko.

src: Mo dibekeng tse di tlang, Palamente e tla tshwara Ditekanyetsokabo tsa mafapha.
tgt: Kulawa masonto ezayo, iPhalamende lizobe libambe Amavoti Eezabelomali zeminyango.

src: Bakhuduthamaga ba ba farologaneng ba mafapha ba tla ala maano a bona a tiro a ngwaga wa ditšhelete wa 2016/17.
tgt: Iziphathimandla zeminyango ehlukahlukene zizothulula izinhlelo zazo zokusebenza zonyaka wezimali wezi-2016/17.

src: Baagi ba tla itsisewe ka manaane a tlamelo ya ditirelo a puso.
tgt: Amalungu omphakathi azokwaziswa ngezinhlelo zokuhanjiswa kwezidingongqangi zikahulumeni.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mo Mererong e e Botlhokwa ya ga jaana.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisematheni.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tsibogo le kopo ya boitshwarelo ya ga Moporesitente Zuma malebana le katlholo ya Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo malebana le go obamela dikgato tsa paakanyo tse di tlhagelelang mo pegelong ya Mosireletsi wa Setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukele impendulo kanye nokuxolisa okulandele lapho okwenziwe nguMongameli uZuma maqondana nesinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo mayelana nokuthobela izinyathelo zokulungisa isimo ezavezwa embikweni woMvikeli Womphakathi.

src: Kabinete e buisa katlholo go bona gore a go na le dikgato dingwe gape tse di tshwanetseng go tsewa go maatlafatsa seabe sa Tirelo ya Setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isafunda isinqumo ukuze ithole ukuthi ngabe zikhona yini ezinye izinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuqinisa indima kaHulumeni.

src: Katlholo ya Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo e tlhomamisa temokerasi ya Aforika Borwa ya molaotheo.
tgt: Isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo siqinisa siphinde sivumele intando yeningi labantu eyatholakala ngokomthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e lemogile dikgato tse di tserweng ke dibanka di le nne tse di ntshitseng kitsiso ya go tswala akhaonto ya banka ya setlamo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiqaphelile isenzo esenziwe ngamabhange amane afake isaziso sokuvala i-akhawunti yasebhange yenkampani ethile.

src: Le fa Kabinete e amogela melawana le dipeelo tsa dibanka, dikgato tseo di ka tshosa babeeletsi ba isago ba ba ka batlang go dira kgwebo mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Yize iKhabhinethi iyiqonda kahle imigomo nemibandela yamabhange, lesi senzo singaphazamisa abatshalizimali bakusasa abangafisa ukwenza ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tlhomamisitse gore Ditona tsa Ditšhelete, Bodiri le Ditlamelo tsa Diminerale di tshwanetse go bula dipuisano tse di agang le dibanka go bona tharabololo ya leruri ya morero ono.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelene ngokuthi uNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, Wezabasebenzi kanye Nowezimbiwa Phansi kumele bavulele ingxoxo eyakhayo kanye namabhange ukuze kutholakale isisombululo sesikhathi eside kulolu daba.

src: Kabinete e akgotse Tona ya Boitekanelo, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, yo o amogetseng sekgele sa boditšhabatšhaba sa USAID-TB ka ntlha ya boeteledipele jwa gagwe mo ntweng ya lefatshe kgatlhanong le bolwetsi jwa lehuba (TB) gammogo le go etelela pele maiteko a Aforika Borwa le a kgaoloa go tlhatlhoba, go alafa le go thibela TB tshwaetso ya TB/HIV mmogo le TB e e dipelang melemo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, othole indondo yomhlaba wonke evela kwi-USAID-TB yokumhlonipha ngobuholi bakhe empini yomhlaba wonke yokulwisana nesifo sofuba (i-TB) kanjalo nokuhola phambili izinhlelo zaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezezifunda ekuhlolelweni, ukwelapha kanye nokuvimbela i-TB amagciwane okutheleleka nge-TB kanye Negciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) ngesikhathi esisodwa kanye ne-TB engazweli amakhambi.

src: Kabinete e amogela go supiwa ga Aforika Borwa jaaka moamogedi wa 2016 wa Sekgele sa Tirelo e e Kgethegileng ya Sedipolomate (Distinguisned Diplomatic Service Award) ke Lekgotla la Merero ya Lefatshe kwa Washington DJaaka naga ya ntlha ya Aforika go amogela sekgele seno, se lemoga maitlamo a naga a thuto ya lefatshe, merero ya boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le tlhaeletsano ya lefatshe go tsweletsa dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukuqokwa kweNingizimu Afrika njengezwe elizokwamukela Indondo yowezi-2016 Yemisebenzi Enhlobonhlobo Yosomaqhinga nguMkhandlu Wezindaba Zomhlaba e-Washington, DNjengezwe lokuqala lase-Afrika ukuthola le ndondo, ihlonipha ukuzinikela okuvelele kwezwe ekufundiseni umhlaba wonke, izindaba zamazwe omhlaba kanye nokuxhumana emhlabeni wonke ukuze liqhubele phambili izimfuno zezwe.

src: Kabinete e akgola Tona ya Dikamano tsa Boditšhabatšhaba le Tirisanommogo, Mme Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ka ntlha ya tshwaelo ya gagwe mo dipuisanong tsa Aforika Borwa tsa boditšhabatšhaba, tse di tsamaisiwang ke ponelopele ya "kontinente ya Aforika e e kopaneng mme e na le kagiso, temokerasi, e sa tlhaole go ya ka bosemorafe, e sa tlhaole go ya ka bong mme e humile, le e e tshwaelang mo lefatsheng le le nang le tshiamo le tekatekano.".
tgt: IKhabhinethi income uNgqongqoshe Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe Nokubambisana, uNkz Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ngegalelo lakhe ezingxoxweni zeNingizimu Afrika namazwe omhlaba, ezigqugquzelwa ngumbono “wezwekazi lase-Afrika elibumbene elinoxolo, elibuswa ngentando yeningi labantu, elingacwasi ngokobuhlanga, elingacwasi ngokobulili futhi eliqhakazile, futhi elinegalelo emhlabeni onobulungiswa nonokulingana.”.

src: Kabinete e amogela go thapiwa ke Moporesitente Zuma ga Moatefokate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi jaaka Tlhogo ya Yuniti ya Dipatlisiso tse di Kgethegileng, mme e rata go mo eletsa masego mo maikarabelong a gagwe a mantšhwa a go lwantsha bobodu le tsamaiso e e sokameng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukuqokwa nguMongameli uZuma ko-Advocate u-Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, njengeNhloko yoPhiko Olukhethekile Lezophenyo, futhi imfisela okuhle nokumhlophe emisebenzini yakhe emisha yokuqeda inkohlakalo kanye nokuphatha budlabha.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso a a tswang kwa botennye jwa dipelo kwa lelapeng la ga Makwetu le Pan Africanist Congress ka go tlhokafala ga Rre Clarence Makwetu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo nokudabuka okukhulu emndenini wakwaMakwetu nakwi-Pan Africanist Congress ngokwedlula emhlabeni kukaMnu Clarence Makwetu.

src: Rre Makwetu o tla gakologelwa ka ntlha ya tshwaelo ya gagwe e e boitshegang le go intsha setlhabelo mo mokgatlhong o o neng o lwela kgololesego mmogo le go tlhamiwa ga Aforika Borwa e ntšhwa ya temokerasi.
tgt: UMnu Makwetu uzokhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe elikhulukazi kanye nasekuzinikeleni kwakhe uqobo embuthweni wokulwela inkululeko kanye nasekusungulweni kweNingizimu Afrika entsha ebuswa ngokwentando yeningi labantu.

src: Moporesitente o goeleditse gore phitlho ya mogaka ono wa kgaratlho ya kgololesego e nne Phitlho e e Kgethegileng ya Semmuso ya Porofense.
tgt: UMongameli umemezele ukuthi kube Nongcwabo Okhethekile Wesifundazwe Osemthethweni wale ngqalabutho yomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso a a tswang kwa botennye jwa dipelo kwa lelapeng la ga Naidoo ka go tlhokafala ga Rre Kumarana Naidoo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo nokudabuka okukhulu emndenini wakwa-Naidoo ngokwedlula emhlabeni kukaMnu Kumaran Naidoo.

src: Rre Naidoo e ne e le Mokaedikakaretso wa Namaotshwere wa Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ubeyiBamba likaMqondisi-Jikelele woMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezomnotho.

src: O kile a dira jaaka Motlhankedimogolo wa Ditšhelete wa Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri.
tgt: Ukhe wasebenza ngaphambilini njengoMphathi Omkhulu Wezezimali woMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni.

src: Rre Naidoo o tshwaetse go utlwala mo tsamaisong ya ditšhelete mo Tirelong ya Setšhaba.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ube negalelo elikhulukazi ekuphathweni kwezezimali emkhakheni weMisebenzi Kahulumeni.

src: Kabinete e tlhagisitse malebo ka tshwaelo e e dirilweng ke Rre William Smith, yo o dirileng jaaka Mokwaledi wa Kabinete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakaliswe ukubonga kwayo maqondana negalelo elifakwe nguMnu William Smith, obesebenza njengeHhovisi likaNobhala weKhabhinethi.

src: Rre Smith o rotse tiro ka bogodi kwa bokhutlong jwa Mopitlwe morago ga go direla Tirelo Setšhaba dingwaga di le Kabinete e mo eletsa molemo mo pakeng ya gagwe ya phenšene.
tgt: UMnu Smith uthathe umhlalaphansi ekupheleni kukaNdasa emva kokusebenzela umkhakha weMisebenzi Kahulumeni iminyaka engama-27.

src: Kabinete e lotlegetswe ka ga Pegelo ya Khomišene ya Dipatlisiso malebana le Magatwe a Tsietso, Bobodu, Tsamaiso e e sa siamang mo Thulaganyong ya Theko ya tsa Phemelo (Khomišene ya Theko ya Dibetsa) e e golotsweng ke Moporesitente mosong ono.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imfisela okuhle kodwa kumhlalaphansi wakhe.

src: Pegelo e fitlhetse go sena bosupi jwa molato, pipamolomo, tsietso gongwe bobodu mo thulaganyong ya theko ya dibetsa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilunywe indlebe mayelana noMbiko weKhomishana Yophenyo Maqondana Nezinsolo Zokukhwabanisa, Inkohlakalo, Ukungahloniphi noma Ukungahambisi Ngomthetho Ekuthengweni Kobuqhinga Kwempahla Yokuzivikela (iKhomishana Yokuthengwa Kwezikhali) okhishwe nguMongameli ekuseni namuhla.

src: Jaaka Puso re amogela diphitlhelelo tsa Khomišene.
tgt: NjengoHulumeni siyayemukela imiphumela yeKhomishana.

src: Re tlhatswitswe maina jaaka re sa bolo go bua mo dingwageng tse dintsintsi gore ga gona phoso epe le gore theko e dirilwe ka WEBTOKEN solofela gore diphitlhelelo di tla tswalela morero ono o o sa bolong go WEBTOKEN golagana le Moporesitente Zuma go leboga Moatlhodi Willie Seriti le Moatlhodi Thekiso Musi, dipaki tsotlhe, go akarediwa le Moporesitente wa maloba Thabo Mbeki, batsamaisi ba bosupi, ditlhopha tsa molao, badiri le botlhe ba ba tshwaetseng go atlegisa tiro ya Khomišene.
tgt: Sikhishwe phambili satholakala singenacala njengoba besilokhu sisho eminyakeni eminingi edlule ukuthi kwakungekho ukuphambana nomthetho okwenziwa nanokuthi ukuthengwa kwezikhali kwenziwa ngendlela efanelekile nesemthethweni.

src: Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi:.
tgt: Siyethemba ukuthi imiphumela izoletha isiphetho kulolu daba oselube yinsakavukela umchilo wesidwaba isikhathi eside.

src: Rre Siyabonga Gama jaaka Mokhuduthamaga wa Setlhopha le Rre Garry Pita jaaka Motlhankedimogolo wa Ditšhelete wa Transnet.
tgt: Sihlanganyela noMongameli uZuma ekubongeni iJaji u-Willie Seriti kanye neJaji uThekiso Musi, bonke ofakazi, kubandakanya noMongameli waphambilini uThabo Mbeki, abaholi bobufakazi, amathimba ezomthetho, abasebenzi kanye nalabo ababe negalelo ekwenzeni umsebenzi weKhomishana ube yimpumelelo.

src: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga Manaane a a Botlhokwa a Puso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza Kwezinhlelo Zikahulumeni Ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e amogela Leeto la Semmuso la ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Islamo ya Iran, le le akofisang botsalano jwa ikonomi le kgwebisano magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi, ka go saeniwa ga ditumelano le maitlamo a le mmalwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamukela uhambo lukaMongameli u-Jacob Zuma lokuHambela Kombuso ezweni lase-Islamic Republic of Iran, oludlondlobalisa ubudlelwano bezomnotho kanye nezokuhwebelana phakathi kwawo womabili lawa mazwe, ngokucikicwa kwezivumelwano ezihlukahlukene kanye nezibophezelo.

src: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma le Moporesitente Hasan Rouhani ba maatlafaditse tirisanommogo mo maphateng a kgwebisano, thuto le tlhabololo ya bokgoni saense le thekenoloji maatla, go akarediwa go phuruphudiwa ga gase ya petorokhemikale mmogo le bokgoni jwa go e fetola temothuo meepo mmogo le go fetolwa ga diminerale tlhabololo ya mafaratlhatlha le dipalangwa ditšhelete, dibanka le inšorense mmogo le bojanala.
tgt: UMongameli u-Jacob Zuma kanye noMongameli u-Hasan Rouhani bakuqinisile ukusebenza ngokubambisana emikhakheni yezokuhwebelana, ezemfundo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ezesayensi kanye nobuchwepheshe ezamandla, kubandakanya nokuhlolwa kwegesi yamakhemikhali kaphethiloli ongakahluzwa kanye namandla okukwazi ukuhluza ezolimo ezezimayini kanye nokuhlomula kwezezimbiwa phansi ezokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda kanye nezokuthutha ezezimali, ezokubhanga kanye nezemishwalense kanye nezokuvakasha.

src: Mme tsotlhe tse di tshwaela mo go diragadiweng ga Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP).Mo go tsa boditšhabatšhaba, baeteledipele ka bobedi ba dumelane ka go maatlafatsa boikuelo jwa tlhabololo ya Ditšhabakopano (UN), bogolo segolo Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UN, mo dikgatlhegong tsa dinaga tse di tlhabologang.
tgt: Konke lokhu kunegalelo ekuqalisweni kokusebenza koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP).Ngasohlangothini lwamazwe omhlaba, abaholi ababili bavumile ukuqinisa ikhwela elihlatshwayo lokuguqulwa kweNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangene (i-UN) ikakhulukazi Umkhandlu Wezokuvikeleka weNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangene, ngokubhekelela izimfuno zamazwe asathuthuka.

src: Dipoelo tseno di maatlafaditse Leeto la Tiro la Moporesitente kwa United Arab Emirates (UAE) koo mebuso ka bobedi e neng ya ntšhwafatsa maitlamo a yona malebana le tsolotanyo le kgodiso ya botsalano jwa sebedi, bogolo segolo mo maphateng a kgwebisano, dipeeletso le ikonomi go nna botsalano jwa togamaano jo bo akaretsang.
tgt: Le miphumela iqinise kabusha Uhambo Lokusebenza lukaMongameli oluya ezweni lase-United Arab Emirates (i-UAE) lapho yomibili le mibuso ivuselele isibophezelo sayo maqondana nokuhlanganiswa kanye nokukhushulwa kobudlelwano obumbaxambili, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni yezokuhwebelana, ezokutshalwa kwezimali kanye neyezomnotho ukuba bube ukubambisana okubanzi okunobuqhinga.

src: Seno se ageletse mo Leetong la Semmuso la ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka Ngwanaitsele 2011, fa go ne ga tlhamiwang Khomišene e e Tlhakanetsweng ya SA-UAE e e akofisitseng lebelo la kgwebisano magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi go tloga go R13 bilione ka 2011 go ya go R27 bilione ka 2015.Aforika Borwa le UAE ba dumelane go atolosa tirisanommogo go dirisa ditšhono tsa Ikonomi ya Mawatle, go tsweletsa go romelwa ntle ga ditlhagiswa tsa temothuo tsa Aforika Borwa, ditlhagiswa tse di dirilweng mme bogolo segolo theko le tirisanommogo mo go tsa phemelo.
tgt: Lokhu kwakhelwe ohambweni lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma Lokuhambela Kombuso ngoLwezi wezi-2011 olwabonakalisa ukusungulwa kweKhomishana Ehlanganyelwe ye-SA-UAE eyadlondlobalisa umgqigqo ophelele wezokuhwebelana phakathi kwamazwe omabili kusukela ezigidini eziyi-13 zamarandi ngowezi-2011 kuya ezigidini ezingama-27 zamarandi ngowezi-2015.INingizimu Afrika kanye ne-UAE baphinde bavumelana ukuthi bazokwandisa ukusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze basebenzise amathub ngendlela efunwa yibona Kwezomnotho Wasolwandle, ukukhulisa ukuhanjiswa emazweni angaphandle kwemikhiqizo yezolimo yaseNingizimu Afrika, imikhiqizo ekhiqiziwe ikakhulukazi ukuthengwa kwezinto zezokuzivikela kanye namaxhama okubambisana.

src: Gape leeto le tsweleditse bokgoni jwa Aforika Borwa jwa go aga mafaratlhatlha go totilwe ditšhono tsa ditlamo tsa Aforika Borwa kwa EXPO 2020 kwa Dubai, gammogo le tirisanommogo mo mererong ya kagiso, tshireletso mmogo le tsepamo.
tgt: Lolu hambo luphinde lwakhulisa amandla iNingizimu Afrika enawo ukwakha ingqalasizinda esophe amathuba azotholwa yizinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika embukisweni i-EXPO 2020 ozobe ubanjelwe eDubai, kanjalo nokusebenza ngokubambisana emkhakheni wezoxolo, ukuvikeleka kanye nozinzo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse dikgato tse di tsepameng tse di beilweng ke Tona ya Metshameko le Boitapoloso Fikile Mbalula go aga sešwa sebopego se se kgaoganeng e bile se tlhaola thata sa metshameko le boitapoloso ka Tumelano ya Diphetogo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamukelile izinyathelo eziqinile ezibekwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezemidlalo Nokungcebeleka uFikile Mbalula ukubumba kabusha ukubukeka kwesimo sezemidlalo nokungcebeleka esiqhekekile nesibandlululayo ngendlela ejulile esebenzisa uMqulu waso Woguquko.

src: Seno se tla akofisa diphetogo tse di lebisang kwa tsamaisong e e kopaneng ya metshameko e e ikaegileng ka dintlhatheo tsa temokerasi, tekatenako, go direla dilo mo pepeneneng, kemedi ya baagi ba ba farologaneng, phitlhelesego, mmogo le seabe se se oketsegileng go lepalepana le dikeletso tsa NDKabinete e amogela ditekanyetsokabo tse di tlhagisiwang ke mafapha a a farologaneng ka dipegelo tse di tseneletseng tse di tlhagisang tswelelopele e e dirilweng malebana le go tokafatsa matshelo a maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuzodlondlobalisa uguquko maqondana nohlelo lwezemidlalo olubumbene olusekelwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yentando yeningi labantu, ukulingana, ukusebenzela obala, ukumeleleka kwabantu ngokwehlukahlukana kwabo, ukufinyeleleka kanye nokubamba iqhaza okukhuphukile ngokuhambelana nezinjongo zoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go latedisisa ditekanyetsokabo mo bobegakgannyeng jo bo farologaneng gore ba tlhaloganye Leanotiro la Puso botoka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamukela izinkulumo zamavoti esabiwomali ezethulwa yiminyango eyehlukene ezihambisana nemibiko ebanzi eqhakambisa inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe maqondana nokwenziwa ngcono kwezimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ikuela gore go nne le maitlamo a a tswelelang go netefatsa gore go nna le diphetogo tse di mosola mo tirong go lebeletswe diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Ngwaga le Ngwaga ya bo 16 ya Khomišene ya Tekatekano mo Tirong ya bathapi botlhe ba ba neng ba supilwe, e e tlhomilweng ka moono wa "Diphetogo di mosola mo kgwebong".
tgt: Lokhu kubonisa ukuqaliswa ukusebenza koHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi olusisondeza eduzane nokufezekiswa koMbono wezi-2030 woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: Pegelo e thusa puso go tlhaloganya seemo sa tekatekano mo tirong mo nageng mmogo le tswelelopele malebana le diphetogo mo tirong mo ngwageng wa 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba balandelele izinkulumo zokwabiwa kwezimali ezinkundleni zabenzindaba ezinhlobonhlobo ukuze baqonde kangcono ngoHlelo Lokusebenza lukaHulumeni.

src: Kabinete e akgola Lefapha la Manno a Batho malebana le go abiwa ga Dintlo di le milione mmogo le ditšhono tsa dintlo fa e sa le temokerasi e le gona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa ukuba kube khona ukuzibophezela okuqhubekayo ukuze kuvikelwe uguquko olunengqondo lwendawo yokusebenzela ngokubhekelela imiphumela evela Embikweni Wonyaka weKhomishana ye-16 Yokuqashwa Kwabantu Ngokulingana wabo bonke abaqashi abaqokiwe owethulwa ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Uguquko lubalulekile”.
