src: Ditšhono tseno di akaretsa dintlo di le 2 806 235 tse di etleediwang ka botlalo (dintlo tsa BNG), dintlo tsa loago/tse di hiriwang di le 121 784, di le 6 329 tsa Lenaane la Ketleetso ya Motho ka nosi le le Golaganeng le Ditšhelete le ditsha tse di nang le ditirelo di le 986 608.Phitlhelelo eno ya hisetori e tlametse batho ba feta dimilione di le 20 ka dintlo mme go keteka phitlhelelo eno, lefapha le tlhomile letsholo la bosetšhaba go bontsha katlego ya naga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu ngokwakhiwa kwezindlu eziyizigidi eziwu-4, 3 kanye namathuba okwakhiwa kwenzindlu kusukela kwafika umbuso wentando yeningi labantu.

src: Go tlhomiwa bosetšhaba go dirilwe kwa COSMO City, e leng nngwe ya diporojeke tsa ditlapele mo nageng e gape e ketekang dingwaga di le lesome e ntse e le teng.
tgt: Lawa mathuba abandakanya izindlu ezixhaswe ngokuphelele eziyizi-2, 806 235 (izindlu ze-BNG), izindlu zomphakathi/eziqashisayo eziyizi-121 784, izi-6329 zoHlelo Lokuxhaswa Komuntu Ngamunye Oluxhunywe Kwezezimali kanye neziza zokwakha ezinezinsizakalo eziyizi-986 608.Leli banga eliyingqophamlando eselihanjiwe selihlinzeke umpheme kubantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-20 kanti-ke ukubhiyozela le mpumelelo umnyango sewethule umkhankaso kazwelonke wokudweba isithombe sempumelelo yezwe lakithi.

src: Kabinete e lebogetse maAforika Borwa otlhe ka ntlha ya ditshwaelo tsa ona, boineelo le go dira ka natla go netefatsa gore maAforika Borwa a a tlhokang a busediwa seriti ka manno.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kukazwelonke kubanjelwe e-COSMO City, okungomunye wemiklamo yezindlu edidiyelwe eseqhulwini ezweni lonkana nawo ogubha iminyaka eyishumi ukhona.

src: Kabinete e akgola Mokwaledikakaretso wa Ditšhabakopano ka go bitsa Moletlo wa Maemo a a kwa Godimo wa go Saena Tumelano ya Paris, e e amogetsweng ke Ditokolo di le 176 ka Sedimonthole 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngegalelo labo, ukuzimisela kanye nokusebenza kanzima ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi isithunzi sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaswele siyabuyiselwa ngezinhlelo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu.

src: Go saeniwa ga Tumelano ya Paris go tshwaile kgato ya ntlha ya go diragadiwa ga yona go go tla kaelang maiteko a boditšhabatšhaba a go lekanyetsa tlhagiso ya digase tsa greenhouse mmogo le go fitlhelela dikgwetlho tsotlhe tsa phetogo ya tlelaemete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income uNobhala-Jikelele weNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangane ngokuhlanganisa Umcimbi Osezingeni Eliphezulu Wokucikicwa Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris, esamukelwa ngamazwe ayi-176 ngoZibandlela wezi-2015.

src: Kabinete e letetse go konosediwa ga dithulaganyo tsa selegae tsa go amogelwa ke botlhe, go kgontsha gore go diragadiwe Tumelano ya Paris ka nako gore ka 2020 e bo e diragadiwa ka botlalo.
tgt: Ukucikicwa Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris kuwuphawu lwesinyathelo sokuqala ekuqalisweni kokusebenza kwaso okuzohola imizamo yamazwe omhlaba ukunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwezintuthu ezingcolisa umoya kanye nokuhlangabezana nazo zonke izinselele eziphonswe ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.

src: Gape Kabinete e lemoga gore Lefapha la Merero ya Tikologo le dirisana mmogo le Lefapha la Bojanala go diragatsa dilaboratori tsa tlamelo tse di bidiwang "Biodiversity Lab: Go godisa tshwaelo ya ikonomi ya ditlamelo tsa bayoloji tsa Aforika Borwa" go tloga ka la bo 10 Moranang go fitlha ka la bo 13 Motsheganong 2016.Maikaelelo ke go lemoga bokgoni jwa ikonomi jwa ditshedi le dimela tse di farologaneng jo bo tlhalositseng mo Togamaanotlhomo ya Ikonomi ya Bosetšhaba ya Ditshedi le Dimela tse di farologaneng e e amogetsweng ke Kabinete ka Phukwi 2015 gore batho ba nne le seabe mo go yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isilangazelele isiphetho sezinqubo zezigunyazo zalapha ezweni ngaphakathi ezihlukahlukene, yibo bonke abantu, ukuvumela ukuqaliswa ngesikhathi kokusebenza ngokuphelele Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris ngowezi-2020.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Leanotiro la Pholisi ya Diindaseteri (IPAP) la 2016/17 - 2018/19, e leng pilara ya botlhokwa ya Leano la Moporesitente la Dintlha di le Robongwe mme le tshwaela mo go diragadiweng ga NDP.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqaphela ukuthi uMnyango Wezemvelo usubambisene noMnyango Wezokuvakasha ekuhlanganiseni amalebhu okuhanjiswa kwezinsizakalo abizwa ngokuthi yi-“Biodiversity Lab: Ukukhulisa igalelo lezomnotho lemithombo yezemvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika” kusukela mhla ziyi-10 kuMbasa kuya mhla ziyi-13 kuNhlaba 2016.Inhloso ukufezekisa amandla ezomnotho emvelo enothile yaseNingizimu Afrika eyingxubevange aveziwe ohlakeni lokuqala lweQhinga Likazwelonke Lezomnotho Yezemvelo Eyingxubevange olwagunyazwa yiKhabhinethi ngoNtulikazi wezi-2015 ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukubamba iqhaza kulona.

src: Seno ke poeletso ya borobedi ya maano a madirelo a puso a a latelanang a a agelelang mo diphitlhelelong, dipholising mmogo le mo manaane a dipoeletso tse dingwe tse di fetileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze Uhlelo Lokusebenza Lwenqubomgomo Yezimboni (i-IPAP) lowezi-2016/17 – 2018/19, oluyinsika eqavile yoHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye lukaMongameli futhi olunegalelo maqondana nokuqaliswa kokusebenza koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: Maitlhomo a IPAP 2016/17 ke go fitlhelela ditlamorago tse di kwa godimo tsa pholisi ya madirelo mo maemong a a boima a ikonomi.
tgt: Lesi yisibuyekezo sonyaka wesishiyagalombili sezinhlelo eziyimpumelelo zezimboni zikahulumeni esakhela ezinzuzweni, izithangami zezinqubomgomo kanye nezinhlelo zezibuyekezo ezidlulile.

src: Seno se akaretsa ditlamorago tse di tswelelang pele tsa kwelotlase ya ikonomi lefatshe ka bophara go akarediwa le mathata a tshipi mmogo le kwelotlase ya diminerale gammogo le komelelo e e tseneletseng mmogo le dikgoreletsi tse dingwe tsa selegae.
tgt: I-IPAP yowezi-2016/17 ifuna ukuzuza inqubomgomo yezezimboni enomthelela ophezulu ezimweni ezinzima zezomnotho.

src: Diphitlhelelo tsa ngwaga o o fetileng di akaretsa go bolokiwa ga ditiro di ka fopholediwa go 67 000 le go tlhamiwa ga ditiro tse di nang le seriti di ka nna 7 000 mo lephateng la Diaparo le Matlalo le Ditlhako.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya imithelela eqhubekayo yokuwohloka kwamandla omnotho emhlabeni wonke kubandakanya nesimo esimazonzo embonini yezensimbi nezimbiwaphansi kanjalo nesomiso esibi kakhulu kanye nezinye izingqinamba ezinkulu ezikhona ezweni lakithi ngaphakathi.

src: Lephatapotlana la phetolo ya ditlhagiswa tsa temothuo ke lengwe la maphata a madirelo a selegae a magolo ka go thapa, mme le tlametse ka ditiro tse di fopholediwang go 216 090 ka 2015 fa go bapisiwa le 208 822 ka 2014.
tgt: Izimpumelelo zangonyaka odlule zibandakanya ukuphephiswa kwemisebenzi ebalelwa ezi-67 000 kanye nokusungulwa kwemisebenzi eqotho emisha sha eyizi-7 000 emkhakheni Wezendwangu, Izimpahla Zesikhumba kanye Nezicathulo.

src: Go ngokilwe dipeeletso tsa boleng jo bo fetang R600 milione ka 2015/16 mme seo ya nna motheo wa go maatlafatsa tlhabololo ya dikgwebo go totilwe baagi ba metsemagae.
tgt: Umkhakhana ongaphansi kwezokukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo yezolimo ungomunye wemikhakha emikhulukazi lapha ezweni yezokukhiqiza ngokuqasha abantu, ngokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi elinganiselwa ezi-216 090 ngowezi-2015 uma kuqhathaniswa nezi-208 822 ngowezi-2014.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Letlhomeso la Makgaolakgang la Tlhabololo e e Kopaneng ya Metsesetoropo le Leano la Tiragatso la 2016/19.
tgt: Izigidi ezingaphezu kwama-600 zamarandi zotshalomali ezihehekile ngowezi-2015/16, ezindlale isisekelo sokuqinisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi ngokugxila kakhulu emiphakathini yasezindaweni ezisemakhaya.

src: Ditlamorago tsa kakaretso tsa Letlhomeso la Tlhabololo e e Kopaneng ya Metsesetoropo ke phetogo ya go abiwa ga dibaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze Uhlaka Lokusebenza Lokugcina Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Ezisemadolobheni Ezididiyelwe kanye Nohlelo Lokuqaliswa Ukusebenza lowezi-2016/19.

src: Seno ke tumelano e ntšhwa ya ditoropokgolo le ditoropo tsa Aforika Borwa, e e tla lebisang kgolo ya metsesetoropo kwa sekaong sa kgolo ya leruri ya ditoropokgolo le metsesetoropo e e kitlaneng, e gokagane, e babalesegile, e dirisa ditlamelo sentle mme e le mafelo a a siameng a bonno le a tiro.
tgt: Umphumela ophelele woHlaka Lokusebenza Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Ezisemadolobheni Ezididiyelwe ukuguqulwa kokuklaywa kwemingcele yedolobha.

src: Seno se tsibogela kaelo ya NDP ya go tlhama pholisi ya tlhabololo ya metsesetoropo e e tla netefatsang thulaganyo e e siameng, dipeeletso tsa mafaratlhatlha le botsamaisi go tshegetsa kgolo le go bulela bokgoni jwa ikonomi jwa ditoropokgolo le ditoropo tsa rona.
tgt: Lokhu kuwuphawu lesivumelwano esisha samadolobha kanye namadolobhana amancane aseNingizimu Afrika, esizoqhubezela phambili ukukhula kwezindawo ezisemadolobheni siziqhubekisele ohlakeni lokukhula okuqinile kwamadolobha namadolobhana amancane ahlangene, axhumene futhi adidiyelwe, aphephile, anezinsiza ezanele futhi ayizindawo ezinhle zokusebenza kanye nokuhlala kuzo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Pholisitlhomo ya Tirelo ya Bosetšhaba ya Tlhabololo ya Tiro - Go agela Aforika Borwa Thulaganyo e e bokgoni le e e Gokaganeng ya Tirelo ya Tlhabololo ya Tiro, mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore batho ba tshwaele.
tgt: Lokhu kuphendula emyalelweni woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe wokuthi kusungulwe inqubomgomo yokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo ezisemadolobheni ezoqinisekisa ukuhlela okufanelekile, utshalomali lwezingqalasizinda kanye nokuphathwa kwalo ukuze kwesekwe ukukhula kanye nokuthukulula amandla ezomnotho amadolobha kanye namadolobhana amancane ethu.

src: Fa Pholisitlhomo e diragadiwa, e tla dira tlamelo ya mokgwa o o gokaganeng wa ditirelo tsa tlhabololo ya tiro tsa boleng go baagi botlhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukushicilelwa koHlaka lweNqubomgomo Yezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi Kazwelonke – Ukwakha Uhlelo Lwezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi Oluyimpumelelo Noludidiyelwe lwaseNingizimu Afrika, eMqulwini Kahulumeni ukuze kutholwe imibono yomphakathi.

src: Seno se tla ba kgontsha go dira boitlhophelo jwa tiro ka kitso go kgona go fitlhelela go thapiwa, go tshwaela mo loagong mmogo le go aga ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Uhlaka lweNqubomgomo uma seluqalisiwe ukusebenza luzohlinzeka ngendlela yokusebenza ehlanganisiwe yezinsizakalo zokuthuthukiswa kwemikhakha yemisebenzi eziseqophelweni eliphezulu zazo zonke izakhamuzi.

src: Tirelo ya Tlhabololo ya Tiro e na le seabe sa botlhokwa go thusa gore mebaraka ya ditiro e dire mme ditsamaiso tsa thuto di fitlhelele diphitlhelelo tsa tsona.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwenza izakhamuzi zikwazi ukukhetha imikhakha yemisebenzi ngomqondo ophusile ukuze zikwazi ukuqashwa, zibe negalelo emphakathini futhi zakhe umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Seno se tshwaela mo go fitlheleleng dikatlenegiso tsa NDP tsa go tsweletsa kgolo ya ikonomi le go thapa, go lepalepanya badiri le ditiro le go oketsa tlhabololo ya bokgoni mmogo le palo ya dialogane tsa diyunibesithi.
tgt: Izinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi zidlala indima esemqoka ekusizeni umsebenzi wezimakethe zabasebenzi kanye nezinhlelo zezemfundo zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezinjongo zazo.

src: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka tiragatso ya Thulaganyo ya Bosetšhaba ya Tshekatsheko mme e amogetse Pegelo ya Ngwaga le ngwaga ya 2014/15 le Leano la botlhano la Bosetšhaba la Tshekatsheko la 2016/17 go fitlha 2018/19 jaaka karolo ya letsholo la go tokafatsa tlamelo ya ditirelo.
tgt: Lokhu kunegalelo maqondana nokufezekiswa kwezincomo zoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe zokugqugquzela ukukhula komnotho kanye nokuqashwa kwabantu, ukuqondaniswa kwabasebenzi abaqashiwe nemisebenzi yabo kanye nokwandisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nesibalo sabantu abaneziqu zemfundo yasenyuvesi.

src: Thulaganyo ya Bosetšhaba ya Tshekatsheko e tswa mo Letlhomesong la Bosetšhaba la Pholisi ya Tshekatsheko le le netefatsang gore bosupi jo bo ikanyegang e bile bo sa gobelele jo bo tswang mo ditshekatshekong, bo akarediwa mo dithulaganyong tsa maano, tekanyetsokabo, tlhabololo ya ditheo, tshekatsheko ya dipholisi, gammogo le jaaka lenaane le le tswelelang pele le tsamaiso ya diporojeke gore go tokafadiwe tiragatso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nokuqaliswa kokusebenza Kohlelo Lokulinganisa Lukazwelonke futhi lagunyaza umbiko Wonyaka wezi-2014/15 kanye Nohlelo Lokulinganisa Lukazwelonke lesihlanu lowezi-2016/17 kuya kowezi-2018/19, njengengxenye yombhidlango wokwenza ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo-ngqangi.

src: Go konoseditswe gongwe go tsweletswe ka ditshekatsheko di le 47, tse di akaretsang ditshenyegelo tsa puso tsa R75 bilione.
tgt: Uhlelo Lokulinganisa Lukazwelonke lususelwa oHlakeni Lokusebenza leNqubomgomo Yokulinganisa Kazwelonke oluqinisekisa ukuthi ubufakazi obuqotho nobunenjongo obuvela ekulinganisweni buyafakwa ezinhlelweni zokuhlela, ukwabiwa kwezimali, ukwenziwa ngcono kwezinhlangano, ukubuyekezwa kwezinqubomgomo, kanjalo nasezinhlelweni eziqhubekayo kanye nokuphathwa kwemiklamo ukuze kwenziwe ngcono ukusebenza.

src: Go amogetswe dipegelo tsa tshekatsheko di le 15 mme go fitlha ga jaana, di le 12 di tlhagisitswe fa pele ga Kabinete.
tgt: Izilinganiso ezingama-47 seziphothuliwe noma zisaqhutshwa, ezikhava izigidigidi ezingama-75 zamarandi ezindleko zikahulumeni.

src: Go diragadiwa maano a tokafatso a le 14 mme tswelelopele ya ona e bontsha diphetogo tse di bonalang.
tgt: Imibiko yokulinganisa eyi-15 yagunyazwa kwathi eyi-12 yabekwa ezithebeni zeKhabhinethi kuze kube manje.

src: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka diphitlhelelo tsa tshekatsheko mme ya amogela dikatlenegiso e lebile go oketsa ditlamorago go tswa kwa tiragatsong ya Lephata la Loago la Lenaanekatoloso la Ditiro tsa Setšhaba (EPWP-SS).Lenaane leno le na le seabe sa botlhoka sa tshireletso ya loago mo bagolong ba ba itekanetseng mme ba sa dire, ka go ba gogela mo tirong e e tlhagisang mme ba amogela tlhatswadiatla ya kgwedi le kgwedi ya palogare ya R1 Bontsi jwa manaane a lephata la loago bo tlamela baagi ba ba mo matshosetsing le ba ba humanegileng ka ditirelo tse di kgethegileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela yokulinganisa kanye nezincomo ezigunyaziwe ngenhloso yokwandisa umthelela osukela ekuqalisweni ukusebenza Kohlelo Lemisebenzi Yomphakathi Eyandisiwe Yomkhakha Wezenhlalo (i-EPWP-SS).Lolu Hlelo ludlala indima esemqoka yokuvikelwa kwesimo senhlalo yabantu abantu abangakhubazeke ndawo abangasebenzi, kokubadonsela emsebenzini onomkhiqizo bese bethola umthobanhlizinyo njalo ngenyanga olinganiselwa esambeni se-R1 517.

src: EPWP-SS e godile ka bonako magareng ga legato la ntlha le legato la bobedi, go tloga go manaane a le 5 go ya go a le 22 a a bakileng gore lephata le fitlhelele ditšhono tsa tiro di le 175 769 mo legatong la ntlha le ditšhono tsa tiro di le 866 246 mo legatong la bobedi, e leng go feta 750 000 e e neng e beilwe.
tgt: I-EPWP-SS ikhule ngesivinini esikhulu phakathi kwesigaba sokuqala nesigaba sesibili, kusukela ezinhlelweni ezi-5 kuya ezinhlelweni ezingama-22 okuholele kulo mkhakha ukuba ufezekise amathuba emisebenzi ayizi-175 769 esigabeni sokuqala kanye namathuba emisebenzi ayizi-866 246 esigabeni sesibili, nokungaphezulu kakhulu kobekusophiwe okungamathuba emisebenzi ayizi-750 000.Izincomo zigxile ekwenzeni ngcono ukuqaliswa kokusebenza ukuze kuncishiswe ukungasebenzi ngendlela egculisayo ekuthathweni kwezinqumo, ukuqaliswa ukusebenza (izinkokhelo zemithobanhliziyo) kanye nokuhlinzekwa ngokuqeqesha, kanjalo nokuxhumanisa.

src: Dikatlenegiso di totile go tokafatsa tiragatso go fokotsa tlhaelo ya go tsaya ditshwetso, tiragatso (tuelo ya tlhatswadiatla) mmogo le tlamelo ka katiso, gammogo le kgokaganyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela kanye nezincomo ezigunyaziwe zedizayini kanye nokuqaliswa ukusebenza kokulinganiswa Kwesabelo Sokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala Ezisemadolobheni kanye Nohlelo Lokwenziwa Ngcono kwaso.

src: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka diphitlhelelo mme ya tlhomamisa dikatlenegiso tsa sethalo le tiragatso ya tshekatsheko ya Kabelo ya Tlhabololo ya Manno a Metsesetoropo mmogo le Leano la teng la Tokafatso.
tgt: Imiphumela yeseka ukugcinwa kweSabelo Sokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala Ezisemadolobheni njengesabelo sokunezezela esikhokhela umqondo ovulekile wokuhlaliswa kwabantu okuqhubekayo nokulinganayo ukuze kuhlomule abantu abahluphekayo kanye namakhaya anemali engenayo engenkulu kakhulu.

src: Diphitlhelelo di tshegetsa go tswelela ka Kabelo ya Tlhabololo ya Manno a Metsesetoropo jaaka kabelo ya tshegetso ya manno a batho a leruri le a a nang le tekatekano a a tswelang mosola magae a a humanegileng le a letseno le le sa reng sepe.
tgt: Lokhu kuwusizo kakhulu ekufezekiseni izinjongo zoHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwamathuba okwakhiwa kwezindlu eziyisigidi esi-1 495 ezindaweni zokuhlala eziseqophelweni eliphezulu ngowezi-2019.

src: Seno se botlhokwa mo go fitlheleleng diphitlhelelo tsa MTSF go tlamela ka ditšhono di le 1 495 milione tsa dintlo mo tikologong ya boleng ka 2019.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze umbiko maqondana Nokuqaliswa Ukusebenza kanye Nokulinganiswa Komthelela Wezobuchwepheshe kanye Nezindaba Zabasebenzi zoHlelo Lwezezimboni, impendulo yabaphathi embikweni kanye nohlelo lokwenza ngcono oluthunyelwe nguMnyango Wezokuhwebelana kanye Nezezimboni.

src: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo ya Tiragatso le Tshekatsheko ya Ditlamorago tsa Ditlamelo tsa Thekenoloji le Badiri tsa Manaane a Indaseteri, tsibogo ya botsamaisi mmogo le leano la tokafatso le le tlhagisitsweng ke Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri.
tgt: Lolu Hlelo lwethulwa nguMnyango Wezohwebo kanye Nezezimboni ngowe-1992 ukuze kuqiniswe ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kwezesayensi, ezobunjiniyela kanye nezobuchwepheshe.

src: Lenaane leno le itsisitswe ke Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri ka 1992 go maatlafatsa tlhabololo ya bokgoni mo saenseng, boenjiniri le thekenoloji.
tgt: Lunegalelo ekusungulweni kwamathuba emisebenzi ngokukhiqiza inqwaba yabacwaningi abanamakhono aphezulu kanye nabaphathi bezobuchwepheshe embonini kanye nokwenza ngcono ubuqhudelwano bezinhlangano zamabhizinisi ezibambe iqhaza.

src: Le tshwaela mo go tlhameng ditiro ka go tlhagisa kelelo ya babatlisisi ba ba nang le bokgoni jo bo kwa godimo le batsamaisi ba thekenoloji mo indasetering le go tokafatsa bokgoni jwa kgaisano jwa dikgwebo tse di nang le seabe.
tgt: Uhlelo luyingxenye esemthethweni, esemqoka futhi egculisayo yokweseka okuqanjwe kabusha okunikezela ngalokho okuyifanele ngempela imali yakho kukhona kokubili ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuthuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezindaba zabasebenzi kanye namakhono ahlobene nezezimboni.

src: Gape le gaisana sentle le Manaane mangwe a boditšhabatšhaba.
tgt: Luphinde futhi luqhathaniseke ngokuvumelanayo nezinye izinhlelo zasemazweni aphesheya.

src: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Setlhophatiro sa Ditona se se neng se batlisisa magatwe a 'diphatlhatiro tsa borutabana tse di rekisiwang' a a amang mekgatlho ya barutabana le batlhankedi ba Mafapha a Diporofense a Thuto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela yoMbiko Wethimba loNgqongqoshe Lokwenziwa Komsebenzi wokuphenya ngezinsolo ‘zokuthengiswa kwezikhala zemisebenzi yothisha’ ezibandakanya abantu abathile, izinyunyana zothisha kanye nezikhulu zeMinyango ethile Yezemfundo Yezifundazwe.

src: Kabinete e tlhomamisitse dikatlenegiso tsa go samagana le diphitlhelelo ka tsela e e WEBTOKEN Pegelong ya sona ya makgaolakgang, Setlhophatiro sa Ditona se sekasekile seabe sa baamegi botlhe mo tsamaisong ya go tlhopha le go ngoka WEBTOKEN lemogile gape mathata a a bonalang mo tsamaisong ya ga jaana ya go thapa mo diphatlhatirong mo lephateng la thuto ya motheo se tlamela ka dikatlenegiso tsa go thusa Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le lephata la thuto ya motheo ka kakaretso go samagana le dikgwetlho tse di supilweng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze izincomo zokubhekana ngendlela enohlelo neqondiswe ngqo emiphumeleni.

src: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Dikgwa wa 1998 (Molao wa bo 84 wa 1998).Tiragatso ya dipaakanyo e tla tokafatsa tsamaiso ya leruri ya dikgwa mme gape e rotloetse seabe sa ditlhopha tse di mo matshosetsing, tse di ikaegileng ka jalo ya dikgwa go itshedisa, mo Lekgotleng la Bogakolodi la Bosetšhaba la Dikgwa.
tgt: Uphinde uqaphele izinkinga ezinkulu ezisohlelweni lwamanje lokuqokelwa ezikhaleni zomsebenzi emkhakheni wezemfundo yamabanga aphansi futhi uphinde uhlinzeke ngezincomo ukusiza uMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo kanye nomkhakha wezemfundo yamabanga aphansi jikelele ukwazi ukubhekana nezingqinamba ezihlonziwe.

src: Baeteledipele ba sedumedi le baeteledipele ba mekgatlho ya baagi ba tla tshwaragana le puso go rapelela go golagana go ya pele ga temokerasi, kopano ya setšhaba, kopano ya loago gammogo le Ditlhopho tsa Pusoselegae tsa 2016 tse di atlegileng e bile di rena kagiso.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wezamahlathi Kazwelonke, we-1998 (uMthetho onguNombolo 84 we-1998).Ukuqaliswa ukusebenza kwezichibiyelo kuzokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa kwezamahlathi okuqinile futhi kuphinde kugqugquzele ukubamba iqhaza kwamaqempu abantu abantekenteke, abathembele emahlathini ukuze bakwazi ukuphila, eMkhandlwini Wezokululeka Ngezamahlathi Kazwelonke.

src: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka maano a Lefapha la Botsweretshi le Setso go tshwara Kgwedi ya Aforika ka Motsheganong 2016 ka moono wa: "Re aga Aforika yo o Botoka le Lefatshe le le Botoka" jaaka karolo ya meletlo ya kontinente go keteka go tlhamiwa ga Mokgatlho wa Kitlano ya Aforika, o jaanong o bidiwang Kitlano ya Aforika le tiro e o e dirileng.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzohambela umcimbi wokugcotshwa kanye nokufungiswa kukaMongameli wase-Uganda u-Yoweri Museveni eKampala ngomhla ziyi-12 Nhlaba 2016.

src: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla tlhoma Kgwedi ya Aforika ka Letsatsi la Bosetšhaba la Thapelo ka la bo 20 Moranang WEBTOKEN 2016, Kgwedi ya Aforika e tla tota maiteko a tlhabololo ya basadi le bašwa, fa re ntse re gopola ngwaga wa bo60 wa Mogwanto wa Basadi le ngwaga wa bo40 wa Dikhuduego tsa Bašwa tsa kwa Soweto.
tgt: Lolu hambo oluphumayo luzophinde luqinise ubudlelwano obumbaxambili phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Uganda.

src: MaAforika Borwa a rotloediwa go nna le seabe mo lenaaneng la maphata mantsi le le akaretsang ditiragalo tse di farologaneng tse di akaretsang botsweretshipono, teatere, mmino, ditlhatlhelelo le dipuisano gammogo le segopotso sa bo10 sa Letlole la Aforika la Ngwaoboswa ya Lefatshe.
tgt: UMongameli u-Jacob Zuma uzokwengamela Usuku Lukazwelonke Lomkhuleko ozobanjelwa Ezinkundleni Zemidlalo i-ABSA e-Durban mhla zingama-29 Mbasa 2016.

src: Kgwedi ya Aforika ke serala sa gore re golagane gape le go itlama gape ka Kopano ya maAforika le Tsosoloso ya Aforika go kopanya batho ba kontinente.
tgt: Abaholi bezenkolo kanye nabaholi bezinhlangano zomphakathi bazohlanganyela nohulumeni ekukhulekeleni okunye ukuqiniswa kombuso wentando yeningi labantu, ubumbano lukazwelonke, ukubumbana komphakathi kanjalo Nokhetho Lohulumeni Bezindawo lowezi-2016 oluyimpumelelo nolunokuthula.

src: Ka la bo 20 Motsheganong 2016, puso e tla etelela pele keteko ya bosetšhaba ya ngwagakgolo wa Yunibesithi ya Fort Hare kwa khamphaseng ya Alice kwa Kapabotlhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nezinhlelo zoMnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko zokusingatha Inyanga ye-Afrika ngoNhlaba 2016 ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Ukwakha i-Afrika Engcono kanye Nomhlaba Ongcono” njengengxenye yemigubho yezwekazi yokusungulwa kweNhlangano Yobumbano lwase-Afrika (i-OAU), manje esiyaziwa ngokuthi Ubumbano lwaseAfrika (i-African Union) kanye nomsebenzi esiwenzile.

src: Go baakanyetsa keteko e kgolo, Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tlhamile Komiti ya Ditona (IMC) go rulaganya le go gokaganya keteko eno ya hisetori ya ngwagakgolo.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzokwethula Inyanga yeAfrika ngoSuku Lukazwelonke Lomkhuleko ngomhla zingama-29 kuMbasa 2016.Ngowezi-2016 Inyanga ye-Afrika izogxila ezinhlelweni eziqanjwe kabusha zokuthuthukiswa kwabantu besifazane kanye nentsha, ngenkathi sigubha iminyaka engama-60 yeMashi Yabantu Besifazane kanye neminyaka engama-40 Yemibhikiso Yentsha eSoweto.

src: Setheo seno sa thuto sa hisetori se dirile jaaka mosupatsela ka nako ya kgaratlho ya rona ya kgololesego mme gape se itsege jaaka "motswedi wa boeteledipele jwa Aforika" jaaka e le setheo se se tlhagisitseng balwelakgololesego ba tshwana le bagaka ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo le Govan Mbeki.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayanxuswa ukuba babambe iqhaza ohlelweni oluzobe luhlanganise iminxa ehlukahlukene olubandakanya imisebenzi enhlobonhlobo efaka phakathi imisebenzi yobuciko obubukwayo, imidlalo yeshashalazi, umculo, izifundo kanye nezingqungquthela kanjalo nokubungazwa kweminyaka eyi-10 yeSikhwama Samasiko Omhlaba Wase-Afrika.

src: Ke yona fela yunibesithi ya Borwa jwa Aforika e e tlhagisitseng ditlhogo tsa mebuso di le tlhano: Nelson Mandela wa Aforika Borwa, Yusuf Yule wa Uganda, Robert Mugabe wa Zimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle wa Lesotho le Sir Seretse Khama wa Botswana.
tgt: Inyanga yase-Afrika isebenza njengenkundla yokuzixhumana kabusha kanye nokuzibophezela kabusha Obumbanweni lwama-Afrika kanye Nasekuvuselelweni kwe-Afrika ekuhlanganiseni abantu bezwekazi lase-Afrika ndawonye.

src: Jaaka karolo ya meletlo ya ngwagakgolo wa Yunibesithi ya Fort Hare, Kabinete e ikuela mo go botlhe ba ba ithutileng koo mmogo le baagi go amogana tseo ba di gakologelwang ka Fort Hare mo letsholong la Anela Kgang ya Gago ba dirisa #MyFortHare.
tgt: Ngomhla zingama-20 Nhlaba 2016 uhulumeni uzohola umgubho kazwelonke weminyaka eyikhulu yeNyuvesi i-Fort Hare ophikweni oluse-Alice eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etelela pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa kwa Foramong ya Lefatshe ya Ikonomi (WEF) ya bo26 ya Aforika kwa Rwanda magareng ga la bo 11 le la bo 13 Motsheganong 2016.
tgt: Ukulungiselela umgubho omkhulu, uMongameli u-Jacob Zuma usesungule iKomidi loNgqongqoshe Abahlukahlukene (i-IMC) ukuba lihlele liphinde lididiyele le ngqophamlando yomgubho weminyaka eyikhulu.

src: Foramo e amogelwa ka moono wa: "Go golaganya Ditlamelo tsa Aforika ka Diphetogo tsa Dijitale".Puso ka Leano la yona la Dintlha tse Robongwe e tsweletsa diphetogo tsa dijitale mo nageng.
tgt: Lesi sikhungo sokufunda esiyingqophamlando sasebenza njengesikhonkwane ngesikhathi sethu sokuzabalazela inkululeko futhi siphinde saziwe njenge “mbiza yobuholi base-Afrika” ngenxa yokuthi iyona nyuvesi eyafunda izingqalabutho zomzabalazo wokulwisana nobandlululo ezinjengo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo no-Govan Mbeki.

src: E atolosa legato la ntlha la maiteko a broadband e e tla golaganyang ditheo di feta 5 000 tsa puso mo makgotlatoropong a dikgaolo a le robedi mo pakeng ya dingwaga tse tharo.
tgt: Iyona kuphela inyuvesi eseNingizimu ne-Afrika eyake yakhiqiza izinhloko zombuso ezinhlanu: u-Nelson Mandela waseNingizimu Afrika, u-Yusuf Lule wase-Uganda, u-Robert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, uNtsu Mokhehle waseLesotho kanye no-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.

src: Go rebotswe matlole a bokana ka R740 milione go tshegetsa katoloso eno.
tgt: Njengengxenye yemigubho yeminyaka eyikhulu yeNyuvesi i-Fort Hare iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abafundi bangaphambilini bale nyuvesi kanye namalungu omphakathi ukuba abelane ngezinkumbulo anazo nge-Fort Hare emkhankasweni Wokuxoxa Indaba Yakho esebenzisa isibambo esithi #MyFortHare.

src: INDABA 2016 kwa Inkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre kwa Durban go tloga la bo 7 go fitlha la bo 9 Motsheganong 2016, ke serala sa Kopano ya maAforika se se tla tsweletsang ditlhagiswa tsa bojanala mo bareking ba boditšhabatšhaba.
tgt: IPhini likaMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uzohola ithimba lezinthunywa zaseNingizimu Afrika eliya Esithangamini Sezomnotho Womhlaba Wonke (i-WEF) sama-26 e-Afrika esizobe sibanjelwe eRwanda phakathi komhla ziyi-11 kanye ne-13 Nhlaba 2016.

src: Bojanala jaaka nngwe ya dipilara tse thataro tsa kgolo ya ikonomi mo Leanong la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo, bo tshwaetse R357 bilione mo GDP ya rona ka 2014 mme bo tshegeditse diperesente di le 9 tsa ditiro tsotlhe mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Isithangami sisingathwe ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Ukuxhumanisa Izinsiza zase-Africa ngokusebenzisa Ukuguquka Kwezobuxhakaxhaka Bukagesi”.Uhulumeni esebenzisa Uhlelo lwakhe Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye uqhubezela phambili ukuguquka kwezwe kwezobuxhakaxhaka bukagesi.

src: Lekgotla la Lefatshe la Maeto le Bojanala le fopholetsa gore bojanala bo tla tshwaela R560 bilione mo GDP ya rona ka 2025 mme bo tla tshegetsa ditiro di feta dimilione di le pedi.
tgt: Uxhaso lwemali ebalelwa ezigidini ezingama-740 zamarandi selwabiwe ukweseka lokhu kukhishwa kwalesi sigaba.

src: Go godisa ditlamorago tsa Bojanala mo Ikonoming ya Mawatle ke ntlha ya botlhokwa mo Leanong la Dintlha tse Robongwe, mme seno se ikaegile ka bokgoni jo bo iseng bo dirisiwe jwa mawatle a rona, a a ka tshwaelang mo kgolong ya ikonomi.
tgt: INDABA 2016 eNkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre e-Durban kusukela mhla ziyi-7 kuya mhla ziyi-9 Nhlaba 2016, iyisithangami Sobumbano lwama-Afrika esizokhuthaza imikhiqizo yethu yezokuvakasha kubathengi basemazweni aphesheya.

src: Ikonomi ya mawatle le bojanala di tlamela ka ditšhono tse di boitshegang tsa kgolo ya ikonomi le go tlhamiwa ga ditiro.
tgt: Ezokuvakasha, njengenye yezinsika eziyisithupha zokukhula komnotho woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe, zibe negalelo lezigidigidi ezingama-357 zamarandi kwiSamba Somkhiqizo Wezwe (i-GDP) ngowezi-2014 futhi zixhase nge-9% esambeni esiphelele sabantu abaqashiwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Mo segopotsong sa Letsatsi la Badiri ka la bo 1 Motsheganong 2016, Kabinete e boeletsa maitlamo a naga go sireletsa ditshwanelo tsa badiri ka melao ya rona e e nang le tswelelopele.
tgt: Umkhandlu Wezokuhamba Nokuvakasha Womhlaba Wonke ulinganisa ngokuthi ezokuvakasha zizoba negalelo lezigidigidi ezingama-560 zamarandi kwi-GDP yethu ngowezi-2025 kanti futhi ziyoxhasa ngemisebenzi engaphezu kwezigidi ezimbili.

src: Fa e sa le ka 1994, puso e ntse e tsweletsa ditshwanelo tsa badiri ka melao e tshwana le Molao wa Dikamano tsa Bodiri, Molao wa Dipeelo tsa Motheo tsa go Thapa, Molao wa Tekatekano ya go Thapa mmogo le wa Boitekanelo le Pabalesego mo Tirong.
tgt: Ukukhulisa umthelela Wezokuvakasha Emnothweni Wasolwandle kuyinsika esemqoka yoHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, okususelwe emandleni angakathintwa muntu ezilwandle zethu, angaba negalelo ekukhuleni komnotho.

src: Letsholo leno la ngwaga le ngwaga la Lefapha la Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso, le tla tswelela bosetšhaba go fitlha ka Lwetse 2016 mme le thusa barutwana go dira boitlhophelo ka kitso fa ba dira dikopo tsa kwa ditheong tsa thuto e kgolwane.
tgt: Ekugujweni koSuku Lwabasebenzi mhla lu-1 Nhlaba 2016, iKhabhinethi igcizelela ukuzibophezela kwezwe ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi ngokusebenzisa imithetho yethu yabasebenzi enenqubekelaphambili.

src: Barutwana ba rotloediwa go ikgolaganya le Tikwatikwe ya Ditirelo tsa Tlhabololo ya Ditiro (Career Development Services Centre) ka SMS gongwe “please call me” mo 072 204 5056 gongwe 086 999 0123, emeile EMAILTOKEN, mo Facebook kwa WEBTOKEN gongwe mo Twitter kwa WEBTOKEN Maemo a Kabinete mo Mererong e e Botlhokwa ya ga jaana.
tgt: Kusukela ngowe-1994 uhulumeni esebenzisa imithetho enjengoMthetho Wezobudlelwano Nabasebenzi, uMthetho Wezimo Zokusebenza Eziyisisekelo, uMthetho Wokuqashwa Kwabantu Ngokulingana kanye noMthetho Wezempilo Emsebenzini kanye Nokuphepha useqhubezele phambili amalungelo abasebenzi.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa baamegi botlhe ba ba maleba go tshwaela mo lekwalotlhomong le le sekasekilweng la Tumelano ya Maatlafatso ya Ikonomi ya Bantsho e e Atolositsweng ya Indaseteri ya Aforika Borwa ya Meepo le Diminerale 2016 le le phasaladitsweng mo Kaseteng ya Puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abafundi beBanga le-12 ukuba baqale ukuthwebula amafomu okufaka izicelo noma bafake izicelo nge-inthanethi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme njengengxenye yoMkhankaso othi Apply Now/Khetha Career Guidance.

src: Lekwalotlhomo le le sekasekilweng la Tumelano ya Meepo gape le gokaganya dipholisi le melao ya puso ya diphetogo go tokafatsa tsela ya go dira kgwebo, go tlhalosa dintlha tsa taolo, diponelopele mmogo le tsepamo.
tgt: Umkhankaso obanjwa njalo minyaka yonke nguMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha, uzobanjwa kuzwelonke kuze kube nguMandulo 2016 futhi uzosiza abafundi ukuba bakhethe ngomqondo ophusile lapho befaka izicelo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.

src: Gape le lepalepane le ditlamelo tsa Molao wa Maatlafatso ya Ikonomi ya Bantsho e e Atolositsweng, 2003 (Molao wa bo53 wa 2003) le Melawana ya Tiragatso e e Siameng (Code of Good Practice (Melawana ya DTI).
tgt: Abafundi bayagqugquzelwa ukuba baxhumane neSikhungo Sezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi ngokuthumela i-SMS noma u-“please call me” ku-072 204 5056 noma ku-086 999 0123, nge-imeyili kuleli kheli: EMAILTOKEN, ku-Facebook kuleli kheli: WEBTOKEN noma ku-Twitter kuleli kheli: WEBTOKEN Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisematheni.

src: Kabinete e lemoga gore go amogelwa ga go tsewa go go tshitshintsweng ga SAB Miller ke AB InBev go sa ntse go sekwasekwa ke bothati jwa dikgaisano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igqugquzela ababambiqhaza abafanelekile ukuba baphawule ohlakeni olubuyekeziwe loMqulu Wokuthuthukiswa Kwabamnyama Kwezomnotho Wezezimboni zaseNingizimu Afrika Zezezimayini kanye Nezimbiwa Phansi, lowezi-2016 olwashicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni.

src: Kabinete e amogela tsamaiso e e dumelanweng ke Tona ya Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi le AB InBev le bothati jwa dikgaisano mo dintlheng tse di farologaneng tsa dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba.
tgt: Uhlaka olubuyekeziwe loMqulu Wezezimayini luphinde luhlanganise izinqubomgomo zenguquko zikahulumeni kanye nomthetho wokuthuthukisa ukwenziwa lula kwebhizinisi, ukusungula incanciselo yezokulawula, ukuqagulwa kanye nokuqiniseka.

src: Maitlamo a setlamo a tla dira jaaka kaedi ya ditlamo tse dingwe tse di mo seemong sa go kopana le go tsaya tse dingwe mo mererong ya dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba.
tgt: Luphinde lwahanjelaniswa nezimiso zoMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwabamanyama Kwezomnotho, wezi-2003 (uMthetho onguNombolo 53 wezi-2003) kanye Namakhodi Enkambiso Enhle (Amakhodi e-DTI).

src: Seno se akaretsa maitlamo a setlamo se dumelaneng ka ona go dirisa R1 bilione mo dingwageng tse di tlang di le tlhano go tsweletsa bolemirui jo bo potlana le tlhabololo ya batlamedi ba selegae, dikgwebo tse dintšhwa, dithekenoloji tse di somarelang maatla le metsi mmogo le tlhabololo ya bašwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphelile ukuthi ukugunyazwa kokuthengwa okuhlongozwayo kwe-SAB Miller yi-AB InBev kusengaphansi kokucutshungulwa ngabasebagunyeni ezemiqhudelwano.

src: Maitlamo a ditiro, go akarediwa maitlamo a go tila go fokotsa badiri ka ntlha ya go kopana ga ditlamo le go tshola badiri mo seemong sa ga jana mo setlamong mo dingwageng tse tlhano tse di latelang, ke karolo ya tumelano magareng ga setlamo le puso go tshegetsa go tlhabololwa ga indaseteri, dikgwebopotlana mmogo le go tlhamiwa ga ditiro.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamukela indlela yokusebenza okuvunyelwene ngayo ethathwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho kanye ne-AB InBev kwabasemagunyeni ezemiqhudelwano maqondana nezindaba ezinhlobonhlobo ezithinta umphakathi.

src: Mo ntlheng e nngwe e e kwa thoko, Kabinete e lemoga go diragadiwa ga ditlamelo tsa Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Dikgaisano tse di reng ke tlolomolao ya bosenyi gore bakaedi le botsamaisi ba dumelane go tsepamisa ditlhotlhwa, dithendara gongwe mebaraka.
tgt: Ukuzibophezela kwenkampani kusebenza njengomkhombandlela, ezindabeni ezithinta umphakathi, kwezinye izinkampani ezihlangene kanye nasekuthengweni okunezimo ezifanayo.

src: Ditlamelo tseno ke karolo ya dikgato tsa go maatlafatsa ntwa kgatlhanong le digongwana tse di senyang ikonomi mme di bolaisa badirisi ditlhotlhwa tse di kwa WEBTOKEN ikuela mo dikgwebong tsa Aforika Borwa go gaisana go ikaegilwe ka ditlhotlhwa tse di kwa tlase, boitlhamedi, boleng jo bo tokafetseng jwa dithoto gongwe ditirelo tse di gaisang go badirisi go na le go dira seo ka go dumelana.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya isibophezelo okuvunyelwene ngaso yinkampani sokuchitha isigidigidi samarandi eminyakeni eyisihlanu ezayo ukukhuthaza ukufuya nokulima kwabalimi abancane kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabaphakeli bempahla balapha ezweni ngaphakathi, amabhizinisi amasha, ubuchwepheshe bamandla kanye namanzi anele kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwentsha.

src: Kabinete e lemogile ka moo lephata la dibanka le laolwang ka gona mo Aforika Borwa - le lefatshe ka bophara, le tlhokego ya gore Aforika Borwa a obamele seemo sa boditšhabatšhaba go tshwana le Basel III le melawana e e kgatlhanong le madi a a bonwang ka bonweenwee (Anti-money laundering regulations) ya Setheo sa Tiro sa Dikgato sa Ditšhelete (Financial Action Task Force (FATF)), tse di kileng tsa amogelwa ke Kabinete, mme di tshegediwa ke molao o o amogetsweng ke Puso.
tgt: Ukuzibophezela ngemisebenzi kubandakanya nesithembiso sokugwema ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi bengazikhethelanga bona njengomphumela wokuhlangana kwezinkampani kanye nokugcina amazinga okuqashwa enkampanini iminyaka emihlanu ezayo, kuyingxenye yesivumelwano esiyingqophamlando esingakaze sibonakale phakathi kwenkampani nohulumeni ukweseka ezezimboni, ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi amancane kanye nokusungulwa kwamathuba emisebenzi.

src: Thulaganyo ya Twin Peaks e tla laola maitsholo a mebaraka mo lephateng la dibanka le ditšhelete.".
tgt: Ngakolunye uhlangothi oluseceleni, iKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezimiso zoMthetho Wokuchibiyela Imincintiswano ezikwenza kube icala lobugebengu ukuthi abaqondisi kanye nabaphathi bavumelane ngasese ekuphekeni kwamanani, amathenda noma izimakethe.

src: Kabinete e amogela ditlamorago tsa Kopano ya Dikgakologo ya Letlole la Boditšhabatšhaba la Ditšhelete le Ditlhopha tsa Dibanka tsa Lefatshe ya 2016 e e neng e tshwerwe ka moono wa "Dikgwetlho tsa Lefatshe, Ditharabololo tsa Lefatshe".
tgt: Lezi zimiso ziyingxenye yezinyathelo zokukhuphula ukulwisana nombimbi olucekela phansi umnotho futhi lubeke amanani aphezulu kubathengi.

src: Go tshitshintswe tsela e e dintlha tse tharo go tlhosetsa kgolo mo legatong la lefatshe, go rotloetsa dinaga go dirisa dipholisi go tsweletsa kgolo, go tewa diphetogo mo go tsa ditšhelete le dipopegotheo.
tgt: Sinxusa amabhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika ukuba ancintisane ngokugxila emananini aphansi, ukuqamba kabusha okuthe xaxa, ikhwalithi eyenziwe ngcono yezimpahla ezinikezelwayo noma insizakalo ephezulu kubathengi kunokuba kuvunyelwane ngasese.

src: Dinaga tse di nang le sebaka sa ditšhelete di rotloeditswe go dira go le gontsi go oketsa tlhokego fela, tiragatso ya diphetogo tsa dipopegotheo e nnile botlhokwa go botlhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphelile indlela ephezulu umkhakha wezokubhanga olawulwa ngayo la eNingizimu Afrika – kanye nasemhlabeni jikelele, kanye nesidingo sokuba iNingizimu Afrika ithobele amazinga omhlaba wonke njenge-Basel III kanye nemithetho ephikisana nokushintshisana ngemali Yombutho Wethimba Lokusebenza Lezezimali (i-FATF), ebivele kakade isigunyaziwe yiKhabhinethi, futhi yasekelwa yimitheshwana engaphansi eyagunyazwa nguHulumeni.

src: Go bontsi, seno se akaretsa dipeeletso mo mafaratlhatlheng, boitlhamedi le go tokafatsa tikologo ya taolo, gareng ga tse dingwe.
tgt: Uhlelo lama-Twin Peaks nalo luzolawula ukuziphatha kwezimakethe emkhakheni wezokubhanga kanye nakwezezimali ngobubanzi.".

src: Kabinete e gakolola botlhe ba ba nang le tshiamelo ya go nna batlhophi ba ba iseng ba ikwadise le go tlhomamisa dintlha tsa bona gore ba sa ntse ba ka dira jalo ka go etela Kantoro ya selegae ya Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho (IEC).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukele imiphumela evela eMhlanganweni Wasentwasahlobo wezi-2016 Wesikhwama Sezezimali Somhlaba Wonke kanye Namaqembu Ebhange Lomhlaba owabanjwa ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Izinselele Zomhlaba Wonke, Izixazululo Zomhlaba Wonke”.

src: Seno se a tlhokega go netefatsa gore leina la gago le teng mo lenaneng la batlhophi le le tla kgontshang batlhophi ba ba nang le tshiamelo go diragatsa tshwanelo ya bona ya temokerasi ka la bo 3 Phatwe 2016.Kabinete e ikuela mo batlhophing botlhe ba ba nang le tshiamelo go netefatsa gore ba fitlhelela ditlhokego tsa go tlamela ka diaterese tsa bona kwa kantorong ya selegae ya Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho (IEC).
tgt: Indlela yokusebenza embaxantathu yokokhwezela ukukhula ezingeni lomhlaba wonke yahlongozwa, egqugquzela amazwe ukuba asebenzise izilinganiso zenqubomgomo ukuqhubezela ukukhula, okuwokuphathelene nezezimali, isikhwama sezimali zikahulumeni kanye nezinguquko zokwakhiwa kwazo.

src: Kabinete e akgola Mokaedikakaretso wa Merero ya Tikologo, Nosipho Ngcaba ka ntlha ya go amogela Sekgele sa 2015/16 Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic go tswa kwa phasalatsong ya tsa tikologo, The Enviropaedia.
tgt: Lokhu kuyadingeka ukuze uqinisekise igama lakho ohlwini labavoti oluzovumela abavoti abafanelekile ukuba basebenzise ilungelo labo lentandoyeningi mhla zi-3 Ncwaba 2016.IKhabhinethi inxusa abavoti abafanelekileyo ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi bayahlangabezana nesidingo sokuhlinzeka ngekheli ehhovisi eliseduzane nabo leKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele.

src: Kabinete e akgola motsweretshi Kemang Wa Lehulere ka go nna "Motsweretshi wa Ngwaga" wa 2017 ka ketleetso ya Deutsche Bank.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uTransnet, Uphiko Lwezokushushisa Lukazwelonke, Inhlangano Yezokusakaza yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SABC) kanye neMinyango Yezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha, Wezobudlelwano Namazwe Omhlaba kanye Nokubambisana kanye Nowezokuthuthukiswa Kwezomthethosisekelo ngokukleliswa njengaba “Qashi Abahehayo Kakhulu” eNingizimu Afrika yinkampani eqopha abaqashi, i-UNIVERSUIKhabhinethi income uNgqongqoshe Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe, uNaledi Pandor, othole Umklomelo Wokusebenza Ngobungqaphambili ovela kwi-Federal Republic of Germany ngegalelo lakhe ekuthuthukisweni kwesayensi emhlabeni wonke jikelele.

src: Wa Lehulere, yo o lebelelang bomaleba jwa botsweretshi mo go Aforika Borwa wa morago ga Tlhaolele, o tla tlhagisa pontsho ya gagwe ya ntlha ya motho a le mongwe kwa Jeremane kwa Deutsche Bank KunstHalle kwa Berlin mo ngwageng o o tlang.
tgt: Umklomelo wokutuswa usunikezwe abantu emhlabeni wonke jikelele ngezimpumelelo zabo kwezepolitiki, kwezenhlalo noma ezigabeni zobuhlakani babo.

src: Kabinete e akgola Lefapha la Bojanala ka ntlha ya go gapa moputso wa Best Public Policy/Support mo Dikgeleng tsa African Responsible Tourism Awards.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uMqondisi-Jikelele Wezemvelo uNosipho Ngcaba ngokuthola Indodo Yokuhlonishwa Impilo Yakhe Yonke yowezi-2015/16 Yokunakekela Ezemvelo eyinikwa yimagazini yezemvelo, i-The Enviropaedia.

src: Sekgele seno se newa lefapha la puso, bothati, gongwe setheo se se dirileng maitlamo a a bonalang le tshwaelo mo go tsweletseng bojanala jo bo nang le maikarabelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ishayele ihlombe iciko uKemang Wa Lehulere ngokuba "Iciko Lonyaka" lowezi-2017 elixhaswe yi-Deutsche Bank.

src: Kabinete e akgola rakolofo Branden Grace ka go gapa la ntlha PGA Tour kwa RBC Heritage kwa Hilton Head, Amerika.
tgt: UWa Lehulere, ohlola ukufaneleka kwesimo sobuciko eNingizimu Afrika yangemuva kobandlululo, uzokwethula umbukiso wakhe ehamba yedwa e-Germany e-Deutsche Bank Kunst Halle e-Berlin ngonyaka ozayo.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe botlhoko ke loso la ga Bertie Lubner yo o nnileng le tshwaelo e e bonalang mo tlhabololong ya Aforika Borwa jaaka moeteledipele wa kgwebo, moetleetsi le modulasetilo wa botshelo wa SA Jewish Board of Deputies.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uMnyango Wezokuvakasha ngokuwina umklomelo weNqubomgomo Engungqaphambili Yomphakathi/Yokweseka emncintiswaneni Wezindondo wezi-2016 Wezokuvakasha Ezinobuhlakani wase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso a a tswang kwa botennye jwa pelo kwa ditsaleng le balesika ba batswasetlhabelo ba le lesome (Tiisetso Tselo, Sesi Mtshali, Sana Sibeko, Mphikeleli Malindi, Gugulethu Sithole, Vusi Nkabinde, Daphney Linda, Sicelo Kheswa, Sphamandla Gedle le Simphiwe Nhlapo) ba kotsi ya masetlapelo ya bese fa ba ne ba tswa kwa Raling ya Kgoeletso ya Manifesto a ANC kwa Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Le ndondo inikezelwa emnyangweni womkhakha kahulumeni, isiphathimandla noma isikhungo esenze isibophezelo esicacile kanye negalelo ekuthuthukiseni ezokuvakasha ezinobuhlakani.

src: Kabinete e rometse matshediso go ba lelapa le ditsala tsa ga Ngaka Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, Moitseanape wa ntlha wa montsho wa mo mererong ya kungwiso ya peo ya pelegi mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele umdlali wegalofu u-Branden Grace ngokuwina umqudelwano wakhe wokuqala we-PGA Tour e-RBC Heritage eHilton Head, eMelika.

src: Jaaka mosimolodi wa tliliniki ya kungwiso ya peo ya pelegi kwa Sepetlele sa Park Lane kwa Johannesburg, Netshidzivhani o thusitse maAforika Borwa a le mantsi go itshimololela malapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphatheke kabi ngokudlula emhlabeni kuka-Bertie Lubner owaba namagalelo amangalisayo ekuthuthukisweni kweNingizimu Afrika njengomholi wezamabhizinisi, umuntu ophanayo kanye nosihlalo kanomphela wokuhlonishwa weNhlangano yamaJuda aseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e rometse matshediso kwa go balelapa le ditsala tsa ga Dene Smuts, Tokololo ya Palamente ya maloba ya Democratic Alliance.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo nokudabuka okukhulu kubangani kanye nemindeni yezisulu eziyishumi (uTiisetso Tselo, Sesi Mtshali, Sana Sibeko, Mphikeleli Malindi, Gugulethu Sithole, Vusi Nkabinde, Daphney Linda, Sicelo Kheswa, Sphamandla Gedle noSimphiwe Nhlapo) zengozi ebuhlungu yebhasi eyehla ngenkathi bebuya eMbuthanweni Wokuthwelwa Komqulu Wezethembiso Zokhetho we-ANC eBhayi.

src: Kabinete e akgola tshwaelo ya gagwe e e matsetseleko mo go tlhamiweng ga temokerasi ya rona ya molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yafisela labo abalimalayo ukululama okusheshayo.

src: Kabinete e ikamanya le Moporesitente Jacob Zuma mo go eleletseng Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela pholo ya ka bonako mme e ikuela gore go tlotlwe ba lelapa mo nakong eno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini kanye nakubangani bakaDkt Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, ungoti wokuqala wenzalo omnyama waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Winnie Mandela o tlotlwa thata ka ntlha ya seabe sa gagwe mo kgaratlhong ya rona ya kgololesego se se dirileng gore go fedisewe dipholisi tse di neng di gatelela batho mmogo le mo go tlisetseng Aforika Borwa temokerasi.
tgt: Njengomsunguli womtholampilo wezenzalo eSibhedlela i-Park Lane eGoli, uNetshidzivhani wasiza abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bakwazi ukuqala imindeni yabo.

src: Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson jaaka Motlhankedimogolo wa Ditšhelete wa SENTECLumko Caesario Mtimde jaaka Mokhuduthamaga wa Setheo sa Ditirelo tsa Botlhe le tsa Phitlhelelo ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini kanye nakubangani baka-Dene Smuts, iLungu Laphambilini le-Democratic Alliance ePhalamende.

src: Go thapiwa gape ga ga Moatefokate Rory Wayne Voller Jaaka Motlatsamokhomišinara wa khomišeneng ya Dithoto le Dithata tsa Ditlamo (CIPC).
tgt: IKhabhinethi imthulele isigqoko ngegalelo lakhe elihle kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwentando yeningi labantu yethu esekelwe ngumthethosisekelo.

src: Go atolosiwa ga konteraka ya ga Lungisa Fuzile jaaka Mokaedikakaretso (DG) wa Lefapha la Matlotlo a Bosetšhaba .
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye noMongameli u-Jacob Zuma ekufiseleni uMama u-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ukululama okusheshayo futhi iyacela ukuba kuhlonishwe umndeni nempilo yawo yangasese ngalesi sikhathi.

src: Go atolosiwa ga konteraka ya ga Nosipho Ngcaba jaaka Mokaedikakaretso wa Lefapha la Merero ya Tikologo.
tgt: U-Winnie Mandela uhlonishwa ezweni lonke ngegalelo lakhe emzabalazweni wethu wokulwela inkululeko owaba negalelo ekuqedweni kwezinqubomgomo zengcindezelo kanye nokulethwa kwentandoyeningi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: N Mafu jaaka Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Botsamaisi jwa Maatlafatso le Baamegi mo Lefapheng la Bagale ba Ntwa.
tgt: AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikeziwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga Manaane a Botlhokwa a Puso.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza Kwezinhlelo Zikahulumeni Ezisemqoka.

src: Kabinete e lemogile pegelo ya Tona ya Ditšhelete e a e neileng Moporesitente malebana le tswelelopele mo Patlomaikutlong ya Puso mo lephateng la poraefete le bodiri malebana le ikonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuqaphelile umbiko wokubuyisa impendulo owenziwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali kuMongameli, maqondana nenqubekelaphambili yezingxoxo zikaHulumeni nabomkhakha ozimele kanye nabasebenzi kwezomnotho.

src: Moporesitente o romile Tona go etelela pele dipuisano le balekane bano ba loago go tlhama togamaano le go tla ka dikgato tsa go godisa ikonomi le go somarela tekanyetso ya molato ya naga.
tgt: UMongameli ugunyaze uNgqongqoshe ukuba ahole izingxoxo nalaba balingani bezokuhlalisana ukuze kuhlahlwe iqhinga futhi kuqhanyukwe nezinyathelo zokukhulisa umnotho kanye nokulondoloza ukukleliswa kwezwe kwezezikweletu.

src: Kabinete e itumeletse gore tiro eno e lebitse kwa maitekong a a tsepameng a a tla tokafatsang selebo sa ikonomi ya naga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ijabulile ukuthi lo msebenzi uphethwe ngokutholakala kwezinhlelo eziqanjwe kabusha ezibambekayo ezizokwenza ngcono amathuba ezwe ezomnotho.

src: Moporesitente o itsisitse maiteko a le mmalwa a ditlapele ka Mosupologo, a a akaretsang: (1) letlole le le kopanetsweng ke lephata la poraefete le la setšhaba la Tshegetso ya Dikgwebopotlana, (2) go samagana le dikgoreletsi tsa go okediwa ga dipeeletso gore go akofisiwe kgolo e e akaretsang, (3) go beeletsa mmogo ga puso le lephata la poraefete mo mafaratlhatlheng go dirisiwa maitemogelo a Lenaane le le Ikemetseng la Tlhagiso ya Maatla le le atlegileng le (4) go maatlafatsa Dikgwebo tsa Puso go netefatsa gore di nnela le ditšhelete leruri le go maatlafatsa seabe sa tsona mo go tsamaiseng tlhabololo.
tgt: UMongameli umemezele izinhlelo eziqanjwe kabusha ezimbalwa eziseqhulwini ngoMsombuluko, ezibandakanya: (1) isikhwama esihlanganyelwe somkhakha ozimele kanye nokahulumeni Sokuxhasa Amabhizinisi Amancane, (2) ukubhekana nemigoqo evimbela ukukhushulwa kotshalomali ukuze kusheshiswe ngesivinini ukukhula okufaka konke okuphelele, (3) ukutshala izimali ngokuhlanganyela kukahulumeni nomkhakha ozimele engqalasizindeni ngokubukela kwisibonelo sempumelelo yoHlelo Labakhiqizi Abazimele Bakages kanye (4) nokuqinisa Amabhizinisi Kahulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuqina nokuzinza kwezezimali zawo kanye nokuqinisa indima yawo ekugqugquzeleni intuthuko.

src: Dikitsiso tseno ke sesupo sa se puso e ka se fitlhelelang fa balekane botlhe ba loago ba tla mmogo go direla go fitlhelela phitlhelelo e le nngwe.2 Kabinete e sa ntse e dumela gore tsolotanyo e e bogale ya matlotlo ya puso, kokoanyo ya hisetori ya R1 triilione ke Tirelo ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa le ditsereganyo tse tlhano tse di itsisitsweng fa gautshwane tsa pakakhutshwane, tsotlhe fela di tshegetsa leano la Dintlha tse Robongwe gore go netefadiwe gore go fetolwa lewa mo mererong ya ikonomi.
tgt: Lezi zimemezelo ziwubufakazi balokho leli lizwe elingakwazi ukukuzuza uma bonke abalingani bezokuhlalisana behlangana ndawonye ukuze basebenzele injongo efanayo.2 IKhabhinethi isalokhu inethemba lokuthi ukuhlanganiswa okunesankahlu kwezimali zezwe nguhulumeni, ingqophamlando yokuqoqwa kwemali eyitriliyoni yamarandi yiSikhungo Sokuqoqwa Kwezimali saseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS) kanye nemingenelelo yesikhathi esifushane eyisihlanu esanda kumenyezelwa, konke kugcwalisa Uhlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuguquka kwezinto engcebweni yethu yezomnotho.

src: Koketsego ya kokoanyo ya lekgetho ke SARS e tla kgontsha Puso go tlamela ka ditirelo tse di tla tokafatsang boleng jwa matshelo a baagi botlhe ba yona.3 Kabinete e amogela kitsiso ya setheo sa tekanyetso sa, Ditirelo tsa Peeletso tsa Moody, e mo bekeng e e fetileng e tlhomamisitseng tekanyetso ya molato ya naga go nna dinoko tse pedi fa godingwaga ga tekanyetso e e kwa tlase ga e e lekanetseng dipeeletso.
tgt: Ukuqoqwa kwezimali okukhuphukile ngu-SARS kuzophinda kwenze uHulumeni akwazi ukuhambisa izinsizakalo ezizokwenza ngcono izinga lezimpilo zazo zonke izakhamuzi zakhe.3 IKhabhinethi iyasamukela isimemezelo sesikhungo sezokuklelisa, esibizwa ngokuthi yi-Moody’s Investor Services, esiqinisekise kabusha esontweni eledlule ukukleliswa kwezwe kwezezikweletu ngamaphuzu amabili ngaphezu kwezinga lotshalomali olungaphansi.

src: Ka go tlhomamisa tekanyetso, Moody e lemogile gore Aforika Borwa o mo tseleng ya diphetogo morago ga dingwaga tsa kgolo e e bokowa mme dikgato tse di bogale tsa tsolotanyo mo tekanyetsokabong ya 2016 di tla tsepamisa molato wa puso mo GDP mo ngwageng ono.
tgt: Ngokuqinisekisa lokhu kukleliswa, i-Moody’s ikuqaphelile ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isifinyelela ekuguquleni izinto emva kweminyaka eminingi yokukhula okuntekenteke kwezomnotho kanti-ke nezinyathelo zokuhlanganiswa ezinesankahlu kwisabelomali sowezi-2016 zizozinzisa isikweletu sikahulumeni Kwisamba Somkhiqizo Wezwe (i-GDP) onyakeni esikuwona.

src: Maphata otlhe a dumelane gore go tlhokega gore go maatlafadiwe maiteko a a tlhakanetsweng go tlhotlheletsa pusetso ya ikonomi.
tgt: Zonke izinhlangothi ziyavumelana ukuthi imizamo ehlanganyelwe kudingeka iqiniswe ukufaka ugqozi ekusimameni komnotho.

src: Re lemoga gape gore tiro ya Tona ya Ditšhelete le balekane ba loago e akaretsa tiro ya tekanyetso ya molato e e tla supang diphetogo le ditsereganyo tse di ka nnang gona go somarela mebaraka e e maatla ya ditšhelete ya Aforika Borwa le tekanyetso ya molato ya peeletso.4 Moporesitente o lebogela Ditekanyetsokabo tsa Ditona tse di farologaneng tse di samaganang le ditlhokego tsa maAforika Borwa otlhe.
tgt: Siyaqaphela futhi ukuthi umsebenzi kaNgqongqoshe Wezezimali kanye nabalingani bezokuhlalisana ubandakanya ithimba labasebenzi bezokukleliswa kwezezikweletu elizohlonza izinguquko ezinokwenzeka kanye nezinyathelo zokugenelela ukuze kulondolozwe izimakethe zezimali eziqinile kanye nokukleliswa kwezezikweletu kwezinga lotshalomali.4 UMongameli uyazincoma Izinkulumo Zevoti Zezabiwomali ezenziwe ngoNgqongqoshe abahlukene ezibhekana nezidingo zabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Dipegelo tsa tswelelopele le maano a a tswang mo Ditekanyetsokabong tsa Mafapha di supa gore Aforika Borwa ke setšhaba se se semeletseng, puso e eteletse pele, go akarediwa le botshelo jo bo botoka go botlhe.
tgt: Imibiko yenqubekelaphambili kanye nezinhlelo ezisuselwa Ezinkulumweni Zevoti Zezabiwomali Zeminyango kubonisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyisizwe esiphezu komsebenzi, nalapho uhulumeni ezihola phambili, ekwakheni impilo engcono yawo wonke umuntu.

src: Go beilwe ditsamaiso tse di tsepameng go fokotsa ditlamorago tse di sa siamang tsa kwelotlase ya ikonomi ya lefatshe mo ikonoming ya rona, le go baakanyetsa kgolo e e itekanetseng fa ikonomi e tokafala.
tgt: Izinyathelo ezibambekayo sezenziwe ukunciphisa umthelela ongemuhle wokuwohloka kwamandla emali emhlabeni wonke kwezomnotho wethu, kanye nokulungiselela ukukhula ngomfutho lapho umjikelezo wezomnotho usushintsha uba muhle.

src: Re dira ka natla gape go tlosa dikgoreletsi tsa kgolo tsa selegae.
tgt: Sisebenza kanzima futhi ukususa izithiyo zokukhula ezikhona lapha ngaphakathi ezweni.

src: Ditekanyetsokabo gape di bontsha gore puso, badiri le kgwebo ba dira mmogo, go feta mo dinakong tsotlhe, go bona ditsela tsa go tsosolosa kgolo le go agela botlhe botshelo jo bo botoka.
tgt: Izinkulumo zevoti zezabiwomali ziphinde zibonise ukuthi uhulumeni, abasebenzi kanye nabamabhizinisi basebenza ndawonye, ukudlula zonke ezinye izikhathi, ukuthola izindlela zokuphemba kabusha ukukhula kanye nokwakha impilo engcono yawo wonke umuntu.

src: Seno se akaretsa go diragadiwa ga Leano la Dintlha tse Robongwe, le le itsisitsweng ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka Puo ya gagwe ya Seemo sa Setšhaba ya 2015 gammogo le Operation Phakisa, e e diretsweng go akofisa go diragadiwa ga ditharabololo mo mefameng ya botlhokwa ya tlhabololo.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqaliswa ukusebenza okunomdlandla koHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, olwamenyezelwa nguMongameli u-Jacob Zuma Enkulumweni Echaza Isimo Sezwe yowezi-2015 kanjalo ne-Operation Phakisa, eyasungulelwa ukusheshisa ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezisombululo ezindaweni ezibucayi zentuthuko.

src: Manaane ano a samagana le dintlha tsa botlhokwa go tswa mo Leanong la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo , go tshwana le go fokotsa lehuma le botlhokatiro.5 Kabinete e netefaletsa maAforika Borwa gape gore go samaganwe le seemo sa botlhokatiro sa naga ka go diragadiwa ga Leano la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo (NDP) la naga ka tsereganyo ya ikonomi ya Leano la Dintlha tse Robongwe le maikaelelo a lona e leng go tlhosetsa kgolo le go susumetsa ditiro mo maphateng a botlhokwa a ikonomi ya rona.
tgt: Lezi zinhlelo zibhekana nezinkinga ezibucayi ezivela oHlelweni Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP), ezinjengokunciphisa ubuphofu kanye nokusweleka kwamathuba omsebenzi.5 IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi isimo sezwe sokusweleka kwamathuba emisebenzi kuyabhekanwa naso ngokuqaliswa ukusebenza kwe-NDP ngokusebenzisa ukungenelela kwezomnotho koHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye okufuna ukuphemba kabusha ukukhula kanye nokuthuthukisa imisebenzi emikhakheni esemqoka yezomnotho wethu.

src: Tirisanommogo le lephata la poraefete e botlhokwa gore go nne le dipoelo tsa katlego.
tgt: Ukusebenzisana komkhakha ozimele kusemqoka ukuze kutholakale umphumela onempumelelo.

src: Puso e dirisa maiteko otlhe a a gona go akarediwa le Leano la yona la Dikgato tsa Pholisi ya Indaseteri (IPAP) go tlhama maphata a mangwe a a monyelang badiri le ditirelo go samagana le botlhokatiro jo gape bo amiwang ke seemo se se boima sa ikonomi mo lefatsheng le mo gae.
tgt: Uhulumeni usebenzisa zonke izinhlelo eziqanjwe kabusha ezikhona kubandakanya noHlelo lwakhe Lokusebenzisa Inqubomgomo Yezezimboni (i-IPAP) ukusungula imikhiqizo eminingi eqasha abasebenzi ngokugcwele futhi esebenzela imikhakha ukuze ibhekane nokusweleka kwamathuba emisebenzi okubuye kwathelelwa kabi izimo ezinzima zezomnotho zalapha ekhaya nezomhlaba wonke.

src: Tona ya Kgwebisano le Indaseteri, Rob Davies o tlhomile poeletso ya borobedi ya ngwaga le ngwaga ya IPAP 2016/17 go ya go 2018-19 ka la bo 9 Motsheganong 2016 kwa bodirelong jo bo gakolosang tshipi e e leng ya bantsho 100% kwa Gauteng.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezezimboni, u-Rob Davies wethule isibuyekezo sesishiyagalombili sonyaka se-IPAP yowezi-2016/17 kuya kowezi-2018-19 ngomhla ziyi-9 Nhlaba 2016 ngo-100% wemikhiqizo ephethwe ngabantu abamnyama kanye nendawo yokubunjwa kwensimbi eGauteng.

src: Puso e gatelela botlhokwa jwa go nna le tirisanommogo le ditlamo tsa madirelo a selegae a a boitlhamedi a seabe sa ona e seng fela mo tlhabololong ya mafarathatlha, dipalangwa le go rora dithoto, fela se ralala maphata a a farologaneng a a dirisang thekenoloji e e marara, a a siametseng thomelontle mme a dirisa badiri thata mo ikonoming ya Aforika Borwa yotlhe.
tgt: Uhulumeni ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokusungula ukusebenzisana ndawonye kanye nezinkampani zezezimboni zangaphakathi ezweni ezinobuchule ezingabandakanyiwe kuphela nje ekuthuthukisweni kwengqalasizinda, kwezokuthutha kanye nokuhanjiswa kwezimpahla, kodwa ezibandakanywe emikhakheni enhlobonhlobo yezobuchwepheshe obuphucukile, yezimpahla ezilungele ukuthengiswa emazweni angaphandle kanye negxile kubasebenzi yezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ngobubanzi.

src: Le fa Tshekatsheko ya Kotara ya Bodiri ya kotara ya ntlha ya 2016 e bontshitse koketsego ya botlhokatiro go ya go diperesente di le kotara nngwe le nngwe, seelo sa go thapiwa sa 2016 se kwa godingwana ka batho ba ba thapilweng ba le 204 000 fa go bapisiwa le kotara ya ntlha ya 20.6 Kabinete e amogela go neelwa ga Setheo sa Bašwa sa Beaufort West, kwa Kapa Bophirima ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma, se se tlamelang ka bašwa ka ditlamelo tse ba ka di dirisang go imaatlafatsa.
tgt: Nakuba Ucwaningo Lwekota Lezabasebenzi lwekota yokuqala yowezi-2016 luqophe ukukhuphuka emathubeni omsebenzi kuya kuma.7% ekota ngekota, amazinga amathuba emisebenzi ezi-2016 aphezulu ngezi-204 000 zabantu abaqashiwe uma eqhathaniswa nekota yokuqala yowezi-20.6 IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukunikezelwa Kwesilulu Sentsha sase-Beaufort West, eNtshonalanga Kapa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma, esihlinzeka ngesikhungo entsheni, lapho ingakwazi khona ukuzisimamisa.

src: Setheo se na le ditlamelo tse di farologaneng tse di nang le tlamelo tsa tlhabololo ya bašwa le baagi ka kakaretso.
tgt: Isilulu sinengxube yezikhungo ezihlinzeka ngokuthuthukiswa okuphelele kwabantu abasha kanye nomphakathi ngobubanzi.

src: Ditlamelo tse di gona mo setheong seno sa bašwa di tla tlamela bašwa ba ba tswang mo mafelong a a humanegileng ka ditšhono tsa go nna le seabe se se botoka le go tshwaela ka tsela e e siameng mo mafelong a bona mmogo le mo nageng.
tgt: Izikhungo ezitholakalayo kulesi silulu sentsha zizohlinzeka abantu abasha abavela emiphakathini ehluphekayo ngamathuba okuthi babambe iqhaza kangcono futhi babe negalelo elihle emiphakathini yabo kanye nasezweni.

src: Tikwatikwe ya Bokgoni e e nang le ditlamelo tsotlhe e e tsamaisiwang ke Kholetšhe ya Kapaborwa e tla tlamela ka katiso ya tsamaiso ya kgwebo, tiriso ya dikhomphiutara mmogo le tlhabololo ya bana ba bannye go bannileseabe ba le 200 ba Ditlhopha tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Tirelo ya Bašwa ba Metsemagae (NARYSEC) NARYSEC ke lenaane la pakatelele le le totileng fela bašwa ba metsemagae, le le ba ngokang mme le ba naya konteraka ya dingwaga tse pedi.
tgt: Isikhungo Samakhono esinazo zonke izinsiza esisetshenziswa yi-South Cape College sizohlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa ekuphathweni kwamabhizinisi, ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabantwana kusenesikhathi kubabambiqhaza abangama-200 boMbutho Kazwelonke Wemisebenzi Yentsha Yasemakhaya (i-NARYSEC) ngonyaka ngamunye.

src: Go ngokiwa le go kwadisiwa bašwa ba ba bogolo jo bo magareng ga dingwaga tse 18 le 25 mo bokgoning jo bo farologaneng jwa kitso ya tiori le ya go dira, gore ba kgone go tlhama ditiro tsa bona le ba bangwe mo mafelong a gaabo.
tgt: I-NARYSEC iwuhlelo lwesikhathi eside lapho kuhloswe khona intsha yasemakhaya kuphela, iqashwa khona bese inikwa inkontileka yeminyaka emibili.

src: Setheo seno sa Bašwa ke porojeke ya Tekeletso le ya ntlha ya mofuta wa yona, mme e tla atolosediwa kw diporofenseng tse dingwe.7 Kabinete e amogela Kopano ya Kgaolo ya Aforika ya Selekane sa Puso e e seng Bofitlha (OGP) ya 2016 e e neng e tshwerwe fa gautshwane, e e neng e amogetswe ke Aforika Borwa ka moono wa "Puso e e seng Bofitlha go ya kwa Tlhabololong e e nnelang Leruri mo Aforika" go tloga ka la bo 5 go fitlha ka la bo 6 Motsheganong 2016.Kokoano eno e tla dikgwedi di le supa morago ga gore Aforika Borwa e nne Moeteledipele wa Selekane sa Puso e e seng Bofitlha.
tgt: Intsha eneminyaka yobudala ephakathi kweyi-18 nama-25 iyaqokwa bese ibhaliselwa ukuqeqeshelwa amakhono anhlobonhlobo azoyihlomisa, ngolwazi olucatshangwayo kanye noluphathekayo, ukuze izisungulele yona amathuba emisebenzi kanye nabanye abantu emiphakathini yabo.

src: Dintlhatheo tsa puso e e seng bofitlha di botlhokwa gore go fitlhelelwe diphitlhelelo tse di farolgoaneng tsa tlhabololo e e nnelang leruri, go golaganya go sa fitlhe sepe le taolo gore go tokafadiwe ba ba mo matshosetsing le ba ba humanegileng mo lefatsheng jaaka le ikadile.
tgt: Lesi Silulu Sentsha siwumklamo Wokuzwa Amanzi Ngobhoko futhi ongowokuqala walolu hlobo, futhi uzosatshalaliswa kwezinye izifundazwe.7 IKhabhinethi iyawamukela Umhlangano Wesifunda sase-Afrika Wokubambisana Kohulumeni Okuvulekile (i-OGP) wezi-2016 owawusingethwe yiNingizimu Afrika kusukela mhla ziyi-5 kuya ziyi-6 Nhlaba 2016 ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi "Uhulumeni Ovulekile Wentuthuko Eqinile Neqhubekayo e-Afrika".Lo mbuthano uza emva kwezinyanga eziyisikhombisa emva kokuba iNingizimu Afrika yaba nguSihlalo Oholayo Wokubambisana Kohulumeni Okuvulekile.

src: Selekane sa Puso e e seng Bofitlha le Puso e e seng Bofitlha ke sekgontshi sa botlhokwa se se tla thusang baagi ba lefatshe go fitlhelela Lenaane la 2030 la Tlhabololo e e nnelang Leruri.
tgt: Imigomo kahulumeni ovulekile isemqoka ekufezekiseni izinjongo zentuthuko eqinile ezibanzi nezihlukehlukene, nezixhumanisa ukuvuleleka ekubuseni ukuze kwenziwe ngcono labo abantekenteke nabahlwempu emhlabeni wonke.

src: Samiti eno ya Kgaolo e ne e le samiti e kgolo go gaisa ya Kgaolo ya Selekane sa Puso e e seng Bofitlha (OGP) e e kileng ya rulaganngwa ke OGP mme e na le dipoelo tse di bonalang go tswa mo kopanong nngwe le nngwe mo khonferenseng.
tgt: Ukubambisana Kohulumeni Okuvulekile kanye Nohulumeni Ovulekile kuphinde kube isivumeli esisemqoka esizosiza umphakathi wasemhlabeni jikelele ukuba ufezekise i-Ajenda yowezi-2030 Yentuthuko Eqinile Neqhubekayo.

src: Go lepalepana le maitlamo a dipuso a selekane le taolo e e siameng, samiti e ngokile bannileseabe go tswa kwa Mekgatlhong e e farologaneng ya Baagi (CSO) go tswa lefatsheng ka bophara, e e tswang mo baaging go ralala maphata a a farologaneng e seng fela diCSO tse di tlwaelegileng tse di sa bolong go nna karolo ya selekane.8 Kabinete e lemoga go amogelwa ga kgolagano ya dipolante tse tharo tsa mabotlolo go dira polante e kgolo go gaisa ya kontinente, Coca-Cola Beverages Africa.
tgt: Lo Mhlangano Wezifunda ube ngumhlangano Wezifunda omkhulu kunayo yonke Wokubambisana Kohulumeni Okuvulekile (i-OGP) owake wahlelwa yi-OGP obe nemiphumela ebambekayo ebivela kwisiqubu ngasinye somhlangano kwaze kwaba inkomfa iyophela.

src: Kabinete e amogela tumelano ya dipeelo tsa dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba tsa kgolagano magareng ga puso le maphata a kgolagano a Coca-Cola Beverages Africa tse di ka tshegetsang maiteko a rona a gore go nne le kgolo ya indaseteri mo ikonoming ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ngokuhambisana nesibophezelo sohulumeni sokubambisana kanye nokuphatha okuhle, lo mhlangano uhehe ababambiqhaza abavela Ezinhlanganweni Zemiphakathi (ama-CSO) ezihlukahlukene emhlabeni wonke ezigxile nezizinze emiphakathini kuyo yonke imikhakha enhlobonhlobo engaphandle kwama-CSO ajwayelekile abehlala njalo eyingxenye yokubambisana.8 IKhabhinethi iyakuqaphela ukugunyazwa kokuhlangana kwezinkampani ezintathu zeziphuzo ezisemabhodleleni ukwakha inkampani yeziphuzo zamabhodlela enkulukazi ezwenikazi, i-Coca-Cola Beverages Africa.

src: Tumelano e sireletsa seelo sa go thapiwa mo setlamong sebaka sa dingwaga tse tharo, e sireletsa badiri mo yuniting ya dipuisanong mo diphokotsong tsa badiri tse di amanang le kgolagano, e tshegetsa go dirisiwa ga ditlamo tsa selegae mo dithekong mme e dira maitlamo a go tlhabolola balemirui le batlamedi ba ditirelo ba ba sa bolong go tlhoka ditšhono mo setlamong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamukela isivumelwano maqondana nezimo zezimfuno zomphakathi mayelana nokuhlangana phakathi kukahulumeni kanye ne-Coca-Cola Beverages Afrika okuwuhlangana kwezinhlangothi ezinkulu okungeseka imizamo yethu yokuba nezimboni ezinkulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Go feta moo, go tlamilwe R400 milione go tlamela ka matlole a tlhabololo ya dikgwebo mo thulaganyong ya tlhagiso ya temothuo le R400 milione e nngwe ya peeletso e e okediwang go tlhabolola go phasaladiwa le bokgoni jwa mabentlele ka tlhabololo e e maleba ya bokgoni le katiso.
tgt: Isivumelwano sivikela amazinga okuqashwa ngokugcwele enkampanini isikhathi esiyiminyaka emithathu, sivikela abasebenzi abasophikweni lwezingxoxo zamaholo ekudilizweni emsebenzini ngezizathu ezihlobene nokuhlangana kwezinkampani, siseka uchungechunge lokuphakelwa kwempahla lwalapha ngaphakathi ezweni futhi siyazibophezela ukuthuthukisa abalimi ababekhishwe inyumbazane ngaphambilini kanye nabaphakeli bempahla enkampanini.

src: Tumelano e bula sebaka sa ditsidifatsi tse e leng tsa gongwe tse di tlamelwang ke Coca-Cola kwa bagwebing ba bannye: go tla nna le sebaka sa setsidifatsi sa diperesente tse lesome go dirisiwa ke ditlhagiswa tsa batlhagisi ba bangwe ba bannye mo mabentleleng a a nang fela le ditsidifatsi tse di tlametsweng ke Coca-Cola.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, izigidi ezingama-400 zamarandi seziboshezelwe ukuxhasa ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi asochungechungeni lokuphakelwa kwempahla yezolimo kanti ezinye izigidi ezingama-400 zamarandi zikhuphule utshalomali ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusatshalaliswa kwempahla iya emazingeni aphansi kanye namandla amabhizinisi ahlobene nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nokuqeqesha.

src: Go tlaleletsa foo, peeletso ya setlamo ya pakatelele mo tlhabololong ya naga ya ikonomi le loago e tla tokafadiwa ka go tlhomiwa ga ntlokgolo ya setheo se se golaganeng mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Umkhiqizo oyingqayizivele we-Appletiser uzoqhubeka nokukhiqizwa eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Tumelano e latela tumelano e e tshwanang le eo ya fa gautshwane magareng ga Annhauser Beush InBev e e amanang le go rekwa ga SAB Miller.
tgt: Isivumelwano sivulela isikhala sokufaka efrijini eziqandisini eziphethwe noma eziphakelwe ngu-Coca-Cola emabhizinisini amancane: i-10% yesikhala sokufaka efrijini sizotholakala ukufaka imikhiqizo eyizimbangi evela kubakhiqizi abancane ezitolo ezinkulu lapho kuneziqandisi eziphakelwe ngu-Coca-Cola kuphela ezitholakalayo.

src: Tota, mo go gateleleng ntlha ya go thapa, go dirisa dikgwebo tsa selegae mmogo le tlhabololo ya dikgwebopotlana, ditumelano tseno di supa botlhokwa jwa go lekalekanya dikgolagano tsa ditheo le dintlha tsa kgatlhego ya setšhaba mme gape di beela ditlamo tse di akanyang ka dikgolagano tse di tshwanang le tseo seemo.9 Kabinete e lemogile go tlhomiwa ga polante ya R350 milione ya bottle-to-bottle ya Mpact Polymers ka tirisanommogo le Coca-Cola.
tgt: Lokhu kuvulela imakethe kubhizinisi amasha kanye nabakhiqizi abancane beziphuzo ezisemabhodleleni, okusiza ukugwema imisebenzi yebhizinisi enemikhawulo egcina amabhizinisi amancane naphakathi nendawo evaleleke ngaphandle kwemakethe.

src: Maiteko ano a tsibogela letlhomeso la semolao la Puso a dira ka phitlhelelo ya Togamaano ya Bosetšhaba ya Tsamaiso ya Leswe ya Merero ya Tikologo go tsweletsa dikgwebo tsa tirisopoeletso.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, utshalomali lwesikhathi eside lwenkampani ekuthuthukisweni kwezomnotho kanye nenhlalakahle yezwe luzothuthukiswa ngokusungulwa kwamahhovisi akomkhulu enkampani ehlanganisiwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Polante eno ke ya ntlha ya mofuta wa yona mo kontinenteng ya Aforika, e e faposetsang ditone (polyethylene terephthalate) PET di le 29 000 tsa mabotlolo a a leswe mme a boloka sebaka se se fopholediwang go dikhubiki metara di le 186 000 tsa dithothobolo mme e tla tshwaela mo phokotsong ya tlhagiso ya khabone taeokosaete (CO2) ka ditone tse di fopholediwang go 53 000 ka ngwaga.
tgt: Isivumelwano silandela esinye isivumelwano sakamuva esifana naso okungenwe kuso kanye ne-Annhauser Beush InBev esihlobene nokuthengwa kwe-SAB Miller.

src: Koporasitlhabololo ya Indaseteri (IDC) e tlametse ka tlamelo ya kadimo ya R210 milione gammogo le R30m mo karolong ya yona ya dišere mme Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri e abile ka tshiamelo ya lekgetho la karolo ya 12 (I).
tgt: Ngokukhethekile, ekugcizeleleni kwabo maqondana namathuba omsebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi alapha ngaphakathi ezweni kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi amancane, lezi zivumelwano zikhomba ukubaluleka kokubhalansisa ukuhlangana kwamabhizinisi kanye nezinkinga zezimfuno zomphakathi bese zibeka izinga okumele ligcinwe yizinkampani ezicabanga ukwenza ukuhlangana okufanayo noma ukuthenga ezinye izinkampani.9 IKhabhinethi ikuqaphelile ukwethulwa kwenkampani yamabhodlela ebiza izigidi ezingama-350 zamarandi yi-Mpact Polymers ngokubambisana no-Coca-Cola.

src: Polante eno ya tirisopoeletso e tlamela badiri ba le 80 ka ditiro mme gape e tlamela bakokoanyi ba matlakala ka ditiro di le 1 000.Dilekane tse di tshwanang le tseno ke enjene ya botlhokwa ya kgolo ya ikonomi, mme di tlhama ditiro di le diketekete mo ikonoming ya tirisopoeletso ya boleng jwa R50 WEBTOKEN jaana, tirisopoeletso ya dipolasitiki e le nosi e tlamela batho ba ba selang matlakala ba feta 60 000 ka ditšhono.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luphendula ohlakeni lokusebenza lezomthetho lukaHulumeni olusebenzisa injongo yeQhinga Lokuphathwa Kwemfucuza Kazwelonke Yomnyango Wezemvelo yokukhuthaza amabhizinisi okusebenzisa kabusha izinto esezisetshenzisiwe.

src: Mpact Polymers, polante ya maemo ya recycling e obamela ditlhokego tsa EU tsa go nna teng ga dijo mme ke feme ya ntlha ya mofuta wa yona mo Aforika e gape e fitlhelelang porotokholo ya tlhomamiso ya Coca-Cola ya mabotlolo a PET.10 Kabinete e amogela pegelo ya Botsamaisi jwa Togamaano ya Ditshukudu jo bo Golaganeng e e bontshitseng gore Aforika Borwa e fetotse lewa mo bogodung jwa manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Le nkampani ingeyokuqala ngqa yalolu hlobo ezwenikazi lase-Afrika eguqula amathani ayizi-29 000 (e-polyethylene terephthalate) amabhodlela asesetshenzisiwe e-PET okunesilinganiso esiqaguliwe sokonga amamitha aphindwe kathathu ayizi-186 000 endawo yokulahla udoti futhi kuzoba negalelo ekuncishisweni kwezintuthu zomoya ongcolile (i-CO2) ngamathani abalelwa ezi-53 000 ngonyaka ngamunye.

src: Fa e sale kwa tshimologong ya monongwaga fela, go tshwerwe babelwaelwa ba bogodu jwa manaka a ditshukudu ba le 206.Botsamaisi jwa Togamaano ya Ditshukudu jo bo Golaganeng bo amogetswe ke Kabinete ka Phatwe 2014, mme jwa dira gore Lephata la Tshireletso le diragatse tsereganyo ya makalamantsi, maphatamantsi go sireletsa ditshukudu mo Aforika Borwa .11 Kabinete e akgola naga ka go amogela ka katlego Tourism Indaba ya 2016 kwa Durban KwaZulu-Natal, e e khutlileng ka Mosupologo, la bo 9 Motsheganong 2016 ka dikgokagano di le mmalwa tse di atlegileng magareng ga babontshi ba ba magareng ga 1 047 go tswa kwa dinageng tse 18 tsa Aforika le bareki ba le 1 856 go tswa lefatsheng ka bophara.
tgt: Inhlangano Yokuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni (i-IDC) ihlinzeke ngemalimboleko yezigidi ezingama-210 zamarandi kanjalo nezigidi ezingama-30 zamarandi ngo-21% wayo wezokulingana kanti futhi noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni unikezele ngesigaba 12(I) somthobanhliziyo wentela.

src: Monongwanga, INDABA e amogetse dikopano di feta 3000 go feta ngogola.
tgt: Inkampani esebenzisa kabusha osekulahliwe ihlinzeka ngemisebenzi kubasebenzi abangama-80 kanye nemisebenzi eyi-1 000 kubantu abaqoqa imfucuza.

src: Gotlhegotlhe, go nnile le dikopano di le 14 000 mo malatsing a le mararo a INDABA, di tlhagisa bokgoni jwa ditshiamelo tsa ikonomi tse di bonalang.
tgt: Ukubambisana okufana nalokhu kuyinjini esemqoka yokukhula komnotho, kusungula izinkulungwane zemisebenzi emnothweni wokusebenzisa kabusha osekulahliwe onengcebo ebalelwa ezigidigidini ezingama-50 zamarandi.

src: INDABA e ne e totile dikgwebopotlana (SMME) tsa indaseteri tse di neng di bontsha ditlhagiswa le ditirelo go tswa kwa dikgwebopotlaneng tsa bojanala tse di solofetsang.
tgt: Njengamanje, ukusetshenziswa kabusha koplastiki asebelahliwe kukodwa nje kuhlinzeka ngamathuba emali engenayo kubantu ababutha imfucuza abangaphezu kwama-60 000.

src: Dikgwebo di le 70 di ungwetswe go tswa kwa diworskhopong tse di malebana le gore di ka fitlhelela jang mebaraka - gore di gole.
tgt: I-Mpact Polymers, inkampani esebenzisa kabusha osekulahliwe esezingeni lomhlaba iyahambelana nemibandela yezokuphepha kokudla ye-EU njengoba iyifektri yokuqala yalolu hlobo e-Afrika futhi iphinde ihlangabezane nomgomo wokugunyazwa ngokugcwele we-Coca-Cola wamabhodlela e-PET.10 IKhabhinethi iyawamukela umbiko wokuphendula maqondana Nokuphathwa Ngobuqhinga Obudidiyelwe Kobhejane osekukhombisile ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isinqobile ekugcineni maqondana nokuzingelwa kobhejane ngokungemthetho.

src: Go golola bokgoni jwa diSMME ke nngwe ya ditsamaisi tsa tiro tse di botlhokwa mo Leanong la Dintlha tse Robongwe tse di tla godisang le go fetola ikonomile go tlhama ditiro.
tgt: Sekukonke imihlangano yamabhizinisi eyizi-14 000 ebanjiwe ezinsukwini ezintathu ze-INDABA, eveze ithuba eliyingqayizivele lomhlomulo wezomnotho.

src: Kabinete e buisanetse go tsenngwa tirisong ga Dikatlenegiso tsa Khomišene ya Nnete le Poelano (TRC) mme ya tshitshinya ka moo Diporojeke tsa Baagi tsa Tsosoloso di ka diragadiwang ka gona.
tgt: INDABA ibigxile ekutheni osomabhizinisi bemboni abancane, abaphakathi nendawo nabakhulu (ama-SMME) babukise ngemikhiqizo yabo kanye nezinsizakalo kosomabhizinisi abancane bezokuvakasha abathembisayo.

src: Go fitlhelelwa ga Diporojeke tsa Baagi tsa Tsosoloso go baakanya go tlhoka tshiamo ga maloba ka go tsosolosa baagi ba le 128 ba ba neng ba lebanwe ke ditiro tsa tirisodikgoka le tshenyo ka paka ya kgotlhang (1 Mopitlwe 1960- 10 Motsheganong 1994).Lefapha la Bosiamisi le Tlhabololo ya Molaotheo le tla batla ditshwaelo go tswa kwa baameging ba ba maleba (ba setšhaba le ba poraefete) gore go bonwe ditlamelo tse di lekaneng go dira gore go nne le tsereganyo e e akaretsang mo baaging bano ba ba 128, ba ba supilweng ke TRC go lebeletswe kgetsi nngwe le nngwe go ya ka ditlhokego tsa yona mme seo se ka farologana ka boleng fela e ka nna boleng jwa R30 milione.
tgt: Amabhizinisi angama-70 ahlomulile emihlanganweni yokucobelelana ngolwazi maqondana nokuthi ungayifinyelela kanjani imakethe – bese uyakhula.

src: Seno se tla netefatsa gore Diporojeke di a kgonagala le gore di nnela ruri gore go fitlhelelwe dikeletso tsa baagi.
tgt: Ama-SMME anamathuba okuba ngamabhizinisi amakhulu.

src: Seno se tshwaela mo go fitlhelelweng ga Leano la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo ka go atolosa tirisanommogo le kopano ya loago, go baakanya go tlhoka tekatekano ga maloba le go fitlhelela mmuso o o tlhabololang, o le bokgoni mme o dira ka tolamo e bile o tshola baagi ba ona ka seriti.2 Kabinete e itsisitswe ka dipoelo tsa Khonferense ya Lefatshe ya Tlhaeletsano ya Diradio (WRC-15) e e neng e tshwerwe go tloga ka la bo 2 go fitlha ka la bo 27 Ngwanaitsele kwa Geneva, Switzerland.
tgt: INDABA iqinise indima ama-SMME ayidlalayo ekuthuthukisweni komnotho wamazwe asethuthukile kanye nasathuthuka, ekukhuliseni umkhakha wezokuvakasha.

src: Aforika Borwa e eteletse pele dipuisano tse di lebisitseng kwa goreng kgaolo e bone bante e nngwe ya broadband mme Aforika ya kgona go sireletsa bante e e kwa tlase ya UHF ya thelebišene ya dijitale ya lefatshe.
tgt: Ukuthukulula amathuba ama-SMME kungomunye wemibhidlango esemqoka yemisebenzi oHlelweni Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye oluzokhulisa futhi luguqule umnotho bese lusungula amathuba emisebenzi.

src: Leano la Bosetšhaba la Makhubu a Radio (NRFP) le tla ntšhwafadiwa go bontsha ditshwetso tsa WRC-15, tse di tla diragadiwang go tloga ka di01 Firikgong 2017.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idingide ukuqaliswa ukusebenza kwezincomo zeKhomishana Yamaqiniso Nokubuyisana (i-TRC) futhi yahlongoza nezindlela zokuqaliswa ukusebenza Kwemiklamo Yokuhlunyeleliswa Komphakathi.

src: Go abiwa ga bante mo NRFP go tla gokaganya maano a kabo a ditirelo tse di farologaneng tse di botlhokwa mo go fitlheleleng maungo a ikonomi, setso le loago ka tiriso ya bante jaaka tlamelo ya tlhago.
tgt: Ukufezekiswa Kwemiklamo Yokuhlunyeleliswa Komphakathi kuzolungisa ukungalingani kwasemandulo ngokuhlunyeleliswa kwemiphakathi eyi-128 eyayivuleleke ezenzweni zodlame kanye nokubhidlizwa ngesikhathi sokungqubuzana (1 Ndasa 1960 -10 Nhlaba 1994).UMnyango Wezobulungiswa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo uzocela izinkokhelo kubabambiqhaza abafanelekile (abakuhulumeni nabazimele) ukuze uzothola izinsiza ezanele zokuza nemingenelelo ephelele kule miphakathi eyi-128, ehlonzwe yi-TRC ngamunye ngamunye nokungenzeka izimo zayo zihluke ngokwenani kodwa lifinyelele enanini eliyizigidi ezingama-30 zamarandi isilinganiso esiphezulu.
