src: Puso e akgola ditheo tsa tiragatso ya molao ka go tsiboga le go tshwara badiri ba tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi le WEBTOKEN ntlheng e, Kabinete e amogela dikgato tse di bonako tse di tserweng ke Yuniti ya Kgwebisano ka Batho ya Hawks le Setlhopha sa Tsibogo sa SAPS ka go tshwara moruti wa kwa Durban ka ditatofatso tsa kgwebisano ka batho kwa Port WEBTOKEN tiro le maikarabelo a maAforika Borwa go dirisana le bothati go sireletsa basadi le bana mo dilalomeng le go netefatsa gore re dira karolo ya rona gore mafelo a rona a babalesege.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzishayela ihlombe izikhungo zokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ngendlela ezisukumela ngayo phezulu ukuze kuboshwe izigilamkhuba ezihlukumeza abesifazane nezingane.

src: Kabinete e akgola Zolani Tete ka go fenya sekgele sa boimatlhofo.
tgt: Mayelana nalokhu-ke, iKhabhinethi izishayela ihlombe izinyathelo ezisheshayo ezithathwe wuPhiko Loklebe Olulwisana Nokushushumbiswa Kwabantu kanye neThimba Elijutshwe Ukubhekana Namacala Abucayi Kakhulu njengoba bebophe umfundisi ozinze eThekwini obekwe icala lokushushumbiswa kwabantu e-Port Elizabeth.

src: Se se mmaya mo maemong a go gwetlha dijana tsa lefatshe kwa mekgatlong e mene ya mabole e megolo: Lekgotla la Mabole la Lefatshe, Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Mabole, Feterasi ya Boditšhaba ya Mabole le Mokgatlo wa Mabole wa Lefatshe (WBO).
tgt: Kungumsebenzi wabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika futhi kuyisibopho sabo ukuba basebenzisane neziphathimandla ukuvikela abesifazane nezingane zethu kubahlukumezi futhi kumele siqinisekise ukuthi sidlala indima yethu ekwenzeni imiphakathi yethu ibe ngephephile kakhulu.

src: Kabinete mmogo le Moporesitente Jacob Zuma e romela matshediso go ba lelapa le ditsala tsa mokatisi le motlhatlheledi yo o manontlhotlho wa mabole, Nick Durandt, yo a neng a itsege ka bokgoni jwa gagwe jwa go tlhagisa bommampodi ba mabole le go ntsha basimanyana mo mebileng mme a ba fetole bommampodi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela uZolani Tete ngokunqoba kwakhe isicoco sesisindo samabhantamu ngaphansi kweNhlangano Yezesibhakela Emhlabeni (i-WBO).

src: Kabinete e ne e tshwere kopano ya yona ka la bo, 10 Motsheganong 2017, kwa Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu mhla ziyi-10 kuNhlaba 2017, e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Foramo ya Ikonomi ya Lefatshe (WEF) e e ka ga Aforika.
tgt: Isithangamu Sezomnotho Emhlabeni (i-WEF) esiqondene ne-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go tshwara kopano go go atlegileng ga WEF e e ka ga Aforika ya bo 27 eo mo go yona Moporesitente Jacob Zuma a neng a eteletse pele Setlhopha sa Barongwa sa Aforika Borwa, Ditlhogo tsa Dinaga le tsa Dipuso go tswa mo kontinenteng ya Aforika, baeteledipele ba lefatshe mo diintasetering le mo dikhomeseng mmogo le baeteledipele ba setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikushayela ihlombe ukusingathwa ngempumelelo kweSithangamu Sezomnotho Emhlabeni sama-27 esiqondene ne-Afrika lapho uMongameli ebehola khona iThimba LaseNingizimu Afrika, iziNhloko Zemibuso kanye Nohulumeni abavela kwiZwekazi lase-Afrika, izinhloko zezimboni emhlabeni nabaholi bezomnotho kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi wonkana.

src: Khonferense eno e ne e tshwerwe ka moono o o reng: “Go fitlhelela kgolo e e akaretsang botlhe: boeteledipele bo bo tsibogelang e bile bo le maikarabelo”.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela yabanjwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ukufezekisa Ukukhula Komnotho Okubandakanya Abantu Bonke: Abaholi Abasabelayo futhi Abaphusile”.

src: Kopano eno ya bo 27 ya WEF e e ka ga Aforika e tota e netefaletsa lefatshe gore e santse e le karolo ya mafelo a go ka beelediwang mo go ona mo kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Lesi sigcawu sama-27 se-WEF eqondene ne-Afrika sibonise ngokucacile phambi kwamehlo omhlaba ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isalokhu iyizwe elikwizwekazi lase-Afrika elikulungele ukutshalwa kwezimali.

src: Barulaganyi ba kopano eno ba netefaleditse gore baeteledipele ba feta ba le 1 000 ba tsenela kopano eno, e leng palo e ntsi go fetisisa fa a bapisiwa le ya WEF e e ka ga Aforika e e fetileng.
tgt: Abagqugquzeli bale ngqungquthela bakuqinisekisile ukuthi beyithanyelwe yizithunywa ezingaphezu kwe-1000, okuyisibalo esiyingqophamlando uma kuqhathaniswa nesibalo sengqungquthela ye-WEF eyabanjwa phambilini.

src: Mowa o o tebileng wa tirisanommogo magareng ga puso le bagwebi mo kopanong ya WEF e e ka ga Aforika e ne e le o o itumedisang.
tgt: Umoya wobumbano oqinile phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nabamabhizinisi obonakale ngenkathi kubanjwe i-WEF bewumuhle kakhulu.

src: Dipuisano tse di tseneletseng tseno di neile Aforika Borwa tšhono ya go bontsha kgatelopele eo e e dirileng mo go kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang botlhe le go bontsha gore Aforika Borwa e buletse dikgwebo.
tgt: Izingxoxo ezinohlonze zihlinzeke izwe laseNingizimu Afrika ngethuba lokubonisa inqubekelaphambili eliyenzayo emshikashikeni wokufezekisa ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke kanye nokukhombisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikulungele noma nini ukwenza ibhizinisi.

src: Aforika Borwa e santse e semeletse mo go tsenyeng tirisong Leano la yona la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) mo go fokotseng maemo a khumanego, tlhokotekatekano le botlhokatiro.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isalokhu izibophezele ekuqhubekeni emgudwini wayo ophokophele ekuqalisweni nokusetshenziswa koHlelo lwayo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) ukuze kuncishiswe ububha, ukungalingani kanye nokuntuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Dipalangwa.
tgt: Ezokuthutha.

src: Go thankgolowa ga diterene tse dintšhwa tsa Setheo sa Banamedi ba Diterene sa Aforika Borwa (PRASA) mmogo le ditirelo tsa diterene, ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka la bo 9 Motsheganong 2017 kwa seteišeneng sa kwa Pretoria.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kwezitimela ezintsha kanye nezinsizakalo zezitimela zoPhiko Lwezitimela Ezithwala Abagibeli LwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-PRASA), nguMongameli Jacob Zuma mhla ziyisi-9 kuNhlaba 2017 eSiteshini Sezitimela sasePitoli kuyingxenye yokuzibophezela kukahulumeni okuqhubekayo okuhloswe ngakho ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinto zokuthutha umphakathi ezingambi eqolo futhi ezithembakele, kanye nokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda yezwe yezomnotho.

src: Diterene tse dintšhwa tsa motseseteropo (tseo di itsegeng ka gore ke diterene tsa batho) ke karolo ya diterene tse dintšhwa tse di tla thankgololwang ke puso mo dingwageng tse di tlang di le 10 go ya go di le 15 jaaka karolo ya Lenaane la Dintšhwafatso la PRASKe tshimologo ya tirisanommogo ya PRASA le Alstom ka tumelano e e saenilweng magareng ga Fora le Brazil.
tgt: Izitimela ezintsha ze-Metrorail (ezaziwa futhi ngokuthi yiZitimela Zabantu) ziyingxenye yohlobo lwezitimela uhulumeni azizofaka emzileni kule minyaka eyi-10 kuya kweyi-15 ezayo njengengxenye yoHlelo lwe-PRASA Lokuhlinzeka Ngezitimela Zesimanjemanje.

src: Diterene tse dintle tse dintšhwa tsa motseseteropo (tseo di itsegeng ka gore ke diterene tsa batho) di abelana ka maemo a a farologaneng a boiketlo le ditirelo, mme adi tla fetola megopolo ya banamedi ka go tsaya maeto.
tgt: Lo mklamo uzodala izinkulungwane ngezinkulungwane zamathuba omsebenzi asimeme kanye namathuba etoho, njengoba uqhubeka umsebenzi wokwakha isikhungo okuzokhiqizwa kusona izitimela e-Nigel, Ekurhuleni.

src: Ke karolo ya puso ya go tlhabolola ikonomi ka go aga mafaratlhatlha a magologadi mme e bile di bonolo go ka dirisiwa le ke batho ba ba nang le bogole.
tgt: Lesi yisiqalo sokuqaliswa kokusebenza kweSivumelwano esenziwe yileli ne-France ne-Brazil esisayindwe yi-PRASA nabakwa-Alstom.

src: Kabinete e dirile boikuelo mo maAforika Borweng go ikgantsha le go tlhokomela diterene tseno tse dintšhwa kgatlhanong le ditiragalo dipe tsa tshenyo ya thoto ya puso.
tgt: Izitimela ze-Metrorail zikanokusho ezintsha (iZitimela Zabantu) zihlinzeka abagibeli ngamazinga aphezulu kakhulu ezinsizakalo zesitimela kanye nokunethezeka, futhi zizoyiguqula indlela abagibeli abaphatheka ngayo uma behamba ngesitimela.

src: Kabinete e amogela ditsereganyo tse di atlegileng tsa Moporesitente Zuma kwa Vuwani, Limpopo.
tgt: Lezi zitimela ziyingxenye yomsebenzi owenziwa nguhulumeni ukuthuthukisa umnotho ngokuqalisa imiklamo emikhulukazi yokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda futhi zikulungele nokusetshenziswa ngabantu abanokukhubazeka.

src: Moporesitente o ne a kopana le Kgosi Toni Mphephu Ramabulana wa Vha-Venda, mmogo le bannaleseabe ba bangwe mo baaging gore go bonwe fa go ka se fitlhelelwe ditharabololo tseo ba ka di utlwanelang mo dingongoregong tseo di tlhagisitsweng.
tgt: IKhabinethi inxuse bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baziqhenye ngalezi zitimela ezintsha futhi bazivikele ekucekelweni phansi.

src: Mo kopanong go utlwanetswe gore tshitshinyo ya Kgosi ya gore Masepala wa Kgaolo wa Vhembe o tshwanetse go tlamela ka ditirelo baagi ba Vuwani fa go santse go sekwasekwa ditharabololo tse di tla nnelang ruri tse di mabapi le dintlha tsa go kgaoganngwa ga mebasepala.
tgt: UMongameli ubambe umhlangano neNgonyama yesizwe samaVenda u-Toni Mphephu Ramabulana, kanye nababambiqhaza bomphakathi ngenhloso yokuthola izisombululo zokuxazulula, ngomoya omuhle nangoxolo, izinkinga ezivezwe ngumphakathi.

src: Tharabololo e e tshitshintsweng eno e tsamaelana le molao o o leng teng ga jaana o o laolang mebasepala.
tgt: Umhlangano wasamukela isiphakamiso seNgonyama sokuba uMasipala Wesifunda saseVhembe kube yiwona ohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kubantu baseVuwani ngenkathi kusathungathwa ikhambi lesikhathi eside lokusombulula impicabadala yodaba lokuklanywa kwemingcele yomasipala.

src: Go ne gape ga swetswa ka gore mafapha a a maleba a puso ya bosetšhaba le a puso ya porofense a tshwanetse go tshegetsa masepala ono wa kgaolo mo maikarabelong ano a o sa tswang go a rwala ga jaana.
tgt: Lesi sombululo esiphakanyisiwe siyahambisana nemithetho efanelekile elawula omasipala.

src: Le fa go le jalo, kwa kopanong eno go gateletswe gore ditshwetso tse di tserweng ga di ree gore masepala o montšhwa ono (LIM 345) o a fedisiwa.
tgt: Kuphinde futhi kwathathwa nesinqumo sokuthi kumele iminyango kazwelonke neyezifundazwe efanelekile ilekelele umasipala wesifunda ukuze ukwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi omusha othweswe wona.

src: Tshwetso eno ke karolo ya maikemisetso a puso a go fitlhelela ditharabololo tse di akaretsang botlhe.
tgt: Kepha-ke, umhlangano ukugcizelelile ukuthi ukuthathwa kwalesi sinqumo akusho ukupheliswa kukamasipala omusha osunguliwe (i-LIM 345).

src: Kabinete e akgola bannaleseabe mo go gateleleng gore go tsenngwetirisong ditumelano tse di utlwanetsweng tse di tlhagisitsweng ke Kgosi.
tgt: Lesi sinqumo siyingxenye yokuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekutholeni isixazululo esibandakanya abantu bonke.

src: Moporesitente o ikanne gore o tla boa go tla go buisana le baagi ba Vuwani mme letlha leo le santse le tla utlwanelwa le Kgosi Toni Mphephu Ramabulana mmogo le bannaleseabe botlhe ba lefelo leo.
tgt: Ukufakana imilomo nokubonisana phakathi kukaMongameli nabo bonke ababambiqhaza sekuholele ekutheni kubuyele esimweni esijwayelekile ukusebenza kwezikole namabhizinisi.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo batsading le mo baaging gore ba tshegetse ditsereganyo tsa lefapha go netefatsa gore bana ba boela sekolong mme ba ithuta le go gatela pele ka tseo ba saletseng morago ka tsona ka matsholo ao a diriwang kwa dikolong tsotlhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabancoma impela ababambiqhaza ngokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa kwezivumelwano ezenziwe ngaphansi kwezingxoxo ebeziholwa yiNgonyama.

src: Ditiragalo tsa tirisodikgoka le dikgato tsa bogodu jwa dithoto le tsa go senya dithoto tsa bagwebi tseo di ntseng di tsweletse malobanyana fa kwa Coligny, Eldorado Park, le Ennerdale di nyefolwa ka bogale ke Kabinete.
tgt: UMongameli uzibophezele ekutheni uzophindela emphakathini waseVuwani lapho ezohlangana nomphakathi ngosuku olusazonqunywa emva kokubonisana nokuvumelana neNgonyama u-Toni Mphephu Ramabulana kanye nabo bonke ababambiqhaza abafanelekile bakuleya ndawo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa mo baaging go tlhagisa matshwenyego a bona ka tsela eo e batlang ditharabololo go sena tlhokego ya gore go senngwe dithoto tsa puso kgotsa go gatakaka ditshwanelo tsa baagi ba babangwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa abazali kanye nomphakathi ukuba basekele izinhlelo zokungenelela zomnyango ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi babuyela emagunjini okufundela futhi bakhathule nomsebenzi osalele emuva ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokungenelela ezihlinzekwayo njengamanje kuzo zonke izikole.

src: Mo nakong ya Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba (SoNA) ya Tlhakole 2015, Moporesitente Zuma o ne a dira boikuelo jwa gore Setlhopha sa Bosiamisi, Thibelobosenyi le Tshireletsego (JCPS) se samagane ka tshwanelo le ditshupetso tse di renang dikgoka e bile di na le tshenyo ya dithoto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa imiphakathi ukuba iyeke ukuzibandakanya ezenzweni ezinodlame, nokwesabisa kanye nokuphangwa kwempahla ezitolo namabhizinisi ngenkathi izwakalisa ukukhathazeka kwayo.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa ntlha eno gore bao ba tshelang molao ba tla kopana le dinta di fuduga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilugxeka kakhulu udlame kanye nezenzo zokuphangwa nokucekelwa phansi kwamabhizinisi okwenzeke esikhathini esifushane esedlule e-Coligny, Eldorado Park kanye nase-Ennerdale.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo bannaleseabeng botlhe gore ba buisanele dintlha tseo ba lebile gore ba di rarabolole ka bonako kwa Ennerdale, Eldorado Park le kwa Coligny.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa imiphakathi ukuba izwakalise ukukhathazeka kwayo ngendlela ehlose ukuthola izisombululo, ngaphandle ngokucekela phansi impahla nezakhiwo zomphakathi noma ukuphazamisa nokucindezela amalungelo amanye amalungu omphakathi.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go saeniwa ke Moporesitente Zuma ga Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Molao wa Dikwatikwe tsa Matlhale a Bosenyi jwa Matlole (FICA) gore e nne molao.
tgt: UMongameli wahlaba ikhwelo eNkulumweni Echaza Isimo Sezwe (i-SoNA) yowezi-2015, enxusa iQoqwana Lezobulungiswa Nokuvinjelwa Kobugebengu kanye Nokuvikeleka (i-JCPS) ukuba lithathe izinyathelo ezinqala zokubhekana nodlame kanye nemibhikisho edala umonakalo omkhulu.

src: Aforika Borwa, jaaka karolo ya lefatshe ka bophara eo e samaganeng le go lwantsha ditiragalo tse di seng mo molaong tsa matlole e tla samagana le ditsereganyo tsa boditšhabatšhaba tseo di lekang go lwantshana le dithulaganyo tse di sa lolamang tsa matlole le dithuso tsa madi a menolopuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela kuleli khwelo lokuthi labo abaphula umthetho kumele babhekane namandla aphelele engalo yomthetho.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o tla nna gape le seabe mo go natlafatseng botlhokalehunela le mo seriting sa thulaganyo ya matlole ya Aforika Borwa le go ketefaletsa basenyi bao ba tlolang melao ya go duelang lekgetho, bao ba amegang mo dithulaganyong tse di sa lolamang tsa matlole le dithulaganyo tse di seng mo molaong tsa go tila go latela melao ya thulaganyo ya matlole ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke ababambiqhaza ukuba baxoxisane futhi babonisane ngenhloso yokusombulula imibango yase-Ennerdale, Eldorado Park nase-Coligny ngokushesha.

src: Ke karolo ya didirisiwa tseo re nang le tsone mo nageng tsa go lwantsha bosenyi jwa matlole mo makaleng ka bobedi a poraefete le a puso.
tgt: Isichibiyelo Somthetho Wesikhungo Sobunhloli Bezimali (i-FICA).

src: Kabinete e ne ya tsiboswa ke Tona ya Matlole gore dipuisano di tsweletse mme di tla konosediwa go ise go e kae gore kgato ya go phasalatsa melawana e tsee kgato e e tla amang FICDitshwetso tsa Kabinete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukucikicwa kweSichibiyelo SoMthethosivivinywa Wesikhungo Sobunhloli Bezimali nguMongameli Zuma ukuze sibe ngumthetho.

src: Tona ya Matlole o ne a tsopolela Kabinete ka kopano ya mo malobeng ya Setheo sa Matlole sa Boditšhabatšhaba (IMF)/kopano ya Dikgakologo ya Banka ya Lefatshe, Dipontsho tsa Dipeeletso mmogo le WEF e e ka ga Aforika.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika, njengoba iyingxenye yamazwe womhlaba alwisana nezenzo ezingekho emthethweni eziphathelene nezezimali, nayo izohambisana nezinhlelo zokungenelela zamazwe ngamazwe okuhloswe ngazo ukulwisana nokushushumbiswa nokushintshisana ngezimali ngendlela efihlakele futhi engekho emthethweni kanye nokuxhaswa kwezenzo zobushokobezi ngezimali.

src: O ne gape a tsopolela Kabinete ka ga Kopano ya G20 ka ditshitshinyo tsa Aforika tsa go rarabolola dingongorego tsa babeeletsi le Ditheo tsa Tshekatsheko Maemo a Ikonomi.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uyalekelela futhi nasekuqiniseni ukusebenza ngokusobala kanye nobuqotho bohlelo lwezimali lwaseNingizimu Afrika futhi uzokwenza kube nzima kakhulu ezigebengwini ezibandakanyeka ezenzweni zokugwema ukukhokha intela kanye nokushushumbiswa nokushintshisana ngezimali ngendlela efihlakele futhi engekho emthethweni ukuba zizifihle ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lwezimali lwaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Go nnile le dipuisano tse di tseneletseng tse di mabapi le sebopego sa maemo a ikonomi ya mo tikologong le ya mo lefatsheng, maeo a a tikologo go tsopotswe tseo di tshwanetsweng ke go diriwa go busetsa morago tshwetso ya go folosiwa mo maemong a ikonomi.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa ungenye yamathuluzi ahlukahlukene esinawo kuleli okulwisana nobugebengu obuphathelene nezimali obenziwa yizikhulu zikahulumeni kanye nabantu abasezikhundleni eziphakeme abasebenza emkhakheni ozimele.

src: Kabinete e gateletse gore e santse e ikemiseditse go sala morago moano wa pholisi ya matlole o o tlhalositsweng mo Puong ya Tekanyetsokabo ya 2017 go tsenngwatirisong ga dipaakanyo tsa go tokafatsa puso mo Ditlamong tsa Puso (di-SOC) go se sutise maemo a a beilweng a go lekanyetsa tiriso ya madi mmogo le go netefatsa gore dikoloto tsa puso ga di tswe mo taolong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali ukuthi izingxoxo zokubonisana nokufakana imilomo ziyaqhubeka futhi zizophothulwa khona maduze nje ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqaliswa kwenqubo yokushaywa kwemithethonqubo ezoqalisa ukusebenza koMthetho we-FICIzinqumo Zekhabhinethi.

src: Lenaane la puso le le totileng go salamorago tshalelomorago e e ka ga go tsenya tirisong dipaakanyo tsa maemo a baeteledipele le ikaeletse go tlhotlhetsa kgolo ya ikonomi, jaaka e tlhalosiwa ka fa teng ga Leano la Dintlharobongwe, mme le santse le le matshwanedi go ka samagana le matshwenyego a mangwe a a tlhagisitsweng ke babeeletsi.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali wethulele iKhabhinethi umbiko mayelana nemihlangano abeyihambele esikhathini esifushane esedlule, ebandakanya imihlangano yaSentwasahlobo Yenhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezezimali (i-IMF) NeBhange Lomhlaba, neZigcawu Zokuheha Abatshalimali kanye neNgqungquthela ye-WEF eqondene ne-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo e e sa tswang go gololwa malobanyana ke ba feme ya EY Consultancy e e mabapi le Peeletso ya Dinaga tsa kwa Ntle e e Tobaneng le Aforika.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokhu uhlinzeke iKhabhinethi ngolwazi mayelana neziphakamiso zeSivumelwano esiphakathi kwe-G20 ne-Afrika kanye nezinto ezikhathaza abatshalimali neziNhlangano Ezenza Izilinganiso Zeminotho Yamazwe Omhlaba.

src: Pegelo eno e nopola Aforika Borwa jaaka lefelo le lengwe le le nang le ikonomi e kgolo le gore e mo maemong a bobedi mo Tshupaneng ya Ngokelo ya Aforika ya 2017.
tgt: Kubanjwe ingxoxo ebanzi mayelana nesimo somnotho emhlabeni kanye nesomnotho wesifunda futhi kwaxoxiswana ngokuthi yini okumele siyenze ukuze siguqule lesi simo esingaphansi kwaso njengamanje sokwehliswa kwesilinganiso somnotho wezwe, njengoba usufakwe ngaphansi kwezinga leminotho efadalalayo.

src: Kabinete gape e ne ya tlotlomadiwa ka maeto a a tla diragalang a go etelwa ke ditheo tsa ditshekatsheko tsa maemo a ikonomi a a leng ka ga go buisana le mekgatlho e le mmalwa mmogo le baeteledipele ba puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcizelelile ukuthi isalokhu izibophezele ekulandeleni umgudu wenqubomgomo yezezimali obalulwe kwiNkulumo Yesabelomali sowezi-2017, nokuqaliswa kwezinguquko zokwenza ngcono indlela okuphethwe ngayo izinkampani zombuso nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezimali akubi ngaphezu komkhawulo obekiwe wokusetshenziswa kwemali kanye nokuqinisekisa uzinzo ezikweletini zikahulumeni ukuze zingabi ngaphezu kwamandla.

src: Togamaano eno e tsibogela ditlapele tsa dimasepala tsa kgaolo ya metseselegae mmogo le diporofense, ka go samagana le tlamelo e e tlhaelang ya Mafaratlhatlha a Dipalangwa tsa Metseselegae e leng seo se thibelang tlhabololo ya ditiragalo tsa ikonomi ya loago.
tgt: Uhlelo lukahulumeni lokusheshisa ukuqaliswa kwezinguquko okuhloswe ngazo ukukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho, njengoba lokhu kuqukethwe oHlelweni Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, lusalokhu lusemqoka kakhulu ekusombululeni ezinye zezinto ezikhathaza abatshalimali.

src: Go tsenngwatirisong ga togamaano eno go tla nna le seabe mo tlhabololong ya ikonomi ya tikologo le ya porofense ka go tokafatsa phitlhelelo ya dipalangwa tsa setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela umbiko okhishwe yifemu i-EY Consultancy ophathelene noTshalomali Olungena Ngqo e-Afrika luvela Emazweni Angaphandle.

src: Seno se tla oketsa kgolagano magareng ga mafelo a kwa metseselegae le a kwa metseseteropong, ka maitlhomo a go dira gore tikologo ya metseselegae e nne karolo ya ikonomi ya naga.
tgt: Lo mbiko ubala iNingizimu Afrika njengelinye lamazwe ayizizinda zomnotho ezinkulukazi futhi ikleliswe endaweni yesibili kwiNkomba yowezi-2017 Yamazwe Akhangayo Kubatshalimali Bangaphandle.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Pholisi e e Golaganeng ya Dipalangwa tsa kwa Mawatle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilugunyazile uHlaka Olubuyekeziwe Lohlelo Lwezokuthutha Lwezindawo Zasemakhaya.

src: Yona e tlhalosa maitlhomo a puso mabapi le kgolo, tlhabololo le phetolothefosano ya lekala la Aforika Borwa la dipalangwa tsa kwa mawatle mo go tshegetseng tlhabololo ya ikonomi ya loago fa mo letlhakoreng le lengwe e tsenya letsogo mo kgwebisanong ya boditšhabatšhaba.
tgt: Lolu hlelo kuhloswe ngalo ukubhekana nezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini komasipala bezifunda kanye nasezifundazweni, ngokuthi kulungiswe inkinga yokugqoza nokungahlinzekwa kahle kweNgqalasizinda Nezinsizakalo Zokuthutha Ezindaweni Zasemakhaya, okuyinto evimbela ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho kulezi zindawo.

src: Seno se tsamaisana le ditlapele tsa puso tseo di amanang le Operation Phakisa mo go godiseng Ikonomi ya Mawatle.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwalolu hlelo kuzolekelela ekuthuthukisweni komnotho wendawo kanye nowesifundazwe ngokwenza ngcono ukutholakala kwezinto zokuthutha umphakathi.

src: Gape e tsamaisana le dipeelo tse di atolositsweng tseo maitlhomo a tsona e leng go rotloetsa kgolo ya ikonomi mmogo le go tshegetsa go tlhamiwa ga ditiro jaaka go tlhalositswe mo go NDP le mo go Leano la Mafaratlhatlha a Naga.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokhulisa ukuxhumana kwezindawo zasemadolobheni kanye nezindawo zasemakhaya, ngenhloso yokuqiniseka ukuthi izindawo zasemakhaya ziyabandakanywa emnothweni wezwe ukuze nazo zihlomule futhi zifake isandla esibonakalayo.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go phasaladiwa ga Sekwalwatlhomo sa Togamaano ya Dipalangwa tse di sa Kgotlheleng Tikologo gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo ka ga sona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyigunyazile iNqubomgomo Ebanzi Yezinto Zokuthutha Zasolwandle.

src: Dipalangwa di na le seabe se segolo mo go kgontsheng gore go nne le kgwebisano mo lefatsheng ka bophara e e siametseng go ka somarela ikonomi, loago le tikologo.
tgt: Lokhu kubonisa ngokucacile ukuzibophezela kukaHulumeni ekukhuliseni umkhakha wezinto zokuthutha zasolwandle, nokuwuthuthukisa lo mkhakha futhi kulethwe noguquko, ukuze kusekelwe ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho yabantu futhi kusenjalo kufakwe isandla kwezokuhwebelana phakathi kwamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Dithulaganyo tsa dipalangwa ke karolo ya seikokotlelo sa ditiragalo tsa ikonomi ya loago ya Aforika Borwa ka go kgontsha gore batho le dithoto tse di rekisiwanng di kgone go kgabaganya melelwane.
tgt: Lokhu kuyahambisana nezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini nguhulumeni eziphathelene nomkhankaso we-Operation Phakisa okuhloswe ngawo ukukhulisa uMnotho Wasolwandle.

src: Le fa go le jalo, semoko se se tswang mo dijanageng se na le seabe mo semokong sotlhe se se tlhodiwang ke naga (GHG), mo dipalangwa tsa mo tseleng e leng tsone tse di eteletseng pele ka semoko se sentsi.
tgt: Kuyahambelana futhi nezinjongo ezibanzi zokugqugquzela ukukhula komnotho kanye nokukhuthaza ukuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi, njengoba lokhu kubekwe ngokucacile kwi-NDP kanye Nohlelo Lwengqalasizinda Lukazwelonke.

src: Togamaano eno e senka go tlhagisa ditsela tse di ka fokotsa semoko sa GHG go ya ka melawanatheo ya tlhabololo ya leruri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa koHlaka Lohlelo Lokuqinisekisa Ukubhekelelwa Kwemvelo Kwezokuthutha ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngalo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore Aforika Borwa e nne karolo ya Smart Africa Alliance.
tgt: Ezokuthutha zidlala indima esemqoka ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ukuhwebelana namazwe omhlaba kwenzeka ngendlela ebhekelela ukusimama komnotho, nenhlalo yabantu kanye nemvelo.

src: Eno ke tirisanommogo e e etilweng pele ke Aforika mme e lebeletse go tlhagisa ditharabololo tse di matshwanedi le go abelana didirisiwa go samagana le dikgwetlho tsa tlhabololo tse di totileng kontinente.
tgt: Izinhlelo zokuthutha zingumgogodla wemisebenzi yansukuzonke ephathelene nenhlalo-mnotho eNingizimu Afrika ngoba zenza kube lula ukuthuthwa kwabantu nempahla.

src: E baya Thekenoloji ya Ditlhaeletsano le Tshedimosetso (ICT) kwa setlhoeng sa Lenaneo la Tlhabololo la 2063 la dinaga tsa Aforika.
tgt: Kodwa-ke, intuthu engcolile ekhiqizwa wumkhakha wezokuthutha inomthelela kumthamo ophelele wentuthu engcolile nesikhutha (ama-GHG) kuleli, futhi umkhakha wezokuthutha ngomgwaqo yiwona ohamba phambili kulokhu.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla unngwelwa mo maemong ka bobedi a ikonomi le a sepolotiki ka go nna le seabe mo go Smart Africa Alliance.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luhlose ukwenza iziphakamiso zokungenelela ezizonciphisa intuthu engcolile nesikhutha ngaphansi kwemigomo yentuthuko esimeme.

src: Ka go baya diintaseteri tsa Aforika Borwa mo maemong a a tla di unngwelang mmogo le kitso ya bokgoni mo lenaneong la tlhabololo la Smart Africa Alliance, Aforika Borwa e tla nna le seabe mo kgolong ya dikgwebo tsa legae mo kgaolong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukuba iNingizimu Afrika ibe yilungu le-Smart Africa Alliance.

src: Kabinete e letleletse gore go phasaladiwe Pholisi ya Naga ya Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo e e ka ga Lebolelamading (HIV), Malwetse a a Fetelanang ka Thobalano (di-STD) le Lehuba (TB).Pholisi ya ngwaga wa 1999 e tobane le tlhokomelo ya lefatshe lotlhe mmogo le dintlha tsa melemo ya tlhago ka ga thibelaketegelo, mme ga e lebelele thata sebopego, mekgwa le maitsholo a a bakang HIV.
tgt: Lolu wubambiswano oluholwa ngamazwe ase-Afrika olugxile ekuthuthukiseni izixazululo ezifanelekile kanye nokwabelana ngezinsiza ukuze kusonjululwe izinselelo ezibhekene naleli zwekazi.

src: Pholisi eno e tshitshinya gore go nne le phetogo ka fao HIV e tsewang ka teng ka fao go dirisiwang maokelo a setšhaba go samagana le HIV, mmogo le go akarediwa ga TB jaaka e nngwe ya dintlha tsa botlhokwa go samaganwa natso kwa dikolong, gareng ga mafelo a mangwe.
tgt: Ngokwenza imboni yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nolwazi nobuchwepheshe bayo obunzulu kube ngumongo we-ajenda yentuthuko ye-Smart Africa, iNingizimu Afrika izofaka isandla ekukhuliseni amabhizinisi akuleli esifundeni.

src: Seno se atologile go akaretsa le barutwana, barutabana mmogo le badiredipuso, kwa dikolong tsa puso le tseo e seng tsa puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukuphasiswa kweNqubomgomo Kazwelonke YoMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo ephathelene neGciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV), iZifo Ezithathwelana Ngokocansi (ama-STI) kanye neSifo Sofuba (i-TB).Ngowe-1999 inqubomgomo yayigxile ezinyathelweni ezisetshenziswa emhlabeni wonke jikelele zokuvimbela ukusuleleka ngegciwane, futhi ingazibhekisisi ngokwanele izimo zenhlalo nokuziphatha kwabantu ezibhebhezela i-HILe nqubomgomo iphakamisa ukuthi kube noguquko olunohlonze kwindlela okusetshenzwa ngayo, ngokuthi i-HIV ibhekwe ngasohlangothini lodaba lokuphatha olungumongo ngokusebenzisa indlela egxile empilweni yomphakathi futhi kusenjalo kubandakanywe ne-TB kulokho okuzogxilwa kukhona ezikoleni, phakathi kokunye.

src: Melaotlhomo.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywa.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go tsenngwatirisong ga Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Ditlamo tsa Difofane, 2017 mmogo le Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Ditirelo tsa Taolosephethephethe le Taolo ya Mebila Difofane gore o isiwe kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukwethulwa ePhalamende kweSichibiyelo Somthetho Wenkampani Elawula Izikhumulo Zezindiza, wezi-2017 kanye neSichibiyelo Somthetho Wokundiza Ngamabhanoyi.

src: Diphetogo tse di leng mo Melaotlhomong eno e mebedi di senka go tlamela ka Setheo sa Leruri sa Melawanataolo.
tgt: Izichibiyelo ezikule Mithethosivivinywa emibili zihlinzekela ukusungulwa koHlaka Lokulawula oluzosebenza unomphela.

src: Di senka gape le go tlamela ka ditsela tsa go tlhoma dikomiti tsa go tlhatlhela boikuelo, tseo di tla nnang le seabe mo go rarabololeng dikganetsano tse di ka runyang.
tgt: Futhi zihlinzekela nokusungulwa kwamakomidi okudluliswa kwezinqumo, azolekelela ekuxazululweni kwanoma yimuphi umbango okungezeka uqubuke.

src: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla neelana ka puo ya pulo ya 2017 ya Tourism Indaba, e e tla tshwarelwang kwa Tikwatikweng ya Kopanelo ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Inkosi Albert Luthuli kwa Durban magareng ga la bo 16 le la bo 18 Motsheganong 2017.Eno ke Indaba ya boditšhabatšhaba e e tla bontshang ditlhagisiwa le ditirelo tsa Aforika Borwa mo lekaleng la bojanala le la botlhabakgobe.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma uzokwethula inkulumo yokuvula uMbukiso Wezokuvakasha wezi-2017 ozobanjelwa e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eDurban phakathi komhla ziyi-16 nomhla ziyi-18 kuNhlaba 2017.Lo mbukiso wamazwe ngamazwe uzophinda ubukise futhi ukhangise ngemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zaseNingizimu Afrika emkhakheni wezokuvakasha kanye nokunakekelwa kwezivakashi.

src: Tourism Indaba 2017 gape e tla rotloetsa le go tshegetsa phetolothefosano e e tsweletseng mmogo le go tlhama intaseteri ya bojanala ya Aforika Borwa, go lebeletswe thata karolo ya baitshimololedi ba dikgwebo mmogo le ya beng ba WEBTOKEN Aforika Borwa, bajanala ba feta dimilione di le 10 ba jetse naga nala ka 2016, e leng palo e e oketsegileng ka 13% fa e bapisiwa le ya 2015.
tgt: Umbukiso Wezokuvakasha wezi-2017 uzogqugquzela futhi usekele noguquko oluqhubekayo njengamanje nokuthuthukiswa kwemboni yezokuvakasha yaseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi indima edlalwa ngosomabhizinisi kanye nabanikazi bamabhizinisi abancane.

src: Eno ke palo e e gaisang kgolo ya lefatshe ka bophara ya 3% mo pakeng eo.
tgt: Zingaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-10 izivakashi ezivela emazweni angaphandle ezivakashele eNingizimu Afrika ngowezi-2016, okuyisibalo esikhuphuke nge-13% uma siqhathaniswa nesowezi-2015.

src: Mo pakeng eno ya Tourism Indaba, Aforika Borwa e tla unngwelwa go tswa mo palong ya baeteledipele bao ba tla jelang naga nala.
tgt: Lokhu kungaphezulu kakhulu kwesilinganiso sokukhula kwezivakashi emhlabeni jikelele esiyi--3% kulesi sikhathi okukhulunywa ngaso.

src: Tona ya Eneji, Mme Mmamoloko Kubayi, mo kgweding eno o tla etelapele letsholo la Kgwedi ya Eneji ka moono yo o reng: “Go rotloetsa metswako ya eneji e e rekegang e bile e le e e somarelegang mo go tshegetseng phetolothefosano ya phetakapejana ya ikonomi ya loago”.
tgt: Kulesi sikhathi sokubanjwa koMbukiso Wezokuvakasha, iNingizimu Afrika izohlomula ngokufika kwezithunywa eziningi ezizotheleka ezweni lethu.

src: Letsholo leno le tla ruta, la lemosa le go buisana le baagi ka ga mosola wa eneji, tlhokomelo ya eneji, mefuta e mengwe gape ya eneji le ka fao e ka thusang malapa, dikgwebo le diintaseteri.
tgt: Kule nyanga, uNgqongqoshe Wezamandla u-Mmamoloko Kubayi uzohola umkhankaso weNyanga Yezamandla ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sigqugquzela ukusetshenziswa kwezintlobo ezahlukene zamandla kagesi ezisimeme futhi ezingambi eqolo ngenhloso yokweseka uguquko lwenhlalo-mnotho olunohlonze”.

src: Puo ya Lefapha ya Thebolo Tekanyetsokabo ya 2017 e naya lefapha tšhono ya go tsibosa Palamente mmogo le baagi ka ga tsela eo ba tla dirisang tekanyetsokabo e ba e neilweng yone mo ngwageng wa 2017.
tgt: Lo mkhankaso uzofundisa, uqwashise futhi ubonisane nomphakathi mayelana nokusebenzisa ugesi ngendlela efanele, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuleli kunogesi owanele ngaso sonke isikhathi kanye nezinye izindaba eziphathelene nogesi, nokuthi lokhu kubaluleke kangakanani ekusetshenzisweni kukagesi emakhaya, emabhizinisini kanye nasezimbonini.

src: Gape ba tla dirisa serala seno go itsise le baagi ka ga seo leano la bona le leng ka ga sona mo ngwageng ono wa matlole.
tgt: AmaVoti Ezabelomali Zeminyango Kahulumeni zowezi-2017 azobanjwa ngoNhlaba 2017 ahlinzeka ngethuba lokuba iminyango kahulumeni yethule ephalamende nasemphakathini jikelele imininingwane yokuthi izoyisebenzisa kanjani imali eyabelwe yona ngowezi-2017.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging go sekaseka dintlha tseno ka di tla bo di tlhagisiwa kwa thulaganyong ya Palamente.
tgt: Iminyango izosebenzisa lezi zethulo ukunekela umphakathi ukuthi yini equkethwe yizinhlelo zayo ngalo nyaka-mali esiwuphethe.

src: Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe le tla tshwara Beke ya Kgeleloleswe ka la bo 16 le la bo 22 Motsheganong ka moono yo o reng: “Kgeleloleswe tebang le Boitekanelo le Seriti”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa umphakathi ukuba uzifakele izibuko lezi zethulo ngenkathi zethulwa ePhalamende.

src: Seno se tla tlisetsa baagi dintlwanaboithusetso tse di dirisang metsi go gelela leswe kwa Masepaleng wa Selegae wa Nketoana, kwa Foreistata, le kwa Masepaleng wa Selegae wa Dawid Kruiper, kwa Kapa Bokone, jaaka e tla bo e le karolo ya go potlakisa ditirelo tsa go fedisa dintlwanaboithusetso tsa mesima.
tgt: UMnyango Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle uzosingatha iViki Lezokuthuthwa Kwendle phakathi komhla ziyi-16 nomhla zingama-22 kuNhlaba 2017 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ukuthuthwa Kwendle Okuqinisekisa Impilo Yabantu Nesithunzi Sabo”.

src: Aforika Borwa e keteka Kgwedi ya Aforika ka moono yo o reng: “Go Aga Aforika yo o Botoka le Lefatshe le le Botoka”.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzibophezele ekubuyiseni isithunzi sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokubahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuthuthwa kwendle.

src: Lefapha la Botsweretshi le Setso le eteletsepele ditiragalo di le mmalwa tse di tla diragadiwang tseo maitlhomo a tsona e leng go tlisa tshwaragano ya Aforika.
tgt: Into okuzogxilwa kuyona kakhulu ngaleli viki wuhlelo oluseqhulwini lokuQeda Ukuthuthwa Kwendle Ngamabhakede.

src: Ditiragalo tseno di tla tshwarwa ka la bo 25 Motsheganong 2017 moo Moporesitente Zuma tla tshwarang moletlo wa dijo tsa motshegare kwa ntlong ya baeng ba Moporesitente ya Sefako Makgatho.
tgt: Njengengxenye yokusheshisa uhlelo lokuqeda ukuthuthwa kwendle ngamabhakede kuzodluliselwa ezandleni zomphakathi ingqalasizindla yohlelo lokuthuthwa kwendle olusebenzisa amanzi, futhi imiphakathi ezohlomula kulolu hlelo wumphakathi ongaphansi kukamasipala wendawo i-Nketoana Local Municipality, eFreyistata kanye ne-Dawid Kruiper Local Municipality, eNyakatho Kapa.

src: Bao ba tla lalediwang kwa moletlong oo e tla nna baeteledipele ba mekgatlho e e emetseng batswantle bao ba nnang mo nageng ya rona ya Aforika Borwa, bao Moporesitente a kopaneng nabo mo ngwageng wa Thomelo ya aasole a Sesole sa Tshireletso ya naga ya Aforika Borwa (SANDF).
tgt: INingizimu Afrika igubha iNyanga ye-Afrika ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sakha i-Afrika Engcono kanye Nomhlaba Ongcono”.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tshwetso ya Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ya go atolosa paka ya thomelo ya masole a SANDF kwa Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC).
tgt: Kunemicimbi ehlukahlukene eqhubekayo eholwa wuMnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko okuhloswe ngayo ukugqugquzela ubumbano kuleli zwekazi lase-Afrika.

src: Ano ke maitlhomo a go nna le seabe mo go tliseng kagiso le tsetsepelo mo kontinenteng ya Aforika bogolosegolo mo tikologong go ya ka maikano a rona a boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le go ya ka dipholisi tsa rona tsa batswantle tsa go nna le seabe mo go ageng Aforika le lefatshe le le botoka.
tgt: Le micimbi izofinyelela kuvuthondaba mhla zingama-25 kuNhlaba 2017 lapho uMongameli Zuma ezosingatha khona umcimbi wesidlo sasemini endlini yezivakashi zikaMongameli i-Sefako Makgatho Presidential guesthouse.

src: Palo e le kanaka 1 371 ya ditokololo tsa SANDF di rometswe kwa DRC mo go tshegetseng Letsholo tsa Tsepamo la Mekgatlho ya Dinagakopano.
tgt: Kulesi sidlo sasemini kumenywe abaholi bezinhlangano zabantu abadabuka emazweni angaphandle asebehlala kuleli ngokugcwele futhi ngokusemthethweni uMongameli ahlangana nabo ngowezi-20.

src: Thomelo ya sesole sa rona mo kontinenteng di tshegetsa dithulaganyo tsa tikologo le tsa kontinente go tsibogelo le go rarabolola dikgotlhang, go tsholetsa kagiso le pabalesego, go tshegetsa tshwaragano ya tikologo, go matlafatsa thata kgwebisano gareng ga dinaga tsa Aforika mmogo le go atlega mo tlhabololong e e nnelang ruri ya Aforika.
tgt: Lokhu kungumzamo wokulekelela ekulethweni koxolo nozinzo kwizwekazi lase-Afrika, ikakhulukazi esifundeni sethu, ngokuhambisana nezibopho zethu zamazwe ngamazwe kanye nenqubomgomo yethu yezangaphandle yokulekelela nokufaka isandla ekuqinisekiseni i-Afrika engcono kanye nomhlaba ongcono.

src: Mo ngwageng o go ketekiwang OR Tambo ba re bontshitse matla a go go dira gore Aforika Borwa e tokafale le go dira gore re nne le naga e e tokafetseng.
tgt: Ukutshalwa kombutho wethu kuleli zwekazi kubonisa ukweseka okuqhubekayo esikuhlinzeka ezinqubweni zesifunda kanye nezezwekazi zokusukumela phezulu nokuxazulula imibango nokungqubuzana, ukugqugquzela ukuthula nokuvikeleka, ukuqinisa ukudidiyelwa kwesifunda, ukukhuphula kakhudlwana uhwebo phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika kanye nokushabashekela intuthuko esimeme e-Afrika.

src: Go phasaladiwa ga Pegelo ya bo 17 ya Khomišene ya Tekatekano mo go Thapeng ka Toya ya Lefapha la Badiri, Mme Mildred Oliphant, go bontsha phetolothefosano e e iketlileng e le ruri mo mafelong a a farologaneng a tirelo mo mebarakeng ya badiri ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabahalalisela bonke labo abahlonishwe ngezindondo eMcimbini Wezindodo Zezwe wezi-2017.

src: Pegelo eno e supa sentle fela gore re santse re le kgakala go ka fitlhelela maemo a a bontshang setšhaba sa borona mo mebarakeng ya badiri.
tgt: Kulo nyaka ka-OR Tambo laba basibonise amandla okusebenzela ukuqinisekisa iNingizimu Afrika engcono kanye nesizwe esingcono.

src: Bathobantsho, basadi le batho ba ba tshelang ka bogole ke matoditodinyana fela mo dikarolong tsotlhe tsa badiri.
tgt: Sithola ugqozi ezimpumelelweni zabo, ukuzinikela kwabo, intshisekelo yabo kanye nokulangazelela nokuzimisela ukuqhubekisela phambili isintu.

src: Pegelo eno e bontsha gore 68% ya bathobasweu ba okame diphatlhatiro tsa botsamaisibogolo mo makaleng a puso le a poraefete, e leng palo e e fetang ga rataro palo ya bao ba nang le seabe mo ikonoming.
tgt: Izindodo ezikhishiwe yilezi ezilandlelayo: i-Order of Ikhamanga yeGolide (munye) iOrder of Ikhamanga yeSiliva (bayisikhombisa) i-Order of Ikhamanga yeThusi (munye) i-Order of the Baobab yeGolide (munye) i-Order of the Baobab yeSiliva (babili), i-Order of the Baobab yeThusi (babili) i-Order of Luthuli yeSiliva (bangama-29) i-Order of Luthuli yeThusi (munye) i-Order of Mapungubwe yeSiliva (babili), kanye ne-Order of the Companions of OR Tambo yeGolide (munye).

src: Go lebeletswe tlhokego e e potlakileng ya go refosana ikonomi le go netefatsa fa kgolo ya ikonomi e le e e akaretsang botlhe, se se diragalang seno ga se itumedise le e seng.
tgt: Lo Mbiko uyakhombisa ukuthi kusekude kakhulu ngaphambi kokuba sifinyelele esimweni sokuqashwa kwabasebenzi esibonisa ukumelwa kwabo bonke abantu bezwe lethu ngendlela efanelekile.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tsiboso ya Tona ya Lefapha la Badiri ya gore lefapha la gagwe le setse le akanya gore le tsenyetiriso dikotlhao tse di bogale go bao ba sa obameleng melao eno.
tgt: Abantu abampisholo, abesifazane kanye nabantu abanokukhubazeka basalokhu bengamelwe neze kahle kuyo yonke imikhakha yokuQasha Ngokulingana Emsebenzini.

src: Kabinete e akgola Meyara wa mo malobeng wa Johannesburg, yo e leng monnasetulo wa Mokgatlho wa Dipusoselegae wa Aforika Borwa (SALGA), Parks Tau, mo go thapiweng ga gagwe jaaka motlatsamonnasetulo wa Phanele e e Ikemetseng ya Maemo a a kwa Godimo ya Dinagakopano go ela maemo tlhoko a Habitat III.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamukela isimemezelo sikaNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi sokuthi umnyango wakhe ucabanga ukuzithathela izinyathelo eziqinile lezo zikhungo ezingawuthobeli umthetho wokuqasha ngokulingana.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la bo 24 Motsheganong 2017, kwa Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu mhla zingama-24 kuNhlaba 2017, e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Kabinete e tlhobaediwa ke ditiragalo tse di tswelelang tsa tiriso e e botlhaswa le tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi mo setšhabeng sa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngokudlondlobala kwezigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane kanye nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane ezweni lakithi.

src: Ditiragalo tsa sešweng tse di amang tirisodikgoka ka bakapelo di bakile gore basadi ba digatlhamelamasisi e bile ba le sebete ba bue kgatlhanong le go gatakwa ga ditshwanelo tsa bona.
tgt: Izigameko zakamuva ezibandakanya udlame olubhebhezelwa ngamasoka abo seziholele ekutheni abesifazane abaningi abanesibindi baphumele obala bazwakalise ukukhathazeka kwabo mayelana nalokhu kwephulwa nokunyathelwa kwamalungelo abo.

src: Kabinete e amogela gore jaaka naga re tswelela go nna le setšhaba se se laolwang ke banna mme ka jalo e ikuela gore go dirwe go le gontsi go lwantsha tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi le kgwebisano ka batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuma ukuthi njengezwe sisalokhu siyizwe elilawulwa ngamadoda futhi elibeka amadoda phambili, ngokunjalo-ke inxusa ukuba kwenziwe imizamo ethe xaxa ukulwisana nesihlava sokubulawa nokushushumbiswa kwabesifazane.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go makala otlhe a setšhaba go dirisana mmogo go fenya bothata jo, go ganetsa mofuta ofe fela wa tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi le bana le go dirisana le sepodisi le tsamaiso ya bosiamisi go dira gore badiri ba ditiro tse di maswe tse ba lebagane le molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa yonke imikhakha yomphakathi ukuba ibambisane ekunqobeni lesi sihlava, ilwisane nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane, futhi isebenzisane namaphoyisa kanye nohlelo lwezobulungiswa ukuze kuboshwe futhi kugwetshwe abenzi bobubi.

src: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o ikuetse gore tiriso e e botlhaswa kgatlhanong le basadi le bana e khutle.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma usenxuse ukuba kuphele ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane okulokhu kuqhubekile njalo.

src: Kabinete e laetse Setlhopha sa Tshireletso ya Loago, Tlhabololo ya Setšhaba le Baagi go tsenya tirisong lenaane la tiro le le tla thusang naga go thibela tiriso e e botlhaswa ya basadi le bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalele iQoqwana Lezokuvikelwa Komphakathi Nokuthuthukiswa Kwabantu ukuba liqalise uhlelo lokusebenza oluzohola izwe empini yokuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: Kabinete e amogela dipoelo tsa Dipatlisiso tsa Dipalopalo le Boitekanelo tsa Aforika Borwa tsa 2016 ka Lefapha la Mananepalo la Aforika Borwa (stats SA), tse di lekanyetsang kemo ya boitekanelo ya maAforika Borwa, le phitlhelelego le boleng jwa manaane a boitekanelo.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyayithokozela imiphumela yoCwaningo lowezi-2016 Lwesimo Sempilo Nenhlalo Yabantu Abahlukahlukene BaseNingizimu Afrika olwenziwe wuPhiko Lwezezibalo eNingizimu Afrika (i-Stats SA), olucubungula futhi luhlole isimo sempilo sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, nezinga lokufinyelela kwezinhlelo zezempilo kubona kanye nekhwalithi yalezo zinhlelo.

src: Gareng ga tse dingwe, dipatlisiso tse di supa kwelotlase ya dintsho tsa masea ka 20% le kwelotlase ya 11% ya basadi le banna ba ba gogang motsoko.
tgt: Umbiko wocwaningo ubonisa ukuthi, phakathi kokunye, sehle ngama-20% isibalo sokushona kwezingane futhi lehle nge-11% inani labesifazane kanye nabesilisa ababhema ugwayi.

src: Dipoelo tse di supa gore ditsereganyo tsa pholisi tse di neng tsa tsenngwa tirisong ke boeteledipele jwa ga Moporesitente Zuma di ungwa maungo a mantle.
tgt: Le miphumela iyakhombisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo zokungenelela eziqaliswe nguhulumeni kaMongameli Zuma seziqalile ukuvuna izithelo ezinhle.

src: Le fa go le jalo, Kabinete e tlhobaediwa ke palo ya maAforika Borwa a a santseng a tswelela go robalana le balekane ba bantsi ntle le tshireletso.
tgt: Kepha-ke, iKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngesibalo sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abasalokhu beqhubeka nokuya ocansini olungaphephile nabalingani abaningi.

src: Basadi ba le 32% le banna ba le 42% ba supile fa ba ise ba ke ba dirwe diteko tsa HIV le fa tota puso e leka go dira matsholotsiboso a go dirwa diteko tsa HIV.
tgt: Abesifazane abangama-32% kanye nabesilisa abangama-42% batshele abenzi bocwaningo ukuthi bona abakaze bahlolelwe igciwane lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) nakuba uhulumeni enza imizamo yokuqwashisa ngokubaluleka kokuhlolelwa i-HIV.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go rwala maikarabelo a boitekanelo le matshelo a bona, go robalana ba dirisa tshireletso le go nna ba dirwa diteko tsa HIV le malwetse a mangwe a a tshelanwang le a a sa tshelanweng gangwe le gape.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqikelele impilo nenhlalakahle yabo, bazivikele uma beya ocansini futhi njalo baye kohlolelwa i-HIV kanye nazo zonke izifo ezithathelwanayo nezingathathelwana.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go batsadi le batlhokomedi go netefatsa gore bana ba soutisiwa kgatlhanong le malwetse a bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abazali kanye nabalondolozi bezingane ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo zigonyelwa izifo ezihlasela izingane.

src: Kabinete e tswelela ka maikemisetso a go netefatsa gore bana ba a soutisiwa go thibela malwetse a a tshelanwang e bile a le kotsi mo matshelong a bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isalokhu izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izingane ziyagonywa ngenhloso yokuqeda izifo ezithathelwanayo eziyingozi kakhulu empilweni yezingane.

src: Kabinete e netefaletsa batsadi le batlhokomedi gore diritibatsi tse di rebolwang ke Lefapha la Boitekanelo di babalesegile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuqinisekisa abazali nabalondolozi ukuthi iphephile imithi esetshenziswa nguMnyango Wezempilo ukugoma izingane zabo.

src: Kabinete e amogela kgato ya ntlha ya Madirelo a Vulindlela Heights a a tsosolositsweng kwa Mthatha kwa Kapa Botlhaba.
tgt: IKhabinethi isamukelile isigaba sokuqala sesizinda sezimboni esivuselelwe kabusha i-Vulindlela Heights Industrial esiseMthatha, eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Se ke karolo ya Lenaane la Tsosoloso ya Diphaka tsa Madirelo.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yoHlelo Lokuvuselelwa Kabusha Kwamapaki Ezimboni.

src: Ke ya bobedi ya mofuta wa yona kwa Kapa Botlhaba e bile e le nngwe ya diphaka tse thataro tse di ntšhwafadiwang go ralala naga.
tgt: Leli paki lezimboni liyisizinda sesibili salolu hlobo eMpumalanga Kapa futhi lingelinye lamapaki ezimboni ayisithupha avuselelwa kabusha njengamanje ezweni lonkana.

src: Puso e ntšhwafatsa diphaka tsa madirelo go etleetsa go tlholwa ga ditiro le go netefatsa kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang.
tgt: Uhulumeni uvuselela amapaki ezimboni ngenhloso yokukhuthaza ukuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi kanye nokuqinisekisa ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke.

src: Go fudusiwa ga ditiragalo tsa ikonomi go tswa kwa mafelong a ditoropo ke karolo ya puso ya maiteko a tlhabololo ya ikonomi.
tgt: Ukufuduswa kwemisebenzi yezomnotho isuka ezizindeni ezisemadolobheni nakho kuyingxenye yemizamo kahulumeni yokuletha uguquko lwezomnotho olunohlonze.

src: Tshedimosetso ka ga go nna le seabe mo ditšhonong tse di leng teng kwa diphakeng tsa madirelo, go fitlhelela tshegetso ya puso le mananeo a thuso, le ditšhono tsa dipeeletso mo makaleng a a farologaneng e ka bonwa mo go WEBTOKEN kgotsa ka Tikwatikwe ya Thuso ya Badirisi ya Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Madirelo (the dti) mo go 0861 843 384.
tgt: Ulwazi mayelana nokuthi abantu bangawasebenzisa kanjani amathuba akhona emapaki ezimboni akuleli futhi bafinyelele nasezinhlelweni zosizo nemihlomulo-nkuthazo ehlinzekwa nguhulumeni kanye namathuba okutshalwa kwezimali emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, luyatholakala WEBTOKEN noma eSikhungweni Sokuxhumana Namakhasimende soMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni (i-dti) ngokufonela le nombolo: 0861 843 384.

src: Kabinete e swabisitswe ke tshwetso ya General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd ya go fedisa tlhagiso le thekiso ya dirori tsa Chevrolet mo nageng e. Se se na le ditlamorago tse di sa itumediseng mo go ba ba tla latlhegelwang ke ditiro le mo ikonoming ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiphawule ngokudabuka nokukhathazeka isinqumo senkampani yezimoto i-General Motors South Africa (i-GMSA) (Pty) Ltd sokuvala umsebenzi wayo wokukhiqiza nokuthengisa izimoto zohlobo lwe-Chevrolet kuleli.

src: Puso e tswelela ka maikemisetso a yona a go tshegetsa lekala la dirori mo nageng e, le le leng botlhokwa mo ikonoming le go tlhola WEBTOKEN dti ba tswelela go dirisana le bannaleseabe botlhe go fokotsa ditlamorago tsa se.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omubi kakhulu kulabo abazophelelwa yimisebenzi yabo kanye nasemnothweni wezwe lakithi.

src: Go oketsa tlhagiso, go tlholwa ga ditiro le kgolo ya thomelontle, re sa tswa go thankgolola kgato ya borobongwe ya Leanotiro la Pholisi ya Madirelo (IPAP) go re supetsa tsela.
tgt: Uhulumeni usalokhu ezibophezele ekusekeleni umkhakha wezimoto, okuwumkhakha obaluleke kakhulu emnothweni wezwe nasekuvulweni kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Kabinete e tlhaloganya gore Isuzu, e e ntseng e le mo semphatong le GMSA dingwaga di le dintsi mo Aforika Borwa, e tla dira ditiro tse di neng di dirwa ke GMSKabinete e lemogile go etegela ga maemo a komelelo kwa Kapa Bophirima le Kapa Botlhaba.
tgt: I-dti iyaqhubeka nokusebenzisana nabo bonke abathintekayo ukunciphisa umthelela walokhu.

src: Setlhopha se se nang le batlhankedi go tswa kwa Lefapheng la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe, Komiti ya Bosetšhaba ya Taolo ya Matlhotlhapelo ka tirisano le diporofense le pusoselegae, e ntse e semeletse go netefatsa gore ditharabololo tsa pakakhutshwane go ya go tsa pakagare di a itlhaganedisiwa go netefatsa tshireletso ya tlamelo ka metsi mo diporofenseng tseno mo pakateleleng.
tgt: Ngenhloso yokukhulisa umsebenzi wokukhiqiza, ukuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi kanye nokuqinisa ukuthunyelwa kwempahla emazweni angaphandle, esikhathini esifushane esedlule sethule isigaba sesishiyagalolunye soHlelo Lokusebenza Lwenqubomgomo Yezimboni (i-IPAP) ukuze ihole izinyathelo zethu.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go akaretsa mo magaeng, dikgwebo, lekala la meepo, maatla le temothuo go dirisana mmogo go dirisa metsi ka tshomarelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuphawulile ukuthi inkampani yakwa-Isuzu, ebilokhu ibambisene nabakwa-GMSA eNingizimu Afrika kule minyaka edlule, izothatha izintambo iqhube umsebenzi obewenziwa ngabakwa-GMSIKhabhinethi isiphawulile isimo esibi kakhulu esidalwe yisomiso eNtsonalanga Kapa kanye naseMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go rebolwa ga tokomane ya dipuisano ya Togamaano Kgatlhanong le Bonweenwee, e e tla nnang mosupatsela mo Togamaanong ya Bosetšhaba Kgatlhanong le Bonweenwee.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa imiphakathi ukuba isekele imikhawulo ebekwe yizifundazwe yokusetshenziswa nokongiwa kwamanzi.

src: Kabinete e laletsa baagi go neela ditshwaelo tse di kwadilweng ka go dirisa webosaete ya Lefapha la Tiromaano,Tekolo le Tshekatsheko ya Tiro: www.
tgt: Ithimba elihlanganisa izikhulu ezivela eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle, neKomidi Likazwelonke Lokuphathwa Nokulawulwa Kwezinhlekelele, ngokusebenzisana nohulumeni bezifundazwe nabezindawo, basebenza ngokuzikhandla okukhulu ukuqinisekisa ukusheshiswa kwezixazululo zesikhathi esifushane kuya esikhathini esimaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala kwamanzi anele ezifundazweni esikhathini eside esizayo.

src: Ntwa kgatlhanong le bonweenwee ke nngwe ya dintlhakgolo mo pusong.
tgt: Impi yokulwisana nenkohlakalo isalokhu ingenye yezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini nguhulumeni.

src: Bonweenwee le maitsholo a a maswe mo makaleng a poraefete le a puso di na le ditlamorago tse di maswe mo tlhabololong ya naga ya rona.
tgt: Inkohlakalo kanye nokungasebenzi ngobuqotho emikhakheni yomibili, okungumkhakha ozimele kanye nomkhakha kahulumeni, kunomthelela omubi kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwezwe lethu.

src: Kabinete e supile fa e tshwenyegile thata ka tlhaselo ya diwebosaete go ralala lefatshe, e e runtseng go sa le gale mme e kaiwa e le yona e kgolo fa e sale.
tgt: IKhabinethi izwakalise ukukhathazeka ngesigameko sakamuva sokuhlaselwa kohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi emhlabeni jikelele, okubikwe njengesigameko esikhulu kunazo zonke kuze kube manje sokuhlaselwa kohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa go ntsha matlho dinameng ka gale fa ba dirisa ditsela tsa ileketeroniki go tlhaeletsana kgotsa go dira diphetisetso tse dingwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bathathe izinyathelo ezidingekile ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwemininingwane yabo ngenkathi bexhumana noma benza ibhizinisi ngohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi.

src: Tiriso ya dithibela-tsenelelo tsa sešweng tsa dikhomphiutha tse di lekolang tikologo ya dikhomphiutha gangwe le gape le tsona di botlhokwa.
tgt: Kunconywa futhi nokuthi abasebenzisi bohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi basebenzise uhlelo-kusebenza lwekhompyutha lwakamuva olulwisana ngokuqhubekayo namavayirasi ahlasela izinhlelo-kusebenza zamakhompyutha.

src: Kabinete gape e tlhobaediwa ke ditiragalo tsa sešweng kwa Eskom.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngezigameko zakamuva ezenzeke kwa-Eskom.

src: Kabinete e lemoga gore ntlha ya go thapiwa gape ga ga Rre Brian Molefe jaaka Motlhankedikhuduthamagamogolo (CEO) kwa Eskom e kwa kgotlatshekelo le kwa Palamenteng, ka jalo e tla ikobela ditiragalo tseo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi udaba oluphathelene nokuqashwa kabusha kukaMnu Brian Molefe njengoMphathi Omkhulu (i-CEO) wakwa-Eskom njengamanje luphambi kwezinkantolo kanye nePhalamende, ngakho-ke izozihlonipha lezo zinqubo zize ziphothulwe ngokufanelekile.

src: Le fa go le jalo, Moporesitente o tlhomile Komiti ya Ditona (IMC) e e nang le Tona ya Dikgwebo tsa Puso, ya Maatla, ya Matlotlo le Bosiamisi le ya Ditirelo tsa Kgopololo.
tgt: Kepha-ke, uMongameli usesungule iKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene (i-IMC) elihlanganisa uNgqongqoshe Wezamabhizinisi Kahulumeni, Owezamandla, Owezezimali kanye Nowezobulungiswa Nokuhlunyeleliswa Kwezimilo.

src: IMC e kopilwe go kokoanya dintlha gore di kgone go kaela Kabinete gore e ka samagana jang le merero e mo isagong.
tgt: Leli Komidi lijutshwe ukuba lenze umsebenzi wokuqoqa ulwazi namaqiniso azonikeza iKhabhinethi umhlahlandlela wokuthi kumele ibhekane kanjani nezindaba ezinjengalezi esikhathini esizayo.

src: Moeteledipele ke Tona ya Bosiamisi le Ditirelo tsa Kgopololo, Michael Masutha.
tgt: Umhlanganisi waleli komidi nguNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuhlunyeleliswa Kwezimilo, uMnu Michael Masutha.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Tumelano e e Tlhabolotsweng ya Matlafatso e e Anameng ya Bantsho mo Ikonoming ya intaseteri ya Meepo le Diminerale ya Aforika Borwa ka 2017.Tona ya Meepo Mosebenzi Zwane o tla tlamela ka pegelo fa tumelano e e sena go phasaladiwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa kukaSomqulu Obuyekeziwe wezi-2017 Wokufukulwa Nokuhlonyiswa Kwabantu Abamnyama Kwezomnotho oqondiswe embonini yeZimayini Nezimbiwa yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e mametleletse Leano la Bosetšhaba la Marang a Radio ka Lefapha la Mafaratlhatlha a Ditlhaeletsano le Ditirelo tsa Poso.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezimbiwa u-Mosebenzi Zwane uzohlinzeka ngolwazi olufanelekile uma lo somqulu usushicilelwe kusomqulu kahulumeni.

src: Go abiwa ga marang ke Khonferense ya Lefatshe ya Radiocommunication go na le seabe sa botlhokwa mo kgolong ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilugunyazile uHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusakaza Ngomoya lowezi-2017 oluvunywe yiHhovisi LikaNgqongqoshe Wezengqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi.

src: Leano la Bosetšhaba la Marang a Radio ke motswedi o o tletseng wa kabo ya marang a ditirelo tse di farologaneng tsa tlhaeletsano ka radio.
tgt: Umthamo wokusakaza ngomoya owabelwe leli lizwe eNgqungqutheleni Yomhlaba Yezokhuxhumana Ngamagagasi Omoya unomthelela omkhulu ekukhulisweni komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Leano la Bosetšhaba la Marang a Radio le le tlhabolotsweng la 2017 le netefatsa gore Aforika Borwa o nyalana le Melawana ya Boditšhaba ya Radio e e amogetsweng kwa khonferenseng ya Kopano ya Mafaratlhatlha a Ditlhaeletsano ya Boditšhaba (ITU) ka 2015.
tgt: UHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusakaza Ngomoya lowezi-2017 luwumthombo obanzi futhi ophelele wokwabelwa kwezinsizakalo zokuxhumana ngamagagasi omoya umthamo wokusakaza ngomoya.

src: Togamaano e, ka Bothati ba Pabalesego ya Mawatle a Aforika Borwa, e tlhoma maemo le go tsweletsa mekgwatsamaiso ya go letla le go rebolela dikepe dilaesense tsa go dira mo metsing a e seng a kwa mawatleng.
tgt: UHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusakaza Ngomoya olubuyekeziwe lowezi-2017 luyaqinisekisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyahambisana neMithethonqubo egunyaziwe Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezokusakaza Ngomoya eyamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kwiNgqungquthela yowezi-2015 yeNhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo.

src: Se se tla netefatsa pabalesego ya diketswana tse mo metsing a a seng kwa mawatleng mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iligunyazile iSu Lokuphepha Kwemifula Emaphakathi Nezwe.

src: Togamaano e e ikaelela go tlhola letlhomeso la taolo e e momaganeng e bile e dira sentle, e e tla netefatsang gore Aforika Borwa o fitlhelela maemo a a gaisang a boditšhaba a ditiro tsa tsamaiso ya dithoto ka tsela.
tgt: Lelisu, ngokusebenzisa uPhiko Lwezokuphepha Olwandle LwaseNingizimu Afrika, lubeka amazinga okumele athotshelwe futhi luphucula izinqubo zokuhlinzekwa ngezimvume namalayisense kwezikebhe ezisebenza emifuleni emaphakathi nezwe.

src: Dikatlenegiso mo letlhomesong le di tla netefatsa nonofo ya tiragatso, thotloetso ya pabalesego mo tseleng, fokotsa seabe mo tikologong, le go tlhola letlhomeso le le momaganeng la kgaisano e e laolwang ka boleng e mo go yona lekala la tsamaiso ya dithoto ka tsela e tla tswelelang go direla ditlhokego tsa maAforika Borwa tsa ikonomi.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuphepha kwezikebhe ezincane emifuleni yaseNingizimu Afrika emaphakathi nezwe.

src: Kabinete e amogetse ditebego tse dišwa tsa madi a segopotso le a a tla dirisiwang ka 2017 le 2018.Ka tirisano le Kabinete, motseletsele o mošwa o, o ne wa tlhongwa go supa setso, kgololesego le temokerasi ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Go keteka Aforika Borwa”.
tgt: Lelisu kuhloswe ngalo ukwakha uhlaka lokulawula nokusebenza oludidiyelwe, oluzokwenza ukuba iNingizimu Afrika ikwazi ukufinyelela emazingeni aphuma phambili emhlabeni jikelele aphathelene nomsebenzi wokuthunyelwa kwempahla ngezinto zokuthutha ezihamba emgwaqeni.

src: Ngwagakgolo wa botsalo jwa mogaka wa Kgaratlho, Oliver Reginald Tambo o ne wa tlhophiwa jaaka setlhogo sa ntlha go supiwa.
tgt: Izincomo zalelisu zizoqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa kangcono kwamazinga abekiwe, zigqugquzele ukuphepha emgwaqeni, zenze ngcono ukuvikelwa kwengqalasizinda, zinciphise umthelela ongemuhle ongakhahlameza imvelo futhi zakhe uhlaka oludidiyelwe lokuncintisana okulawulwa ngokwekhwalithi yomsebenzi oluzovumela ukuba umkhakha wokuthunyelwa kwempahla ngezinto zokuthutha ezihamba emgwaqeni ukwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi wokubhekelela nokuhlinzekela izidingo zomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Go tlhagisiwa ga ledi la tshipi le lešwa la R50 (1oz, selefera e e tsabakelang), ledi la tshipi la R500 (1oz, gauta ya 24-carat) le ledi la tshipi la R50 (metale wa motheo) go keteka ngwaga wa bo100 wa letlha la matsalo la ga OR Tambo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwagunyazile amadizayini eNkampani Ekhiqiza Izinhlamvu Zemali yaseNingizimu Afrika, owezi-2017 nowezi-2018 ezinhlamvu zemali ezizoba yisikhumbuzo kanye nalezo ezizosetshenziswa emphakathini nsukuzonke.

src: Ditebego tsa motseletsele wa madi a tshipi a a latelang a 2017 le 2018 di tlhagisitswe:a. Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa 2017: Keteko ya Ngwagakgolo wa Oliver Reginald Tambob.
tgt: Ngokubambisana neKhabhinethi, sekwakhiwe olunye uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zemali eziwuphawu olumele amasiko, inkululeko kanye nombuso wentando yeningi labantu ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sibungaza iNingizimu Afrika”.

src: Ledi le le phasaladiwang la 2017: ledi la R5 le le supang Letshwao la Tlotlo la Ditsala tsa ga OR Tamboc.
tgt: Umbungazo weminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa ingqalabutho yomzabalazo u-Oliver Reginald Tambo uqokwe njengomfanekiso wokuqala ozoboniswa kulezi zinhlamvu zemali.

src: Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa 2017 R1: Digagabi tsa Aforika Borwa - Leboloboloe.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kohlamvu olusha olungama-R50 (oluyisiliva soqobo olusinesisindo esilingana ne-awunsi elilodwa), uhlamvu olungama-R500 (olwakhiwe ngamakharethi egolide angama-24, olusinesisindo esilingana ne-awunsi elilodwa) kanye nohlamvu olungama-R50 (olwakhiwe nge-sterling silver), okuyizinhlamvu okuhloswe ngazo ukugubha iminyaka eyi-100 kwazalwa u-OR Tambo.

src: Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa 2018 Mokgatlo wa UN wa Thuto, Saense le Setso (UNESCO) Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa Motho le Tikologo: Serapa sa Waterberg sa Botshelof.
tgt: Sekwakhiwe izinhlamvu zesikhumbuzo ezilandelayo zowezi-2017 nowezi-2018:a. Uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zowezi-2017: Umgubho Yeminyaka Eyikhulu ka-Oliver Reginald Tambob.

src: Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa 2018: Setšhaba sa Thutalefatshe ya Bosetšhaba ‘Maiteko a Dikatse tse Dikgolo’ - Taug.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu olungu-R5 lowezi-2017 oluzosetshenziswa nsukuzonke emphakathini: uhlamvu olungu-R5 olubonisa i-Order of the Companions of OR Tamboc.

src: Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa 2018: Sejana sa Lefatshe sa FIFA 2018 FIFA RussiaTDitiragalo tse di tlang.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu lwe-Protea lowezi-2017: Impilo Yengqalabutho – u-Nelson Mandelad.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go tshegetsa Beke ya Tshireletso ya Bana go tloga ka la bo 28 Motsheganong go fitlha ka la bo 4 Seetebosigo ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Tlaang rotlhe re sireletse bana go isa Aforika Borwa kwa pele”.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu olungu-R1 lowezi-2017: Izilwane Ezihuquzela Ngesisu zaseNingizimu Afrika – iBululue.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa makala otlhe a baagi go dira mmogo go tlhola setšhaba se se babalesegileng e bile se itekanetse gore bana ba rona ba tshele sentle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba basekele iViki Lokuvikelwa Kwezingane kusukela mhla zingama-28 kuNhlaba kuze kube ngumhla zizi-4 kuNhlangulana, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sonke masivikele izingane ukuze siqhubekisele iNingizimu Afrika phambili”.

src: Mo ketekong ya ngwagakgolo wa ga OR Tambo, Aforika Borwa e tla bo e keteka Ngwaga wa Bašwa ka Seetebosigo 2017 ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Ngwaga wa ga OR Tambo: Go Tsweletsa Seabe sa Bašwa mo Ikonoming.”Mo kgweding e puso e tla nna le matsholo a a farologaneng a bašwa go akaretsa dipontsho, ditherisano mafelo a dikgwebo a bašwa go bontsha ditšhono tse bašwa ba ka nnnang natso le go ba rotloetsa go tsepama mo meonong ya thuto le boeteledipele ya ga OR Tambo.
tgt: Ukuvikelwa kwezingane zethu kungumthwalo wabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abazali, abalondolozi, umuntu ngamunye kanye nemiphakathi.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa bašwa botlhe go fitlhelela mananeo a a farologaneng a tshegetso le thuto a puso a a tlhagisang go tokafatsa ditšhono tsa bona le go tsweletsa seabe sa bona mo ikonoming.
tgt: Njengezwe, sinomthwalo wokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi mabangahlukunyezwa nakancane labo abangakwazi ukuzivikela ngokwabo emphakathini wethu.

src: Moporesitente Zuma ka Labone, la bo 25 Motsheganong 2017 o tla nna moamogelabaeng wa keteko ya bosetšhaba ya Letsatsi la Aforika la 2017 kwa Ntlong ya Baeng ba Moporesitente ya Sefako Makgatho kwa Pretoria.
tgt: Ngenhloso yokugubha iminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa u-OR Tambo, iNingizimu Afrika izoqopha iNyanga Yentsha ngoNhlangulana wezi-2017 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Lona Ngunyaka ka-OR Tambo: Siqhubekisela Phambili Ukubandakanywa Kwentsha Kwezomnotho.”Ngokuqhubeka kwenyanga kaNhlangulana uhulumeni uzosingatha imicimbi ehlukahlukene kubandakanya imibukiso eyenzelwe intsha, izinkulumo-mpikiswano kanye nezizinda zamabhizinisi entsha ngenhloso yokubonisa amathuba akhona enzelwe abantu abasha kanye nokubafaka ugqozi lokuba bamukele futhi bagxile kumagugu-mgomo ka-OR Tambo obuholi nemfundo.

src: Se e tla bo e le tsweletso ya ditiragalo le mananeo a a ntseng a le teng go keteka Kgwedi ya Aforika ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Ngwaga wa OR Tambo: Go Aga Aforika o o Botoka le Lefatshe le le Botoka”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabakhuthaza bonke abantu abasha ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi bayafinyelela ezinhlelweni zosizo nezemfundo ezahlukahlukene ezihlinzekwa nguhulumeni ukuze baphucule futhi baqhubekisele phambili amathuba abo okubamba iqhaza emnothweni.

src: Keteko ya ngwaga le ngwaga ya Letsatsi la Aforika le ka ga go tlhangwa ga Mokgatlo wa Tshwaraganelo ya Aforika (OAU) ka 1963.Jaaka re konosetsa Kgwedi ya Aforika, Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go dirisana le balekane ba bangwe ba Aforika ba ba nnang mo Aforika le mafelo a mangwe mo kontinenteng e go netefatsa tswelopele ya kgaolo ya rona le Aforika WEBTOKEN maikarabelo gape a botlhe ba ba nnang mo nageng ya rona, maAforika Borwa le baditšhaba go ikobela melao ya naga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abaqashi ukuba nabo balekelele emkhankasweni obizwa nge-Take a girl child to work mhla zingama-25 kuNhlaba kuya kumhla zingama-26 kuNhlaba.

src: Mmogo re tshwanetse go lwantsha kgwebo ka batho, go thopiwa le tiriso e e botlhaswa ya basadi le bana.
tgt: Inhloso yalo mkhankaso wukuhlinzeka amantombazane afunda iBanga le-10 kuya kwele-12 ngethuba lokuzibonela ngamehlo awo imisebenzi ehlukahlukene angayifundela uma esephothule isikole.

src: Kabinete e akgola setlhopha sa dingaka sa Yunibesithi ya Stellenbosch le Bookelo jwa Tygerberg Academic se se nang le Moporofesara Andre van der Merwe, Ngaka Alexander Zuhlke, Moporofesara Rafique Moosa, Ngaka Amir Zarrabi le Ngaka Zamira WEBTOKEN ne go sale gale ba dira karo ya go jalelela serwe sa bonna ya bobedi e leng se se dirang gore e nne tikwatikwe ya ntlha ya boitekanelo mo lefatsheng go ka dira karo e ka katlego lekgetlho la bobedi.
tgt: NgoLwesine mhla zingama-25 kuNhlaba 2017 uMongameli Zuma uzosingatha umgubho kazwelonke woSuku lwe-Afrika wezi-2017 endlini yezivakashi zikaMongameli i-Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse ePitoli.

src: Katlego ya tiro e mo diatleng tsa setlhopha sa jalelelo ke bopaki jwa maemo a a kwa godimo a nonofo le boitseanape a a leng teng mo lekaleng la puso la boitekanelo mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lo mgubho wuvuthondaba lwemicimbi nezinhlelo okuqoshwe ngazo iNyanga ye-Afrika ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Lona Ngunyaka ka-OR Tambo: Sakha i-Afrika Engcono Kanye Nomhlaba Ongcono”.

src: Kabinete e akgotse Phaka ya iSimangaliso Wetland ka go amogela Sekgele sa Manontlhotlho mo Boruning kwa Dikabong tsa Botswerere mo Lekaleng la Puso tsa Setheo sa Diakhaontente sa Aforika Borwa (SAICA) go sale gale mo kgweding e. Kabo e ke ya go tlotla Phaka e ka go amogela boruni jo bo senang dilabe dingwaga di le tlhano ka tatelano.
tgt: Umgubho waminyaka yonke woSuku lwe-Afrika uqopha ukusungulwa kweNhlangano Yobumbano Lwamazwe ase-Afrika (i-OAU) ngowe-1963.Njengoba sesiphothula iNyanga ye-Afrika, iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babambisane nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika abahlala eNingizimu Afrika kanye nalabo abahlala kwezinye izingxenye zaleli zwekazi ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuchuma nokuphumelela kwesifunda sethu kanye ne-Afrika yonkana.

src: iSimangaliso e ne ya goelediwa jaaka Lefelo la Ngwaoboswa la Lefatshe la ntlha mo Aforika Borwa ka Sedimonthole 1999.
tgt: Futhi kungumthwalo osemahlombe abo bonke abantu abahlala kuleli, okungabantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanjalo nabantu abavela emazweni angaphandle, ukuba bathobele imithetho yezwe.

src: Kabinete e akgola lenaane la Go Dira ka Molelo ka go amogela sefikantswe go tswa go Puso ya Alberta kwa Canada jaaka segopotso sa thuso e e tlametsweng ke lenaane le mo go laoleng melelo ya naga mo Porofenseng ya bona ka 2016.
tgt: Ngokubambisana kumele sonke silwisane nesihlava sokushushumbiswa nokuthunjwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: Kabinete e ne e tshwere kopano ya yona ka la bo, 7 Seetebosigo 2017, kwa Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu, mhla ziyi-7 kuNhlangulana 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse boikuelo jwa ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma jwa gore maAforika Borwa a tshwaragane kgatlhanong le tirisodikgoka le go bogisiwa ga basadi le bana, le go ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go tsaya dikgato ka ponyo ya leitlho tsa go fedisa setlwaedi seno mo metseng ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcizelela ikhwela elihlatshwe nguMongameli uJacob Zuma lokuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babumbane baphikisane nodlame kanye nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu besifazane kanye nezingane, futhi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bathathe izinyathelo eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqedwe lesi sihlava emiphakathini yethu.

src: Seno se latela leeto la ga Moporesitente kwa Elsies River, kwa Motsekapa, mo go tshegetseng letsholo la Imbizo la Ntwa Kgatlhanong le Bosenyi.
tgt: Lokhu kulandela ukuhambela kukaMongameli e-Elsies River eKapa ngokweseka Imbizo Yokulwisana Nobugebengu.

src: Leeto leno gape le nopotse go nna mo tlalelong ga basadi le bana mo metseng ya rona.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambela kuphinde futhi kwaqhakambisa ubuthakathaka babantu besifazane kanye nezingane ezweni lakithi.

src: Moporesitente o ne a swetsa ka gore o tla boela kwa lefelong leno go tlhotlhomisa dikgwetlho tse dintsi tsa bosenyi le dipolao, bogolosegolo mo baneng le gore boramolao ba tla tokafatsa jang ditirelo tseo ba di abelang baagi ba foo.
tgt: UMongameli uthembise ukuthi uzophinda abuyele kule ndawo ukuzobheka kabanzi izingqinamba eziningi zobugebengu kanye nokubulawa kwabantu, ikakhulukazi izingane kanye nokuthi iziphathimandla zengalo yomthetho zizoziphucula kanjani izinsizakalo zazo ezizenza emphakathini.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga pegelo ya Dipatlisiso tsa Malapakakaretso tsa 2016, e leng seo se tsweletseng go bontsha kgatelopele e e leng teng mo go tsenyeng tirisong manaane a puso mabapi le go tokafatsa matshelo a maAforika Borwa, bogolosegolo a baagi bao mo malobeng ba neng ba sa neelwe ditšhono.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukukhishwa koCwaningo Lwamakhaya Olujwayelekile lowezi-2016, oluqhubekayo nokukhombisa inqubekelaphambili ekuqalisweni ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ukwenza ngcono izimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi imiphakathi eyayikhishwe inyumbazana phambilini.

src: Dipalo di bontsha gore puso e dira go tlala seatla mo go tlameleng baagi ka dintlo, mo malapa a maAforika Borwa a nnang mo dintlong tsa ‘RDP’ kgotsa mo dintlong tseo puso e thusanang le moreki go di duelela ka dipalo tse di oketsegileng go tloga mo go 5% ka 2002 go fitlha mo go 13,5% ka 2016.Dipatlisiso tseno gape di bontsha gore manaane a thuso ya tlhokomelo ya setšhaba a oketsegile go tloga mo go 12,7% ka 2003 go fitlha mo go 29,7% ka 2016.Gape go na le koketsego e e nopotsweng mo go tlameleng ka metsi, motlakase le kgeleloleswe, e leng sengwe se se botlhokwa thata mo maitlhomong a pusong ya Aforika Borwa a go baakanya diphoso tsa puso ya tlhaolele ka go tlamela baagi botlhe ka ditlamelo tsa motheo.
tgt: Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi uhulumeni unamagalelo amahle ekuhlinzekeni ngezindlu, nalapho amakhaya abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlala ezindlini ezazakhiwe ngoHlelo Lwentuthuko Nokwakha Kabusha (i-RDP) noma ezindaweni zokuhlala ezixhaswe nguhulumeni ekhuphukile kusuka ku-5% ngowezi-2002 kuya ku-13,5% ngowezi-2016.Ucwaningo luphinde lukhombise ukuthi izinhlelo zikahulumeni zosizo lwezenhlalakahle zikhombisa ukukhuphuka kusuka ku-12,7% ngowezi-2003 kuya ku-29,7% ngowezi-2016.Kunokukhuphuka okuphawulekayo esibalweni samakhaya afakelwe amanzi, axhunyelwa ugesi nathola izinsizakalo zokuthuthwa kwemfucuza, nokuwuphawu olusemqoka logqozi nofuqufuqu lukaHulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika lokulungisa izinto ezimbi zobandlululo bese ehlinzeka ngezidingo-ngqangi kubo bonke abantu.

src: Kabinete, le fa go le jalo, e nopotse gore le fa ikwadiso kwa thutong e kgolwane e oketsega, le fa e le ka lebelo le le kwa tlase, ke bathobatsho ba le 3,3% ba ba mo magareng ga dingwaga di le 18 le 29 ba ba ithutelang pele fa go bapisiwa le 18,8% ya maIndia/maAsia mme 17,5% ke ya basweu mo bathong ba dingwaga tse di WEBTOKEN fela 3,5% ya makhalate ao a neng a ithutela pele mo ngwageng wa 2016.Dipatlisiso di bontshitse gape le phokotsego go tloga mo go 23,8% go fitlha mo go 11,8% ya malapa a a robalang ka tlala, e leng sesupo sa kgatelopele mo go samaganeng le baagi ba ba leng mo khumanegong e e tseneletseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi, nakuba kunjalo, ikuqaphelile ukuthi yize isibalo sabantu ababhalisela imfundo ephakeme sikhuphukile, nakuba sikhuphuka ngonyawo lonwabu, abantu abamnyama abangu-3,3% kuphela abaneminyaka ephakathi kweyi-18 kuya kuma-29 ubudala abafundayo uma kuqhathaniswa no-18,8% wabantu abangamaNdiya/abase-Asia kanye no-17,5% wabantu abamhlophe abakuleli qoqo leminyaka.

src: Kabinete gape e tsibogetse Dipatlisiso tsa Badiri mo Kotareng tseo di dirilweng mo kotareng ya ntlha ya ngwaga tseo di bontshitseng fa ikonomi e kgonne go tlhola gape ditiro tse dingwe di le 144 000.
tgt: Ngu-3,5% kuphela wabantu abangamakhaladi obufunda ngonyaka wezi-2016.Ucwaningo luphinde lwakhombisa ukwehla kusuka ku-23,8% kuya ku-11,8% wamakhaya abhekene nendlala, okukhombisa inqubekelaphambili ekubhekaneni nemiphakathi ephila nobubha obuseqophelweni eliphezulu.

src: Dipalo tseno di rotloeditswe ke koketsego ya batho ba le 433 000 bao ba senkang ditiro.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluqaphelile Ucwaningo Lwamakota Lwezabasebenzi lekota yokuqala yonyaka olukhombise umnotho wengeza imisebenzi eyizi-144 000.

src: Kabinete e gatelela maikemisetso a yona a go tswelela go dirisana mmogo le lekala la poraefete le mekgatlho ya badiri mo maitlhomong a yona a go samagana le dikgwetlho tsa naga tse di mabapi le botlhokatiro.
tgt: Lezi zibalo zicekelwe phansi ukukhuphuka esibalweni sabantu abafuna umsebenzi ngabantu abayizi-433 000.IKhabhinethi iyasiqinisekisa isibophezelo sayo sokuqhubeka nokusebenzisana nomkhakha ozimele kanye nabasebenzi emizamweni yayo yokubhekana nezinselele zokungabibikho komsebenzi ezweni.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go thankgololwa ya Intaseteri ya Diphaka ya Babelegi kwa Hammanskraal jaaka karolo ya puso ya go potlakisa tlhabololo ya ikonomi le go tlhola ditiro mo lefelong leo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukwethulwa kweBabelegi Industrial Park eHammanskraal njengengxenye yamacebo kahulumeni okudlondlobalisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho kanye nokusungulwa kwemisebenzi kule ndawo.

src: Porojeke eno e e jeleng R42 milione ke karolo ya puso ya Lenaane la Tsosoloso ya Mafelo a Diintaseteri mme gape ke le lengwe la mafelo ao a le marataro ao a tsosoloswang mo nageng gore a kgone go tlhabolola ikonomi ya diintaseteri.
tgt: Lo mklamo obize izigidi ezingama-42 zamarandi uyingxenye yoHlelo lukahulumeni Lokuvuselela Izizinda Zezimboni kanti futhi ungenye yezizinda eziyisithupha ezivuseleliwe ezweni lonkana ukuze kuthuthukiswe kabanzi umnotho kanye nezimboni.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa diintaseteri tsa fa gae mmogo le dikgwebo go ka fudusetsa dikgwebo tsa bone kwa mafelong ao a diintaseteri gore ba iponele ditshegetso tse di farologaneng tseo di leng teng go ka atolosetsa pele dikgwebo tsa bone.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igqugquzela izimboni zalapha ngaphakathi ezweni kanye nabamabhizinisi ukuba bacabangele ukuvula amagatsha amabhizinisi wabo ezizindeni zezimboni ukuze bathole izindlela zokwesekwa ezinhlobonhlobo ezitholakalayo ukuze bathuthukise amabhizinisi abo ngokuthe xaxa.

src: Kabinete e ne ya tsiboswa ke Tona ya Matlole, Rre Malusi Gigaba, ka tshedimosetso ya jaanong e e ka ga dipalo tsa Seelosotlhe sa Ditlhagisiwa tsa Naga mo Ngwageng (GDP) sa Aforika Borwa, seo se aparetsweng ke 0,7% mo kotareng ya ntlha ya 2017.Dipoelo tse di bokoa thata tseno tseo di neng di sa solofelwa di kwa tlase thata go gaisa tsa Tshekatsheko ya Tekanyetsokabo ya 2017, tseo di neng disolofetse kgolo ya GDP mo ngwageng wa 2017 go gola ka 1,3%.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilunywe indlebe nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, uMnu Malusi Gigaba, maqondana nezibalo zakamuva Zesamba Somkhiqizo Wezwe(i-GDP) waseNingizimu Afrika, ezinciphe ngo-0,7% ekoteni yokuqala yowezi-2017.Lo mphumela we-GDP omubi kunalokho obekulindelwe ungaphansi kakhulu kuneSibuyekezo Sesabelomali sowezi-2017, esaqagula ukukhula kwe-GDP yowezi-2017 sakubeka ku-1,3%.

src: Seno, gareng ga tse dingwe, se tlhodilwe ke go se dire sentle ga tlhagisodikuno, kgwebisano, diintaseteri tsa dijo le tsa marobalo.
tgt: Lokhu kubangelwe, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukukhwantabala kwezimboni zemikhiqizo, ukuhweba, ukupheka kanye nezindawo zokulala.

src: Le fa go le jalo, ikonomi e ne e sa tshegediwa ke kgolo mo intasetering ya meepong le ya mo mawatleng e leng e e tlhatlogileng ka 12.8%.
tgt: Umnotho nakuba kunjalo wesekwe ukukhula embonini yezimayini kanye neyokuqwalwa kwamatshe ekhuphuke ngo-12.8%.

src: Temothuo, intaseteri ya dikgwa le boreatlhapi di itharabologetswe mo kotareng ya ntlha ya 2017 ka koketsego ya 22,2%.Go na le dikgato tseo naga e ka di tsayang go thusa go tshegetsa sebopego sa kgolo ya ikonomi ya yona.
tgt: Imboni yezolimo, ezamahlathi kanye nezezinhlanzi isimamile ekoteni lokuqala lowezi-2017 ngokukhuphuka ngo-22,2%.Kunenhlansi yethemba elokozayo izwe elingabambelela kuyona ukuze lisimamise ukububeka kokukhula komnotho walo.

src: Tseno di akaretsa go tokafatsa kgolo mo lefatsheng, go somarela ditlhwatlhwa tsa dithoto, go nna le maemo a loapi a a siametseng naga, go nna le tlamelo ya motlakase e e tshepagalang le go nna le dikgogakgogano tsa badiri tse di senang tshenyo.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya ukwenza ngcono ukukhula emhlabeni wonke, ukuzinzisa amanani ezimbiwa, izimo zesimo sezulu ezivunayo, ukuphakelwa kukagesi okwethembekile kanye nokwehla kobudlelwano nabasebenzi obuntekenteke.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa mo dikgwebong, mekgatlhong ya badiri le mo setšhabeng ka botlalo go dirisana le puso mo go matlafatseng manaane a rona a kgolo ya ikonomi le mo go direng gore babeeletsi ba nne le tshepo e kgolo mo nageng ya rona gore re kgone go kgaotsa kwelotlase mme re kgone go godisa ikonomi, go fitlhelela kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang WEBTOKEN ntlheng eno, Tona ya Matlole e tla kopana le baeteledipele ba dikgwebo mo maitekong a go tlhama ditogamaano tse di tla samaganang le kwelotlase ya ikonomi le go ka fitlhelela kgolo ya ikonomi.
tgt: Njengesimo esiphuthumayo kakhulu, iKhabhinethi inxusa abamabhizinisi, abasebenzi kanye nomphakathi ngobubanzi ukuba babambisane nohulumeni ukuze kuqiniswe uhlelo lwethu lokukhula komnotho futhi kwenziwe ngcono nokuzethemba ukuze kunqandwe ukwehla komnotho futhi kubekwe umnotho esikhundleni esiphezulu, ukuze kufezekiswe ukukhula komnotho okuhlanganisa zonke izinto.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tsiboso ka botlalo ya bobegakgang e e dirilweng ke Tona ya Matlole go tsibosa maAforika Borwa ka ga dikgato tseo puso e tla di tsayang go latela letlhomeso la ga jaana la tekanyetsokabo.
tgt: Maqondana nalokhu uNgqongqoshe Wezezimali uzohlangana nabaholi bamabhizinisi embhidlangweni wokusungula amaqhinga azophikisana nokuzika komnotho bese efezekisa ukukhula komnotho okuhlanganisa zonke izinto.
