src: Samiti ya bo 15 ya BRICS mmogo le Tumelano ya Bobedi ya BRICS e e Tserweng kwa Johannesburg.1 Naga ya Aforika Borwa e ne e tshwere Samiti ya bo 15 ya BRICS mo go neng ga utlwanelwa Tumelano ya Bobedi ya BRICS e e Tserweng kwa Johannesburg.2 Kabinete e lebogile Setlhopha se se Neng se Emetse Naga ya Aforika Borwa se se neng se eteletswe pele ke Moporesitente wa Naga, Motlotlegi Cyril Matamela Ramaphosa yo a dirileng bonnete jwa gore samiti eno e tsamaya ka katlego mo tirong ya yona le mo tsamaisong ya yona.3 Moporesitente o tla ema naga ka lefoko go ba bolelela ka ga tseo di tsamaileng sentle ka ga Samiti ya bo 15 ya BRICS mmogo le ka ga merero e mengwe.
tgt: Ezisematheni INgqungquthela ye-15 ye-BRICS kanye neSimemezelo saseGoli seSibili INingizimu Afrika isingathe ngempumelelo iNgqungquthela ye-15 ye-BRICS neyamukele ingqophamlando yeSimemezelo SaseGoli seSibili.

src: Aforika Borwa e ne ya amogela Motlotlegi Moporesitente Xi Jinping wa Naga ya Rephaboliki ya Batho ba China mo Leetong la gagwe fa a ne a etetse ka fa nageng ka mabaka a tiro ka Labobedi la bo 22 Phatwe 2023, mme leeto leno le tshwerwe ka Labobedi pele ga kopano ya BRICS e ka simolola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulise ukubonga kwiThimba laseNingizimu Afrika eliholwa kuMongameli woMbuso, uMhlonishwa u-Cyril Matamela Ramaphosa oqinisekise ukuthi iNgqungquthela iyimpumelelo enkulu ezingeni lezwekazi nasekuhlelweni komcimbi wonke.

src: Mo leetong leno gape go ne ga ketekiwa le sebaka sa dingwaga di le 25 dinaga ka bobedi e ntse e le ditsala mo mererong ya botsalano jwa dinaga tsa boditšhaba.
tgt: UMongameli uzokhuluma nesizwe ngempumelelo yeNgqungquthela ye-15 ye-BRICS kanye nezinye izindaba ezibalulekile.

src: Ga jaanong Naga ya Rephaboliki ya Batho ba China ke naga e kgolo go gaisa e e gwebisanang le naga ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Uhambo Lomsebenzi lukaMongameli wase-China INingizimu Afrika isingathe uMhlonishwa, uMongameli u-Xi Jinping wase-China ngoLwesibili, mhla wama-22 kuNcwaba 2023, ngaphambi kokuqala kweNgqungquthela ye-BRICLolu Hambo Lomsebenzi luphinde lube luphawu lokubungaza iminyaka engama-25 yobudlelwano bamazwe phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-China.

src: Naga ya Rephaboliki ya Batho ba China mo nakong e e fetileng e abelane ka didirisiwa tsa motlakase go thiba phatlha fa go na le tshoganyetso tse di jang bokanaka R167 milione mme e bile gape e abelane le ka madithuso a le kanaka R500 milione go thusa go tlisa tlhabologo.
tgt: Izwe lase-China njengamanje liyizwe elikhulu elihwebelana neNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e neseditse pula Ditumelano tsotlhe tse di saenilweng mmogo le Dimemorantamo tsa go Dirisana Mmogo magareng ga puso ya naga ya Aforika Borwa mmogo le ya Naga ya Rephaboliki ya Batho ba China fa go tla mo maphateng a kgwebisano, motlakase le a ditheo tsa thuto e kgolwane.
tgt: Izwe lase-China ngokwedlule lanikela ngomshini ophehla ugesi wezimo eziphuthumayo wenani eliyizigidi eziyi-R167 laphinde lakhipha isibonelelo sezigidi ezingama-R500 zokusiza kwezentuthuko.

src: Gare ga ditumelano tse di saenilweng ke tse di ka ga Matlole a Dinaga tsa Aforika le China magareng ga Koporasi ya Tlhabololo ya Diintaseteri (IDC) le Banka ya China.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele ukusayinwa kweZivumelwano ezahlukahlukene phakathi kukahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika nezwe lase-China emikhakheni yezohwebo, owezamandla nemfundo ephakeme.

src: Matlole ano a tla thusa go fetlha dipeeletso gore di oketsege ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.6 .Kabinete e itumedisiwa gape le ke go bulelwa dikgoro tsa mebaraka ya naga ya kwa China gore maAforika Borwa a kgone go rekisetsa naga eno nama ya kgomo, mo godimo ga go bulelwa dikgoro tsa go e rekisetsa diabakhado.
tgt: Phakathi kweZivumelwano ezisayiniwe, kube ukusayinwa kwesivumelwano seSikhwama sezeNtuthuko se-China ne-Afrika phakathi kwe-IDC kanye neBhange lase-China.

src: Ditšhono tseno tsa mebaraka ya go rekisetsa dinaga tsa boditšhaba di tla kgotholela batlhagisi ba naga ya rona ditšhono, go akaretsa le bona balemirui ba rona ba bannye.
tgt: Lesi Sikhwama sizovuselela utshalomali eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Naga ya Aforika Borwa e ntse e buisana le BYD, setlamo sa dijanaga sa China seo e leng setlamo se segolo mo lefatsheg sa dijanaga tsa motlakase mme ba leka go dira gore setlamo seno se bule feme ya go aga dijanaga tseno ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela ukuvulwa futhi kwezimakethe saze-China ukuze kuzothunyelwa inyama yenkomo evela eNingizimu Afrika, ukwengeza kukwatapheya waseNingizimu Afrika othunyelwa e-China.

src: Seno ke morago ga gore setlamo sa BAIC (seo le sona e leng setlamo sa dijanaga sa China) le sona se bule feme ya go aga dijanaga ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: La mathuba okuthunyelwa kwemikhiqizo yalapha ekhaya kwamanye amazwe azovula amathuba amasha kubakhiqizi bakuleli lizwe kubandakanya nabalimi kanye nabafuyi abasafufusa.

src: Dintlha tse Dikgolo tse di ka ga Ikonomi.
tgt: Amazwibela Ezomnotho.

src: Kabinete e amogetse dipoelo tsa Pegelo ya Dipatlisiso tsa Kotara tsa Palo ya Badiri mabapi le kotara ya bobedi tseo di rebotsweng ke Lefapha la Dipalopalo la Aforika Borwa, tseo di bontsitseng palo e e wetseng kwa tlase ya batho ba ba senang ditiro mme e fokotsegile go tloga mo go 32.9% mo kotareng ya ntlha go fitlha mo go 32.6% mo kotareng ya bobedi.
tgt: Ucwaningo Lwangekota Lwezabasebenzi IKhabhinethi lamukele imiphumela yoCwaningo Lwangekota Lwezabasebenzi lwekota yesibili njengoba ikhishwe eZezibalo eNingizimu Afrika, ebonise ukwehla kancane kwezinga labantu abangasebenzi lisuka kuma-32.9% kwikota yokuqala liya kuma-32.6% kwikota yesibili.

src: Kabinete e itumedisitswe gape le ke ditiro tse dintšhwa tse di tlhodilweng mo kotareng ya bobedi tse di kanaka 154 000, mme seno se okeditse palo ya batho ba ba nang le ditiro go nna ba le milione.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde layithakasela imisebenzi emisha eyizi-154 000 eyasungulwa kwikota yesibili, lokho okwenza ukuthi inani labantu abasebenzayo liyofikelela kwizigidi eziyi-.

src: Eno e setse e le kotara ya bosupa ka go latelana ga tsona palo ya ditiro e ntse e tlhatloga ka setsopolwana ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa mme re boela gannyane gannyane kwa palong ya badiri ya pele ga leroborobo la COVID-19 ya badiri ba le milione.
tgt: Lena sekuyikota yeSikhombisa ngokulandelana inani labasebenzayo linyuka eNingizimu Afrika nokusondela kakhulu kwinani eliyizigidi eziyi-16.4 langesikhathi sangaphambi kobhubhane i-COVID-19.

src: Kabinete gape e nopotse le tse dintle mo palo ya bašwa ba ba tlhokang ditiro e fokotsegileng ka ba le 131 000 mme re bone le koketsego ka ba le 105 000 mo palong yotlhe ya bašwa ba ba dirang go dira gore e nne ba le milione.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lakubona ukusimama komnotho ngenxa yokwehla kwezibalo zentsha engasebenzi ngezi-131 000 kanye nokwenyuka ngezi-105 000 kwizibalo zentsha esebenzayo zayoba yizigidi ezi-.

src: Phetogotlhotlhwa ya Madi a Dikadimo (CPI).1Kabinete e itumedisitswe gape le ke dipegelo tsa Setheo sa Dipatlisiso tsa Dipalopalo sa Aforika Borwa (StatsSA) tse di reng CPI ya ngwaga le ngwaga e fokotsegile go fitlha mo go 4.7% ka Phukwi 2023, mme e tswa mo go 5.4% ka Seetebosigo 2023.2 Ka Phukwi 2023 maemo a phetogotlhotlhwa a ne a eme mo go 5.5% mme a tswa mo go 6.3% ka Seetebosigo 2023, fa ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe lebelo la phetogotlhotlhwa mo ditirelong le wetse kwa tlase mo go 4.0% le tswa mo go 4.5% mo go yona paka eo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela imibiko ye-StatsSA ethi Ukukhuphuka Kwamanani Abathengi kwaminyakayonke kwehlele ku-4.7% ngoNtulikazi wezi-2023, kusuka ku-5.4% ngoNhlangulana wezi-20.

src: Ka la bo 27 Phatwe 2023 Lefapha la Temothuo, Pusetsodinaga le Tlhabololo ya Metsemagae, ka go dirisana mmogo le Banka e e Thusang Balemi ba Mafatshe ka fa Nageng, ba thankgolotse letsholo la matlole a le kanaka R1,21 bilione la Matlole a go Tlamela Temothuo le Tlhagiso ya Motlakase go Ema Nokeng Balemirui le Dikgwebo tsa Temothuo gore ba kgone go itsenyetsa didirisiwa tse dingwe tse di ka ba thusang ka motlakase gore ba se iphitlhelel ba palelwa ke go tlhagisa dijo le dino.
tgt: Izinga lokwenyuka kwamanani kwaminyakayonke ezimpahla belingu-5.5% ngoNtulikazi wezi-2023, kanti izinga lokwenyuka kwamanani ezinsizakalo belingu-4.0% nelehle lisuka ku-4.5% esikhathini esifanayo.

src: Lekala leno ke le lengwe la makala a a dirisang motlakase o montsi e bile le botlhokwa mo go direng gore naga ya Aforika Borwa e se felelwe ke dijo, e kgone go iponela letseno la go rekisetsa dinaga tsa kwa ntle mmogo le go tlhola ditiro, mme seno ke sona se se dirang gore go nne botlhokwa gore puso e thuse gore maemo a ritibale.
tgt: ISikhwama Sezolimo Nezamandla sokusiza ezolimo namabhizinisi ahlobene nezolimo.

src: Matlole ano a buletswe go thusa dikgwebo tsotlhe go sa kgathalesege bonnye kgotsa bogolo jwa tsona ka Dithuso tse di Farologaneng tsa Matlole, mme Banka e e Thusang Balemi ba Mafatshe ka fa Nageng ke yona e e tla laolang Matlole ano.
tgt: Mhla wama-27 kuNcwaba 2023, uMnyango Wezolimo, Izinguquko Zomhlaba nokuThuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya ngokusebenza ngokubambisana ne-Land Bank, bethula iSikhwama Sezolimo Nezamandla sezigidigidi ezi-R.21 sokusiza umkhakha wezolimo nowamabhizinisi ahlobene nezolimo ukuthi bakwazi ukufaka ezinye izindlela zokuphehla ugesi futhi baqhubeke nokukhiqiza ukudla, i-fibre kanye neziphuzo.

src: Matlole ano a tla tshegetsa gape le ditiro totlhe tsa temothuo le tsa dikgwebo tsa temothuo tse di tsamaisanang le tiriso e ntsi ya motlakase.
tgt: Lo mkhakha ungomunye wabasebenzisa ugesi kakhulu futhi ubalulekile ekuletheni uzinzo ekutholakaleni kokudla eNingizimu Afrika, ukwenza inzuzo ngokuthunyelwa kwemikhiqizo kwamanye amazwe nokusungulwa kwemisebenzi, lokho okwenza ukuthi lokhu kungenelela kukahulumeni kubaluleke kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukusimama.

src: Mo pakeng eno ya Letlhomeso la Tirisomatlole ya Pakagare (MTEF) Setheo sa Bosekisi jwa Naga se kgonne go busetsa madi a le kanaka R.2 bilione mme mo go ona matlole ano R.55 bilione ke e e neng e ile ka ntlha ya ditiragalo tsa Go Goga Puso ka Nko.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kwezincomo zeKhomishini Ephenya Ngokuthunjwa Kwamandla Ombuso Impahla ebuyiswe nguPhiko Lukazwelonke Lwezokushushisa ibe yizigidigidi eziyi-R.2 kulesi sikhathi samanje se-MTEF kanti izigidigidi ezi-R.55 zayo le mpahla ihlobene nokuThunjwa Kwamandla Ombuso.

src: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go isa kwa Palamenteng dikarolo tse dintšhwa di le robedi mo go di le 14 tsa melao e e kwalolotsweng sešwa tse di nopotsweng gore di tsenngwe mo Leanong la rona la Dikgato tse di tla Diragadiwang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze laphinde lenekela iPhalamende izichibiyelo ezintsha zomthetho eziyisishiyagalombili kweziyishumi nane ezicashunwe ohlelweni lokuqaliswa kwezincomo.

src: Ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe tiro e tsweletse go dira bonnete jwa gore botlhe ba ba nnileng le seabe mo ditiragalong tsa go go goga puso ka nko ba rweswa maikarabelo.
tgt: Umsebenzi nawo uyaqhubeka wokuqinisekisa ukuthi labo abanesandla ekuthunjweni kwamandla ombuso bayaphendula.

src: Go Lwantshana le Bogodu, Bonweenwee le go Kgabaganya Melelwano go se mo Molaong.
tgt: Ukulwa nobugebengu, inkohlakalo kanye nokuthuthela kwelinye izwe ngokungemthetho IZibalo Zobugebengu Zekota zakamuva zibonisa ukuthi kufanele senze okukhulu njengomphakathi ukulwisana nesihlava sobugebengu.

src: Pegelo ya mo malobeng e e ka ga Dipalopalo tsa Dikgetse tsa Bosenyi tsa Kotara e Nngwe le e Nngwe di a bontsha gore re le setšhaba re tshwanetse go tiisa letsogo fa re lwantshana le bosenyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi licela bonke abantu ukuthi balwe futhi basebenze ngokubambisana ekwenzeni ukuthi amakhaya ethu, izindawo zethu zokusebenza kanye nezindawo zomphakathi ziphephile kuwona wonke umuntu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa mo go motho mongwe le mongwe gore re ipope ngatananngwe mo go lwantshaneng le bosenyi le go nna seoposengwe mo go direng gore malapa a rona, mafelo a re dirang kwa go ona mmogo le mafelo a boitapoloso jwa baagi gore e nne mafelo a a babalesegileng mo bathong botlhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela ukusatshalaliswa kohlelo oludidiyelwe lokulwa nobugebengu i-“Operation Shanela” kwezinye izifundazwe, kubandakanya eNyakatho Kapa, eMpumalanga Kapa naKwaZulu-Natali.

src: Kabinete e itumedisitswe gape le ke dikgato tsa go godisa letsholo la go lwantshana le bosenyi la “Operation Shanela” kwa diporofenseng tse dingwe, g akaretsa ya Kapa Bokone, Kapa Botlhaba mmogo le ya KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuphawulile ukuvunywa kwamacala kanye nokugwetshwa kwamadoda ayisithupha ayesolwa ngokubulala loyo owayeyingede ekulwisaneni nenkohlakalo, uNks.

src: Kabinete e sekegetse tsebe go ikatlhola ga banna ba le barataro ba ba latofadiwang ka go bolaya yo mongwe wa ba ba neng ba buletsa ditiragalo tsa bonweenwee, e bong Mme Babita Deokaran, ka Phatwe 2021.
tgt: Babita Deokaran, ngoNcwaba wezi-2021.

src: Kabinete e ikuetse gore ditheo tsa molao di tswelele go dira dipatlisiso go dira bonnete jwa gore bao ba logileng maano a polao eno ba di gama ba sa di tlhapela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi licele abezomthetho ukuthi baqhubeke baphenyisise futhi baqinisekise ukuthi ongqondongqondo baloku kubulala babhekana nomthetho.

src: Kabinete e akgotse dikgato tsa mo malobeng tsa go dika ditiragalo tsa bosenyi moo Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae e leng lona leo le neng le eteletse kwa pele letsholo leno mo go golegilweng baagi ba kwa nageng ya Pakistani ba le 67 bao ba neng ba leka go tsena ka fa nageng ka mokgwa o o seng mo molaong kwa Boemelafofaneng jwa Difofane tsa Boditšhabatšhaba jwa OR Tambo ka Latshipi wa la bo 13 Phatwe Samiti ya Ngwaga wa 2023 e e ka ga go Fetola Megopolo ya Batho ba Bong jo Botona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lishayele ihlombe indlela yokusebenza edidiyelwe yokulwa nobugebengu kamuva-nje eholele ekutheni uMnyango Wezasekhaya uvimbe abokubaduka e-Pakistan abangama-67 abebezama ukungena kuleli lizwe ngokungemthetho e-OR Tambo International Airport ngeSonto, mhla ziyi-13 kuNcwaba 2023.

src: Samiti ya Ngwaga wa 2023 e e ka ga go Fetola Megopolo ya Batho ba Bong jo Botona e e sa tswang go konosediwa e nnile le seabe se se tseneletseng mo bathong ba le 1 500 ba ba neng ba e tsenetse, mme dipuisano tse di tshwerweng di ne di rora jaaka ditau e bile le tshedimosetso e e tlhagileng mo go tsona e ne e le e e bulang matlho mme tseno maitlhomo e ne e le go fetola maitsholo le megopolo ya banna le basimanyana.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yokuguqula Ukucabanga Kwamadoda ephothulwe kamuva-nje ishiye uphawu olungacimeki kwizethameli eziyi-1 500, nebe nokuxoxisana okunamandla nokujulile okuphembe indlela yesidingo sezinguquko endleleni yokuziphatha yamadoda nabafana.

src: Jaaka e ne e tshwaretswe kwa Birchwood Hotel kwa tikwatikweng ya OR Tambo Conference Centre, samiti eno e ne e tsenetswe ke Ditlhogo, Batlatsatlhogo, Bagokgo le Baeteledipele ba Makgotlha a Dikhole tsa Katiso le Thuto ya Diatla le ya Setegeniki (di-TVET), Mekgatlho e e Emang Nokeng Baithuti mmogo le e e Eteletseng Baithuti Pele, Batlhankedikhuduthamagabagolo (di-CEO)ba Bothati jwa Lekala la Thuto le Katiso (di-SETA), ba ditheo tse di leng ka fa tlase ga Lefapha la Thuto e Kgolwane, Saense le Boitshimololedi, batlhankedi ba ba kwalang dipholisi, batswasetlhabelo ba ditiragalo tsa go bogisa basadi, bankane ba fatlhosanang, mmogo le batho bao ba dirang diphetogo, mme bano botlhe ba ipopile ngatana nngwe ka mosito o le esi e leng go samagana leditiragalo tsa go bogisa basadi mo Ditheo tsa Thuto tse di Latelang Konosetso ya Dithuto tsa Sekolo le kwa Ditheong tsa Katiso (PSET).
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ebibanjwe e-Birchwood Hotel and OR Tambo Conference Centre, ihlanganise amaPhini oShansela Bamanyuvesi, iziNhloko Zamanyuvesi, oThishanhloko kanye noSihlalo beMikhandlu yamaKolishi Okuqeqesha, Izinhlangano Ezeseka Abafundi kanye Nobuholi, Abaphathi Abakhulu bama-SETA, izinhlangano zoMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme, iSayensi Nokuqamba Kabusha, abenza izinqubomgomo, abasinde ku-GBV, ama-peer educator, kanye nabeza noguquko, bonke bahlangane ngazwi linye lokuzinikela ekulweni noDlame Olubhekiswe Kwabobulili Obuthile (i-GBV) ngaphakathi emkhakheni wezemfundo ephakeme i-Post-School Education and Training (i-PSET).

src: Samiti eno e ne e tshwerwe ke setheo sa HIGHER HEALTH mmogo le Lekgotla la Dipatlisiso tsa Saense le Batho (HSRC) mo legatong la Lefapha la Ditheo tse Dikgolwane tsa Thuto le Katiso mmogo le Lefapha la Saense le Boitshimololedi.
tgt: Ingqungquthela beyisingathwe yi-HIGHER HEALTH kanye noMkhandlu Wezocwaningo Lwesayensi Yabantu (i-HSRC) omele uMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqeshwa kanye noMnyango Wezesayensi Nokuqamba Kabusha.

src: Maitlhomo e ne e le go buisana le baeteledipele ba lephata leno, go buisana ka ga gore go ka fetolwa jang megopolo e e dirang gore re nne le ditiragalo tsa GBBopaki mmogo le tshedimosetso e e leng teng bobedi bo supa gore banna ke bona ba ba tlhotlhang GBV mme mo Samiting eno go ikuetswe gore go tsewe dikgato gore banna le basimanyana e nne karolo ya ditharabololo.
tgt: Inhloso yale ngqungquthela bekungukuxoxisana nobuholi, mayelana nokuguqula ukucabanga kanye nokubhekana nembangela engumnyombo we-GBUbufakazi nolwazi oluqoqiwe lubonisa ukuthi ukuziphatha kwamadoda yikona okuyimbangela ye-GBV kanti kule ngqungquthela kucelwe amadoda nabafana ukuthi babe yingxenye yesisombululo.

src: Kwa samiting go ikuetswe gore palo ya bankane ba ba fatlhosanang mmogo le bao ba nang le seabe mo mererong eno e okediwe mo dikhamphaseng tsotlhe, go nna batlisaphetogo mo go fetoleng Megopolo ya Batho ba Bong jo Botona, go oketsa palo ya dipuisano tse di nnang gone mo ditheong tsotlhe tsa thuto, go dira gore mo ditheong tsa thuto tsa PSET go nne le dirutwa tsa segapeletsa tsa go ithuta ka go tsholana ga batho ba bong jo bo farologaneng mmogo le ka GBV, dithuto tsa go lekalekana ga batho ba bong jo bo farologaneng, tsa pharologano ya batho ba bong jo bo farologaneng mmogo le go fetoleng Megopolo ya Batho ba Bong jo Botona.
tgt: Kule ngqungquthela kucelwe ukuthi kuthuthukiswe ama-peer educator nama-champions kuzona zonke izikhungo, abazosebenza njengama-change agents azosebenza ukuguqula indlela amadoda acabanga ngayo, kube nezinye izingxoxo zamadoda kuzona zonke izikhungo, kufakwe izifundo ezifundisa ngobulili kubandakanya ne-GBV, ukulingana kwezobulili, ukwahlukana ngobulili kanye nokuguqula ukucabanga kwamadoda njengezifundo ezizohambisana nohlelo lwezemfundo emkhakheni we-Post-School Education and Training (i-PSET).

src: Kabinete e amogetse tshedimosetso go e baya mo dinakong ka ga seemo sa motlakase ka fa nageng mmogo le go nopola dipegelo tse di ka ga maemo a a tsweletseng go tokafala mo go direng gore naga e nne le motlakase.
tgt: Ezikagesi IKhabhinethi litshelwe ngesimo sikagesi kuleli lizwe laphinde layibona imibiko emayelana nokwenza ngcono okuqhubekayo endimeni yokutholakala kukagesi.

src: Le fa tota matsatsi a le mmalwa a a fetileng re itemogetse maemo a a kwa godimo a bo 4 a motlakase o o tshabetseng ruri, fa e le ga jaanong maemo a tokafetse mo dikarolo tse dingwe tsa phetlho ya motlakase di buseditsweng tirong ya tsona, mme Eskom e tswelela go fokotsa ditiragalo tsa motlakase o tshabetseng ruri.
tgt: Yize izinsuku ezedlule ezimbalwa zibonise ukwenyuka kwamazinga okucinywa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga okufinyelele ezingeni leSine, isimo sibe ngcono ngokubuyiselwa kokusebenza kwamayunithi eziphehlimandla, kanti no-Eskom uyaqhubeka nokwehlisa amazinga okucinywa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga.

src: Kabinete e tsopoletswe gore go na le metse e e senang motlakase ka ntlha ya motlakase o o tshabetseng ruri le go timelwa motlakase.
tgt: IKhabhinethi litshelwe kafushane ukuthi kunemiphakathi engenawo ugesi ngenxa yokuhamba kukagesi okungekona ukuthi ucinywe ngenhloso yokuwonga.

src: Go timelwa motlakase gone go tlhodiwa ke go imelwa ga didirisiwa tsa tlamelo ya motlakase ka ntlha ya batho ba ba ikgogetseng motlakase go se mo molaong, go senyediwa le go utswediwa megala ya motlakase mo diteišeneng tse di potlana tsa motlakase le mabokoso a motlakase a a leng mo metseng, mmogo le go kgaolwa ga megala ya motlakase.
tgt: Lokhu kucima kukagesi kudalwa ukusindwa kukagesi ngenxa yokuxhunywa kukagesi ngokungemthetho, ukwebiwa nokucekelwa phansi kweziteshi kanye nama-transformer, kanye nokucekelwa phansi kwemigudu ethumela ugesi.

src: Baagi ba ba amegileng ke ba kwa Soweto, Thembisa, Kwa-Thema, Komane, Taung le kwa Ditsobotla.
tgt: Imiphakathi ethintekayo ibandakanya izingxenye ze-Soweto, izingxenye zeThembisa, KwaThema, eKomane, e-Taung nase-Ditsobotla.

src: Tona ya Merero ya Motlakase mmogo le Lefapha la Pusoselegae le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA) ba setse ba simolotse ka letsholo la go buisana le baagi gore ba utlwane ka seo se tla diriwang gore mafaratlhatlha a a sentsweng a ntshiwe mme go tsenngwe a mantšhwa mme go tshwanetswe go dumelwanwe gore ga go sa tlhole go tla nna le ditiragalo tsa go ikgogela motlakase go se mo molaong, baagi ba tla tshwanela go sirisana le ditheo tseno mo go tlhokomeleng mafaratlhatlha e bile ba tla tshwanela gape le ke gore ba reke motlakase.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezikagesi kanye noMnyango we-COGTA sebeqalile nohlelo lokuxoxisana nemiphakathi ethintekayo ukuze bezovumelana ngezinyathelo ezizolungisa ingqalasizinda emoshekile kodwa ezizohambisana nokuvinjelwa kokuxhunywa kukagesi ngokungemthetho, ukubambisana komphakathi ukuvikela ingqalasizinda kagesi, kanye nokukhokhelwa kwezinsizakalo zikagesi.

src: Tumelano ya naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya China, e e saenilweng mo malobanyaneng, e tla nna le seabe se se botlhokwa thata mo go nneng le mafaratlhatlha a motlakase a a kgonang go sonaga motlakase.
tgt: ISivumelwano seNingizimu Afrika nezinkampani zase-China, kulezi zivumelwano ezisayinwe kamuva-nje, sizodlala indima ebaluleke kakhulu ekwethulweni kwengqalasizinda kagesi ezokwazi ukulondolozeka.

src: Molaotlhomo wa Maatla a Dipuso tsa Diporofense wa Porofense ya Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wamandla Esifundazweni saseNtshonalanga Kapa.1 IKhabhinethi litshelwe kafushane ngoMthethosivivinywa ohlongozwayo Wamandla Esifundazweni saseNtshonalanga Kapa ongalandeli umthethosisekelo.

src: Kabinete e lomilwe tsebe ka ga Molaotlhomo wa Maatla a Dipuso tsa Diporofense wa Porofense ya Kapa Bophirima o o kwadilweng o o sa tsamaisaneng le Moaotheo wa naga.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Ohlongozwayo wephula ukuhlinzekwa kweShejuli yeSine neyeSihlanu yoMthethosisekelo obeke amandla nemisebenzi kubandakanya namandla akanyekanye esifundazwe nawabaphathi bakaZwelonke.

src: Molaotlhomo yono ga o sekegele tsebe Sekejule sa bo 4 le sa bo 5 sa Molaotheo e leng tsona dikarolo tse di tlhalosang gore ditheo dife di na le matla afe go fitlha kae mmogo le maatla a baeteledipele ba dipuso tsa diporofense le ba naga.. Kabinete e nopotse gore Molaotlhomo yono ke maiteko a go busetsa naga mo diatleng tsa mokgatlho wa dipolotiki wa bogologolo wa Democratic Party (e leng mokgatlho o mokgatlho wa dipolotiki wa Democratic Alliance o tsereng lefa leno mo go ona) mme teng go ne go busiwa naga eno ka mokgwa wa sefederale mme seno ke go nyatsa puso e e golaganeng e e tsenyeletsang botlhe ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuphawulile ukuthi lo Mthethosivivinywa ohlongozwayo ungumzamo wokubuyela emuva endleleni eyayithandwa yi-Democratic Party (iqembu elandulela i-Democratic Alliance) ehlose ukubukela phansi iNingizimu Afrika eBumbene nebandakanya wonke umuntu.4 Kuyaqapheleka ukuthi lo Mthethosivivinywa ohlongozwayo waseNtshonalanga Kapa ushaya indiva ukunqatshelwa ukufinyelela kwizinsizakalo zemiphakathi yabantu abamnyama emikhulu yaseKhayelitsha, eGugulethu, eNyanga, kwaLanga, e-Cape Flats, e-Delft, e-Central Line, phakathi kweminye.

src: Go botlhokwa go ela tlhoko gore Molaotlhomo ono wa puso ya porofense ya Kapa Bophirima o itlhokomolosa ka bomo maikarabelo a go akaretsa mo ditirelong tsa yona metse e megolo e go nnang bana ba mmala wa sebilo ya kwa Khayelitsha, Gugulethu, Nyanga, Langa, the Cape Flats, Delft, Central Line, gareng ga e mengwe e mentsi.5 Kabinete e romile Tona ya Bosiamisi le ya COGTA go atlhaatlha kgang eno le puso ya porofense ya Kapa Bophirima go rarabolola kgang eno go ya ka dikgato tse di matshwanedi tsa tharabololo ya dikgogakgogano jaaka di tlhagisiwa go ya ka karolo ya bo 146 ya Molaotheo mmogo le leano le le leng gone la go tsamaisa tiro magareng ga ditheo tsa puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze oNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa nowe-COGTA ukuthi bangene ezingxoxweni nohulumeni wesifundazwe saseNtshonalanga Kapa bakhulume ngezindlela ezifanele zokuza nesixazululo njengokusho kwesahluko se-146 soMthethosisekelo kanye nohlaka olufanele lwangaphakathi kuhulumeni.

src: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete Go Atolosiwa ga Paka ya go Thusa ka Matlole Beng ba Dithekesi.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi Ukwelulwa kwezinkokhelo zeSikhwama Sokusiza Osomatekisi IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukwelulwa kwesikhathi sezinkokhelo zeSikhwama Sokusiza Osomatekisi ngezinye izinyanga eziyi-12.

src: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go atolosiwa ga paka ya go thusa ka matlole beng ba dithekesi ka paka e nngwe ya dingwa di le Go atolosiwa ga paka eno go tla kgontsha Lefapha la Dipalangwa gore le neelwe nako e e tlhokagalang gore le kgone go thusana le matšhwititšhwiti a beng ba dithekisi ba ba iseng ba neelwe thuso ba ba tla tlamelwang ka matlole a go ba thusa.
tgt: Ukwelulwa kwesikhathi kuzonika uMnyango Wezokuthutha isikhathi esanele sokusiza abashayeli bamatekisi abaningi abangakayitholi imali yosizo.

src: Go fitlha mo pakeng e re leng mo go yona eno ke beng ba dithekesi ba le 88 580 ba ba setseng ba kgonne go bona thuso eno.
tgt: Kuze kube manje, bayizi-88 580 abashayeli bamatekisi asebesizakele.

src: Thuso eno e simolotse mo nakong ya fa re ne re le mo pakeng ya dikgatong tsa go sekega nakwana ditiro tsa ka fa nageng ka ntlha ya Bolwetse jwa Mogare wa Corona mme yona e ne e lebeletse go tswa thuso beng ba dithekesi tse dikgolo, tsa dijanaga le tsa e-hailing, mme madi ano a tswa go ya ka lenaneo la bopaki jo bo tshwanetseng go tlhagisiwa ke badiradikopo.
tgt: Isikhwama sasungulelwa ukusiza abashayeli bamatekisi, abama-cab kanye nabezimoto ezibizwa ngobuchwepheshe i-e-hailing abakhahlamezeka ngokwezimali ngesikhathi sokuvalwa thaqa kwezwe ngenxa yeSifo Segciwane i-Corona, ngokwemibandela ebekiwe.

src: Sekwalwa sa Bofelo sa Tetlelelo ya Tiragatso ya go Ntshetsapele Bojanala ka fa Nageng ya Aforika Borwa Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go phasalatsa Sekwalwa sa Bofelo sa Tetlelelo ya Tiragatso ya go Ntshetsapele Bojanala ka fa Nageng ya Aforika Borwa gore baagi ba ntshe se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga sona.
tgt: Uhlaka Lomthetho wokuThuthukisa Ezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koHlaka Lomthetho wokuThuthukisa Ezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika ukuze umphakathi uzophawula ngawo.

src: Maitlhomo a sekwalwa seno ke go tlhabolola le go ntshetsa pele lephata la bojanala ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa, mmogo le go samagana le dikgwetlho tse di dirang gore lephata la bojanala le retelelwe ke go gola.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo ihlose ukuthuthukisa nokugqugquzela ezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokubhekana nemigoqo ekhona ekukhuleni kwezokuvakasha.

src: Sekwalwa seno se tla ntshetsa pele gape le bojanala mo mafelong a metseselegae le a metsesekateropo ka go rotloetsa gore ditlhagisiwa tse di tswang kwa mafelong ano di babadiwe le go bewa mo pepeneneng.
tgt: Inqubomgomo izophinde igqugquzele ezokuvakasha ezindaweni zasemakhaya neziseduzane kwamadolobha ngokugqugquzela ukuboniswa nokubonakala kwemikhiqizo ephuma ezindaweni zasemakhaya.

src: Ditshitshinyo tsa pholisi eno le tsona, gare ga dilo tse dingwe tse dintsi, di samagana le merero ya go laola le go dirisana mmogo mo bojanaleng mo taolong ya pabalesego le phemelo mo phetolong ya botshwarateu mmogo le mo go rotloetseng tiriso ya didirisiwa tsa thekenoloji.
tgt: Iziphakamiso zenqubomgomo ziphinde zigxile ekuphathweni komkhakha wezokuvakasha nokusebenzisana ukuphepha kanye nokuvikeleka uguquko kanye nokwamukela ubuchwepheshe, phakathi kwezinye izinto.

src: Baagi ba neilwe sebaka sa matsatsi a le 90 go ntsha se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga sekwalwa seno.
tgt: Amalungu omphakathi anezinsuku ezingama-90 zokuphawula kule nqubomgomo.

src: Sekwalwa seno se ka fitlhelwa mo go: WEBTOKEPholisi ya Naga e e ka ga Metshameko ya mo Seraleng mmogo le Go Ja Leoto.1 Kabinete e neseditse pula Pholisi ya Naga e e ka ga Metshameko ya mo Seraleng mmogo le Go Ja Leoto.
tgt: UHlaka Lomthetho luyatholakala kwisizindalwazi esithi: WEBTOKEINqubomgomo kaZwelonke Kwezeshashalazi nokuDansa IKhabhinethi ligunyaze iNqubomgomo kaZwelonke Kwezeshashalazi nokuDansa.

src: Maitlhomo a pholisi eno ke go tumola ka moodi tlhokotekatekano le go se tshwarwe ka go tshwana ga baagi e leng selo se se sa bolong go agelelwa mo ditheong tsa rona se se gatang ka mosito o le mongwe le wa tlhaolele le go tswalela mejako ya go iphedisa mo ditheong tsa metshameko ya mo seraleng mmogo le ya ditheo tsa go ja leoto.2 Maitlhomo a pholisi ke go tlhoma ponelopele le dipholisi tse di ka diragadiwang, go loga maano, go tla ka dikgato tse di tla latelwang go tsenya tirisong maano ano mmogo le go tlhagisa dinako tse ka tsona go tshwanetsweng go bo go garetswe go dira gore lephata la metshameko ya mo seraleng mmogo le go ja leoto le tswelele go nna teng le go nna le matlhagatlhaga mo diporofenseng tsotlhe di le robongwe tsa naga, mo badiragatsi ba metshameko ya mo seraleng mmogo le ba go ja leoto ba kgone go ipela mo go emeleng naga ya rona mo kontinenteng le mo lefatsheng ka bophara.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo kuhloswe ngayo ukuxazulula ukungalingani kwakudala kwangaphakathi kanye nokungafani, okulandela izindlela zokufinyelela ngokobuhlanga nangokomnotho kwezeshashalazi nokudansa.2 Inqubomgomo ihlose ukubeka umbono nemithethonqubo, amaqhingasu, izindlela zokuqalisa ukusebenza kwemithetho kanye nezikhathi ezibekiwe okuzoholela emkhakheni wezeshashalazi nokudansa osimeme nonomndlandla kuzozonke izifundazwe eziyisishiyagalolunye, kanye nabadansi nabadlali beshashalazi baseNingizimu Afrika abazomela izwe ngokuzigqaja ezwenikazini nasemhlabeni jikelele.

src: Dipegelo tsa go Ela Tlhoko Maemo a Ditlhwatlhwa tsa Dijo tse di Botlhokwa.1 Khomišene e e Okameng Merero ya Dikgaisano tsa Dikgwebo e ntse e etse tlhoko maemo a ditlhwatlhwa tsa dijo tse di botlhokwa go latela gore go nne le ditiragalo tsa go tlhatlosa ditlhwatlhwa ka ditlhwatlhwa tse di kwa godimo e leng ditiragalo tse di simolotseng go iponagatsa fa go ne go nna le Ditiragalo tsa go Emisa Ditiro tsa ka ga Nageng ka Ntlha ya Masetlapelo ka Mopitlwe 20.2 Maitlhomo a go ela tlhoko ditlhwatlhwa tsa dijo ke ka ntlha ya gore ka fa nageng bareki ba dijo ba tshwanetse go kgona go reka dijo tse di botlhokwa tse di rekegang e bile ga di a tshwanela go tlhaela.3 Khomišene e etse tlhoko maemo a a tlhatlogang ka lebelo le le bofefo mo ditlhwatlhwa di tlhatlogetseng ruri ka bonako mme gantsi tlhwatlhwa e di tlhatlogang ka yona e feta eo ba e dirisang fa ba reka dilo tseo ba di rekisang e bile ditlhwatlhwa tse ba rekileng ka tsona fa di fokotsega tseo ba rekisang ka tsona di fokotsega ka bonya.
tgt: Imibiko Yokuqashwa Kwamanani Okudla.1 IKhomishini Yezokuncintisana ibilokhu ibeke iso amanani okudla kulandela izikhalazo zokwenyuka kwamanani okudla kusuka kwamenyezelwa iSimo seNhlekelele ngoNdasa wezi-2020.

src: E nopotse gape le go tlalatlala ga dijo mo mebarakeng e e rekisang gore le seno ke se sengwe sa dilo tse di nang le seabe mo go seo se diragalang.4 Kabinete e nopotse dikgato tse di tshitshintsweng ke Khomišene mme di tsenyeletsa le dipatlisiso tse di dirilweng mo dimarakeng tseno go samagana le mamo a dimaraka tseno a e leng ona a a dirang gore ditlhwatlhwa di ye kwa godimo mme go se nne le batho ba le bantsi ba ba gaisanang le mabentlele ano a a tlhatlosang ditlhwatlhwa ka ditlhwatlhwa tse di kwa godimo.5 Kabinete e dumetse gore Setlhopha sa Merero ya Ikonomi se tshwanetse go tsenya tirisong leano la go tseela ditlhwatlhwa tsa dijo dikgato, tsa go dira gore dijo di se tlhaele le gore go se nne le ope yo a palelwang ke go iponela dijo.
tgt: Ukuqhubeka nokubeka iso amanani okudla kugqugquzelwa ukuba khona kwesidingo sokuqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bayakwazi ukufinyelela ekudleni okungambi eqolo.

src: Go ThapiwaPele batho botlhe ba thapiwa go tla tlhatlhobiwa makwalo a bona a dithuto le ditlankana dingwe tse di tlhokagalang.
tgt: IKhomishini iyiqaphelile indlela ebizwa ngokuthi yi-‘rocket and feather’, lapho amanani akhuphuka ngokushesha njalo ngokwedlulele ezindlekweni bese kuthatha isikhathi ukuthi ehle uma izindleko zishona phansi.

src: Rre Brad Binder, yo a tswileng mo maemong a bobedi mo metshamekong ya mabelo a dijanaga a Austrian MotoGP.
tgt: Ntebaleng Rolland Setlako.10 Nks.

src: Setlhopha sa naga sa di-Springboks go bo se fentse motshameko wa rakabi kgatlhanong le setlhopha sa All Blacks mme re ba lakaletsa matlhogonolo mo metshamekong e e tlang ya Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Rakabi.
tgt: Marcia Xolisile Mkhari.11 Nks.

src: Kopanokakaretso ya Kokoano ya Dinagakopano (UNGA) Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke puo ya ga Moporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa kwa kopanong ya bo 78 ya UNGA e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa New York, kwa Amerika go tloga ka la bo 18 go fitlha ka la bo 26 Lwetse 2023.
tgt: UMhlangano Jikelele weZizwe Ezibumbene (i-UNGA) IKhabhinethi lamukele inkulumo kaMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa kwi-UNGA yama-78 ebibanjelwe e-New York, e-United States of America kusuka mhla we-18 kuya mhla wama-26 kuMandulo 2023.

src: Puo ya ga Moporesitente e e neseditsweng pula ke botlhe e totobaditse maemo a naga ya Aforika Borwa mo go nneng le seabe mo go direng gore kontinente ya Aforika mmogo le dinaga ka kakaretso tse di leng kwa Borwa jwa Lefatshe dikgatlhegelo tsa tsona le go nneng le seabe ga tsona go sekegelwe mosako mo diforamong tsa Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano (UN) mmogo le mo diforamong tse dingwe tsa dinaga tsa mafatshefatshe.
tgt: Inkulumo eyamukelwe kaMongameli iqinisekise ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ime kuphi ekwesekeni izimfuno, kanye nokuzibandakanya okulinganayo nokubonakalayo kwezwekazi i-Afrika kanye noMhlaba Oseningizimu jikelele kwi-UN nakwezinye izinkundla zamazwe ahlukahlukene.

src: Puo eno gape e totobaditse le kemo ya naga ya Aforika Borwa mabapi le go bokeletsa kemonokeng mo:
tgt: Le nkulumo iqinisekise ukuqina kweNingizimu Afrika ekugqugquzeleni ukwesekwa kwalokhu okulandelayo:

src: mererong e e ntšhwafaditsweng ya go ema nokeng bosetšhaba, mme seno se tla diriwa go ya ka melao e e tlhamaletseng e e engweng nokeng ke ditheo tse di mosola.
tgt: Ukuvuselelwa kokuzinikela ekusebenzisaneni kwamazwe ahlukahlukene, ngokulandela imithetho ecacile nokwesekwa kwezikhungo ezifanele.

src: go rulaganyeng sešwa Lekgotla la Tshireletso la Dinagakopano (UNSC), go dira gore le nne le bokao jo bo sa tshwaneng le jwa mo nakong e e fetileng fa go tla mo go lekalekaneng ga maatla a dipuso tse di ipusang gore UNSC e kgone go tsibogela ka tshwanelo dikgwetlho tsa ga jaana tsa dipolotiki tsa dikgaolo.
tgt: Ukuguqulwa koMkhandlu Wezokuvikeleka we-UN (i-UNSC), lokho okuzoholela ekulinganeni kwamazwe nokuzovumela i-UNSC ukuthi ixazulule ngendlela eyimpumelelo izinkinga ezikhona zepolitiki.

src: go direng gore dinaga tse khumo ya tsona e tswang ka dinala e oketse matlole a go thusa go tsenya tirisong Mogopolo wa ngwaga wa 2030 wa Dipeelo tsa Tlhabololo e e Nnelang Ruri gore go kgonwe go busetsa morago maemo a phetogo ya maemo a loapi ka mokgwa o o tshwaraganeng le o o utlwanetsweng, mmogo le botlhokwa jwa go tsenya tirisong Letlole la Ditatlhegelo le Ditshenyegelo go thusa dinaga tse di tlhokang tse di nang le ditshenyegelo tse dintsi tse di tlhodiwang ke phetogo ya maemo a loapi, go ya jaaka go dumelanwe mo kopanong ya bo 27 ya Khoferense ya Makoko e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Egepeto ka Ngwanaitseele 2022.
tgt: Amazwe acebile azokhuphula uxhaso ngokwezimali ukuze kuzoqaliswa ukusebenza kwe-Ajenda yowezi-2023 YeNtuthuko Esimeme kanye nokufeza izinjongo zokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu ngendlela ecacile nedidiyelwe, kubandakanya nesidingo sokuqalisa ngokuphuthuma ukusebenza kwesikhwama i-Loss and Damage Fund esizosiza amazwe abuthakathaka ashayeke kakhulu izinhlekelele ezidalwa isimo sezulu, njengoba kwavunyelwana kwiSeshini yama-27 yeNgqungquthela Yamaqembu eyayibanjwe e-Egypt ngoLwezi wezi-2022.

src: Moporesitente Ramaphosa o totobaditse maikano a naga ya Aforika Borwa go tswelela go samagana le phetogo ya maemo a loapi le go dira gore naga e digoge kwa pele mo mererong ya motlakase wa go fetlhiwa ka ditsela tse dintšhwa, leokwane la gase le le sa kgotlheleng tikologo mmogo le mo go direng gore re nne le diintaseteri tse di sa phutlhameng.
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa uqinisekise ukuzinikela kweNingizimu Afrika ekuqhubekeni nokubhekana nokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu nokuthi leli lizwe lizohamba phambili kwezamandla avuselelekayo, ihayidrojini enganukubezi imvelo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezimboni okusimeme.

src: Moporesitente Ramaphosa o atlhaatlhile gape le kgang ya go Atolosa Dikgato tsa go Thibela Maroborobo, ya Samiti ya go Ipaakanyetsa le go Samagana le ona, mo maemong a gagwe a Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU )jaaka a tseewa a Dirile Bontle mo go Samaganeng le Bolwetse jwa Mogare wa Leroborobo (COVID-19).
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa uphinde wakhuluma kwiNgqungquthela Yokugwema, Ukulungela kanye Nokubhekana neZifo Ezilubhubhane, ngokwesikhundla sakhe njenge-African Union Champion yeZindlela Zokubhekana Nesifo Segciwane i-Corona (i-COVID-19).

src: Letsholo la Naga ya Aforika Borwa la Dikopano tsa Tirisanommogo Magareng ga Dinaga ka Bobedi tse di Tshwaretsweng ka fa Letlhakoreng kwa Kopanong ya bo 78 ya UNGA Ka fa Letlhakoreng kwa Kopanong ya bo 78 ya UNGA, Moporesitente Ramaphosa o ne a eteletse kwa pele Letsholo la Naga ya Aforika Borwa la Dikopano tsa Tirisanommogo Magareng ga Dinaga ka Bobedi tseo maitlhomo a tsona e neng e le go gagamatsa tirisanommogo mo togong ya maano, dipolotiki, botipolomate le kgwebisano.
tgt: Uhlelo lwamazwe amabili lweNingizimu Afrika oluqhubeke ngesikhathi se-UNGA yama-78 Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka i-UNGA yama-78, uMongameli u-Ramaphosa uhole ithimba likahulumeni elibambe imihlangano eminingana yamazwe amabili inhloso yayo kungukuqinisa ubudlelwano ngokwamacebo, ngokwepolitiki, ubunxusa kanye nobudlelwano kwezokuhweba.

src: Moporesitente o ne a tshwara kopano le Moporesitente ka ene wa naga ya Ukrain, Volodymyr Zelensky, mo ba tšhotlhileng kgang ya gore Letsholo la Barongwa ba Kontinente ya Aforika go Buisanela Kagiso le Dinaga tse di leng mo Ntweng le tsamaya kae mo go tleng ka ditharabololo mmogo le go buisanela le dintlha tse dingwe.
tgt: UMongameli uhlangane nozakwabo wase-Ukraine u-Volodymyr Zelensky ukuze bazodingida ngenqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe ngezinyathelo zoMzamo Wokuletha Ukuthula nokubuyisa ukuzethemba kanye nokunye ukuthuthuka.

src: Moporesitente Ramaphosa o kopane gape le:2.
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa uphinde wahlangana nalaba abalandelayo:2.

src: Moporesitente Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wa naga ya Türkiye, mabapi le go gagamatsa tirisanommogo magareng ga naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Turkey, mmogo le go tsopolelana ka merero ya letsholo la go buisanela kagiso magareng ga naga ya Russia le ya Ukraine.
tgt: UMongameli u-Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wase-Türkiye, badingida ngokuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Turkey, nokudlana indlebe mayelana nemizamo yokuletha ukuthula kwingxabano phakathi kwe-Russia ne-Ukraine.

src: Moporesitente Bola Tinubu wa naga ya Federal Republic of Nigeria, mabapi le go gagamatsa tirisanommogo magareng ga naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Nigeria.
tgt: UMongameli u-Bola Tinubu wase-Federal Republic of Nigeria, badingida ngokuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Nigeria.

src: o ne gape a tsopolelwa tshedimosetso e e ka ga seo se setseng se dirilwe mo letsholong la Mererong ya Ikonomi le le eteletsweng kwa pele ke Dinaga tsa Bophirima jwa Aforika, mo go rarabololeng matsapa a menolopuso e e dirilweng kwa nageng ya Niger mmogo le dikgato tsotlhe tse go samaganweng natso mo go busetseng molao we temokerasi kwa karolong ya Sahel.
tgt: Uphinde watshelwa ngohlelo olubenzima loMnotho Wamazwe aseNtshonalanga ye-Afrika e-Nigeria kanye nemizamo yokubuyisa ukubusa ngentando yeningi e-Sahel.

src: Moporesitente Emmerson Mnangagwa wa naga ya Rephaboliki ya Zimbabwe, mabapi le maiteko a Zimbabwe mo go direng gore maemo kwa nageng a boele sekeng go latela gore naga eno mo malobeng e tshware ditlhopho tse di neng di sena merusu.
tgt: UMongameli u-Emmerson Mnangagwa waseRiphabhulikhi yase-Zimbabwe, lapho bedingide ngezinhlelo zikahulumeni wase-Zimbabwe zokuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kabusha kwaleliya lizwe emva kokhetho lwakamuva olube nokuthula.

src: Moporesitente Ramaphosa o ne gape a tsaya karolo le mo kopanong ya magareng ga naga ya Aforika Borwa le Amerika mabapi le Kgwebisano le Dipeeletso, mo go neng go le baeteledipele ba dikgwebo ba dinaga ka bobedi.
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa uphinde wabamba iqhaza eMhlanganweni Wezohwebo Notshalomali phakathi kwe-United States (i-US) kanye neNingizimu Afrika, obubandakanya abaholi bamabhizinisi baseNingizimu Afrika nabaseMelika.

src: Jaaka ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa go na le dikgwebo di feta di le 6 000 tsa Amerika, go ne go le botlhokwa gore dipuisano tseno di tshwarwe gore tirisanommogo ya dinaga tseno e kgone go tswelela go gagamala.
tgt: Njengoba kunezinkampani ezingaphezu kwama-600 zase-US ezisebenza lapha eNingizimu Afrika, le nguyazana ibibaluleke kakhulu ezingxoxweni eziqhubekayo zokuqinisa amaxhama phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-UNgesikhathi kuqhubeka le ngqungquthela, kumenyezelwe ngokusemthethweni ukuthi i-US-Sub-Saharan Africa Trade and Economic Cooperation Forum yama-20, (i-AGOA Forum) izobanjelwa eGoli kusuka mhla wesi-2 kuya mhla wesi-4 kuLwezi 2023.

src: Mo pakeng eno go ne ga ntshiwa tsiboso e e tlhamaletseng ya gore Kopano ya Kgato ya go Oketsa Ditšhono tsa go Godisa Ikonomi ya Aforika (AGOA) ya bo 20 e e ka ga Amerika le Dinaga tsa Borwa e tla tshwarelwa kwa Johannesburg go tloga ka la bo 2 go fitlha ka la bo 4 Ngwanaitseele 2023.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela izoba nombukiso obizwa nge-‘Made in Africa Exhibition’ ozobe ubukisa ngobuxhakaxhaka bemikhiqizo yezwekazi.

src: Mo foramong eno go tla tlhagisiwa gape le 'Dipontsho tsa Dilo tse di Dirilweng ka fa Kontinenteng ya Aforika' mme tsona di tla bontsha ka fao kgaolo ya kontinente e nang le dilo tse di botlhokwa mo ikonoming.
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa uphinde wazizwela ngokusebenzisana phakathi kwe-Novo Nordisk ne-Aspen.

src: Moporesitente Ramaphos gape o ne a le teng ga go diriwa kitsiso ya gore setlamo sa Novo Nordisk le sa Aspen di tla dirisana mmogo.
tgt: Lokhu kusebenzisana kuzoholela ekukhiqizweni kwekhambi lokwelapha ushukela i-insulin ezikhungweni zase-Aspen eGqeberha, eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Tirisanommogo eno e tla dira gore go tlhagisiwe melemo ya go lwantshana le bolwetse jwa tshukiri e feta dimilione di le 16 mo ngwageng wa 2024, mme palo eno e tla tlhatlosiwa gape mo ngwageng wa 2026.
tgt: Lokhu kusebenzisana kuhloswe ngakho ukuthumela imithamo engaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-16 ze-insulin ngowezi-2024, okuzokwengezwa ngowezi-2026.

src: Seno se tla oketsa tota palo ya melemo eno gore e kgone go lekana balwetse ba ba e tlhokang e seng fela ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa mme gape le go ralala le kontinente ka bophara.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwenza ngcono ukuthi ukwelashwa nge-insulin kutholakale hhayi kuphela eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa kulolonke izwekazi.

src: Motlakase.
tgt: Ezamandla.

src: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke dikgato tsa Setheo sa Naga ya Aforika Borwa sa Taolo ya Merero ya Motlakase tsa go neela Setlamo sa Naga ya Aforika Borwa sa go Reka Motlakase tetla ya go reka le go rekisa motlakase, mme seno se bulela setlamo seno dikgoro tsa go ka reka motlakase go tswa kwa dinageng tsotlhe tsa kgaolo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele ukuthi i-National Energy Regulator of South Africa igunyaze ukuhweba kanye nezicelo zemvume yokuthumela nokwamukela impahla kwamanye amazwe kwe-National Transmission Company of South Africa, lokho okuzophemba indlela yokuthengwa kukagesi esifundeni jikelele.

src: Go busediwa tirong ga Yuniti ya Bone ya Seteišene sa Motlakase sa Kusile, e e neng e baakanngwa, go busetsa tirong motlakase o o kana ka dimekawate di le 800 mo diyuniting tsa tlamelo ya motlakase.
tgt: Ukusebenza futhi kwe-Unit 4 esiteshini sikagesi i-Kusile Power Station emva kokulungiswa obekuhleliwe kubuyise ugesi ongama-800 megawatts kwisizinda sikagesi.

src: Kgato eno e botlhokwa thata mo go tokafatseng maemo a tlhagisong ya motlakase mo diyuniting tsa ka fa nageng tsa tlamelo ya motlakase mmogo le mo go samaganeng le ditiragalo tsa motlakase o o tshabetseng ruri.
tgt: Lo msebenzi ubaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni umthamo wokuphehlwa kukagesi kwisizinda sikagesi sikazwelonke kanye nokubhekana namazinga okucinywa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga.

src: Kabinete e tsopoletswe gape le ka dikgato tse di setseng di dirilwe mo go busetseng tirong pele ga nako yuniti ya bo 1, 2 le ya bo 3 tsa Seteišene sa Motlakase sa Kusile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde latshelwa kafushane ngenqubekelaphambili yokulungisa ama-Unit 1, 2 no-3 e-Kusile Power Station ngaphambi kwesikhathi ebesibekiwe.

src: Kabinete e itumeletse gape le maemo a Eskom e a reboletsweng ke Setlamo sa Ditirelo tsa Dipeeletso sa Moody, mme ona a tla thusa go tlhatswa leina la setlamo seno mo mererong ya go adimiwa madi mmogo le go se kgontsha gore se kgone go ipaakanya sentle mo nakong e e tlang pele se ka diragatsa dikgato tsa go baakanya le go tsosolosa mafaratlhatlha a sona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele imiphumela yokuhlolwa kozinzo lwe-Eskom okwenziwe yi-Moody’s Investors Service, okuzokwenza ngcono ukusebenza kweziphehlimandla zikagesi futhi kuvumele ukuthi kuhlelwe kusenesikhathi ukunakekelwa kweziphehlimandla.

src: Go se Felelwe ke Metsi.
tgt: Ukutholakala kwamanzi.

src: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka dikgato tse di tserweng go leka go rarabolola dikgwetlho tsa metsi tse di amang mafelo a le mantsinyana ka fa nageng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi litshelwe kafushane ngemizamo yokubhekana nezinselele zamanzi ezithinta izindawo eziningana ezweni lonkana.

src: Tona ya Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe, Rre Senzo Mchunu mmogo le Dimeyara tsa tse dingwe tsa diteropo tse dikgolo kwa Gauteng ba tla ema baagi ka lefoko go ba itsise gore ke eng se se diriwang go samagana le tlamelo ya metsi a a tshabetseng ruri mo porofenseng eno.
tgt: Senzo Mchunu kanye nezimeya zamanye amadolobhakazi ase-Gauteng bazokhipha imibiko yokwazisa ngezingenelelo eziqhubekayo zokuletha uzinzo ekuthunyelweni kwamanzi esifundazweni.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo go botlhe go gakologelwa gore naga ya Aforika Borwa ke e nngwe ya dinaga tse di senang metsi go le kalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lifisa ukukhumbuza wonke umuntu ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe elintula amanzi.

src: MaAforika Borwa mmogo le botlhe ba ba leng ka fa nageng ba tshwanetse go somarela metsi le go se a dirise botlhaswa.
tgt: Bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika nawowonke umuntu okuleli lizwe kufanele bonge futhi basebenzise amanzi ngokuwonga.

src: Merero ya Kgwebisano.
tgt: Ezohwebo.

src: Kopano ya Dintlo tsa Barongwa ba Dinaga (BNC) mmogo le Setlhopha sa Ditona tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Lesotho.
tgt: IKhomishini Yamazwe Amabili okuyiNingizimu Afrika ne-Lesotho (i-BNC) kanye noMhlangano WoNgqongqoshe I-BNC yeNingizimu Afrika ne-Lesotho kanye noMhlangano Wongqongqoshe obubanjwe mhla zingama-25 kuya mhla zingama-28 kuMandulo 2023 ugxile ekusebenzeni ngokubambisana kwezomnotho, izinkinga zokweqa imingcele, kanye nokuhamba ngokukhululeka kwabantu, impahla kanye nezinsizakalo phakathi kwala mazwe amabili.

src: Kopano ya Dintlo tsa Barongwa ba Dinaga (BNC) mmogo le Setlhopha sa Ditona tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Lesotho e tshwerwe go tloga ka la bo 25 go fitlha ka la bo 28 Lwetse 2023 e tsepamisitse mogopolo mo go dirisaneng mmogo mo mererong ya ikonomi, ya go kgabaganya melelwane, mmogo le mo go letleleleng baagi le dithoto go kgabaganya melelwane ya dinaga ka bobedi ntle le tshitiso epe.
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa kanye noNdunankulu u-Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane bazobambisana ngokuba ngosihlalo kwiSeshini Yokuqala ye-BNC phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Lesotho ngoLwesine, mhla wama-28 kuMandulo 2023.

src: Moporesitente Ramaphosa mmogo le Tonakgolo ya naga ya Lesotho e bong Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane e tla nna badulasetilo mo kopanong e e ka ga Dintlo tsa Barongwa ba Dinaga tsa Aforika Borwa le Lesotho ka Labone wa la bo 28 Lwetse 2023.
tgt: Kule BNC kuzodingidwa ngobudlelwano bamanxusa, ezokuzivikela nokuvikeleka, amanzi, ezokuthutha, ugesi kanye nezohwebo.

src: Mo kopanong eno go tla tšhotlhiwa merero e e ka ga tirisanommogo magareng ga dinaga, ditirelo tsa sesole le tsa pabalesego, metsi, dipalangwa, motlakase le kgwebisano.
tgt: Inkundla Yezobuchwepheshe Exazulula Izinkinga Zezimakethe.

src: Dipatlisiso tse di ka ga go Tsenya Letsogo mo Diraleng tsa go Rekisa mo Inthaneteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithole umbiko obuya kwiKhomishini Yezokuncintisana omayelana nokutholakele kanye nezinyathelo zokulungisa iNkundla Yezobuchwepheshe Exazulula Izinkinga Zezimakethe.

src: Kabinete e rometswe pegelo go tswa kwa go Khomišene e e Okameng Merero ya Dikgaisano tsa Dikgwebo e e ka ga tseo e di ribolotseng mmogo le ditharabololo tsa tsona mo Dipatlisisong tse di ka ga go Tsenya Letsogo mo Diraleng tsa go Rekisa mo Inthaneteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lincome umsebenzi wekhomishini ekubhekaneni nezikhalazo zokuba nomthengisi oyedwa ezinkundleni zedijithali, kubandakanya i-ecommerce, ama-ejensi ezokuvakasha, ukuhanjiswa kokudla, ama-app store, abezikhangiso kanye nezinjini zokubheka okuthile ngobuchwepheshe.

src: Kabinete e rolela hutshe tiro e e dirilweng ke khomišene eno mo go samaganeng le matsapa a go paralela dikgwebo tsotlhe ga dikgwebo tse dingwe mo diraleng tseno, go akatsetsa le dirala tse di supetsang bareki koo ba ka rekang gone, dirala tse di rekisang ditlhagisiwa, dirala tsa inthanete tse di rekisang mareu ka go rulaganyetsa bao ba tsayang maeto dithulaganyo tsa dinamelwa tse ba tla di dirisang, dirala tse di tlisetsang bareki dijo ba le kwa ba leng gone, dirala tse di rekisang diepe, dirala tse di rekisang ditirelo tse di itlhophileng mmogo le dirala tsa go batla dilo mo inthaneteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyalele oNgqongqoshe beminyango kahulumeni efanele ukuthi baqhubeke balandele izincomo ukwenza ngcono isimo, babheke imithelela yenqubomgomo baphinde balandele izinguquko ezifanele zenqubomgomo ezizobhekelela ukubandakanyeka kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye namabhizinisi amancane nasafufusa ekukhuleni kwamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe.

src: Mokgotlhwane wa Dikgogo.
tgt: Umkhuhlane wezinyoni.

src: Kabinete e tsibositswe ka Malwetse a a Tshelanang a Mokgotlhwane wa Dikgogo (HPAI) H5 le H7 a a aparetseng leruo la dikgogo ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuqaphele ukuthi kunokuqubuka okukhona komkhuhlane obanga isifo (i-HPAI) H5 ne-H7 embonini yezinkukhu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Porofense ya Kapa Bophirima mmogo le ya KwaZulu-Natal di wetswe ke bolwetse jwa HPAI H5 fa HPAI H7 yona e begilwe kwa diporofenseng tsa Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga le Bokone Bophirima.
tgt: INtshonalanga Kapa neKwaZulu-Natali babhekane nokuqubuka kwe-HPAI H5 kanti i-HPAI H7 kubikwe ukuthi ihlasele esifundazweni sase-Gauteng, e-Limpopo, eMpumalanga naseNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Go setse go tsentswe dikgato tirisong go ka samagana le go thibela go anama ga malwetse ano mme barui ba rotloediwa gore ba obamele dikgato tsa go thibela malwetse ano.
tgt: Izinyathelo zokunqanda nokulawula ukubhebhetheka komkhuhlane zime ngomumo futhi nabalimi bayagqugquzelwa ukuthi balandele izindlela zokuvikeleka abanikezwe zona.

src: Bolwetse jono bo dira gore go nne le tlhaelo ya dijo le dikgwebo di retelelwa ke go rekisetsa dinaga tse dingwe mae a go thuthusa ditsuane, mae a go jewa le dinama tsa kgogo go tswa ka fa nageng.
tgt: Lo mkhuhlane ufaka engcupheni ukutholakala kokudla kanti kungahle kuthathwe izinyathelo zokuhweba ezifana nokuthola ukudla kwamanye amazwe ukuze kuzolawuleka ukutholakala kwamaqanda avundile, amaqanda alungele ukudliwa kanye nenyama yenkukhu.

src: Lefapha la Temothuo, Pusetsomafatshe le Tlhabololo ya Metsemagae, Setheo sa Taolo ya Melemo ya Boitekanelo ya Aforika Borwa mmogo le intaseteri eno ba samagane le dithulaganyo tsa go dira kopo ya go kwadisa meento e e ka dirisiwang mo bolwetseng jono, mme merero ya go obamela melao ya pabalesego, kalafo le boleng ke tsona dikarolo tse di botlhokwa mo go kwadiseng meento eno.
tgt: UMnyango Wezolimo, Ukuguqulwa Komhlaba Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya, iZiphathimandla Ezilawula Imikhiqizo Yezempilo eNingizimu Afrika kanye nemboni yonkana bahlolisisa izicelo zokubhaliswa kwemigomo engasetshenziswa, ngokulandela izinyathelo ezihambiselana nokuphepha, ukusebenza kahle kanye nobukhethelo ukuthi kube yikho okubekwe phambili uma kubhaliswa le migomo.

src: Go Tshwaraganela go Lwantshana le Bosenyi Kabinete e neseditse pula tshedimosetso ya go e baya mo dinakong e e ka ga dikgato tsa go lwantshana le bosenyi, e Tona ya Mapodisi, Bheki Cele, a neelaneng ka yona mo setšhabeng mmogo le Setlhopha sa Maphata a a Farologaneng a Naga a go Lwantshana le Bosenyi.
tgt: Uhlelo oludidiyelwe lokulwa nobugebengu IKhabhinethi lamukele umbiko wakamuva omayelana nokulwisana nobugebengu, ophinde wethulelwa isizwe nguNgqongqoshe Wamaphoyisa, uJenene Bheki Cele, kanye ne-National Joint Operational and Intelligence Structure.

src: Letsholo la go lwantshana le bosenyi le le tshwaraganetsweng ke ditheo tse di farologaneng tsa molao kwa porofenseng ya Kapa Bokone le le samaganeng le bogodu jwa dirašwa tsa meepo le kgonne go ka tshwara batho ba le 867, mme bontsi jwa bona bo tswa kwa nageng ya Lesotho, Zimbabwe, Mozambique mmogo le ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Umkhankaso omikhakhaminingi wokulwisana nokumba izimayini ngokungemthetho kanye nokuthuthela kwamanye amazwe ngokungemthetho eNyakatho Kapa kuholele ekuboshweni kwabantu abangama-867, abaningi okungabase-Lesotho, e-Zimbabwe, e-Mozambique kanye nabanye abangalapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa mafoko a ditheo tsa molao gore maAforika Borwa a a fitlhang ditlhokotsebe tse di amegang mo bogodung jwa dirašwa tsa meepo ba tla di gama ba sa di tlhapela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligcizelele umbono wama-ejensi aqinisekisa ukugcinwa komthetho ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abafuye izinswelaboya ezibandakanyeka ekumbeni izimayini ngokungemthetho bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Dipula tse di Bogale.
tgt: Isimo sezulu esibi.

src: Maemo a a bogale a dipula ka fa nageng a bontsha gore re mo dinakong tsa phetogo ya maemo a loapi mmogo le gore go tlhokagala gore go tsewe dikgato tsa go fedisa kgotlhelo ya loapi mo ditirong tsa ikonomi ntle le go kgaotsa tlhabololo e e tsepameng.
tgt: Isimo sezulu esibi siqinisekisa umphumela wokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu ezimpilweni zethu kanye nesidingo sokuthatha isinyathelo sokuguqukela kumnotho wekhabhoni ephansi ngesikhathi silwela ukuzinza kwentuthuko.

src: Kabinete e beewa mo dinakong ka dipula le merwalela e e gogotseng mafelo kwa porofenseng ya Kapa Botlhaba, Kapa Bophirima le Gauteng, mme go na le kgonagalo ya gore ditshenyegelo tseno di tla aparela le diporofense tse dingwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi laziswe ngokukhahlamezeka okudalwe izivunguvungu nezikhukhula ezimbi eMpumalanga Kapa, eNtshonalanga Kapa nase-Gauteng, nokunezinkomba zokuthi zingahle zidlulele kwezinye izifundazwe.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging go ntsha matlho dinameng fa go na le melaetsa e e ka ga dipula tse di bogale, tse di ka senyetsang pele ka fa nageng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi licela yonke imiphakathi ukuthi ihlale iqaphe ngeso lokhozi kwezinye izexwayiso zesimo sezulu esibi, esingaletha okunye ukukhahlamezeka ezweni lonkana.

src: Puso e tswelela go ema nokeng ditirelo tsa tshoganyetso mmogo le ditikwatikwe tsa taolo ya masetlapelo gore di kgone go thusa ba ba leng mo tlalelong mmogo le go tswa baagi thuso ka ditlamelwana tse ba di tlhokang.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokweseka abezimo eziphuthumayo kanye nezikhungo ezilawula inhlekelele ukuthi basebenze ngokuphepha kanye nokunikeza usizo kubantu.

src: Winnie Mandela Avenue Kabinete e neseditse pula kgato ya go fetola leina la mmila wa William Nicol Drive kwa teropong ya Sandton go o neela leina la Winnie Mandela Avenue jaaka e tsaya seno e le kgato e kgolo mo hisetoring ya naga ya Aforika Borwa ka go dira gore bao ba nnileng le seabe se se botlhokwa mo kgaratlhelong ya kgololesego maina a bona a tlhagelele ka magetla.
tgt: Umgwaqo u-Winnie Mandela Avenue IKhabhinethi likuphawulile ukushintshwa komgwaqo u-William Nicol Drive e-Sandton waba ngu-Winnie Mandela Avenue njengesinyathelo esibalulekile sokubhala kabusha umlando waseNingizimu Afrika nozoqhayisa ngegalelo lalabo abalwela inkululeko yethu.

src: Moletlo ono o diragetse ka nako e le esi le nako eo e ka bong go ketekiwa letsatsi la matsalo la ga Winnie Madikizela-Mandela mo a ka bong a ne a keteka dingwaga di le 87 ka la bo 26 Lwetse 2023 fa a ne a ka bo a tshela.
tgt: Lo mcimbi uhambisane nosuku lokuzalwa luka-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela lapho ebezobe egubha iminyaka yokuzalwa engama-87 mhla wama-26 kuMandulo 2023.

src: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete Leano le le Kwalolotsweng Sešwa la Naga ya Aforika Borwa la Nama ya Diphologolo tsa Naga Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa gore go tsenngwe tirisong Leano le le Kwalolotsweng Sešwa la Naga ya Aforika Borwa la Nama ya Diphologolo tsa Naga, mme maitlhomo a lona ke go dira gore intaseteri ya nama ya diphologolo tsa naga e tsenngwe tirisong semmuso mmogo le go fetola intaseteri eno.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi IQhingasu Elibuyekeziwe Lenyama Yenyamazane leNingizimu Afrika IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukuqaliswa kweQhingasu Elibuyekeziwe Lenyama Yenyamazane leNingizimu Afrika, okuhloswe ngalo ukusebenza ngokulandela imithetho kanye nokuguqula imboni yenyama yenyamazane.

src: Maitlhomo a leano leno ke go gagamatsa intaseteri ya nama ya diphologolo tsa naga gore le yona e nne le seabe mo go direng gore go se nne le tlhaelo ya dijo mmogo le mo go godiseng ikonomi gore le yona e tlhole ditiro.
tgt: Leli qhingasu kuhloswe ngalo ukuqinisa umkhakha wenyama yenyamazane njengabahlinzeki bokudla kanye nomkhakha okhulisa umnotho futhi ongaba nesandla ekusungulweni kwemisebenzi.

src: Aforika Borwa ke yona e e di gogang kwa pele ka fa kontinenteng ya Aforika fa go tla mo nameng ya diphologolo tsa naga.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ibalwa njengephuma phambili ezwenikazini i-Afrika ngokukhiqiza inyama yenyamazane.

src: Leano leno le ikaeletse go tlhola ditiro di ka nna 202 666 tse di tla nnelang ruri mo lephateng la intaseteri ya nama ya diphologolo tsa naga mo ngwageng wa 2030.
tgt: Iqhingasu leli lihlose ukuqinisekisa ukusungulwa kwemisebenzi esimeme eyizi-202 666 embonini yenyama yenyamazane uma kushaya unyaka wezi-2030.

src: Leano leno le tla phasaladiwa mo webesaeteng ya Lefapheng la Merero ya Dikgwa, Botshwaro jwa Ditlhapi le ya Tikologo mo go: WEBTOKELeanokonokono la Kgwebo ya Bojanala Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go bapisa Leano la go Tsosolosa Lekala la Bojanala le Leanokonokono la Kgwebo ya Bojanala.
tgt: Leli qhingasu lizoshicilelwa kwisizindalwazi soMnyango Wezamahlathi, Ukudoba Nemvelo ku: WEBTOKEUHlelo Olukhulu Lomkhakha Wezokuvakasha IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukuhanjelaniswa koHlelo Lokuvuselela Umkhakha Wezokuvakasha kanye noHlelo Olukhulu Lomkhakha Wezokuvakasha olusha.

src: Karolo e e botlhokwa ya leanokonokono leno ke go samagana le ditlamorago tsa leroborobo la COVID-19 mo lephateng la bojanala.
tgt: Ingxenye ebalulekile yoHlelo Olukhulu ngukuqeda nya ngemithelela yobhubhane lwe-COVID-19 emkhakheni wezokuvakasha.

src: Le thusa gape le gore naga e itharabologelwe ka botlalo mo lephateng la bojanala.
tgt: Luphinde luhlinzeke ngomhlahlandlela wokuvuselelwa kwezokuvakasha kuleli lizwe.

src: Fela jaaka maitlhomo a Leano la go Tsosolosa Lekala la Bojanala le ne le logetswe go thusa go tsosolosa lekala leno, go somarela ditiro le ditsela tse batho ba iphedisang ka tsona, Leanokonokono leno le logetswe go tsweletsa pele tiro ya leano leno ka go dira gore go nne le ditšhono tse dintšhwa mo lekaleng leno.
tgt: Ngesikhathi uHlelo Lokuvuselelwa Komkhakha Wezokuvakasha lwasungulelwa ukuqapha ukuvuselelwa kwalo mkhakha, ukugcinwa kwemisebenzi kanye nokuvikela indlela yabantu yokuziphilisa, uHlelo Olukhulu Lwezokuvakasha lona luzothatha lo msebenzi uluse kwelinye izinga futhi uqaphe amathuba amasha kulo mkhakha.

src: Leano leno le tshitshinya dikgato di le supa go thusa go busetsa lekala la bojanala mo maemong a le neng le le mo go ona mo motsing yoo botshelo bo neng bo itobetsa, mme le dira gore lekala leno le nne botlhokwa mo go tlholeng ditiro le mo go itshimololeleng dikgwebo.
tgt: Uhlelo lolu luhlongoza amaqhinga ayisikhombisa okungenelela ukuze kuzoqinisekiswa ukuthi umkhakha wezokuvakasha ubuyela kuleziya zikhathi ezinhle, nokuthi uba ngummongo wokusungulwa kwemisebenzi nokuvulwa kwamabhizinisi amasha.

src: Intaseteri ya bojanala e na le seabe se se botlhokwa thata mo ikonoming, mme pele ga leroborobo la COVID-19 e ne e eme nokeng ditiro di le 725 000.
tgt: Imboni yezokuvakasha inegalelo elibalulekile emnothweni kanti isize ngemisebenzi eyizi-725 000 ngaphambi kokuhlasela kobhubhane lwe-COVID-19.

src: Melaotlhomo.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywa.

src: Molaotlhomo wa Lekgotlakgaso la Aforika Borwa (SABC) wa Ngwaga wa 2023.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa weNkampani Yezokusakaza eNingizimu Afrika (i-SABC) wangowezi-2023.

src: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go isa kwa Palamenteng Molaotlhomo wa SABC wa 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukulethwa koMthethosivivinywa we-SABC wezi- ePhalamende.

src: Fa molaotlhomo ono o sena go fetisiwa go ka nna molao wa semmuso, o tla tsena mo legatong la molao wa ga jaana o o bidiwang Molao wa Kgaso wa ngwaga wa 1999 (Molao wa bo 4 wa 1999).
tgt: Uma usuphasisiwe waba ngumthetho, uMthethosivivinywa uzochitha uMthetho Wezokusakaza, wangowe-1999 (Umthetho wesi-4 we-1999) okhona njengamanje.

src: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa di tla dira gore ditiro tsa setheo sa kgaso di nne tse di manontlhotlho.
tgt: Izichibiyelo zizoqinisa ukusebenza kahle kwendlela yokusebenza yabasakazi bomphakathi.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o dira gape le ditshitshinyo mo mererong e e ka ga tlamelo ya SABC ka matlole mmogo le mo go ya dithulaganyo tsa dilaensense tsa thelebišene.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uphinde uhlongoze izinguquko kwindlela yokuxhasa ngezimali i-SABC kanye nendlela yokukhishwa kwamalayisensi e-TUMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Osahlongozwa Wezinsizakalo Zamanzi IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela ukuze umphakathi uzophawula ngawo.

src: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Ditirelo tsa Metsi Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Ditirelo tsa Metsi gore baagi ba ntshe se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga ona.
tgt: Izinhlosonqangi zalo Mthethosivivinywa ngukuqinisa ukuphendula kwabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zamanzi kanye nokwethula uhlelo lokusebenzela obala kungafihlwa lutho.

src: Maitlhomomagolo a Molaotlhomo ono ke go gagamatsa dikgato tsa go nna le maikarabelo ga batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa metsi mmogo le go dira gore mo lephateng leno go se nne mahunelo.
tgt: Izichibiyelo zoMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zamanzi, we-1997 (Umthetho we-108 we-1997) zizoqinisekisa ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zamanzi bathumela amanzi asemgangathweni ophezulu ngokuya ngemibandela yamalayisensi abo.

src: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa mo Molaong wa Ditirelo tsa Metsi wa ngwaga wa 1997 (Molao wa bo 108 wa 1997) di tla dira bonnete jwa gore batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa metsi ba abelane ka metsi a maemo a ona a leng boleng jo bo kwa godimo jaaka seno e tla nna karolo ya ditlhokwa tse di beewang mo tumelanong ya go ba neela dilaesense.
tgt: Izichibiyelo zizophinde zibhekana nezinkinga ezibonakale kumkhakha wezinsizakalo zamanzi.

src: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa tseno di tla thusa gape le go tswalela makoa a a nopotsweng mo lekaleng la ditirelo tsa metsi.
tgt: Umthethosivivinywa ubeke ubuncane bezindinganiso zabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zamanzi, okufanele iziphathimandla zeZinsizakalo Zamanzi ziqinisekise ukuthi ziyalandelwa.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o tlhoma maemo a batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa metsi ba tshwanetsweng go itepatepanya nao, mme tiro ya go netefatsa gore go itepatepanngwa nao e rwele ke magetla a Setheo sa Ditirelo tsa Metsi.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Osahlongozwa Wezamanzi Kuzwelonke.

src: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Metsi a Naga Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Metsi a Naga gore baagi ba ntshe se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela osahlongozwa Wezamanzi Kuzwelonke ukuze umphakathi uzophawula ngawo.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o kwalola sešwa Molao wa Metsi a Naga wa ngwaga wa 1998 (Molao wa bo 36 wa 1998).
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Kazwelonke Wezamanzi, we-1998 (Umthetho wama-36 we-1998).

src: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa di tla thusa go tokafatsa melawanataolo ya metsi mmogo le go dira bonnete jwa gore metsi a naga a tlhokomelwa ka tshwanelo, a sirelediwa mmogo le go somarelwa.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zizothuthukisa imithethonqubo futhi zizoqinisekisa ukuthi imithombo yamanzi kuleli lizwe iphethwe kahle, ivikelekile futhi iyalondolozwa.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o dira ditshitshinyo tsa gore go fedisiwe go tlhoka tekatekano go go tlhodilweng ke ditiragalo tsa mo nakong e e fetileng tse di ka ga kabelo ya metsi, mme o tshitshinya gore go nne le dikgato tse di matlhagatlhaga tsa go rarabolola ka bonako dikgogakgogano tse di nnang teng magareng ga ditheo tse di dirisanang mmogo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uzophinde wenze iziphakamiso zokuqeda nya ukungalingani esikhathini esidlule okuhlobene nokuphakelwa kwamanzi, uphinde uhlinzeke ngezindlela ezisebenzayo nezisheshayo zokuxazulula izingxabano zangaphakathi.

src: Go Thapiwa Pele batho botlhe ba thapiwa go tla tlhatlhobiwa makwalo a bona a dithuto le ditlankana dingwe tse di tlhokagalang.
tgt: Abaqashiwe Bonke abaqashiwe kufanele kuqinisekiswe iziqu zabo zemfundo kanye nokuhlolwa okufanele.

src: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwa Monongwaga Kgwedi ya go Keteka Dipalangwa e tla ketekiwa ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Re a Aga - Re aga mafaratlhatlha a a botoka thata gore Aforika Borwa e kgone go gola”.
tgt: INyanga Yezokuthutha Kulo nyaka iNyanga Yezokuthutha izogujwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Siyakha – Sakha ingqalasizinda engcono ezokhulisa iNingizimu Afrika”.

src: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwa ya ngwaga wa 2023 e tla tsepamisa mogopolo mo dipeeletsong tse dikgolo mo lephateng la mafaratlhatlha a dipalangwa, mmogo le mo go direng boikuelo jwa gore mafaratlhatlha a dipalangwa a tlhokomelwe gore a se utswiwe le go phutlhamisiwa.
tgt: INyanga Yezokuthutha ngowezi-2023 izogxila kutshalomali olukhulu kwingqalasizinda yezokuthutha, kanye nekhwelo lokuthatha igxathu lokuvikela ingqalasizinda yezokuthutha ukuthi ingebiwa futhi ingacekelwa phansi.

src: Letsatsi la go Keteka Tiro ya Barutabana Naga ya Aforika Borwa e tla keteka mmogo le lefatshe ka bophara Letsatsi la go Keteka Tiro ya Barutabana ka Labone wa la bo 05 Diphalane 2023 ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Barutabana ba re ba tlhokang go tlisa thuto e re e batlang: dikgato tse di botlhokwa tsa lefatshe ka bophara tsa go dira gore barutabana ba se tlhaele”.Maitlhomo a letsatsi leno ke go lemosa setšhaba, go dira gore se tlhaloganye le go lemoga botlhokwa jo barutabana ba nang le bona mo thutong le mo go tliseng tlhabologo lefatshe ka bophara.
tgt: Usuku Lomhlaba Lothisha INingizimu Afrika izohlanganyela nomhlaba wonke ekukhumbuleni uSuku Lomhlaba Lothisha ngoLwesine, mhla wesi-5 kuMfumfu 2023, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Othisha esibadingela imfundo esiyifunayo: Ukubaluleka komhlaba ukuthi uvale igebe lokuntuleka kothisha”.

src: Letsatsi leno le utlawnetswe mmogo ke Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Badiri mmogo le Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano o o ka ga Merero ya Thuto, Saense le Ditso go keteka tiro e e botlhokwa e barutabana ba rona ba e dirang.
tgt: Lolu suku kuhloswe ngalo ukuqwashisa, ukuqondisisa kanye nokubonga igalelo elibaluleke kakhulu elifakwa ngothisha kwezemfundo kanye nentuthuko emhlabeni jikelele.

src: Melaetsa ya go AkgolaKabinete e romela melaetsa ya yona ya go akgola le go eletsa masego kwa go: Rre Bheki Cele, Tona ya Mapodisi, yo a abetsweng Metale wa Tlotlo wa Great Wall go tswa kwa nageng ya China mabapi le go nneng le seabe ga gagwe mo Tirelong ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) mo go dirisaneng le ditheong ka bontsi tsa molao tse di dirisanang le dinaga ka bobedi.
tgt: Lolu suku luphinde lwamenyezelwa ngokuhlanganyela yiNhlangano Yabasebenzi Yamazwe Ngamazwe kanye neNhlangano Yezizwe Ezibumbene Yezemfundo, Isayensi Namasiko njengendlela yokubungaza umsebenzi obaluleke kakhulu owenziwa ngothisha.

src: Mme Angie Motshekga, Tona ya Thuto ya Motheo, jaaka a tlhophilwe ke Mokwaledikakaretso wa UN Rre Antonio Guterres, gore a nne yo mongwe wa baeletsi ba gagwe ba bagolo mo Setlhopheng sa Merero e e kwa Godimo mo Lefatsheng ba ba mo eletsang ka fao dinaga di ka fetolang ka gone dithulaganyo tsa tsona tsa thuto.
tgt: UkuhalalisaIKhabhinethi lihalalisela futhi lifisela okuhle laba abalandelayo: UJenene Bheki Cele, uNgqongqoshe Wamaphoyisa, oklonyeliswe nge-Great Wall Commemorative Medal ephuma e-People’s Republic of China ngegalelo loPhiko Lwamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika lokusebenzisana ekuqinisekiseni ukuthotshelwa komthetho phakathi kwala mazwe womabili.

src: Go tlhophiwa ga Tona Motshekga mo Setlhopheng sa Merero e e kwa Godimo mo Lefatsheng go supa kitso e e tseneletseng e a nang le yona mo thutong e bile seno ke sesopu sa go bontsha tshepo mo dikgatong tsa thuto tse Aforika Borwa e di WEBTOKEN setlhopheng seno go na le baemedi go tswa kwa Mokgatlhong wa Lefatshe wa Badiri, Setlhopha sa Barutabana sa Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano o o ka ga Merero ya Thuto, Saense le Ditso, Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Badiri mmogo le Ditona di le tharo tsa Thuto.
tgt: Angie Motshekga, uNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo, ngokukhethwa nguNobhala-Jikelele we-UN, uMnu.

src: Disetudio tsa kwa Motse Kapa tsa Metshameko ya Difilimi, batshameko ba ka fa nageng mmogo le bao ba diragatsang ditiro tse di masisi mo legatong la batshameki, jaaka ba dirile bontle mo Metshamekong ya ditshwatsho tsa Netflix, mo setshwantsho sa One Piece, se tlhatlogetseng kwa maemong a ntlha a a kwa godimo a setshwantsho se se bogelwang ga jaana ke batho ba bantsi mo diraleng tse di gasang ditshwantsho tse di bogelwang.
tgt: Antonio Guterres, ukuthi abe yingxenye ye-Global High-Level Panel okuyithimba elizomeluleka ngokuthi amazwe angaziguqula kanjani izindlela-kusebenza kwezemfundo.

src: Setlamo sa go titiela dinotagi sa Van Ryn's, jaaka kwa moletlong wa ngwaga wa 2023 wa dikgaisana tsa dinotagi o o neng o tshwaretswe kwa London, se abetswe terofi ya maemo a a kwa godimo ka ntlha ya bojalwa jwa bona jo bo bogale jwa porenti e e titieletsweng sebaka sa dingwaga di le 12 ka fa nkgong.
tgt: Ukukhethwa kukaNgqongqoshe u-Motshekga kuleli thimba eliphezulu kubonisa ukungcitha-buchopho bakhe emkhakheni wezemfundo futhi kubonisa ukuthi indlela yezemfundo eNingizimu Afrika ithenjiwe.

src: Melaetsa ya Matshediso Kabinete e romela matshediso a yona kwa ba lelapa le ditsala tsa: Rre Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), yo e neng e le molwelakgololesego kgatlhanong le puso ya tlhaolele yo gape e nnileng ene Motlatsatona wa ntlha mo pusong ya temokerasi ya Aforika Borwa go ka tsorama maemo ano mo Lefapheng la Merero ya Tirisanommogo le Dinaga tsa Boditšhaba go simolola ka ngwaga wa 1994 go fitlha ka 2008.Lieutenant Commander Gillian Elizabeth Hector, Master Warrant Officer William Masela Mathipa, mmogo le Warrant Officer Class One Mmokwapa Lucas Mojela, ba ba tlhokafetseng ba le mo letsholong la tiro fa ba ne ba le ka fa teng ga sekepe se se thumelang ka fa gare ga mpa ya lewatle se se bediwang, SAS Manthatisi, kwa ntle ga lefelo la Kommetjie kwa lewatleng la porofense ya Kapa Bophirima.
tgt: Ithimba liqukathe abamele iNhlangano Yabasebenzi Yamazwe Ngamazwe, iThimba Lothisha beNhlangano ye-UN Yezemfundo, Isayensi Namasiko, Izinyonyana Zothisha Zomhlaba kanye noNgqongqoshe bezemfundo abathathu.

src: Merero ya ga Jaanong Bagale ba Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Rakabi ya Ngwaga wa 2023 Kabinete e akgotse setlhopha sa di-Springbok jaaka se fentse Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Rakabi ya Ngwaga wa 2023 mme phenyo eno e dirile gore Aforika Borwa e nne yona naga e le esi mo lefatsheng go ka fenya makgetlo a le mane Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Rakabi mme e bile gape setlhopha seno se fentse sejana seno ka tlhomagano makgetlo a le mabedi.
tgt: OShampeni Bomhlaba Bebhola Lombhoxo ngowezi-2023 IKhabhinethi lihalalisele iqembu lama-Springboks ekunqobeni kwalo iNdebe Yomhlaba Yebhola Lombhoxo ngowezi-2023 nokwenze ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibe ilona kuphela lizwe elinqobe iNdebe Yomhlaba yebhola Lombhoxo izikhawu ezine (4) kanye nelesibili ukunqoba izikhawu zilandelana.

src: Fa e sale go nna le rakabi mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa setlhopha seno sa di-Springbok ke sona sa ntlha se se emetsweng ke batshameki ba merafe e e farologaneng ya naga ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Emlandweni webhola lombhoxo eNingizimu Afrika, leli qembu lama-Springboks liyiqembu elahlukehlukene kakhulu uma ubheka ukwahlukana kwemvelaphi yabantu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Gore setlhopha seno se rulaganngwe ka mokgwa o se leng ka ona ga se ka ntlha ya lesego, ke ka ntlha ya ditshweetso tse di totobetseng tse balaodi le bakatisi ba di tsereng ba butse matlho mo ba neng ba batla gore di-Springbok di emelwe ke setlhopha sa merafe e e farologaneng.
tgt: Ukudidiyelwa kwaleli qembu elahlukahlukene kanje akuzenzekelanga, kodwa kube ngumsebenzi wabaphathi nabaqeqeshi bama-Springboks wokukhetha iqembu elingacwasi muntu.

src: Tshweetso e e nonofileng e e tserweng ke mokatisi wa mo malobeng Rassie Erasmus mmogo le setlhopha se se neng se mo eme nokeng e tswelela go iponagatsa mo go maAforika Borwa le mo lefatsheng ka bophara gore motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo a nang le bokgoni, fa a ka neelwa tšhono le go enngwa nokeng, a ka kgona go ntsha ga tshwene – mme seno ke bontlha bongwe jo bo totobatsang boammaruri jwa gore Re le Ngatananngwe ga go se se ka re Tsenang fa Gare.
tgt: Isinqumo esiphusile esathathwa ngumqeqeshi wangaleso sikhathi u-Rassie Erasmus nethimba lakhe siyaqhubeka ukubonisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika nomhlaba wonke, ukuthi wonke umuntu onekhono, uma enikezwa ithuba nokwesekwa, angenza ezibukwayo – okuyisiqinisekiso sokuthi Sinamandla uma Sibambisene.

src: Se se botlhokwa go gaisa ke ka fao batshameki ba di-Springbok ba neng ba kakatletse ka teng mo lebaleng fa ba ne ba tshameka e leng sesupo sa go nna moAforika Borwa tota, e leng sona se se dirang gore naga eno ya baganka e atlege le go finyelela le fa e tobane le dikgwetlho tsa dinta di fuduga.
tgt: Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukuphikelela nokuzimisela kwama-Springboks enkundleni yezemidlalo kubonise ukufana nse nokuba ngumuntu waseNingizimu Afrika, lokho okwenza lesi sizwe esikhulukazi sibhekane nazo zonke izingqinamba kanye nobunzima ukuze sizonqoba.

src: Ba bangwe ba batshameki ba ba dirileng bontle mo setlhopheng seno sa di-Springbok ba ne ba itshokela dikgwetlho mo matshelong a bona gore ba kgone go atlega.
tgt: Abanye babadlali abaphuma phambili eqenjini lama-Springboks bebebhekene nobunzima ezimpilweni zabo endleleni yabo eya ekunqobeni.

src: Kabinete e akgotse Siyamtanda “Siya” Kolisi, mokapotene wa setlhopha sa di-Springbok sa go fenya gabedi ka tatelano Sejana sa Lefatshe jaaka a eteletse kwa pele setlhopha seno gore se kgone go fenya maemo a a iseng a tle a bonwe mme ka ntlha ya seno re tshwanetse go se kgaotse go keteka tiro e ntle eno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisele uSiyamtanda “Siya” Kolisi, ongukaputeni wama-Springboks onqobe kabili iNdebe Yomhlaba ngokuhola iqembu lafinyelela ezingeni esilibiza nge-Greatest of All Time (GOAT) kanti imigubho kufanele iqhubeke.

src: Kopano ya AGOA Kabinete e neseditse pula mafoko a puso ya Amerika mmogo le a palamente ya yona a go totobatsa gore ba ikemiseditse go oketsa nako ya go nna mo tirisong ga Molao wa Kgato ya go Oketsa Ditšhono tsa go Godisa Ikonomi ya Aforika (AGOA), mme seno se tla digela matswalo a bao ba batlang go ka beeletsa mo dinageng tse di nang le matshwanedi a go unngwelwa ke AGOKabinete e neseditse pula gape le go neelwa tetla ya go tshwara Kopano ya AGOA ya 2023 kwa Johannesburg go tloga ka la bo 2 go fitlha ka la bo 4 Ngwanaitseele 2023 mme e tla tsenelwa ke bannaleseabe go tswa kwa dinageng di le 32 tsa Aforika mo maphateng a puso, kgwebo, mme lekgetlho la ntlha fa e sale go tla bo go na le mekgatlho ya baagi le mekgatlho ya badiri mmogo le batlhankedi ba puso ya naga ya Amerika.
tgt: IForamu ye-AGOA IKhabhinethi lamukele isiqinisekiso esenziwe ubuholi baseMelika kanye nenhlangano ngezinhloso zokwelula i-AGOA, nokuqinisekisa abatshalizimali emazweni afanelekile e-AGOIKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela ukusingathwa kweForamu ye-AGOA yezi-2023 eGoli kusuka mhla wesi-2 kuya mhla wesi-4 kuLwezi 2023 ebe nezethameli ezisuka emazweni ase-Afrika angama-32, umkhakha wezamabhizinisi, umphakathi kanye nomkhakha wezabasebenzi okokuqala ngqa kanye nabamele uhulumeni waseMelika.

src: Kabinete ga e a bolo go ema ka lefoko le le reng AGOA e naya Amerika tšhono ya go ka ema ka dintsetsenkwano go thusa ikonomi ya Aforika mme ka jalo go matshwanedi gore e okelediwe nako gore e nne mo tirisong sebaka se se utlwagalang, mme e atlaatlhiwe gore e kgone go nna le seabe se se utlwagalang mmogo le go ngokela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi belihlezi njalo liqinisekisa ukuthi i-AGOA ihlinzeka ngethuba lokuthi iMelika iqinise ubudlelwano bayo bezomnotho ne-Afrika ngakho-ke kufanele yelulwe isikhathi esibonakalayo, iphinde yenziwe ngcono ibe negalelo futhi ihehe.

src: Kopano ya Ditona tsa Bojanala mo Dinageng tsa BRICS Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go garela ka katlego Kopano ya Ngwaga wa 2023 ya Ditona tsa Bojanala mo Dinageng tsa BRICS e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Motsekapa, mme kopano eno e lopile dinaga tse e leng leloko go oketsa tirisanommogo ya tsona ka go rotloetsa go jelana nala ga batho ba dinaga tsa BRICS, go aga mebila gore go etelana le go golagana ga dinaga tse e leng leloko e nne selo se se botlhofo.
tgt: UMhlangano woNgqongqoshe Bezokuvakasha be-BRICIKhabhinethi lamukele ukuphothulwa ngempumelelo koMhlangano woNgqongqoshe be-BRICS wangowezi-2023 obubanjwe eKapa, nalapho amazwe angamalungu ezinikele ekusebenzeni ngokubambisana kanye nokugqugquzela ezokuvakasha ngaphakathi kumazwe angamalungu e-BRICS, ukusungula imigudu ezohambeka kalula kwezokuvakasha kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu.

src: Seno se tla gagamatsa lephata la bojanala la naga ya Aforika Borwa jaaka le setse le ntse le itharabologelwa.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuqinise umkhakha wezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika nosuvele ubonisa izimpawu zokuvuka.

src: Mo dikgweding di le robedi tsa ntlha tsa ngwaga wa 2023, re bone ka fa nageng go goroga bajanala ba le dimilione di le tlhano le halofo mme palo eno e lekana le koketsego ya bokana ka diphesente di le 63.4% go tloga mo go tsa yona paka eno mo ngwageng wa 2022.
tgt: Ezinyangeni eziyisishiyagalombili zokuqala kowezi-2023, izwe lamukela izivakashi ezingenayo eziyizigidi eziyisi-5.5 nokuchaza ukuthi izinga lezivakashi lenyuke ngama-63.4% kusuka esikhathini esifanayo ngowezi-2022.
